We have been receiving reports of a lack of equipment and staff from the police forces in Estord. With the escalating violence in the city, the officers have been working 12-hour-shifts to suppress the protests to no avail.

The Police Commissioner of Estord has requested reinforcements and extra supplies of tear gas from nearby cities.

name: Turn02_FolceDator_Accident
title: Rifle Production Halted In Folce Dator After Accident
description: A machine at the Folce Dator rifle plant has experienced a malfunction, stalling weapons production for the next week. The cause is being looked into, but the plant manager indicates that due to the ongoing labor shortage, fewer workers have been overseeing production at the plant, leading to more potential for human error.

name: Turn02_Holsord_BFFActivity
title: Reports of BFF Activity in the Capital
description:
The Chief of Police, Karl Greiser, reports that two Bludish women with affiliations to the Bludish Freedom Front (BFF) have been caught in Holsord before they could execute a terror attack at a crowded rally. Both women are listed as wanted criminals and enemies of the state.

The arrested women have admitted their intentions to attack the National Front Party’s rally at Soll Square when Kesaro Kibener gave his speech but rejected any connections to the BFF. Both claimed that they were acting alone.

Police reports that the situation is under control and further investigations are underway.

name: Turn02_Holsord_EPARepealStarts
title: Repeal Proposal for the Energy Protection Act of 1932
description:
The Grand National Assembly of Sordland gathered yesterday for a significant session, where a proposal from Frens Ricter of the People's Freedom and Justice Party  and supported by the independent MP Mansoun Leke was put forth to repeal the Energy Protection Act of 1932. This act, as it currently stands, restricts foreign ownership of security-sensitive energy corporations to 20%. 

The proposal to repeal or modify this law has been a topic of debate in the Assembly, with proponents arguing for an open market approach, and opponents advocating for the protection of Sordland's critical industries from foreign influence. If the repeal successfully garners the requisite majority in the Assembly, it will then head to the Maroon Palace for final approval.

name: Turn02_Holsord_GNAGreenBill
title: Grand National Assembly's Green Bill in Holsord
description: The Grand National Assembly is preparing the Green Bill, with a focus on promoting sustainable industry practices, particularly in Gruni. Section I of the Act proposes stricter regulations on industrial pollution and waste disposal. It suggests hefty fines for non-compliance, with the collected revenue to be reinvested in environmental recovery projects.

name: Turn02_Holsord_KesaroDemandsEmergency
title: Kesaro Kibener Demands Emergency to be Called
description: The leader of NFP, Kesaro Kibener, has demanded an emergency be called to address the increasing political violence in the country. He stated that without a declaration of emergency, Sordland would be destabilised and the integrity of the country would be damaged even further.

name: Turn02_Holsord_L1_SSC
title: L-1 Construction Plans Started by SSC
description: Sordish State Corporation has reported that preparatory work for the L-1 railway has already started, including clearing land and transporting equipment. Construction of the railway will be starting in the next months from Holsord.

name: Turn02_Holsord_L1_Taurus
title: L-1 Construction Plans Started by Taurus
description: Taurus Holding has reported that preparatory work for the L-1 railway has already started, including clearing land and transporting equipment. Construction of the railway will be starting in the next months from Holsord.

name: Turn02_Holsord_L1_Underhall
title: L-1 Construction Plans Started by Underhall
description: Underhall Construction has reported that preparatory work for the L-1 railway has already started, including clearing land and transporting equipment. Construction of the railway will be starting in the next months from Holsord.

name: Turn02_Jen_WeaponsSeized
title: Weapons Seized in Cultural Center
description:
Local police forces report that a wardrobe full of heavy military equipment has been seized in a Young Sords cultural center in Jen. Regulars of the place denied having any knowledge about the weapons. The owners of the building have been detained along with 13 other people.

The police captured 22 rifles and 2 machine guns. The equipment belonged to the Sordish Armed Forces, dated 1929, but kept in very good condition.

name: Turn02_Lachaven_CPSLUSPicketLine
title: CPS and LUS Picket Line
description: The Communist Party of Sordland  and the Labor Union of Sordland have set up a picket line in the city. The two organizations, after recently moving to the Gasom HQ in the city, are actively expressing their discontent. The situation is attracting attention, with the impact on the city's daily functioning yet to be determined. The response of the local administration to this development is being keenly observed.

name: Turn02_Lachaven_H3_SSC
title: H-3 Construction Plans Started by SSC
description: The Sordish State Corporation has reported that preparatory work for the H-3 highway has already started, including clearing land and demolishing buildings in the path of the future roadway. Construction of the highway will be starting in the next months, working west from Lachaven.

name: Turn02_Lachaven_H3_Taurus
title: H-3 Construction Plans Started by Taurus
description: Taurus Holding has reported that preparatory work for the H-3 highway has already started, including clearing land and demolishing buildings in the path of the future roadway. Construction of the highway will be starting in the next months, working west from Lachaven.

name: Turn02_Lachaven_H3_Underhall
title: H-3 Construction Plans Started by Underhall
description: Underhall Construction has reported that preparatory work for the H-3 highway has already started, including clearing land and demolishing buildings in the path of the future roadway. Construction of the highway will be starting in the next months, working west from Lachaven.

name: Turn02_Lenkurg_DuruBoatEncounter
title: Incident At President Soll's Mansion on Duru Island
description: A private boat nearing Tarquin Soll's mansion on Duru Island prompted the coast guard to fire warning shots. Despite the initial alarm, former President Tarquin Soll allowed the boat to approach for a brief conversation. The occurrence has raised questions about the security protocols near the obscure mansion. Details of the conversation remain undisclosed.

name: Turn02_Lespia_Decision_BanMalenyevistPropaganda_DontBan
title: PM Alvarez Warns Not To Underestimate Malenyevism
description: Lespia’s Prime Minister Patricio Alvarez has issued a strong warning following increasing Malenyevist activity in the region. While not naming Rizia by name, the PM said that “certain countries are blind to the dangers of Malenyevism and its propaganda – dangerous ideas like these should not be allowed to spread.”

name: Turn02_MITZ_Decision_SaveArufeldeOrg_Donation
title: Save The Arufelde Coalition Receives Substantial Donations
description: After requesting donations from all MITZ stakeholders to further their campaign against the pollution of the Arufelde river, the coalition reported substantial gifts from Valgsland, Morella and Rizia, with only Lespia refusing to donate to the cause. The coalition expressed its gratitude to the countries that donated, as well as to individual smaller donors.

name: Turn02_MITZ_Decision_SaveArufeldeOrg_NoDonation
title: Save The Arufelde Coalition Thanks Socialist Countries For Donations
description: After requesting donations from all MITZ stakeholders to further their campaign against the pollution of the Arufelde river, the coalition reported substantial gifts from Valgsland and Morella, with Lespia and Rizia refusing to donate to the cause. The coalition expressed its gratitude to the socialist countries that donated, as well as to individual smaller donors.

name: Turn02_Monqiz_PortQueues
title: Monqiz Port Reports Ship Logjam
description: Nearly 30 container ships were caught in a logjam by the Port of Monqiz yesterday, many of them transporting goods to Rumburg's Port Grim. Officials say this highlights the need to upgrade the facilities for faster docking and processing.

name: Turn02_Montaklar_LeisureClubShutDown
title: Alca Springs Leisure Club Closed Amid Homosexual Revelations
description: Police in Montaklar conducted a raid of the so-called "health retreat" Alca Springs Leisure Club following a tip-off that the bathing facility was in fact a gathering place for the local homosexual community. During their unscheduled visit, several same-sex couples were indeed found to be engaging in illegal activity. They were promptly arrested, and the leisure club shut down.

name: Turn02_Morbel_NaturePreservation
title: Nature Preservation Protest
description: The Nature Preservation Foundation is protesting against the remaining coal industry, a significant contributor to Sordish energy. The group is voicing concerns about the environmental impact of the industry. The protest is gaining momentum and drawing attention to the need for sustainable energy alternatives. The future of coal industry operations in Morbel is uncertain.

name: Turn02_Morella_Decision_Arufelde_CondemnsInaction
title: Save The Arufelde Condemns Rizia's Continued Inaction
description:
The organization Save the Arufelde has issued an official statement condemning Rizia’s continued failure to address industrial contamination of the Arufelde River, citing “decades of unchecked wastewater dumping” by Rizian Royal Gold. 

Morella’s environmental coalition criticized Rizia for repeatedly refusing to contribute to cleanup efforts and failing to implement adequate safeguards in the Meftiem International Trade Zone. “The Arufelde runs through us all,” they stated, “and so does the responsibility.”

name: Turn02_Morella_SendsCondolencesCircas
title: Morella Expresses Condolences for Circas
description: In the wake of Bernard Circas' untimely passing, Prime Minister Alma Saltana of Morella conveyed heartfelt condolences to the people of Sordland. The leader recognized Circas as an influential poet and advocate for Malenyevist ideas, lamenting his loss as a blow to the literary and political world. She called for the memorialization of Circas' contribution to social discourse and reaffirmed Morella's commitment to the ideals he espoused.

name: Turn02_Narbel_PoliceUnderstaffed
title: Police Understaffed
description:
Narbel has reported that it is currently too understaffed to deal with the ongoing political violence. Due to the small size of the police force in the city, they have been working non-stop and a number of officers were sent to the hospital as a result of severe fatigue.

Minister of the Interior Lileas Graf has been working with Head of Police Karl Greiser to address the issue.

name: Turn02_Narbel_SituationReport
title: Situation Report
description:
The Ministry of Defense reports that the situation along the border is under control. Rumburg’s southern army was sighted training close to our borders, but soon retreated after we issued a radio message.

The Chief of the Armed Forces, General Kruger, reports to have increased patrolling duties along the northern border to signal readiness.

name: Turn02_Narbel_TenseSituationReport
title: Situation Report
description:
The Ministry of Defense reports that the situation along the border is getting tense. Rumburg’s southern army was sighted training close to our borders, and did not respond after we issued a radio message.

The Chief of the Armed Forces, General Kruger, reports to have increased patrolling duties along the northern border to signal readiness.

name: Turn02_Nelvisar_Decision_NelvisarFieldShutsDown_OilWorkerCommemoration
title: Oil Workers Commemorate Closing Field
description: Oil workers in Nelvisar organized a commemoration for the closing field, marked with a parade of the workers through the town and a large gala held in their honor. While some will keep their jobs for the foreseeable future as operations wind down, many are now unemployed and have to look elsewhere for employment.

name: Turn02_Nelvisar_NelvisarShutsDown
title: Nelvisar Oil Field Ends Production
description: The Nelvisar oil field in Cardesse-Montaklar has ceased operations following the depletion of its reserves. Experts advise prioritizing the kingdom’s natural gas resources to address the resulting energy gap. Authorities are now planning energy distribution to maintain economic activity.

name: Turn02_Pales_RaisesCautionOfRizia
title: Pales Issues Warning Over Rizian Actions
description:
In a formal address, Grand Duke Axel Reinhart of Pales issued a cautionary statement regarding recent Rizian activities. The Grand Duke expressed increasing concern over the intensifying border disputes and clashes over territorial waters and gas fields. Asserting Pales' sovereignty, he called for respect for international laws and peaceful dialogue to prevent further escalation. 

He urged the Alliance of Nations to mediate the situation, emphasizing the potential risks these tensions could pose to regional stability.

name: Turn02_PorteDrazon_HousingCrisis
title: Officials Warn of Potential Housing Crisis
description: Urban planning officials have warned us of a lack of affordable housing for residents of Porte Drazon. They cite a lack of rent controls for landlords as well as a shortage of available apartments for unhoused and low-income citizens as major problems. Officials also warned that if the situation continues to deteriorate, it might spread to other major cities.

name: Turn02_PorteDrazon_SordishVisitPrep
title: Sordish Delegation To Visit Porte Drazon
description: Sordish President Ewald Alphonso will be arriving in Porte Drazon on Monday; in lieu of the Vice President, he will be accompanied by his development minister Gus Manger. As this is Sordland's first visit to Rizia in many years, a morning of diplomatic ceremonies at Palas Rezna has been planned, followed by talks in the afternoon and a banquet in the evening.

name: Turn02_Ribery_IllegalFirearms
title: Illegal Firearms Found in Communist Party Office
description: The Bergian Security Forces raided the local Communist Party office after alleged attacks organized by one of their members and found illegal firearms in the office. The building has been closed and 22 members of the Communist Party of Sordland have been detained.

name: Turn02_Rumburg_CondemnsClosure
title: Rumburg Condemns Closure
description: Queen of Rumburg, Beatrice Livingston has released a statement this morning to publicly condemn the closure of Sordland's consulate in Dome. Thornbourgh has also accused Sordland of increasing tensions in the region.

name: Turn02_Sallabes_AntiNarcotics_Alliance
title: Sallabes Anti-Narcotics Alliance Established
description: Countess Leona Sazon has launched a new initiative to combat the rise of drug use in Sallabes. The Sallabes Anti-Narcotics Alliance (SANA) seeks to address public health and safety concerns through a combination of rehabilitation programs and stricter enforcement measures. Local officials and stakeholders are expected to collaborate in implementing these efforts to curb drug-related issues in the city.

name: Turn02_Terador_AzaroMilitaryExercise
title: Azaros Rebuked for Conducting Military Exercise Close to Terador Border
description: The Governor of Terador has issued a stern rebuke to the Azaros of Cardesse-Montaklar after their provincial military conducted exercises near the Pales Administrative District. Labeling the drills as unnecessarily provocative, the Governor called for restraint and dialogue to address any inter-provincial tensions. The statement emphasized the importance of peaceful coexistence and cooperation within the Kingdom of Rizia.

name: Turn02_Topes_ExcavationPromisesTourism
title: Excavation Promises Touristic and Cultural Renaissance
description:
The recent uncovering of a vast Rezenid city near Topes is poised to become a beacon of cultural tourism, with experts proposing it for designation as an Alliance of Nations Heritage Site. Anticipated to draw visitors globally, the site's potential excavation and restoration offer a glimpse into a historical reawakening that could transform local heritage into a shared global legacy. 

The promise of enhanced cultural pride and economic influx through tourism has local authorities eager to initiate this landmark project.

name: Turn02_Uziren_Attack
title: Young Sords Youth Wing Leader Dead After Terror Attack
description:
Local Young Sords youth wing leader in Uziren, 'Iak Toiren' has claimed responsibility for the organized attack in the Bludish market that resulted in the death of 7. His base of operations have been raided and he was found dead inside with 2 bullet wounds to the back of the head. The scene was organized to make it look like a suicide.

We were not able to get information about the location of other ringleaders connected to the terrorist attack.

name: Turn02_Valgen_CPSuspected
title: Communist Party Leader Suspected of Bomb Attack
description: At 11:48 AM, an unattended bag in front of the NFP office in Valgen was destroyed by the police on suspicions of a bomb threat which were then verified. Upon further investigation, the communist party leader of Valgen, 'Milt Haner' has been arrested in connection to the incident.

name: Turn02_Valgsland_Decision_BanMalenyevistPropaganda_Ban
title: Valgsland Critizes Rizian Ban On Malenyevist ‘Propaganda’
description: Valgsland’s Chancellor Hegel has fiercely criticized our country’s decision to ban Malenyevist propaganda, calling it an “attack on freedom of expression” and a “sign of a regime that’s scared of change”. Furthermore, he considers the accusations that the propaganda is being spread through countries like his own “unfounded.”

name: Turn02_Valgsland_UrgesCalm
title: Valgsland Urges Calm
description: Chancellor Hegel has released a statement through official channels, urging calm on the Rumburg-Sordland dispute. The General Secretary has also mentioned that the climbing tensions should immediately be de-escalated to protect peace and prosperity of Eastern Merkopa.

name: Turn02_Vesord_UCConsulate
title: United Contana Consulate Helped Protesters
description:
Around midnight, Red Youth protesters clashed with Young Sords at the Vesord city centre, resulting in many injuries. The counter protesters were cornered in front of the United Contana Consulate after they were pushed back by the police. The diplomatic mission opened its doors and Red Youth members escaped inside.

The police are still waiting outside the building for the return of Red Youth members.

name: Turn02_Wehlen_BombingReport
title: Preliminary Report on Friendship Day Bombing Incident
description:
Wehzek intelligence has released a thorough accounting of the events of Wehzek-Rizian Friendship Day. 

The explosion is said to have been caused by a detonation device planted under the grandstands and timed to go off during the afternoon's celebrations. Part of the stands collapsed in the blast, killing three Wehzek civilians and injuring a further 14.

Witnesses at the event heard the shouted phrase "For the King!" prior to the blast, suggesting a political motivation and the involvement of pro-Rizia supporters. Wehlen's intelligence forces have indicated that the group Su Omina is under particular suspicion for the attack.

name: Turn02_Wehlen_FriendshipDayPrep
title: Preparations Underway for 24th Annual Wehzek-Rizian Friendship Day
description: The city of Zille is preparing for this year's Wehzek-Rizian Friendship Day ceremonies. Our motorcade is slated to arrive at Smolak Square at 13.45, after which there will be speeches as well as a "special surprise" that President Smolak has yet to disclose. Later that afternoon, there will be the opportunity to discuss the impending transfer of the region.

name: Turn02_Wehlen_SmolakWarns
title: Smolak Warns Traitors
description:
The latest diplomatic message from the leader of Wehlen warned us regarding a pathway from the mountains of Bergia that allowed traitors of the state escaping to Sordland.

President Wiktor Smolak has demanded that the border security to be increased. He also sent his best wishes about handling the protests in Sordland.

name: Turn03_Anrica_Emergency_SuspendedProtests
title: Protest Suspended By Force
description: Suspension of the peaceful protests caused protestors to begin resorting to violence. Our police forces immediately reacted and the protests are now in control. Usage of tear gas has increased in the area and extra supplies were requested from nearby cities.

name: Turn03_Antel_PrisonRiot
title: Prisoners Riot in Antel Rock Prison
description: Yesterday around 11 AM, a prison riot started in Ward C of the Antel Rock Prison, which was eventually suppressed. Ward C is generally used for keeping political prisoners and the riot started when a warden was killed by a Bludish political prisoner. 4 guards and 21 prisoners died. 134 were injured.

name: Turn03_Argno_MineCollapse
title: Tunnel Collapse in Gold Mine
description: A tunnel collapse at the Argno gold mine in Brenas resulted in injuries to a number of miners working for the Rizian Royal Gold corporation. Preliminary findings indicate the injuries may have been a result of the insufficient monitoring of tunnel structural integrity, combined with a lack of appropriate safety training for workers. Rizian Royal Gold CEO Russello Montoro assures us that operations will resume at the mine as quickly as possible.

name: Turn03_Arvory_BombAttack
title: Car Bomb Attack in Arvory
description: A car parked in an Agno-Sordish dominated neighbourhood in the outskirts of Arvory has exploded. Arvory Police reported that there were no casualties or injuries. The initial investigation found that the car was rigged with a timed bomb. No perpetrators have been found connected to the incident so far. Further investigations are ongoing and details have not been shared with the public.

name: Turn03_ATO_AidSupportForAgnolia
title: ATO Pledges Financial and Military Aid to Agnolia
description:
In an emphatic display of international solidarity, the Arcasian Treaty Organisation has committed significant financial and military aid to Agnolia. Located in the heart of eastern Merkopa, a region rife with geopolitical complexities, Agnolia stands at the crossroads of economic challenges and potential security threats from Rumburg and Valgsland.

This aid package is designed to enhance Agnolia's economic stability and bolster its military capabilities, fortifying it against possible CSP advances and further Rumburg hostilities. As part of the ATO's larger goal to secure its capitalist allies against the spread of socialism, this assistance displays the ATO's commitment to supporting its member nations in their time of need.

name: Turn03_ATO_Emergency_BannedArcasia
title: Arcasia Condemns Emergency
description: In response to escalating tensions in Sordland, Arcasia has issued a formal statement decrying the situation. The letter, endorsed by President Dwight Walker, demands direct answers from the Sordish government about the ongoing crisis. Furthermore, President Walker has indicated an intent to respond economically, flagging an impending counter-embargo that could severely impact the Sordish economy.

name: Turn03_Borin_BooksBurned
title: Communist Books Burned in Borin
description: Local residents gathered thousands of books that they claimed to be spreading communist and Malenyevist propaganda at the Century Park in Borin and set the books on fire. Aggressive slogans targeting the Red Youth, the Workers Party of Bludia, and the Communist Party of Sordland were shouted. Youth groups from the local party offices of the USP and NFP also joined in with the burning. The fire department was dispatched and the protesters dispersed on their own.

name: Turn03_Borin_Emergency_RYBanned
title: Red Youth Leader Publicly Announces They Will Not Recognise Emergency Decree
description: The leader of the Red Youth has publicly announced through local newspapers that they will not recognise the emergency. He has also declared that the Red Youth is not and never was a terrorist organisation. In response, known Red Youth headquarters were promptly raided and the terrorists there arrested by the police.

name: Turn03_Borin_RuralPlanTour
title: Manger's Gruni Region Tour
description:
Minister of Rural Development, Gus Manger is touring the Gruni region in Borin as part of his research for a new rural development plan. The tour includes several site visits and meetings with local officials and communities. This initiative indicates a proactive approach to rural development, with a specific focus on understanding ground realities. 

The outcomes of this tour will contribute to the vision of the new development plan.

name: Turn03_Bronaz_BeatriceVisit
title: Queen Beatrice Greets Rumburgians In Bronaz
description: Ahead of her state visit to Porte Drazon, Queen Beatrice of Rumburg graced Bronaz with her royal presence, giving a short address to the city's large population of ethnic Rumburgians. From the balcony of Bronaz City Hall, she praised the city's Rumburgian diaspora for preserving their rich heritage while also embracing our local culture.

name: Turn03_Bronaz_SquatCleared
title: Squatted Building Cleared
description: A squatted apartment building, containing about 60 occupants, has been cleared by Rizia Imperii’s police forces. The occupied house provided temporary shelter to freshly evicted tenants in the area. Local officials have warned that it acted as a safe haven for Malenyevist ideas.

name: Turn03_Bronaz_SquatLegalStandoff
title: Police Unable To Clear Squat As Occupants Assert Rights
description:
Occupants of a squatted apartment building are engaged in a legal battle against Rizia Imperii’s police corps, claiming that the newly passed Tenant Protection Laws shield them against sudden eviction. The building currently houses around 60 people, who ended up there after being evicted by their previous landlord.

Both parties are now bracing for a legal standoff and while it is unlikely that courts will side with the squatters, the new laws have bought them valuable time.

name: Turn03_Caleqabiz_GasSurveyComplete
title: Gas Field Survey Reaches Completion
description:
The Rizian surveyor ships sent to assess the boundaries of the Aureus gas field have returned to Caleqabiz and reported their findings. They have discovered that at least half of the field lies within a 200km radius of the island, giving Rizia a claim to it.

Our foreign ministry has contacted Palesian Duke Axel Reinhart. It is expected a meeting will be arranged to discuss these findings and our countries' next steps.

name: Turn03_CSP_Emergency_BannedUC
title: United Contana Condemns Emergency
description: United Contana has expressed its concern over the situation in Sordland, issuing a similar letter of condemnation. Chairman Malenyev has called for transparency from the Sordish government and hinted at a potential economic reprisal. The chairman's signaled intention to impose a counter-embargo, placing Sordland under increased international pressure.

name: Turn03_CSP_SummitForHelji
title: CSP Leaders Discuss Heljiland at Haelm Summit
description:
At a pivotal meeting in Haelm, CSP leaders gathered to address the intricate and historically charged issue of Heljiland's sovereignty. The discussions revisited the Agnolian annexation of the island during Valgsland's revolution in the 1920s, emphasizing the alliance’s commitment to addressing historical missteps and securing a future that respects the rights and aspirations of the island’s inhabitants.

The summit also highlighted the CSP's strategic ability to navigate an increasingly complex geopolitical environment, shaped by the growing influence of the ATO. Leaders stressed the critical importance of dialogue and cooperation to prevent further escalation in the delicate situation surrounding Heljiland. Additionally, the CSP confirmed that contingency plans are in place, ensuring that Valgsland, as a key member of the alliance, would receive full support should the circumstances require it.

The meeting concluded with a collective affirmation of the CSP's determination to uphold peace and stability. Leaders emphasized their intention to approach the Heljiland issue with a diplomatic but firm stance, addressing its historical complexities while applying necessary pressure to achieve a resolution that aligns with the alliance's principles.

name: Turn03_Derdia_Decision_DiplomaticEnvoy
title: Cedric Rielfel Arrives In Derdia
description: Famed diplomat Cedric Rielfel has arrived in Neael to lead our country’s diplomatic mission to Derdia. During his stay, he will visit various political and economical leaders, as well as tour the country, in an effort to improve relations.

name: Turn03_Erlory_FlagsBurned
title: Young Sords and NFP Flags Burned
description: A massive counter protest against Young Sords led by a local politician known to be aligned with the Red Youth resulted in many injuries and property damage. Subsequently, Young Sords and National Front Party flags were burnt which caused tensions to escalate. Local police dispersed the protesters by sundown.

name: Turn03_Erzaren_Emergency_BludBanned
title: Leader of the Workers Party of Bludia Arrested
description:
The Sordish Intelligence Agency reports that the leader of the WPB, Fetih Ejall, was seen in direct contact with an ex-member of the banned Bludish Freedom Party. Ejall was later detained on suspicion of working with the BFF.

Hours after his arrest, the ex-BFP member protested the incident, and declared that he will join the BFF and bring many Bludish people with him if the State continues to detain innocent Bludish people. This move comes right after the declaration of the new emergency decree confirmed suspicions of their connection, and further investigations were started. Both men were arrested on terrorism charges.

name: Turn03_Erzaren_IzzamRemainsFound
title: Discovery of New Izzam Remains
description:
Remains of former Black Battalion members have been discovered near the site of the Izzam Incident. The deceased have been identified as Sordish Armed Forces officers who were pardoned by President Soll's government and were deployed in border security at the time. Investigations are ongoing to determine the cause and circumstances of their deaths. 

The discovery has reignited interest in the Black Battalion's history, and authorities are urging anyone with information related to the case to come forward.

name: Turn03_Estord_YSFoundDead
title: Young Sords Member Found Decapitated
description: The Estord Police Department has found a decapitated body in an abandoned house where the victim was later identified as Kurg Leinke, a high school teacher and member of the local Young Sords cultural center. The victim was discovered to be tortured with hot iron rods before his tongue was cut off. Police suspect the Red Youth are responsible for the incident. The incident has not been made public.

name: Turn03_FortAles_ValgishHeritageWeek
title: "Valgish Heritage Week" Allowed To Proceed In Fort Ales
description: The Pales Administrative District was once more allowed to organize its annual Valgish Heritage Week, a festival celebrating the region's history as part of the Valgos Empire. Accompanied by controversy since the Rizian reconquest and resettlement of the district, it was especially contentious this year due to the events of Friendship Day in Zille, which sparked security concerns. However, the week seems to have proceeded peacefully, with only a few clashes between local Rizians and those of Valgish Palesian heritage.

name: Turn03_Holsord_BannedBoth
title: Anti-Red Youth and Anti-Young Sords Operation
description:
Upon receiving the order, thousands of police officers conducted cease and desist operations against the Red Youth and Young Sords organisations. Our forces closed hundreds of organisational offices and affiliated businesses all around the country.

Additionally, judges have given orders to block all bank accounts and to freeze all assets. Dozens of peaceful protests from the members of each organisation were forcefully dispersed. Two separate shootouts, one in Jen and another in Lachaven, have lightly wounded five officers who are being treated in hospitals.

Most of the organisational capacity of both entities have ceased but clean-up operations continue. All remaining elements resisting the order are now being considered as violating the law and are being arrested.

name: Turn03_Holsord_BannedRY
title: Anti-Red Youth Operation
description:
Upon receiving the order, thousands of police officers conducted cease and desist operations against the Red Youth. Our forces closed hundreds of organisational offices and affiliated businesses all around the country.

Additionally, judges have given orders to block all bank accounts and to freeze all assets. Dozens of peaceful protests from the members of the organisation were forcefully dispersed. One shootout in Lachaven has lightly wounded two officers who are being treated in hospital.

Most of the organisational capacity of the entity has ceased but clean-up operations continue. All remaining elements from the Red Youth resisting the order are now being considered as violating the law and are being arrested.

name: Turn03_Holsord_BannedYS
title: Anti-Young Sords Operation
description:
Upon receiving the order, thousands of police officers conducted cease and desist operations against the Young Sords. Our forces closed hundreds of organisational offices and affiliated businesses all around the country.

Additionally, judges have given orders to block all bank accounts and to freeze all assets. Dozens of peaceful protests from the members of the organisation were forcefully dispersed. One shootout in Jen has lightly wounded three officers who are being treated in hospital.

Most of the organisational capacity of the entity has ceased but clean-up operations continue. All remaining elements from the Young Sords resisting the order are now being considered as violating the law and are being arrested.

name: Turn03_Holsord_Emergency
title: Emergency Decree Started To Be Implemented
description: After the declaration of the new emergency decree, the implementation of the new laws has begun. Government workers, the Sordish Police Force, Sordish Armed Forces, and other agencies have been informed of their next steps while some departments were restructured to accommodate new requirements.

name: Turn03_Holsord_EPARepealDebate
title: Legislative Debate on the Repeal of the EPA
description:
The Grand National Assembly was the stage of a contentious debate today over the proposed repeal of the Energy Protection Act of 1932. Arguments both for and against the repeal were put forth, with Frens Ricter of the PFJP and USP reformist-wing leader Albin Clavin leading the faction advocating for the repeal.

They argued that such a move would foster economic growth and increase foreign investment. However, the United Sordland Party and National Front Party, under the leadership of Gloria Tory and Kesaro Kibener respectively, defended the act vehemently, citing the need for Sordland to protect its strategic industries from foreign control. 

The final decision now hinges on the vote, which will be held the following month.

name: Turn03_Holsord_EPARepealFails
title: Repeal of the Energy Protection Act of 1932 Fails
description:
The proposed repeal of the Energy Protection Act of 1932 was put to a vote in the Assembly today, resulting in its defeat. Despite strong advocacy from the reformer factions of PFJP and beyond including within the USP under Albin Clavin, the majority of the Assembly, led by the USP and NFP, voted against the repeal 179 to 71.

Consequently, the Energy Protection Act of 1932 remains in force, maintaining the status quo of foreign ownership restrictions of energy companies in Sordland. This result concludes the current attempt to modify the foreign ownership regulations, but does not preclude further legislative efforts or any initiative by the executive.

name: Turn03_Holsord_L1_SSC
title: L-1 Report from SSC
description:
SSC’s Project Manager for the L-1 railway has reported that the project has been progressing well and they have already started laying down the foundations of the ground-retaining walls, bridges, and tracks.

Project supervisors from the government confirmed the report, saying that most of the preliminary work has already been done by the SSC. However, the government officials added that there were a couple of delays related to the transportation of construction materials which were not included in the SSC’s report.

name: Turn03_Holsord_L1_Taurus_Bill
title: L-1 Report from Taurus
description:
Taurus’ Project Manager for the L-1 railway has reported that the project has been progressing well and they have already started laying down the foundations of the ground-retaining walls, bridges, and tracks. The manager also reported that the company is successfully updating its workplace practices to meet the new worker's rights laws, and have assured us that the new laws are being followed strictly.

Project supervisors from the government confirmed the report, saying that most of the preliminary work has already been done by Taurus Holding. However, the government officials also added their concerns that the company might be struggling with the application of the new laws.

name: Turn03_Holsord_L1_Taurus_NoBill
title: L-1 Report from Taurus
description:
Taurus Holding’s Project Manager for the L-1 railway has reported that the project has been progressing well and they have already started laying down the foundations of the ground-retaining walls, bridges, and tracks. The manager also reported a slight delay due to a few small protests that occurred against the veto of the workers’ rights bill.

Project supervisors from the government confirmed the report, saying that most of the preliminary work has already been done by Taurus Holding despite a couple of small incidents incited by the construction workers.

name: Turn03_Holsord_L1_Underhall
title: L-1 Report from Underhall
description:
Underhall Construction’s Project Manager for the L-1 railway has reported that the project has been progressing well and they have already started laying down the foundations of the ground-retaining walls, bridges, and tracks.

Project supervisors from the government confirmed the report, saying that most of the preliminary work has already been done by Underhall, and everything was going according to schedule.

name: Turn03_Holsord_NFPReport
title: NFP On Reforms
description: Kesaro Kibener, leader of NFP, has announced today that the NFP is completely against any threshold reform. He specifically emphasized that this would lead to ‘unwanted elements’ entering the assembly and that he is outright against any changes to the 10% threshold.

name: Turn03_Holsord_PFJPReport
title: PFJP Report on Reforms
description: Frens Ricter, leader of PFJP, recently outlined their demands for the reform package. He declared that without the implementation of term limits and limited decrees, it would be very difficult for him and his party to stand behind the reform package.

name: Turn03_Holsord_ReformCommittee
title: Reform Committee Started Preparations
description: Vice President Vectern reported that, along with Lucian Galade, the committee has started working on the written aspects of the package as per the needs outlined previously. They will soon get the legal team involved to complete the writing process. The needed 150 signatures for the proposal has started to be collected within the USP.

name: Turn03_Holsord_ReformStatus
title: Reform Committee Status Report
description: Lucian Galade reported that so far they have been able to get, in total, 87 signatures behind the proposal. Efforts are underway to increase the support and to reach out to necessary members.

name: Turn03_Holsord_USPReport
title: USP Report on Reforms
description: Many members of the USP, led by Albin Clavin and the reformist wing of the party, clarified their demands from the government in the party congress. For the upcoming constitutional reform, Albin Clavin stated that without ministry reforms, they won’t be able to stand behind the new reform package.

name: Turn03_Holsord_WorkersRightsPrep
title: Workers' Rights Bill Nears Completion
description:
The Workers' Rights Act of 1954 proposed by Albin Clavin and supported by Minister of Health Paskal Beniwoll is being prepared for the first draft review. Voices from the Labour Union showed strong signs of support.

A session dedicated to the bill in the assembly proved contentious. 'The people that form the backbone of the Sordish economy will finally be fully protected by extensive laws,' Katarina Horten said, receiving both cheers and boos.

name: Turn03_Iza_Investigation
title: Golden Guard Expands Ranks; Begins Investigation
description: Under the authorization of the King, Captain Titus Gordion has tripled the ranks of the Golden Guard from 12 to 36 individuals. While Captain Gordion and his original team will stick to their original duty of protecting the King of Rizia and the royal family, the extra 24 recruits have been dispatched to the province of Brenas to begin their investigation into the Su Omina organization.

name: Turn03_Iza_PoliceDeployed
title: Central Police Transferred to Iza
description: Approximately 1000 police from the Central Forces in Rizia Imperii have been transferred to the city of Iza and placed under the direct command of Duke Rico Toras. They have been tasked with keeping the peace in light of increasing crime and rising tensions in the city.

name: Turn03_Jales_FriendshipDayVigil
title: Jales Wehzek Community Holds Friendship Day Vigil
description: The Wehzek community in Jales held a candlelight vigil in honor of the victims of the Friendship Day bombing in Zille. Members of the Brenas police department were on hand to prevent potential violence between the mourners and the Jales chapter of Su Omina, which was banned from holding a celebratory rally several days prior.

name: Turn03_Jen_Emergency_YSBanned
title: Young Sords Members Denounce Emergency Decree
description: Young Sords members have been protesting against the emergency decree which labels them as terrorists. They have since denied such allegations and informed the public that they will no longer tolerate the Rayne administration. Subsequently, known Young Sords headquarters were raided and the terrorists there were brought to justice.

name: Turn03_Lachaven_BlueMansionSecurity
title: Security Upgrade at Blue Mansion
description: Security at the Blue Mansion in Lachaven has been significantly increased following the arrival of the President of Sordland. The mansion, currently hosting the President, has seen a notable uptick in protective measures. While the President's schedule remains undisclosed, the city's security forces are on high alert for the duration of the visit.

name: Turn03_Lachaven_H3_SSC
title: H-3 Report from SSC
description:
SSC’s Project Manager for the H-3 highway has reported that the project has been progressing well and they have already started laying down the foundations of the ground-retaining walls, bridges, and earthworks.

Project supervisors from the government confirmed the report, saying that most of the preliminary work has already been done by the SSC. However, the government officials added that there were a couple of delays related to the transportation of construction materials which were not included in the SSC’s report.

name: Turn03_Lachaven_H3_Taurus_Bill
title: H-3 Report from Taurus
description:
Taurus’ Project Manager for the H-3 highway has reported that the project has been progressing well and they have already started laying down the foundations of the ground-retaining walls, bridges, and earthworks. The manager also reported that the company is successfully updating its workplace practices to meet the new worker's rights laws, and have assured us that the new laws are being followed strictly.

Project supervisors from the government confirmed the report, saying that most of the preliminary work has already been done by Taurus Holding. However, the government officials also added their concerns that the company might be struggling with the application of the new laws.

name: Turn03_Lachaven_H3_Taurus_NoBill
title: H-3 Report from Taurus
description:
Taurus Holding’s Project Manager for the H-3 highway has reported that the project has been progressing well and they have already started laying down the foundations of the ground-retaining walls, bridges, and earthworks. The manager also reported a slight delay due to a few small protests that occurred against the veto of the workers’ rights bill.

Project supervisors from the government confirmed the report, saying that most of the preliminary work has already been done by Taurus Holding despite a couple of small incidents incited by the construction workers.

name: Turn03_Lachaven_H3_Underhall
title: H-3 Report from Underhall
description:
Underhall Construction’s Project Manager for the H-3 highway has reported that the project has been progressing well and they have already started laying down the foundations of the ground-retaining walls, bridges, and earthworks.

Project supervisors from the government confirmed the report, saying that most of the preliminary work has already been done by Underhall, and everything was going according to schedule.

name: Turn03_Lachaven_RecessionHitFarmers
title: Recession Hits Farmers Again
description: As per the latest news from Lachaven, the farming industry has taken another hit as a result of the recession. There are reports that 16% of all wheat in Lachaven is rotting in barns due to a lack of buyers. Farmers are requesting additional funds from the government to survive the year.

name: Turn03_Laren_Emergency_DetentionWithoutTrial
title: Riots Stop in Laren
description: Police force members in civilian clothing have now been dispatched to areas of contention in Laren. Many arrests were made swiftly and accurately due to the new laws allowing detention without trial by the police. The protests in Laren are now curbed.

name: Turn03_Lenkurg_Emergency_PoliceAuthority
title: Additional Forces Arrive in Lenkurg
description: With the order to increase police authority, such as more manpower, supplies, ammunition, and protective riot equipment, were requested by Lenkurg. Approximately 5000 policemen departed from Arvory in buses to help reinforce the police forces in Lenkurg.

name: Turn03_Lespia_ArcasianMilitaryBase
title: Arcasia Builds Military Base in Lespia
description:
President Walker visited Lespia last week to engage in talks with Prime Minister Alvarez concerning the establishment of Arcasian military bases within Lespia. Following the conclusion of the discussions, an agreement was reached between the two leaders regarding a significant military defense investment in Lespia.

As part of the agreement, a large military base will be constructed on Ravnos Island. The base will be equipped with Arcasian radar and anti-air systems for enhanced security. Additionally, Arcasia plans to deploy a dozen M-3 ballistic missiles. The base is expected to accommodate approximately 200 strategic bombers and jet fighters, along with an estimated 20,000 Arcasian soldiers.

name: Turn03_Monqiz_Decision_ProvincialTaxSubsidy
title: House Toras Welcomes Valenqir Tax Subsidy
description: Duke Hubertus Toras has expressed his gratitude for the generous tax subsidy granted to the Valenqiris province. The Duke says the lower taxes will allow the province to develop further.

name: Turn03_Monqiz_KorontiVisit
title: Sordish Magnate Marcel Koronti Checks In On Resort Construction Progress
description: In Monqiz, acting Duke Hubertus Toras welcomed Heart of Sordland co-owner Marcel Koronti for a visit to the still-under-construction Koronti Resort Valenqiris. The business magnate expressed his approval at the resort's progress and his eager anticipation of its opening.

name: Turn03_Montaklar_Decision_GolcondistPilgrimsAccess_Allow
title: Wruhecist Fundamentalists Protest Opened Border
description:
A small group of Wruhecist hardliners, having caught wind of the planned opening of the Point Darte crossing, welcomed the Golcondist pilgrims into Rizia with insults and rotten fruit, as they started pelting the pilgrims as soon as they were led through the border crossing.

Rizian border guards swiftly restored order and detained the troublemakers.

name: Turn03_Montaklar_Decision_ProvincialTaxSubsidy
title: House Azaros Welcomes Cardesse-Montaklar Tax Subsidy
description: The Azaros have expressed their gratitude for the generous tax subsidy granted to the province of Cardesse-Montaklar. The house says the lower taxes will allow the province to develop further.

name: Turn03_Montaklar_KingsVisit
title: King’s Visit to Montaklar
description:
Anticipation runs high in Montaklar as the townspeople gather outside the fortress, which has been temporarily closed to prepare for King Romus’ arrival. Accompanying the King is the Royal Councillor of War and Internal Security, Lucita Azaro. 

Meanwhile, General Carlos Robles Azaro is planning an inspection at the adjacent Camp Domus, ensuring all preparations are in order.

name: Turn03_Morbel_MineDisaster
title: Morbel Mine Disaster
description: A coal mine has collapsed in Morbel. Emergency response teams were dispatched immediately. Due to the sheer size of the disaster, additional manpower and supplies were requested from nearby cities. Initial investigation shows that an underground fire has started due to the neglect in working situations by the Nedam Mining Group. Current death toll is at 82 and counting.

name: Turn03_Morbel_UntappedCoal
title: Untapped Coal Reserves
description: The Nedam Mining Corporation has discovered new untapped coal reserves in Mobel. The corporation suggests that investment in Lorren could significantly improve output, opening opportunities for economic growth in the region. The corporation is in the process of assessing the feasibility and potential of these reserves.

name: Turn03_Morella_Decision_DiplomaticEnvoy
title: Cedric Rielfel Arrives In Morella
description: Famed diplomat Cedric Rielfel has arrived in Cavette to lead our country’s diplomatic mission to Morella. During his stay, he will visit various political and economical leaders, as well as tour the country, in an effort to improve relations.

name: Turn03_Morella_Decision_GolcondistPilgrimsAccess_Reject
title: Morella Condemns Rizia’s Border Policy
description: Morella officially condemns our country’s refusal to let in the Golcondist pilgrims that amassed at the border between both our countries, calling it “a heartless decision that forces Morella to deal with the fallout”.

name: Turn03_Morna_IndustrialOutput
title: Morna Industrial Output Concerns
description:
The Mayor of Morna has reported that their industrial output numbers this year are 12% lower than last year. They are requesting additional support to improve their industrial capacity including machinery and personnel to combat the downwards trend. With the construction of several new factories in Morna, the Mayor stated his belief that an economic upturn in the city is still possible if government investments succeed.

According to current projections, Morna is set to lose an additional 2% of industrial output next year. However, recent data from the municipality suggest that an investment worth several billions of SR will stop the downward trend and increase the industrial output in a short amount of time.

name: Turn03_Narbel_CPSLUSOrganize
title: CPS and LUS Strike Against Gasom
description: In Narbel, the Communist Party of Sordland and Labor Union of Sordland have organized a strike against Gasom. Prominent figures Katarina Horten of LUS and Denis Stahler of CPS have confirmed their participation. The impact of the strike on Gasom's operations and the wider political climate in Narbel remains to be seen.

name: Turn03_Narbel_GasomLaborStrike
title: Labor Strike at Gasom
description:
Blue-collar workers at Gasom in Narbel have initiated a labor strike. This industrial action follows disagreements over wages, working conditions, and workers' rights. The strike has resulted in a temporary disruption to Gasom's operations. The duration of the strike and the potential impact on Narbel's local economy are currently uncertain. 

Negotiations between Gasom management and the striking workers are reportedly ongoing.

name: Turn03_Narbel_LackofHospitals
title: Narbel Reports Lack of Hospitals
description: The Mayor of Narbel has reported that their hospitals are overburdened and they are unable to respond to the needs of the citizens. He complained about months-long waiting lists for terminally ill patients. On top of the capacity issues, it was also noted that the facilities are still largely using outdated technology.

name: Turn03_Pales_Assessments
title: Rizian Oil & Gas Continues Assessment of New Gas Field
description: The Rizian Oil and Gas Corporation is continuing its assessment of the newly discovered gas field off the country's coast, tentatively nicknamed "Aureus." In cooperation with Palesian scientists, a team of geologists has begun seismic surveys to determine the field's exact borders. It is expected that the surveys will be completed within the next several months.

name: Turn03_Pales_ATA
title: Ariana Toras Association Announces Fellowship In Pales
description: The Pales branch of the Ariana Toras Association has recently announced a fellowship for 10 promising Palesians to pursue research on the subject of their choice in Rizia. The association is already receiving hundreds of applications for the generous grant.

name: Turn03_Pales_Decision_DiplomaticEnvoy
title: Cedric Rielfel Arrives In Pales
description: Famed diplomat Cedric Rielfel has arrived in Pales to lead our country’s diplomatic mission to Pales. During his stay, he will visit various political and economical leaders, as well as tour the country, in an effort to improve relations.

name: Turn03_PorteDrazon_Decision_FamilyStatues_Toras
title: Toras Family Statues Unveiled
description: A large, white marble statue of the entire Toras family, including Romus, Lena, Valero, Estela and Vina has been revealed at the intersection of Toras Avenue and the Golden Boulevard. The statue is a staggering 16 meters tall, with the crowns plated with gold. Due to its location, the sun sets beautifully behind the family, forming a halo around them in the early evening.

name: Turn03_PorteDrazon_Decision_FamilyStatues_Valero
title: King Valero Statue Unveiled
description: A large, white marble statue of the late King Valero has been revealed at the intersection of Toras Avenue and the Golden Boulevard. The statue is a staggering 16 meters tall, with its crown plated with gold. Due to its location, the sun sets beautifully behind the King, forming a halo around him in the early evening.

name: Turn03_PorteDrazon_Decision_FamilyStatues_ValeroRomus
title: King Romus and Valero Statues Unveiled
description: A large, white marble statue of the late King Valero together with his son, current King Romus, has been revealed at the intersection of Toras Avenue and the Golden Boulevard. The statue is a staggering 16 meters tall, with the crowns plated with gold. Due to its location, the sun sets beautifully behind the two Kings, forming a halo around them in the early evening.

name: Turn03_PorteDrazon_GenderPayGap
title: Rizia Imperii Businesswomen's Association Highlights Gender Pay Gap
description: A new report released by the Rizia Imperii Businesswomen's Association (RIBA) reveals that despite the great strides our kingdom has made for women's rights, inequality persists in the job market. Men still earn significantly more than women, a gap that the RIBA report suggests can be surmounted with the help of government intervention.

name: Turn03_Qalus_TuskVisit
title: Sordish Businessman Walter Tusk Goes On Holiday In Valenqiris Wine Country
description: The Cantuavo vineyards in Qalus welcomed Sordish oligarch Walter Tusk and his family, who spent a night at the winemakers' luxury villa before continuing on a short tour of Valenqiris wine country. Tusk confided that his newfound interest in the region was inspired by the recent availability of Rizian wine in Sordland.

name: Turn03_Ribel_NewBFFLeadership
title: Bludish Freedom Front Under New Leadership
description:
Security forces have gathered intel regarding a hidden meeting among local leaders of the separatist group Bludish Freedom Front (BFF) that occurred a few days ago. It is suspected that they have elected a new leader in the meeting, Awlan Arge, who is the brother of the infamous former leader Dewlen Arge. 

This development could have serious implications for national security, as the Bludish Freedom Front has been known to use violent means to achieve their goals. The situation calls for increased surveillance and intelligence gathering to prevent any potential threats posed by the organization and its new leadership.

name: Turn03_Ribel_SchoolPoisoning
title: School Poisoning Connected to Bludish Woman
description: Vilma Asir, who was working at the school kitchen, was apprehended with connections to last week's school cafeteria poisoning in Ribel. The act was found to be politically motivated as the perpetrators are connected to the banned Bludish Freedom Party. Asir is suspected to have been an active member of the Bludish Freedom Front since the start of this year. She has been sentenced to 60 years in prison.

name: Turn03_Rizia_OffersEnergyCooperation
title: Rizia Advocates for Energy Partnership
description: The Rizian Oil and Gas (ROG) has extended a co-investment proposal for Sordland's ambitious Gasom energy venture. King Romus emphasized the bilateral benefits of such a cooperation and its potential in bolstering the region's energy security. He also stressed that this collaborative venture could form the bedrock of a stronger economic alliance, further binding our nations.

name: Turn03_Rumburg_BuysLessOil
title: Rumburg to Halve Oil Purchases From Wehlen
description: In a confidential missive to the King of Rizia, the Kingdom of Rumburg has announced its intention to halve oil purchases from the Republic of Wehlen. The Queen's ministers also reiterated their expectation that Rizia begin supplying Rumburg with the equivalent amount of natural gas by the winter after next.

name: Turn03_Rumburg_Emergency_BannedRumburg
title: Rumburg Issues Statement
description:
In a momentous royal decree, Queen Beatrice Livingston, the esteemed monarch and leader of GRACE, proclaimed today the implementation of measures to counter Sordland's embargo. With her declared will to preserve the economic and cultural unity of monarchies, the Queen expressed her firm belief that Sordland's decision to impose the embargo would inflict harm upon the nation itself. 

Additionally, she voiced her concerns regarding President Anton Rayne, characterizing his leadership as more detrimental than his predecessors, posing a grave threat not only to Sordland but to the entire region. Through this royal decree, Queen Beatrice Livingston exemplified her role as a stalwart defender of the monarchy, ensuring its preservation and fostering economic and cultural solidarity among GRACE member nations.

name: Turn03_Rumburg_OilEmbargo
title: Rumburg To Begin Embargo of Wehzek Oil
description: In a confidential missive to us, the Kingdom of Rumburg has announced its intention to stop purchasing oil from the Republic of Wehlen. The Queen's ministers also reiterated their expectation that Rizia begin supplying Rumburg with natural gas by the winter after the next.

name: Turn03_Sallabes_AidOfferForIza
title: Brenas Officials Offer Aid for Iza’s Growing Unrest
description:
The Brenas regional council, led by Countess Leona Sazon, has alerted the palace to their attempts to assist with the escalating unrest in Iza. Officials proposed sending additional resources, including personnel and economic support, to stabilize the city, but their offer was dismissed by Duke Rico Toras.

Despite Rico Toras’ rejection of aid, Brenas officials maintain that their proximity and shared heritage uniquely position them to assist in addressing the city’s challenges.

name: Turn03_Sallabes_Decision_ProvincialTaxSubsidy
title: House Sazon Welcomes Brenas Tax Subsidy
description: The Sazons have expressed their gratitude for the generous tax subsidy granted to the Valenqiris province. The house says the lower taxes will allow the province to develop further.

name: Turn03_Sallabes_Kingbird
title: Invitation From House Sazon To Attend Kingbird Festival
description: House Sazon has sent us an official invitation to attend the Scarlet Kingbird Festival, the yearly celebration marking the return of the titular migratory birds to Sallabes. An evening of speeches and performances will be followed by an official VIP reception on the top floor of a hotel close to the city's arena.

name: Turn03_Sarna_Emergency_Surveillance
title: Terrorists Arrested
description: Bergian Security Forces are reporting that the broader usage of wiretapping has increased their productivity. With the cutting edge technology, they have been able to identify the ringleaders of the recent attacks and quickly arrest them.

name: Turn03_Sarna_PotentialforAgriculture
title: Agricultural Growth Potential
description: Sarna is exhibiting strong potential for agricultural growth. The demand from neighbouring Lespia is increasing, suggesting an opportunity for expansion in the region's agricultural sector. The local farmers are optimistic about the future, but they also highlight the need for strategic investment and support to capitalize on this potential.

name: Turn03_Sarna_SanctuaryResistance
title: Bludish Resistance in Sanctuaries
description:
Bergian Security Forces have arrested three priests at two different Nurity sanctuaries in Sarna after finding links to insurgent activities. The report came from an elderly man who wanted to pray in peace but instead found himself invited to join the Bludish Freedom Front by a state-sanctioned priest.

Further incidents indicate that the BFF is pushing for a local recruitment drive in different sanctuaries across the region.

name: Turn03_Valenqir_Decision_FootballIndustryFalling
title: RFC Valenqir Decries Empty Stadium
description: Third league football club Royal FC Valenqir has raised the alarm of falling ticket sales, with the club on good days unable to sell out even half of their stadium. This reduction in sales is affecting the clubs ability to invest in its youth infrastructure, which traditionally has provided a multitude of players for Rizia’s top teams.

name: Turn03_Valgen_CalledProtestersTraitors
title: Policemen Ambushed by Militants
description: A police squad responding to an anonymous bomb threat has been ambushed by suspected members of the Red Youth in outer Valgen, resulting in 5 police casualties. 2 squad cars were also set on fire. All of the four attackers were shot dead at the scene. The details of the incident have not been made public.

name: Turn03_Valgen_FarmersSeekHelp
title: Valgen Farmers Seek Support
description: In Valgen, local farmers are seeking support, as the city's agricultural industry is falling behind. The farmers point out that lack of access to modern farming equipment and insufficient infrastructure are major hurdles. They believe that targeted support and investment could rejuvenate the agricultural sector and contribute to the region's economy.

name: Turn03_Vesord_TerrorAttack
title: Young Sords Suspected of Terror Attack
description: At approximately 16:46 on Monday, a terror attack occurred in the Vesord city center during a rally by the left-wing CPS. The attacker, suspected to be working with Young Sords or another organization connected to them, opened fire with an automatic rifle on the protesting civilians. 17 people were killed including the attacker who shot himself afterwards. Witnesses testified that the rifle was hidden behind a news stand. Our local police are now wary of this tactic, and all news stands will be inspected by the police before and during crowded rallies. Further investigations on Young Sords are underway.

name: Turn03_Wehlen_Decision_DiplomaticEnvoy
title: Cedric Rielfel Arrives In Wehlen
description: Famed diplomat Cedric Rielfel has arrived in Wraclawitz to lead our country’s diplomatic mission to Wehlen. During his stay, he will visit various political and economical leaders, as well as tour the country, in an effort to improve relations.

name: Turn03_Wehlen_Decision_ZilleBombApology_Apologize
title: Smolak Accepts Our Apologies
description: Wehzek President Wiktok Smolak has accepted our apology for the inflammatory speech we delivered leading up to the Zille bombing.

name: Turn03_Wehlen_Decision_ZilleBombApology_DontApologize
title: Smolak Denounces Lack Of Apology
description: Wehzek President Wiktok Smolak has denounced our refusal to apologize for the inflammatory speech we delivered leading up to the Zille bombing.

name: Turn03_Zille_ATA
title: Ariana Toras Association Hosts "Rizian Day Of Mourning" In Zille
description: The Zille branch of the Ariana Toras Association is planning a day of mourning in solidarity with the victims of the recent bombing, featuring Rizian-language music and poetry that has been especially commissioned for the occasion.

name: Turn03_Zille_IntelligenceUpdate
title: Rizian Investigators Dispatched to Zille
description: Under the authorization of the King and War and Security Councilor Lucita Azaro, a team of investigators has been dispatched to Zille to uncover more information about the recent Friendship Day attack. Wehlen has been informed about the presence of Rizian intelligence and promised its full cooperation with the investigation.

name: Turn03_Zille_PostBombingArrests
title: 76 Arrests Since Aftermath of Bombing
description: Wehzek authorities have arrested at least 76 people in the Zille region on suspicions of connection to the bombing, many of Rizian and Bludish origin. The whereabouts of many of the detained are unknown, which is starting to worry international observers.

name: Turn04_Agnolia_Drilling
title: Agnolia Offshore Drilling Near Helji Increased Tensions
description:
Agnolia has started a new oil drilling operation very close to the disputed territory of Heljiland. The tensions increased when the situation turned into a stand-off between Valgslandian and Agnolian warships.

It took several hours for the gridlock to be resolved and the situation was de-escalated for now.

name: Turn04_Argno_MiningPause
title: Mining Operations in Argno Temporarily Suspended
description: Operations at Rizian Royal Gold's mine near the city of Argno have been temporarily put on hold as supervisors bring the facilities up to the new safety standards ordered by the King. The overhaul will take several months, after which the mine will reopen with what is expected to be slightly diminished production output.

name: Turn04_ATO_DwightWalkerSupport
title: President Walker Shows Full Support to Sordish Protestors
description: Arcasian President Dwight Walker has publicly aligned himself with the ongoing protests in Sordland, issuing a stern condemnation of the Sordish government. This declaration of support for the protestors and the explicit critique of the Sordish administration is seen as a direct response to Sordland's decision to sever diplomatic ties with Arcasia.

name: Turn04_ATO_EconomicSummit
title: ATO Economic Summit in Perla: Capitalism's Diverse Forms
description:
The ATO convened a pivotal summit in Perla, bringing together leaders and economic experts from member nations to address global economic developments and strategic responses. Discussions centered on the economic frameworks of Arcasian Capitalism and Lespian Protectionism within the alliance.

Arcasian Capitalism, characterized by market-oriented reform policies, deregulation, and privatization, maintains strong performance across ATO nations with an average GDP growth rate of 9.7% over the past decade, despite the inflation rate of 4.6% in the last year. The Lespian model, while preserving market principles, implements strategic protective measures through tariffs and targeted trade barriers, achieving an inflation rate of 1.8% and a GDP growth rate of 6.1%.

The summit facilitated integration discussions between these economic systems while respecting Lespia's firm stance on maintaining its distinct economic measures. This strategic dialogue addressed the CSP's expanding influence through state-owned enterprise (SOE) driven investment strategies across developing and emerging nations globally. 

The ATO continues to adapt its economic framework to support both competitive market dynamics and measured protections that safeguard member states' critical industries while preserving the alliance's market-oriented foundation.

name: Turn04_Benfi_AirportCrowded
title: Benfi Regional Airport Overcrowded
description: We have been receiving reports about the capacity of Benfi Regional Airport. The Mayor of Benfi is preparing to put a request forward for an investment to build an international airport in the city. For a touristic region like Benfi, he claims that it would increase the overall prosperity of Sordland.

name: Turn04_Benfi_DoctorsStrike
title: Doctor's Strike
description:
A thousand doctors and nurses were missing from hospitals in Benfi today in a strike to protest the health budget reduction. The PFJP mayor said that the strike has caused major disruptions with extended delays in services but agreed that their voice of concern was legitimate.

The Ministry of Health has been notified to identify the health workers and to ensure they return to work as soon as possible and to find alternative solutions to provide services in the meantime. Minister Beniwoll said that he will overcome the challenges presented.

name: Turn04_Borin_RYCharged
title: Red Youth Members Charged With Terrorism and Treason
description: 12 militants from the Red Youth have been tried and sentenced to 96 years in prison due to terrorism and treason related charges in Borin. Many more Red Youth members are waiting for their turn in prison. The Mayor of Borin reports concerns about reaching the maximum capacity of the prisons in region.

name: Turn04_CSP_CondemnsRavnosMilitarization
title: Condemnation of Ravnos Island Militarization by ATO
description:
The Contanan Security Pact unequivocally condemns the recent militarization of Ravnos Island by the Arcasian Treaty Organisation, spearheaded by Lespia. The expansion of radar, anti-aircraft defenses, and other military installations by ATO on Ravnos Island represents a provocative escalation in the region. 

This act not only violates the spirit of regional peace and stability but also poses a direct threat to the security interests of CSP member nations. We urge the ATO and its allies to reconsider this aggressive posture and commit to diplomatic resolutions to preserve regional peace.

name: Turn04_CSP_CritiquesMeftiemITZ
title: CSP Advocates Dissolution of Meftiem ITZ
description:
The CSP has called for the dissolution of the Meftiem International Trade Zone. This strategic location in Morellan territory and complemented by a strategically vital port, has been the joint venture of Rizian, Morellan, Lespian, and Valgsland state corporations since the pre-revolutionary era. Yet, the recent ascension of Alma Saltana to the premiership of Morella has sparked a seismic shift in this arrangement. 

With staunch backing from Valgsland, Prime Minister Saltana has declared intentions to nationalize the mines and port, a move that potentially upends the status quo and alters the trajectory of the region's economic future. This move directly challenges the interests of Rizian Royal Gold and by extension, King Romus Toras of Rizia.

The announcement drew immediate attention from Lespia's Prime Minister Alvarez, an ATO stalwart, who firmly expressed his commitment to maintaining the current free market practices, heightening the tension between the two blocs.

name: Turn04_CSP_UCLaunchSatellite
title: United Contana Launches Second Satellite
description:
In a significant technological milestone, United Contana has successfully launched a second satellite capable of facilitating radio communications. This development catapults United Contana to the forefront of space-based communication technology, enabling radio signals to be transmitted via satellite for the first time. 

No other nation currently possesses this advanced capability, marking a significant achievement for United Contana.

name: Turn04_Derdia_Decision_GolcondistPilgrimsPlavo_DeportDerdia
title: Derdia Condemns Deportation Of Golcondist Pilgrims
description: Derdia officially condemns our country’s decision to deport the Golcondists pilgrims occupying Plavo sanctuary to their country, calling it an “unprecedented attack on religious rights”.

name: Turn04_Deyr_BFFBombPolice
title: BFF Bombs Police Station
description: In a treacherous attack, the BFF has bombed a police station in Deyr. Initial casualties are reported at 3 officers dead and 22 injured. The perpetrators have escaped into the Gumren mountains near Uziren, and a search was started to bring them to justice. The Border Guard has been notified of the attackers in case they try to flee to Wehlen. The Workers Party of Bludia condemned the incident.

name: Turn04_Deyr_GolcondistViolence
title: Golcondist Violence in Deyr
description: There have been several incidents of religious violence committed by Bludish Golcondists in Deyr. The attacks targeted members of other religious groups, resulting in injuries and property damage. The situation is concerning and warrants immediate attention from law enforcement and government officials. It is recommended that measures be taken to prevent future incidents and to address the root causes of the violence.

name: Turn04_Deyr_LockdownAfterArrest
title: Deyr Under Lockdown After Arrest of WPB Leader
description: After the arrest of Fetih Ejall, the leader of the WPB, the Bludish populace has been rioting in Deyr, calling for an end to the unfair emergency decree. In the following protests 6 people were killed and 264 people were injured. The police moved into the city of Deyr which has now been placed under lockdown. All WPB party headquarters were raided and its members were arrested to answer for the terrorism charges.

name: Turn04_Erlory_GiraltUnveilsWine
title: Giralt Unveils Newest Wine and Sends Message
description:
The famed Dandelion label of Erlory, rooted in the rich viticulture legacy of Giralt of Ribery, has introduced a new wine to its esteemed collection. Mr. Haute-Bellasorde has sent a fine selection to the Maroon Palace and wrote a little note to accompany it.

"Wine, like politics, operates not on a scale of lesser or greater, but on a spectrum of nuanced complexity. The distinctions are subjective, the flavors as variable as policy decisions. As a winemaker studies the subtle notes in each grape, a politician must examine the unique shades of each strategy. If I'm to choose between one vintage and another, between one policy and another, I'd rather not choose at all, but rather, appreciate and comprehend the intricate interplay each presents. After all, the art of winemaking, and indeed politics, lies not in forced choices but in understanding and celebrating the subtle complexities inherent within."

This latest addition is expected to uphold the characteristic floral tones, depth, and elegance that Dandelion wines are cherished for.  Wine connoisseurs and industry experts await the opportunity to savour this new vintage, and its potential influence on the Sordish wine industry is a topic of considerable interest.

name: Turn04_Erzaren_BFFPriests
title: Massive Network of BFF Priests Discovered
description:
Bergian Special Zone Security has reported the discovery of a large-scale religious network of the BFF that encompasses all cities in Bergia. Under the guise of state-sanctioned priesthood, the BFF has recruited hundreds and possibly thousands of Golcondist worshippers to join the militant group and converted hundreds of Nurity worshippers to the sect of Golcondism.

A dozen arrests were made but since most police officers don't speak Bludish it will be difficult to find the actual ring leader priests of the network. Many requests were made to ban Bludish as a language from sanctuaries. Governor Bron also requested Golcondism to be banned as a religion.

name: Turn04_Erzaren_BFFSchool
title: Bludish Freedom Front Using Schools To Recruit And Train Militants
description:
A school in Erzaren was discovered to be acting as a hidden facility of the Bludish Freedom Front, where they employed methods of Bludish nationalist propaganda and military training. It is suspected that the BFF has been using rural schools all around Bergia to recruit and train students for their cause. These operations are often hidden and occur mainly in areas with a majority Bludish population, where schools opt for using the Bludish language over Sordish. Many of these communities tend to struggle with the Sordish language and become easier targets for the BFF.

The situation is concerning, as it involves the indoctrination and recruitment of young individuals into a violent and extremist organization. It is recommended that the government take immediate action to prevent the Bludish Freedom Front from using schools as a tool for their recruitment efforts.

name: Turn04_FortAles_NavyDeployed
title: Navy Deployed to Aureus Gas Field
description: By royal order, six ships from the Rizian Royal Navy have been deployed from the Fort Ales harbor to the area around the Aureus gas field, which we have determined lies in both Rizian and Palesian waters. The officers on board have been instructed to block any Palesian vessels from entering the field, using Caleqabiz as a base to refuel and refresh their supplies.

name: Turn04_Gelsord_IllegalAssemblyArrest
title: 359 Arrested at Illegal Assembly
description: Thousands of railway construction workers from Taurus Holding went on strike at Gelsord today to protest the veto of the workers' rights bill. They violated the suspension of protests and disrupted progress on the L-1 Railway. Riot police immediately intervened and arrested 359, after a massive clash in which dozens were wounded. The situation at the site caused massive damage to the equipment.

name: Turn04_Gelsord_L1Strike
title: L-1 Workers On Strike
description: Thousands of railway construction workers from Taurus Holding went on strike at Gelsord today disrupting progress on the L-1 Railway project. The management board of Taurus reported that they have lost control. The workers, many of whom were wearing Labour Union flags, petitioned for better working conditions and for a raise of the minimum wage. Dozens were seen holding slogans against the recent veto.
