Police have arrived on site to act if necessary.

name: Turn04_GRACE_CondemsTradeDecline
title: GRACE Condemns Trade Decline
description: GRACE is concerned with the recent downturn in trade with the Kingdom of Rizia. We are actively seeking to identify the causes of this decline and are dedicated to implementing measures to rectify this situation. Our aim is to restore and elevate our trade relations with Rizia, reinforcing our commitment to economic cooperation and mutual success.

name: Turn04_Holsord_AFFoundationThanks
title: Alphonso Foundation Acknowledges Presidential Donation
description: The Alphonso Foundation has publicly expressed gratitude for a sizable donation from the President. This contribution bolsters the foundation's multifaceted efforts to combat homelessness and income inequality. The influx of funds is a boon to the foundation's resource pool and promises to facilitate the expansion of its existing projects and future initiatives.

name: Turn04_Holsord_ArcasiaEmbargo
title: Arcasia Embargo Begins
description:
The embargo on Arcasia has come into full effect. A massive convoy of 1158 trucks accumulated at the Sodord Border Crossing close to Valgen when the border officials shut the gates. Nearly eighty percent of Arcasian trade was previously conducted through this area. Meanwhile 4507 Arcasian citizens were denied entry to the country at customs areas.

Massive economic disruptions occurred in the Gruni region. President Walker sent a direct message to the administration highlighting that this action was a grave mistake.

name: Turn04_Holsord_CommendationGeneralStaff
title: General Staff Commends The Administration
description:
The general staff convened at Camp Strongarm. A session much shorter than usual concluded with a positive military analysis of Sordland's field capabilities. The Chief of the Armed Forces Valken Kruger, made a public press statement praising the administration and its efforts to strengthen the most important branch of the government, the military.

All staff generals co-signed a letter of support to the Rayne administration.

name: Turn04_Holsord_CondemnationGeneralStaff
title: General Staff Condemns The Administration
description:
The general staff convened at Camp Strongarm. A session much longer than usual concluded with a disastrous military analysis of Sordland's field capabilities. The Chief of the Armed Forces Valken Kruger, made a public press statement condemning the administration and its efforts to weaken the most important branch of the government, the military.

All staff generals co-signed a letter of condemnation to the Rayne administration.

name: Turn04_Holsord_ConstructionFixed
title: Construction Problems Fixed
description: The Sordish State Corporation has sent a positive report outlining that the safety issues slowing down the construction have been solved due to the allocation of new funds. The doubled machinery and workers helped the SSC get back on track to finish the project on time. The Ministry of Economy also confirmed the statement.

name: Turn04_Holsord_CustodyAfterProtest
title: 3684 Were Taken Into Custody After Unlawfully Protesting
description: Over the weekend, we have taken 3684 citizens in police custody for protesting unlawfully after the passing of the emergency decree. Out of the 3684, 134 have been arrested and charged. The interrogations are still underway to learn if they have memberships to any known organisations.

name: Turn04_Holsord_DecreasedPoliceBudget
title: Decreased Police Budget Left Police Overwhelmed
description: Recent decreases in the police budget has left many police headquarters all over the country overwhelmed against the recent protests. They simply do not have enough supplies to handle the riots. A help request was raised from almost every city and we are unable to provide the required supplies.

name: Turn04_Holsord_DismissedForLinks
title: 2660 Dismissed For Links To Terrorist Groups
description: This week, 2660 state employees were sacked for alleged links to terrorist groups under the emergency decree.

name: Turn04_Holsord_EducationReformStart
title: Ministry of Education Has Started Work On Education Reform
description: Minister of Education Ciara Walda is reporting that she has begun working on the approved education reform. The details of the education reform will be finalised over the upcoming months. If the reform package is accepted, the next steps of this process would be to discuss the indoctrination of education.

name: Turn04_Holsord_IncreasedPoliceBudget
title: Increased Police Budget Restores Stability
description: Recent increases in the police budget has helped the police forces tremendously in dealing with protests all over the country. Arrests are being made swiftly and quickly while protecting the population. With the current forecast, we are expecting everything to return to normalcy very soon.

name: Turn04_Holsord_RumburgEmbargo
title: Embargo on Rumburg Enacted
description:
The embargo on Rumburg has come into full effect. Thousands of citizens with Rumburgian nationality are being rejected at the customs areas from all points of entry. Trade between our two nations has virtually ceased.

Trains with cargo are lining up at the Albrecht Border Crossing north of Estord with several hundred thousand tons of goods unable to cross for delivery on either side of the border. Tensions are rising because oil, coal, and gas shipments bound to Rumburg were denied passage by border officials.

The Rumburg ambassador called the action an act of escalation towards war.

name: Turn04_Holsord_SSCPromised
title: SSC Promised To Deliver
description: The official warning from the Presidency and the Ministry of Economy was received by the Sordish State Corporation. The chairman of the managers has apologised for the current situation but highlighted that rushing the work would risk real lives. The entire board signed a letter promising to meet the deadlines earlier outlined.

name: Turn04_Holsord_SSCReplaced
title: SSC Managers Replaced
description: After the recent order from the Ministry of Economy, the Sordish State Corporation has reshuffled their entire managerial board with new experts suggested by Minister Holl. The new managers are getting used to their positions and have indicated that they will do their best to meet current deadlines.

name: Turn04_Holsord_UnitedContanaEmbargo
title: United Contana Embargoed
description:
The embargo on United Contana has come into full effect. Our mutual trade has stopped and travellers with Contanan nationality are being denied entry into Sordland from all airports, sea ports, and border crossings. The port of Lachaven has denied 58 cargo ships from docking and unloading since the embargo began. The gulf is filled with Contanan trade ships that have anchored. This led to a major disruption of goods in Lachaven and Sordland in general.

The Embassy of United Contana made a condemning declaration calling unilateral actions like this a threat to world peace.

name: Turn04_Iza_SOMembersExtradited
title: Su Omina Suspects Extradited
description: Two members of Su Omina, Anderius Extalde and Cristo Bidegain, were extradited to Wehlen after confessing to their involvement in the Friendship Day bombing that killed three Wehzek civilians last year. The handover took place at the Zille border under the supervision of Duke Rico Toras and Wehlen's own security forces. It is not yet known the extent of questioning they will face or what fate awaits them.

name: Turn04_Kyrute_ArbitrationBegins
title: Gas Field Arbitration Process Begins At AN
description: Following our agreement with Pales, the Alliance of Nations is set to begin the arbitration process to determine ownership of the Aureus gas field. The process will be conducted by a panel of international law experts, including maritime law specialists. The panel is set to convene next month in Kyrute and is expected to carry out a rigorous examination of claims from all parties involved.

name: Turn04_Lachaven_CrackdownTeachersStrike
title: Crack Down on Teachers Strike
description:
The teacher's union went on a large strike today at Republic Avenue in Lachaven to declare their opposition to the reduction in the education budget. Many displayed worry for their salaries and positions even though a suspension of protests was in place.

Riot police cracked down on the group immediately leaving several wounded. The strike ended the same day. Minister Walda gave an official statement that the strikers had a right to make their point but at home and that she is equally saddened by the developments.

name: Turn04_Lachaven_GasomBoomsHires100
title: Gasom Resumes Hiring
description: Gasom, Lachaven's local energy giant, has resumed its hiring operations after several months of pause. The company recently welcomed a hundred new employees to its workforce, signaling a potential recovery phase after an extended hiring freeze. With the latest additions, Gasom looks set to rejuvenate its operations and drive towards a more robust performance in the upcoming months.

name: Turn04_Lachaven_GasomDownsizes
title: Downsizing Announced at Gasom
description: A significant shift in workforce dynamics has been announced at Gasom's Lachaven branch. In a strategic move, the energy company has declared its plan for downsizing. While this action aims at boosting the operational efficiency of the organization, it has created an atmosphere of uncertainty among the existing workforce. The effects of this decision on the local economy and Gasom's future course of action are being keenly observed.

name: Turn04_Lachaven_HighBudget
title: Central Bank Releases Incentivizing Statement
description:
The Central Bank of Sordland issued an encouraging statement regarding the extensive government budget surplus that has accumulated in the first year of the administration.

The potential consequences of a lack of investments were highlighted. Edith Agnoc relayed that a large surplus should be utilized in further expenditures to increase the strength of the currency and the drive the recovery of the economy.

name: Turn04_Lachaven_LabourViolatesCurfew
title: Labour Union of Sordland Rally Violates Curfew
description: The rally organised by the Labour Union of Sordland in Lachaven has violated the curfew law and was disrupted by local police. MP Katarina Horten was the leader of the protests and after a brief scuffle with the police, she was released.

name: Turn04_Lachaven_NegativeBudget
title: Central Bank Issues Budget Deficit Warning
description:
The Central Bank of Sordland issued a warning regarding the extensive government budget deficit that has occurred in the first year of the administration.

The potential consequences of irresponsible economic management were highlighted. Edith Agnoc relayed that a large deficit could have dire consequences on the strength of the currency and the hamper the potential of the still to recover economy.

name: Turn04_Lachaven_TeachersStrike
title: Teachers Strike
description:
The teacher's union went on a large strike today at Republic Avenue in Lachaven to declare their opposition to the reduction in the education budget. Many displayed worry for their salaries and positions. Some even brought their children and partners in solidarity.

Minister Walda gave an official statement that the strikers had a right to make their point and that she is equally saddened by the developments.

name: Turn04_Lachaven_VeryNegativeBudget
title: Central Bank Releases Strong Budget Deficit Warning
description:
The Central Bank of Sordland issued a damning warning regarding the extensive government budget deficit that has occurred in the first year of the administration.

The potential consequences of irresponsible economic management were highlighted. Edith Agnoc relayed that a large deficit could have dire consequences on the strength of the currency and could hamper the potential of the still-to-recover economy.

name: Turn04_Lachaven_YSArrest
title: Young Sords Members Arrested and Face Terrorism Charges
description: 6 terrorists from Young Sords plotting to bomb a rally were caught by Lachaven police. The perpetrators confessed to their plans and said they did it in response to the ban on Young Sords. They have each been convicted and sentenced to 154 years in prison for planning a terrorist attack on the people of Sordland and for treason against Sordland.

name: Turn04_Laren_DetainedOrganisingRally
title: 16 Students Detained For Organising Rally
description: 16 students plotting to organise a rally have been arrested by the police and taken into solitary confinement. Due to the removal of the trial process, the arrests are being made much faster and we have been able to suppress the protests quickly and decisively.

name: Turn04_Laren_MilitaryOutdated
title: Military Equipment Outdated
description: The General Staff has performed an analysis on our borders to assess our military defense capabilities against a potential Rumburg attack. The results show that our military equipment is outdated and needs replacement as soon as possible. The continuation of the worrying report shows that in the event of an attack our border would be broken through easily, leaving the primary regions of Sordland exposed.

name: Turn04_Lenkurg_H3Strike
title: H-3 Workers On Strike
description: Thousands of railway construction workers from Taurus Holding went on strike at Lenkurg today disrupting progress on the H-3 Highway project. The management board of Taurus reported that they have lost control. The workers, many of whom were wearing Labour Union flags, petitioned for better working conditions and for a raise of the minimum wage. Dozens were seen holding slogans against the recent veto. Police have arrived on site to act if necessary.

name: Turn04_Lenkurg_IllegalAssemblyArrest
title: 436 Arrested at Illegal Assembly
description: Thousands of railway construction workers from Taurus Holding went on strike at Lenkurg today to protest the veto of the workers' rights bill. They violated the suspension of protests and disrupted progress on the H-3 Highway. Riot police immediately intervened and arrested 436, after a massive clash in which dozens were wounded. The situation at the site caused massive damage to the equipment.

name: Turn04_Lenkurg_PoliceBrutalityArrest
title: Protesters protesting against police brutality arrested
description: The civil protest happening in Lenkurg against police brutality has been broken up by the police with relative ease thanks to the increased police authority laws. Water cannons have been deployed and tear gas guns were supplied to the police force which resulted in a prompt suppression.

name: Turn04_Lespia_CondemnsRiziaEnergy
title: Lespia Condemns Rizia's Energy Alliance
description:
In a recent public statement, Prime Minister Patricio Alvarez voiced stern condemnation of Rizia's cooperative energy agreement with Sordland. Alvarez argued that the partnership undermines Lespia's energy industry, and specifically raised concerns about LesPower's stake in the region's energy market. 

The Prime Minister also drew attention to ongoing disagreements between Lespia and Rizia over maritime borders, warning that the energy deal could further exacerbate these issues.

name: Turn04_Monqiz_Decision_VendonesamAidRequest_Energy
title: Shipments Of Gas Leave For Vendonesam
description: The natural gas promised to Vendonesam’s Prince Consort Kabauen Sang Tam has left the harbor of Monqiz, sealing the commitment of our Kingdom to international solidarity in the face of great challenges against established fellow monarchies.

name: Turn04_Monqiz_Decision_VendonesamAidRequest_Equipment
title: Weaponry Departs For Vendonesam
description: The arms promised to Vendonesam’s Prince Consort Kabauen Sang Tam have left the harbor of Monqiz, sealing the commitment of our Kingdom to international solidarity in the face of great challenges against established fellow monarchies.

name: Turn04_Monqiz_Decision_VendonesamAidRequest_Financial
title: King Promises Financial Support To Vendonesam
description: At a private event in Monqiz with representatives of Prince Consort Kabauen Sang Tam’s Confederacy, King Romus has promised that Rizia will provide financial aid to the country, sealing the commitment of our Kingdom to international solidarity in the face of great challenges against established fellow monarchies.

name: Turn04_Monqiz_Decision_WelfareProtest_Dispersed
title: Scores Injured During Protest
description: After orders to disperse the welfare protest at the Monqiz Palace gates, mounted local police charged into the crowd, violently dispersing the thousands of people that gathered there. The protest was quickly dispersed, but local hospitals reported a worrying number of injuries as people were trampled by police horses, calling it a surprise no one died during the charge.

name: Turn04_Monqiz_Decision_WelfareProtest_Peaceful
title: Protest At Palace Gates
description: Thousands of protesters gathered outside the Monqiz Palace, complaining about the state of our welfare system. After rousing speeches by local community leaders, the crowd slowly started to dissipate, with the protest over by the early evening.

name: Turn04_Monqiz_WineExport
title: Monqiz Grapples with Rising Tourism and Trade Demands
description:
The governor of Monqiz faces new challenges as it becomes the epicenter of Rizia's surging trade exports and tourist arrivals. The influx of visitors, especially from Sordland, and the burgeoning wine trade have brought economic growth but also concerns over cultural and environmental impacts. 

The situation is particularly strained in the entertainment district, where the blend of local tradition and foreign influence is most palpable. As Monqiz navigates these waters, balancing its historic role as a trade hub with its modern identity is proving to be a complex task.

name: Turn04_Morella_Decision_GolcondistPilgrimsPlavo_DeportMorella
title: Morella Condemns Deportation Of Golcondist Pilgrims
description: Morella officially condemns our country’s decision to deport the Golcondists pilgrims occupying Plavo sanctuary to their country, claiming “we are not responsible for cleaning up Rizia’s heartless policy”.

name: Turn04_Morella_Decision_RRGStakeChangeIncrease
title: Morella Sends Congratulations For Taking Control Of Natural Resources
description: When asked during a press conference, Morella’s Prime Minister Alma Saltana said she welcomes Rizia’s decision to take control over a larger part of its Royal Gold Corporation. She reiterated her government’s position that countries should be in control of their own natural riches, which should in her view never be owned by either capital nor foreign power.

name: Turn04_Morella_FlyingObjectSpotted
title: Unidentified Object Spotted Close to Qinali Border
description:
Security agencies in Morella have reported sighting an unidentified object close to the Qinali border. The object was flying at high altitude and at very high speeds. Currently, there is no clarity on what the object could be or its potential implications. Some intelligence officers indicated that the sighting could be a potential CSP low orbit satellite. 

The Morellan authorities are working with their Qinali counterparts to investigate the matter further.

name: Turn04_Narbel_EducationImprovements
title: Education in Rural Regions Require Improvements
description: Ciara Walda reports that the current education institutions in rural regions of Sordland have been largely neglected. As part of her analysis, the literacy rate in Sordland currently stands at 80% while rural regions like Narbel has a literacy rate of only 64%. The lack of schools per capita also reflects these results.

name: Turn04_Pales_GasClaim
title: Pales To Send Ship to Newly Surveyed Gas Field
description: We have received an urgent briefing that Pales has laid claim to the newly discovered gas field between the Rizian island of Caleqabiz and the Palesian peninsula. A ship is currently being outfitted in Remaz and is set to begin exploratory drilling in the next several days.

name: Turn04_Pales_NavyWithdrawn
title: Navy Withdrawn
description:
In a move signaling a de-escalation of tensions, we have ordered the withdrawal of Rizian naval forces from the Aureus gas field in the Antacean Sea. The decision was announced earlier today in an official statement issued by Palas Rezna.

It remains to be seen how Lespia and Pales will respond to this development. Our government will be closely monitoring the situation.

name: Turn04_Pales_PalesianNavySent
title: Pales Sends Navy to Aureus Field
description: Following our refusal to withdraw the Rizian navy from the borders of the Aureus gas field, Duke Reinhart has sent an equal number of Palesian naval reinforcements to patrol the vicinity. Our deployed officers warn of potential escalation.

name: Turn04_Pales_PipelineBegins_QuarterField
title: Construction To Begin on Aureus Field Pipeline
description: Following our agreement with Patricio Alvarez, preliminary construction has begun on a pipeline from the western quadrant of the Aureus natural gas field to mainland Rizia. Once the exact terms and details for our exploration rights deal have been finalized, it is expected that drilling and energy delivery will be able to commence immediately.

name: Turn04_Pales_PipelineBegins_WholeField
title: Construction To Begin on Aureus Field Pipeline
description: Following our agreement with Duke Reinhart, preliminary construction has begun on a pipeline from the Aureus natural gas field to mainland Rizia. Once the exact terms and details for our exploration rights deal have been finalized, it is expected that drilling and energy delivery will be able to commence immediately.

name: Turn04_Plavo_Decision_GolcondistPilgrimsPlavo_Deported
title: Clashes As Police Clears Sanctuary
description: Fighting broke out as the police cleared the Plavo sanctuary of the Golcondist worshippers that occupied it. While the riot didn’t last long, minor damage was inflicted on the sanctuary and several police officers were injured.

name: Turn04_Plavo_Decision_GolcondistPilgrimsPlavo_Stay
title: Sanctuary Wing Converted Into Sleeping Quarters
description: To accommodate the Golcondists pilgrims occupying the Plavo sanctuary, authorities have converted a less-used wing of the complex into temporary living space for the pilgrims. While some of the local Wruhecist community issued mild complaints, overall it would seem all religious communities prefer a peaceful solution over a violent eviction.

name: Turn04_PorteDrazon_Arbitration_Canceled
title: AN Arbitration Canceled
description: Following our conversation with Patricio Alvarez, the Alliance of Nations arbitration committee has been informed that it will no longer be needed to assist with the Aureus gas field ownership dispute. A deal is being worked out for Rizia to gain exploration rights to one quadrant of the field, with Lespia purchasing the main share from Pales.

name: Turn04_PorteDrazon_BFFUnmasked
title: Derdian Golcondist Communities Sheltering BFF?
description: Internal security forces have informed us that Rizia's Derdian communities may be harboring fugitives from the Bludish Freedom Front in Wehlen. As Wiktor Smolak's government cracks down on the separatist movement, an increasing number of Bluds are fleeing to Derdia, and from there to Rizia via the Sallabes harbor. Our security forces will monitor the situation closely as it develops.

name: Turn04_PorteDrazon_ELM_AnimalWelfare
title: ELM Initiative Gains Traction in the Capital
description:
The recent launch of the Every Life Matters initiative by Duchess Leona Sazon is beginning to reshape public spaces in Porte Drazon. Small wooden shelters for cats and dogs have appeared across streets, marketplaces and parks, alongside feeding stations maintained by local volunteers.

Officials say the ELM initiative may soon extend beyond stray animal care, with plans to support wildlife protection programs already under discussion.

name: Turn04_PorteDrazon_HousingCrisisWorsens
title: Average Rent Doubling Every 18 Months
description: The average rent per square meter in the Rizian capital is skyrocketing rapidly, with experts estimating a doubling every 18 months with no sign of slowing down. Not only are prices on the rise, a severe lack of housing stock due to the deadly combination of the city's growing population with market speculation has resulted in the average search time for new apartments approaching almost 8 months.

name: Turn04_PorteDrazon_SellField_Agreement
title: Rizia, Pales To Begin Drafting Gas Field Rights Transfer Agreement
description: Following our discussion with Duke Axel Reinhart, the economic ministries of the Kingdom of Rizia and the Grand Duchy of Pales are to begin drafting an agreement regarding the Aureus Gas Field. Pales will retain ownership of the field, while Rizia will have exclusive exploration rights. The King and the Grand Duke will have the opportunity to review the agreement in the coming months.

name: Turn04_PorteDrazon_SellField_Reneged
title: Deal With Duke Reinhart Canceled
description: Duke Axel Reinhart has been informed of our decision to back out of our purchase of the entire exploration rights to the Aureus natural gas field. It is expected that Pales will proceed with the sale of the rights to Lespia, with Rizia being permitted to drill in one quarter of the area.

name: Turn04_Qalus_CantuavoInvitation
title: Cantuavo Family Sends Official Invitation To Uncorking of 'Romus The Red'
description: Lord Eduard and Lady Sephina Cantuavo have officially invited the entire Rizian royal family and council to attend the uncorking ceremony for their coronation wine, Romus the Red. Harvested and bottled in honor of the king, it is to be sampled for the first time at the Cantuavo vineyards in Qalus. A number of suites in the vineyard's luxury villa have also been reserved for us for the occasion.

name: Turn04_Qalus_Decision_PublicTransportationWeak
title: Vital Rail Link Fails
description: Due to a technical issue affecting a vital railroad switch near Qalus, train traffic between Porte Drazon and Monqiz has been cut. While the issue is likely to be resolved within a few days, the closure of the vital railway is affecting not just passenger traffic but also the transport of goods between Monqiz’s harbor and the rest of the country.

name: Turn04_Rizia_HailsEnergyCooperation
title: Rizia Hails Energy Collaboration Success
description: Following the successful joint investment in Gasom, King Romus praised the initiative as a model of regional cooperation. He emphasized its potential to inspire future partnerships aimed at achieving mutual economic growth. The King also expressed confidence in the continued expansion of ROG and the sustainability of this collaborative approach to energy investments.

name: Turn04_Rumburg_Decision_GraceTradeWeakens
title: Rumburg Tries To Reassure GRACE Members
description: The Rumburgian Crown sent out a communique to all GRACE members, assuring that the recent decrease in trade volume is temporary and that member states of the organization should not worry and continue to trade as usual.

name: Turn04_Rumburg_QueenThreat
title: Queen Beatrice Livingston Calls Sordland a Threat to World Peace
description:
Queen Beatrice Livingston appeared on TV to call Sordland not just a threat to peace in Eastern Merkopa but a threat to peace in the entire world.

She has also publicly condemned President Anton Rayne’s new policies and also she expressed her worries about the direction Sordland is headed. She urged the Rumburgian Army to secure the southern border, citing violent incidents in northern Sordland.

name: Turn04_Rumburg_QueenThreat2
title: Queen Beatrice Livingston Calls Sordland a Threat to World Peace
description:
Queen Beatrice Livingston appeared on TV to call Sordland not just a threat to peace in Eastern Merkopa but a threat to peace in the entire world. She condemned the riots and police violence in Sordland, also expressing her worries about the direction Sordland is headed.

She urged the Rumburgian Army to secure the southern border, citing violent incidents in northern Sordland.

name: Turn04_Sarna_SurveillanceArrest
title: Mass surveillance resulted in 1984 arrests
description: The Sordish Intelligence Agency reports that the new surveillance laws have provided the possibility to stop protester gatherings before they even started. Results were extraordinary and it allowed 1984 dissidents posing a danger to Sordland to be arrested in recent days alone.

name: Turn04_Sordland_Decision_SordlandOffersInvestment_Accept
title: Sordland Prepares To Host King Romus
description: After we agreed to attend talks in Holsord regarding a lucrative investment opportunity, the Sordish capital now hurryingly prepares itself to host our King. Reportedly, the former Royal Quarters in the Maroon Palace are now to house royalty once more, even if only for a few days.

name: Turn04_Topes_SordishTourists
title: Sordish Tourists Disrupt Ancient Topes Site
description:
A group of tourists from Sordland caused a disturbance at the ancient Rezenid excavation site in Topes. The tourists, reportedly ignoring guidelines, ventured into restricted areas, damaging some recently unearthed artifacts. Local authorities have detained the individuals involved, and the incident has prompted calls for stricter enforcement of heritage site regulations. 

The city council is considering implementing mandatory guided tours for foreigners to protect the site's integrity and educational value.

name: Turn04_Valenqir_ClimateConference
title: Regional Environmental Conference Held in Valenqiris
description:
Valenqiris recently hosted a prestigious regional environmental conference organized by Duke Hubertus Toras. The event brought together scientists, researchers, and journalists from around the world to discuss conservation, land preservation, and sustainable resource management.

During the conference, Duke Hubertus gave a presentation on the underwater current he discovered in 1930. 

To conclude the event, Duke Hubertus welcomed guests to the renowned Grand Valenqir Hotel, known for its luxurious amenities and iconic casino, providing a fitting end to the conference.

name: Turn04_Valenqir_Decision_XinaConflictEndsEnergyDrops_Penalty_ExportQuotas
title: ROG Adjusts Distribution Amid Export Quotas
description:
Following the Crown’s imposition of temporary export quotas, Rizian Oil and Gas has begun adjusting its operations to stabilize domestic supply. With reduced shipments leaving Valenqiris’ coastal terminals, ROG has rerouted refined stock to inland depots and fuel stations across the Kingdom.

Spokespersons describe the move as “preventative, not reactionary,” aimed at shielding Rizian households from external volatility. While ROG's leadership signals confidence, analysts suggest long-term impacts on international contracts may depend on how quickly global markets rebound.

name: Turn04_Valgen_GruniRuralDev
title: Gruni Rural Development Plan Nears Completion
description: The Gruni Rural Development Plan, a brainchild of Rural Development Minister Gus Manger, is nearing completion in Holsord. This strategy aims to revitalize the rural economy, fortify food security, and enhance the regional economy of Gruni. The upcoming presentation of the finalized plan marks a significant milestone in the evolution of Sordland's rural development agenda.

name: Turn04_Wehlen_Decision_WehlenIntelligence_Cooperate
title: Wehlen Thanks Us For Cooperation
description: Wehzek authorities have extended their gratitude to their Rizian counterparts for agreeing to cooperate on the Zille bombing investigation, calling it ‘an important sign of goodwill from the Rizian side’.

name: Turn04_Wehlen_Decision_WehlenIntelligence_DontCooperate
title: Wehlen Denounces Refusal To Cooperate
description: Wehzek authorities have called our country’s refusal to cooperate with them on the Zille bombing investigation a “hostile move, signaling a lack of trust and respect for our people”. They continued by promising that the Wehzek investigation shall be successful in finding the culprits, even without Rizian help.

name: Turn04_Zille_ATAProtest
title: Ariana Toras Association Leads Peaceful Protests Against Wehlen's AN Decision
description: In the weeks since Wiktor Smolak's AN announcement, the Zille branch of the Ariana Toras Association has spearheaded a number of peaceful demonstrations, meant to show the Wehlen government that the citizens of Zille want to be Rizian once more. The association's spokesperson has vowed the demonstrations will continue until Zille is returned.

name: Turn04_Zille_LargeGatheringBan
title: Large Gatherings In Zille Prohibited
description: As part of increasingly tight security measures, public gatherings of over 50 people are now prohibited in the region of Zille. While critics see this as a restriction of voices calling for a return of the region to Rizia, officials have guaranteed Rizia that the measures are merely intended to increase the safety of both Rizian and Wehzeks living in the region.

name: Turn04_Zille_SOProtest
title: Violent Protests Break Out In Zille
description: In the weeks since Wiktor Smolak's AN announcement, violent demonstrations and police altercations have broken out in towns across the Zille region, meant to intimidate the Wehlen government into returning Zille. It is suspected that Su Omina may be involved in at least some of these events.

name: Turn04_Zille_TravelRestrictions
title: Wehlen Restricts Access To Zille Region
description: Wehlen has reduced travel access to the disputed Zille region, making it particularly hard for non-Wehzek citizens to visit the region. Local officials have cited security and risk of further terror attacks as reasons for this temporary measure.

name: Turn05_Anrica_LesteResign
title: Curtan Leste Switches To NFP
description: The Mayor of Anrica, Curtain Leste, has recently resigned from the United Sordland Party and joined the National Front Party. Until the next local elections, the city of Anrica will continue as a NFP municipality.

name: Turn05_Anrica_YSRaided
title: Young Sords Militants Arrested
description: The Anrica Police Force has organized a raid today after reports from the Sordish Intelligence Directorate about suspected Young Sords activity in Anrica. The police were ambushed during their raid of the suspected building. In the firefight that broke out, four militants were killed and ten more have been arrested in the aftermath. Unfortunately, an officer was also killed during the fighting.

name: Turn05_Anrica_YSRaided_Fail
title: False Alarm
description: The Anrica Police Force has organized a raid today after reports from the Sordish Intelligence Directorate about suspected Young Sords activity in Anrica. During their raid, a resident of the building was killed. The police did not uncover any evidence of connections to Young Sords. The resident who was killed was identified as a 72-year-old retired man, and the officers apologized for the accident.

name: Turn05_ATO_ArcasiaCondemnsAid
title: Condemnation from Arcasia
description: Arcasia has publicly criticized the recent financial agreement between Sordland and United Contana. President Walker accused President Rayne of enabling the CSP's interference in Eastern Merkopan affairs. The Arcasian president has pledged to protect the interests of the ATO, asserting his readiness to counter any perceived encroachment of Malenyevism.

name: Turn05_ATO_CritiquesTradeWar
title: ATO Advocates for Resolution Amid Tensions in Gulf of Rika
description:
In a rapidly evolving political landscape, the Gulf of Rika has emerged as a significant focal point for global attention. With the recent changes in Nibiya's leadership resulting in a shift towards a more nationalist government, tensions between the Arcasian 3rd Fleet and the United Contanan Rika Fleet have escalated.

Unfortunately, United Contana's decision to enact a blockade in the Gulf, an essential conduit for worldwide commerce, has led to a significant ripple effect on the global trade scenario. The imposition of tariffs and embargos, from both sides, raises concerns over the potential initiation of a disruptive trade war. 

ATO is actively working towards facilitating a diplomatic dialogue to ensure a swift and peaceful resolution, safeguarding global economic interests.

name: Turn05_ATO_LegalizesPMCs
title: ATO Embraces the New Paradigm: PMCs Legitimized
description:
The ATO has extended official recognition and legitimacy not only to Cerberus International and Palantor Security Solutions, but to all Private Military Companies. This decision marks a significant policy shift, acknowledging PMCs as instrumental to the future security strategy of the ATO member states. Private militaries now stand firmly in the global arena with the ATO's full endorsement, augmenting existing military resources and providing a new layer of strategic capabilities against potential challenges, most notably from the CSP.

The sanctioning of PMC activities has consequently reshaped the operational dynamics of these organizations, amplifying their roles in international security and conflict resolution. With this newfound recognition, PMCs are poised to operate within the mainstream security framework, demonstrating the ATO's adaptable, forward-thinking approach to defence policy.

name: Turn05_ATO_WarnsRiziaKingdom
title: ATO Brokers for Peace Amidst Rizian Claims, Lespia Mediates
description:
Amidst rising tensions triggered by Rizia's territorial claims over the Aureus gas field and the pressure exerted on Pales, the ATO has issued an advisory cautioning against potential disturbances in the region's stability. The advisory is coupled with the ATO's commitment to protect the interests of its member states, both economically and strategically. 

Lespia, a key ATO member and home to LesPower Corp – a significant player in the energy industry – is stepping in to mediate the dispute, seeking to avert a potentially destabilizing conflict over the lucrative gas field. The ATO's stance on this dispute, particularly given Lespia's involvement, highlights its readiness to protect its strategic interests and its capacity for diplomacy in managing regional tensions. 

This proactive diplomatic intervention and the economic stakes involved emphasize the importance of the Aureus gas field as an asset, underscoring its significance in maintaining geopolitical balance.

name: Turn05_Benfi_InfraAtCapacity
title: Infrastructure at Full Capacity in Benfi
description: The bustling city of Benfi is facing infrastructural challenges as its airport and port facilities are at full capacity due to high volumes of logistics and tourist travel. The situation is raising concerns over the ability to sustain the growing demand without causing delays and disruptions. Infrastructure expansion and modernization are being considered to resolve the issue.

name: Turn05_Benfi_RadicalEditorSuspect
title: Editor of Radical Is Suspected Of Helping Terrorists
description:
Sordish Intelligence reported that Jon Dandern, a famous journalist and columnist at the Radical, is suspected to be working for the terrorist organization, Red Youth.

According to the report, Dandern had continuously published anti-government articles and repeatedly attempted to report on state secrets countless times. Moreover, he has publicly endorsed Red Youth in the past and promoted Malenyevist ideals.

name: Turn05_Benievon_OdeToTorasFilm
title: Ode To Toras Film Wraps Up Production
description: As part of the efforts by the RNC to move beyond traditional campaigning methods, a new campaign film called ‘Ode To Toras’ has been produced over the last few weeks, the luscious hills of Benievon providing a scenic background. The film is expected to premiere in the final week leading up to the election and will be shown for free in cinemas across the country.

name: Turn05_Bronaz_RPPCampaignEnd
title: RPP Closes Campaign In Bronaz
description: With a colorful rally, the RPP closed their election campaign. The decision to close it in Bronaz is a testament to a creative and unique campaign, with the small city being chosen as its location on the border of Rizia Imperii and Brenas is highly symbolic.

name: Turn05_Conriat_UCBase
title: United Contanan Access To Conriat Base
description: Preparations began in Conriat Naval Base to expand the port and restructure the security of the naval base in order to welcome United Contanan ships in the short future. Contanan security and logistics professionals have already been welcomed to the base to work with Sordish officials.

name: Turn05_CSP_BansPMCs
title: CSP Asserts Sovereignty with PMC Ban
description:
The Contanan Security Pact has outlawed private military companies, prioritizing state-regulated forces and, as a secondary measure, citizen militias and revolutionaries to uphold security within its territories. The alliance emphasizes the state’s capacity and responsibility to secure its boundaries, viewing citizen militias as democratic assets when necessary, rather than relying on profit-driven military organizations.

The ban aims to maintain the rule of law within its territories and reinforce state sovereignty. By distinguishing between profit-driven military operations and the responsibilities of the state toward its citizens, the decision highlights the ideological differences from the Arcasian Treaty Organization.

name: Turn05_CSP_DefendsTradeWar
title: CSP Stands Firm on Gulf of Rika Blockade
description:
In the aftermath of the leadership transition in Nibiya, the United Contanan Rika Fleet was compelled to safeguard the Gulf of Rika, a move made necessary by the prevalent circumstances. It is imperative to understand this as not just a blockade but a statement against political interference and aggressive expansionism.

While the blockade may have resulted in temporary disruption of global trade, it is clear that Contana's steadfastness and commitment to maintaining regional stability is ever present. Despite the ensuing tariff and embargo tug-of-war, CSP stands united in its resolve to protect its member states' interests. 

The evolving geopolitical landscape in the Gulf of Rika carries substantial implications for the international order, and CSP continues to monitor the situation closely.

name: Turn05_CSP_UCCondemnsAid
title: Condemnation from United Contana
description: United Contana has voiced its disapproval of the financial accord between Sordland and Arcasia. Chairman Malenyev criticized President Rayne for inviting the ATO to meddle in the affairs of Eastern Merkopa. In a firm stance against perceived Arcasian imperialism, the chairman has vowed to defend the sphere of influence of the CSP.

name: Turn05_Derdia_DerdiaANSupport_Given
title: Supreme Wiseman To Support Us At AN
description: Derdia’s Supreme Wiseman, Jorga Azmal, has agreed to support our country at the upcoming Alliance of Nations arbitration surrounding the Aureus Gas Field. He also expressed his wishes that in the future cooperation between our two nations can increase.

name: Turn05_Derdia_DerdiaANSupport_Rejected
title: Supreme Wiseman Refuses To Support Us At AN
description: Derdia’s Supreme Wiseman, Jorga Azmal, has refused to support our country at the upcoming Alliance of Nations arbitration surrounding the Aureus Gas Field, citing cold relations between our two countries as the reason.

name: Turn05_Deyr_LockdownLifted
title: Lockdown Lifted
description:
The regional governor lifted the lockdown that was being imposed on the city of Deyr after the operations of the Sordish Police Forces against the Bludish terrorists were completed.

The police reports that more than 100 terrorists were killed, and 28500 people were detained for supporting or working with the terrorists. The operations of the Workers Party of Bludia is reported to be eliminated in the city. The Governor said he was confident that Deyr will return back to normal with great speed.

name: Turn05_Deyr_RegionalGrowthStagnates
title: Regional Growth Stagnates in Deyr
description: Bergia is witnessing a period of economic stagnation, with the regional growth rate flatlining. Industries and businesses across various sectors are reporting sluggish performance, affecting the city's economic vitality. This downturn has sparked concerns about the region's economic resilience and the need for innovative growth strategies.

name: Turn05_Deyr_SuspectedCooperators
title: Governor of Bergia Reports Hundreds of BFF Collaborators
description:
The governor of Bergia, Phelix Bron, suspects that hundreds of Bludish Freedom Front (BFF) collaborators are living inside Deyr, posing a significant threat to national security. 

To counter this threat, the governor has proposed a series of measures, including increased surveillance and intelligence gathering, as well as the deployment of additional security forces to the area. Due to the extra authority vested upon him as the governor of the Special Zone, some of these measures can be implemented by the governor inside Bergia without the approval of the central government.

The governor has also suggested that community members be encouraged to report any suspicious activities or individuals, and that the government offer incentives for information leading to the capture of BFF members. The proposed measures raise concerns about potential violations of civil liberties, and it is recommended that the government follow the actions of the governor closely and ensure that he does not violate his authority as the governor of the Special Zone.

name: Turn05_Deyr_WPBProtestBill
title: WPB Protests Bill
description: The Workers Party of Bludia spokesperson Ejall has condemned the decision to sign the Religious Harmony Bill and organized a huge rally in the city of Deyr to protest the newly signed law. The protest has pulled in thousands of people from many different political movements. Local police report that they are watching the situation closely and so far no attempts to incite violence have occurred.

name: Turn05_Erlory_ArcasianBase
title: Arcasian Access To Erlory Base
description: Preparations began in Erlory Air Force Base to expand the hangars and restructure the security of the air base in order to welcome Arcasian planes in the short future. Arcasian security and logistics professionals have already been welcomed to the base to work with Sordish officials.

name: Turn05_Erlory_JudgesStrike
title: Judges On Strike
description:
The leader of the bar associations and a large following of judges from different cities have gathered in front of the old Justice Palace in Erlory to protest the reduction of the Justice budget.

Minister Morgna has made an announcement that she is as worried as her fellow peers. The Ministry of Justice officially released a statement assuring all judges and justices that they will do their best to restructure without disruption.

name: Turn05_Erlory_StoppedJudgesStrike
title: Judges On Strike
description:
The leader of the bar associations and a large following of judges gathered in front of the old Justice Palace in Erlory to protest the reduction of the justice budget.

The Police Chief of Erlory requested the strikers to disperse or face forceful action and the judges and lawyers dispersed immediately. Minister Morgna has made an announcement that she is as worried as her fellow peers and hoped that no one was hurt. Following the incident, the Ministry of Justice officially released a statement assuring all judges and justices that they will do their best to restructure without disruption.

name: Turn05_Erzaren_PoliceReport
title: Police Report
description: The Bergian Security Forces report that 2600 citizens were taken into police custody over the weekend. Most of them are suspected to have close ties with the Bludish Freedom Front. The interrogations are still underway to learn if they have memberships to any terrorist groups.

name: Turn05_Erzaren_ReligiousRallyAgainstSordland
title: Golcondist Rally Against Sordland
description:
A recent religious rally by the Golcondists turned into a political demonstration against Sordland and its constitution. The rally, which was initially intended to be a peaceful gathering, quickly escalated into a protest against what the Golcondists see as an "unjust and evil government."

The sect's leaders have been actively promoting these views to their followers, who have been receptive to their message. The government is urged to monitor the activities of the Golcondists and take appropriate action to prevent further escalation of tensions and potential violence.

name: Turn05_Estord_ForeignEnergyInvestments
title: Estord Energy Sector Draws Foreign Investors
description: Estord's energy sector is experiencing a surge of foreign investments following the recent amendments to the Energy Protection Act. The relaxed regulations on foreign ownership have opened up new capital flows, bolstering the local energy industry. This influx of overseas capital offers promising prospects for economic growth in Estord.

name: Turn05_Estord_FormerBBBrigadierDead
title: Death of Former Black Battalion Brigadier General
description: In Estord, a former Brigadier General of the Black Battalion has been found dead. The cause of death is currently under investigation. The Brigadier General, who once held a significant position in the military establishment in the 1930s, had many followers from the NFP, and his sudden death has caused a stir in the city.

name: Turn05_Estord_GangViolenceIncreased
title: Gang Violence Increased Report
description:
The decrease of the police budget caused many police stations in the region to downscale. Since open warfare was declared between Skinner and the Koranelli Cartel, the destructiveness of the raids have been increasing.

Attempts on the police are becoming more and more brazen as well. The Ministry of Interior reported that the corruption rate within the police force has doubled since the Soll period, causing the situation to spiral even more out of control.

name: Turn05_Estord_GangViolenceReduced
title: Gang Violence Reduced Report
description:
The Ministry of Interior has reported that after the police raid on the Skinner and Koranelli Cartel’s supply chains, their activities have reduced in the region.

“Those operations were only possible as a result of the new resources we received from this administration. It has allowed the local police force to launch inside investigations, purging the corrupted officials, and getting information about criminal networks.” said the Ministry of Interior.

name: Turn05_Estord_Unrest
title: Protests and Looting
description:
Protests and occasional looting continues in the region of Nargis. The police reports that the violence has been minimized and the situation is mostly under control outside the big cities.

Estord Police Force reported that several militants have been hiding among the protesters and are being watched closely.

name: Turn05_FolceDator_RNCDominatesAirwaves
title: Opposition Figures Lodge Complaint Against Rizian Radio
description: At the Rizian Radio central broadcasting location of Folce Dator, several RPP figures have gathered to formally complain against the dominance the RNC enjoys on the airwaves. The opposition claims that due all radio being state controlled, there’s no space for RPP viewpoints to be represented in the electoral campaign. Rizian Radio has already replied that they will continue to broadcast RNC ads as before.

name: Turn05_Holsord_CBRProposal
title: Central Bank Drafts Economic Recovery Proposal
description: In an effort to mitigate economic damages, Holsord's Central Bank is working on a new proposal. The plan comprises several measures, including the accumulation of foreign exchange reserves, the adoption of a cautious fiscal policy, and increased support for export-oriented industries. The bank's initiative forms a crucial part of the broader strategy to stabilize Sordland's economy.

name: Turn05_Holsord_EducationNegative
title: Education Negative Report
description:
The Ministry of Education cut funding from several universities and technical schools which caused significant outrage among academicians, scientists, and teachers. The new operational and structural changes in a significant portion of the education institutions will result in a reduced standard of education.

There are reports of schools being understaffed and faculties shutting down. Minister Walda reported that the skilled workers and bright students of Sordland are leaving for greener pastures.

name: Turn05_Holsord_EducationReform
title: Education Reforms
description:
The Ministry of Education is reporting that the massive overhaul to the education system is progressing very well. All schools in Sordland will collaborate in the reduction of hours taught in citizenship, Sollism, and nationalism subjects. Significant efforts are being made to lessen the political indoctrination in education.

Other changes are also happening in the curriculum, pedagogical improvements like improved teacher-student relations and the emphasis on critical thinking development have begun all across the entire country. Minister Walda reports solid progress on many fronts with few schools delaying the transformation on political grounds.

name: Turn05_Holsord_EducationReform_NoFunds
title: Education Reforms
description:
The Ministry of Education is reporting that the massive overhaul to the education system is progressing slower than expected. Only a few schools in Sordland will collaborate in the reduction of hours taught in citizenship, Sollism, and nationalism subjects. Significant efforts are being made to lessen the political indoctrination in education but are being met with resistance.

Other changes which were supposed to happen in the curriculum, pedagogical improvements like improved teacher-student relations and the emphasis on critical thinking development weren't able to start due to a lack of workforce and funding. Minister Walda reports little progress with most schools delaying the transformation on political grounds.

name: Turn05_Holsord_FireInvestigationHold
title: HSU Fire Investigation Suspended
description: A lack of further evidence from the investigation into the fire that occurred at the Holsord State University archives has caused the case to be suspended until further notice from the police and SID. The cordon has been lifted.

name: Turn05_Holsord_HealthcareNegative
title: Healthcare Negative Report
description:
The Ministry of Health has shut down several hospitals and let go of thousands of nurses and doctors as a result of healthcare budget cuts. The health services suffered a major shock with these changes that resulted in longer waiting times, lack of cleaning staff, and overcrowded hospitals in areas with lower ratios of hospitals per 100.000 people.

Minister Beniwoll reported that the healthcare system is in a state of crisis.

name: Turn05_Holsord_HealthPrivatizationDiscussion
title: Ministry of Health Discusses Privatization
description: The Ministry of Health has begun working on a health report with a proposal to allow privatization in the health system to potentially generate new resources for the Ministry. Minister Beniwoll is personally overseeing the discussion and the report with top aides including members from the National Business Council.

name: Turn05_Holsord_HPEditorSuspect
title: Holsord Post’s Connection To Young Sords
description:
Chief of Police Karl Greiser reported that Young Sords sympathizers as well as several old members of the terrorist organization are currently working for the newspaper, Holsord Post.

Investigations are underway.

name: Turn05_Holsord_InteriorIncreased
title: Report from the Ministry of Interior
description:
The Ministry of Interior reports that the restructuring of the ministry has been completed with success after the increase of its budget. According to the report, some portion of the budget was transferred specifically to local police forces that are fighting against organized crime in northern Sordland, which have already made successful gains in the war against crime.

The Ministry reports that the two major business rings of the two crime families, Koranelli and Skinner have been shut down and several high-ranking members have been arrested. With the implementation of the witness protection program, the Sordish Police reports that they are confident in eliminating the said crime families in the short future.

name: Turn05_Holsord_JusticeIncreased
title: Report from the Ministry of Justice
description:
The Ministry of Justice reports that the restructuring of the ministry has been completed with success after the increase of its budget. According to the report, a large portion of the budget was transferred specifically to solve the case backlog issues at lower courts, which has already helped ease the situation.

Additional efforts will be directed at fighting corruption, upholding the integrity of judges and the consolidation of the rule of law. Minister Morgna said that she intends to bring back trust in the justice system with more accessible and efficient courts, a public information campaign, and by rooting out corruption in society.

name: Turn05_Holsord_L1CloseOpenTaurus
title: L-1 Railway Nears Completion
description:
The L-1 railway running from Holsord to Lachaven is mostly complete with final preparations being made for the opening. Regrettably, there have been some issues around the Workers' Rights Law with Taurus Holding. Nonetheless, the project will be completed on time thanks to the administration’s decisive actions.

With Holsord about to be closely linked to the country's biggest port in Lachaven, businesses in the region are expected to gain a significant boost and are already negotiating rail transport contracts for the transfer of goods.

name: Turn05_Holsord_L3NearCompletionUnderhall
title: L-1 Railway Nears Completion
description:
The L-1 railway running from Holsord to Lachaven is mostly complete with final preparations being made for the opening. Underhall Construction guarantees a timely delivery of all contractual obligations.

With Holsord about to be closely linked to the country's biggest port in Lachaven, businesses in the region are expected to gain a significant boost and are already negotiating rail transport contracts for the transfer of goods.

name: Turn05_Holsord_NegativeApproval
title: Negative Presidential Approval Rating
description: A new approval rating poll has shown that we have landed below a 25% Presidential approval rating. Our administration's performance has been widely questioned by the diverse poll taken by a thousand respondents from all the regions of Sordland.

name: Turn05_Holsord_PositiveApproval
title: Positive Presidential Approval Rating
description: A new approval rating poll has shown that we have landed above a 50% Presidential approval rating. Our administration's good performance has been confirmed with the diverse poll taken by a thousand respondents from all the regions of Sordland.

name: Turn05_Holsord_ReformStatus_Both
title: Reform Status
description: Lucian Galade reported that so far they have been able to get, in total, 142 signatures behind the proposal. Efforts are underway to increase the support and to reach out to necessary members to reach 150.

name: Turn05_Holsord_ReformStatus_GloriaAlbin
title: Reform Status
description: Lucian Galade reported that so far they have been able to get, in total, 121 signatures behind the proposal. Efforts are underway to increase the support and to reach out to necessary members to reach 150.

name: Turn05_Holsord_ReformStatus_None
title: Reform Status
description: Lucian Galade reported that so far they have been able to get, in total, 96 signatures behind the proposal. Efforts are underway to increase the support and to reach out to necessary members to reach 150.

name: Turn05_Iza_Decision_SocialWelfareSpending_Employment
title: Migrant Job Bureaus Spring Up Across City
description: As part of the Government’s program to assist migrants in finding employment, special job bureaus have been set up across Iza. Meanwhile, employers have been encouraged to hire non-native Rizians in sectors that have been struggling with filling job vacancies.

name: Turn05_Iza_Decision_SocialWelfareSpending_Food
title: Thousands Queue As Food Programs Start
description: Large queues were seen across the city of Iza as the food program kicked off. Food banks and large mess halls were established in the city’s poorest. most diverse neighborhoods, lowering the financial burden of purchasing food on those most vulnerable.

name: Turn05_Iza_Decision_SocialWelfareSpending_Integration
title: Cultural Integration Courses Peak Curiosity
description: Courses aimed at teaching migrant populations about Rizian values and cultural traditions are attracting a substantial number of people, as many appear willing to learn about our country's great cultural traditions.

name: Turn05_Iza_Decision_SocialWelfareSpending_Language
title: Language Schools To Help With Integration
description: Language schools have been popping up across Iza, free of charge for all inhabitants of the city, even for those unable to present the necessary paperwork. Interest has been substantial, with hopes that knowledge of the Rizian language among the city’s migrant population will increase drastically in years to come.

name: Turn05_Iza_PreElectionRiots
title: Riots As Migrant Groups Clash With Su Omina
description: Scores of injured and hundreds of arrests make up the balance after a night of rioting gripped Iza’s city center. Migrant rights groups had organized a counter demonstration to Su Omina’s pre-election rally, during which the ultranationalist group repeatedly criticized the Crown’s decision to offer paths to citizenship to non-ethnic Rizians. In the aftermath of the rally, Su Omina militants attacked counter demonstrators. Order was eventually restored in the early morning.

name: Turn05_Iza_RPPCampaignStarts
title: RPP Turns Iza Into Sea Of Yellow
description: Thousands of yellow flags and people wearing yellow clothes filled the streets of Iza over the past week, culminating in a rally featuring a speech by Manus Sazon and an art performance of the ‘ghosts of democracy’, the new mascot for the RPP’s electoral campaign. With this unique display of force, the RPP has set itself up for a strong and recognisable campaign.

name: Turn05_Iza_SuOminaEndorsesRNC
title: Su Omina Calls For RNC Vote
description: The militant nationalist group Su Omina has declared its support for the RNC, encouraging its sympathizers to vote for the King’s party. In addition, the organization has announced its intention to protect polling stations on election day from what it describes as ‘foreign actors’.

name: Turn05_Iza_ThousandsToVoteForFirstTime
title: Quarter Of A Million To Vote For First Time
description: Due to a combination of a young population reaching the voting age and the Government’s extensive naturalization program for foreign citizens, almost a quarter of a million citizens are expected to head to the polls for the first time in upcoming elections. This provides for a huge challenge for the electoral commission, who are scrambling to get everything in order by the time voting comes.

name: Turn05_Iza_WehzekRightsCelebration_NoOppression
title: Street Parties In Little Wraclawitz Celebrate New Wehzek Rights Laws
description: Residents of Iza's Little Wraclawitz enclave threw spontaneous street parties in celebration of the new rights that have been granted to citizens of Wehlen living in Rizia. The mood was festive, with little if any violence or hooliganism reported.

name: Turn05_Iza_WehzekRightsCelebration_PoliceOppression
title: Police Break Up Little Wraclawitz Street Party
description: The residents of Iza's Little Wraclawitz enclave held a spontaneous street party celebrating the new rights granted to Wehzek citizens of Rizia. However, the recently expanded Iza police force, at the orders of Duke Rico Toras, put a premature end to the proceedings, intimidating the revellers into dissipating.

name: Turn05_Iza_WehzekRightsCelebration_SOOppression
title: Little Wraclawitz Street Party Disrupted By Su Omina
description: The residents of Iza's Little Wraclawitz enclave held a spontaneous street party celebrating the new rights granted to Wehzek citizens of Rizia. However, the festivities were interrupted by a group of Su Omina members, who intimidated the revellers into dissipating.

name: Turn05_Kyrute_EmphasizesNeutrality
title: Chancellor Inos Adriumer Emphasizes Neutrality
description: Chancellor Inos has publicly supported Sordland's sovereignty amid ongoing attempts by superpower alliances to exert influence. Kyrute, maintaining its neutral stance, emphasizes the importance of independent decision-making for the Sordish nation and advocates for peace, stability, and autonomy in internal affairs.

name: Turn05_Lachaven_EconomyAutocrat
title: Economic Report
description: The Ministry of Statistics along with the Ministry of Economy and the Central Bank have delivered a preliminary economic status report detailing that the state of emergency has caused major disruption in the market. The recession is deepening and the financial system is headed towards a potential collapse if we don't take serious action. Minister Holl said that the situation was extremely dangerous.

name: Turn05_Lachaven_EconomyBad
title: Economic Report
description: The Ministry of Statistics along with the Ministry of Economy and the Central Bank have delivered a preliminary economic status report detailing that the recession is deepening and the financial system is headed towards a potential collapse if we don't take serious action. Minister Holl said that the situation was dangerous.

name: Turn05_Lachaven_EconomyGood
title: Economic Report
description: The Ministry of Statistics along with the Ministry of Economy and the Central Bank have delivered a preliminary economic status report detailing that the recession has slowed down significantly and the system is likely to reach stability soon if the current progress is maintained. Minister Holl said the signs were good but more needed to be done.

name: Turn05_Lachaven_EconomyGreat
title: Economic Report
description: The Ministry of Statistics along with the Ministry of Economy and the Central Bank have delivered a preliminary economic status report detailing that the recession has virtually ended and that minor economic growth will return to the country if the current progress is maintained. Minister Holl said the signs were positive.

name: Turn05_Lachaven_EconomyOkay
title: Economic Report
description: The Ministry of Statistics along with the Ministry of Economy and the Central Bank have delivered a preliminary economic status report detailing that the recession is ongoing and the system isn't likely to reach stability soon if we don't take serious steps. Minister Holl said the signs were negative.

name: Turn05_Lachaven_EducationPrivatizationResult
title: Privatization in Education
description:
The new privatization plan of the Ministry of Education is in full swing and the first dozen public schools have transitioned into for profit organizations already after a public bidding process determined the buyers.

Minister of Education Ciara Walda said that only a small percentage of all institutions will be allowed to transition. It is expected that the Ministry will gather a substantial amount of private funds from the initiative.

name: Turn05_Lachaven_ForeignEnergyInvestments
title: Foreign Energy Investments Surge
description: In the wake of recent modifications to the Energy Protection Act, Lachaven has seen an uptick in foreign energy investments. The softened foreign ownership rules have catalyzed the entry of overseas capital, infusing new energy into the local industry. This surge in foreign investments is a positive sign for Lachaven's energy sector and its economic future.

name: Turn05_Lachaven_H3CloseOpenTaurus
title: H-3 Highway Nears Completion
description:
The H-3 Highway running from Lachaven to Arvory is mostly complete with final preparations being made for the opening. Regrettably, there have been some issues around the Workers' Rights Law with Taurus Holding. Nonetheless, the project will be completed on-time thanks to the administration’s decisive actions.

With Arvory about to be connected to the country's biggest port in Lachaven with a large highway, people in the region are expected to have better access to jobs, welfare, and other services. The H-3 will also improve trade links with Agnolia.

name: Turn05_Lachaven_H3NearCompletionUnderhall
title: H-3 Highway Nears Completion
description:
The H-3 highway running from Lachaven to Arvory is mostly complete with final preparations being made for the opening. Underhall Construction guarantees a timely delivery of all contractual obligations.

With Arvory about to be connected to the country's biggest port in Lachaven via a large modern highway, people in the region are expected to have better access to jobs, welfare and other services. The H-3 will also improve trade links with Agnolia.

name: Turn05_Lachaven_MarketCrash
title: Market Crash
description: Black Tuesday caused a financial collapse today around the country and the immediate effects are being felt in Lachaven with shops closing and hastily adapting to the prices of goods rapidly tripling. Thousands of people were seen waiting in front of shops forming queues to buy necessary supplies as part of the mass panic caused by the crisis. The financial repercussions are now influencing all facets of society.

name: Turn05_Lachaven_NoUnrest
title: Calm Returns To Nargis
description: The protests and occasional looting of the past weeks have ceased to occur in the region of Nargis, particularly in the city of Lachaven. The Lachaven Police Force has reported that the situation is now under control, despite several small protests still going on across the region.

name: Turn05_Lachaven_TradeWar
title: International Trade War
description: The Nibiya confrontation and the subsequent naval blockade of all ships has caused a massive disruption of trade and production goods that drive the economy of Sordland. The immediate effect in Lachaven was felt at the port when hundreds of scheduled ships failed to arrive. The collapse of this vital logistical supply chain has caused a massive economic downturn.

name: Turn05_Lenkurg_Unrest
title: Rioters Arrested
description: The protests and occasional looting of the past weeks has ceased in the city of Lenkurg. Lenkurg Police have reported that the situation is now under control, and thousands of arrests have been made while quelling the situation.

name: Turn05_Lespia_CondemnsUCAid
title: Lespia Worried About United Contanan Base
description: Prime Minister Alvarez has criticized Sordland for accepting financial aid from United Contana. He blamed Sordland for opening a gateway for United Contana to expand their influence in the Merkopan continent.

name: Turn05_Lespia_CondemnsWehlenDeal
title: Lespia Condemns Cooperation with Wehlen
description:
Prime Minister Alvarez condemned the joint Wehzek-Sordish military operation in Northern Wehlen against the Bludish separatists. He blamed Sordland and Wehlen for being aggressive and undiplomatic, urging us to cancel the operation.

Alvarez also stated that his ‘heart is with all the innocent Bludish people in the region,’ and that ‘hope will never cease to exist’ for them.

name: Turn05_Monqiz_RNCCampaignEnd
title: RNC Closes Campaign In Monqiz
description: A massive rally, not too dissimilar from the one that started the campaign, marks the end of the RNC campaign. Tens of thousands of supporters gathered in the RNC stronghold of Monqiz, ending their campaign with an impressive display of strength.

name: Turn05_Montaklar_AntiMonarchyProtests
title: Montaklar Anti-Monarchy Protests
description: Montaklar experienced civil disobedience marked by organized sit-ins, where participants demanded economic reforms to address the wealth gap.

name: Turn05_Montaklar_ArmsExhibitionInLespia
title: General Carlos Azaro Returns from Arms Exhibition in Lespia
description:
General Carlos Azaro, accompanied by a select group, attended the Arms Industry and Equipment Exhibition at the Canavi Exhibition Center in Lespia, where the latest advances in military technology were showcased.

Following his visit, General Azaro has returned to Rizia and is preparing a detailed presentation for His Majesty. His report is expected to outline key findings from the exposition and highlight potential applications for Rizia's defense strategy.

name: Turn05_Montaklar_CarlosHomeVisit
title: General Carlos Azaro Visits Royal Estate
description:
General Carlos Robles Azaro recently visited the Azaro family estate in Cardesse-Montaklar to meet with General Taddeus Azaro, who is still recovering from his stroke.

Sources indicate that General Carlos and General Taddeus held a private discussion, likely addressing Rizia's current security challenges and strategic priorities. Despite his fragile health, General Taddeus remains an influential figure in military affairs, while General Carlos continues to assume a critical role in ensuring stability across the region.

name: Turn05_Montaklar_CarlosVisitsMemorial
title: General Carlos Azaro Visits the Reclamation War Memorial
description:
General Carlos Robles Azaro paid a solemn visit to the mausoleum near the southern border, honoring the fallen soldiers of the Reclamation War. As the sole surviving officer of the encircled brigade, the moment carried deep personal significance.

The royal band played a mournful hymn as he placed a wreath at the memorial, standing in silence before the names of his fallen comrades.

name: Turn05_Montaklar_RNCFlyerCampaign
title: RNC Hopes To Secure Montaklar Support
description: By embarking on a massive flyering campaign, providing leaflets to every household, the RNC hopes to secure its support in Montaklar. As the biggest city in the Azaro-ruled region, which traditionally votes for the Crown party but has an ever diversifying population, it is considered a vital piece of the electoral puzzle for the party.

name: Turn05_Montaklar_TaddeusReturnsHome
title: Taddeus Azaro Discharged From Hospital
description: General Azaro has returned home after spending an extended period in the hospital due to a stroke. The family patriarch is still suffering from convulsions, but will now focus on recovering further at the Azaro’s palace in Montaklar.

name: Turn05_Morella_DemandsZilleReturn
title: Morella Urges Timely Zille Return
description: In an official diplomatic communique to Wehlen’s president, Prime Minister Alma Saltana has urged the speedy return of Zille to Rizia, saying that previous agreements should be respected. Morella’s PM also said that her government will oppose any attempts by Wehlen to prolong the process and that a possible Wehzek annexation could see heavy sanctions imposed.

name: Turn05_Morella_EmergencyITZBoardMeeting
title: Prime Minister Saltana Calls Emergency MITZ Board Meeting
description: Following up on the recent AN discussion about the Meftiem International Trade Zone, Morellan Prime Minister Alma Saltana has pushed forward the date of the next stakeholder meeting between Morella, Rizia, Lespia and Valgsland. We will be expected to present our opinion regarding the nationalization of the MITZ and its possible alternatives.

name: Turn05_Morella_MITZ_NationalizationInvite
title: Morella Invites MITZ Members To Discuss Nationalization
description: Morella has sent formal invites to all participants in the MITZ, including Rizia, to discuss the nationalization plans. Talks will be held in the Morellan capital of Cavette.

name: Turn05_Morella_MITZ_RenegotiationInvite
title: Morella Invites MITZ Members To Discuss Trade Zone Renegotiation
description: Morella has sent formal invites to all participants in the MITZ, including Rizia, to renegotiate the existing agreement. Talks will be held in the Morellan capital of Cavette.

name: Turn05_Morella_PipelineConstructionBegins
title: Construction Begins On Rizia-Morella Energy Pipeline
description: Following our agreement with Prime Minister Alma Saltana, preliminary construction has begun on a pipeline that will deliver energy from Rizia to the Morellan capital of Cavette. The work is expected to take up to two years.

name: Turn05_Morella_PollutionCleanupWork
title: Arufelde Rehabilitation Begins In Earnest
description: Aided by Rizia's funding, the 'Save the Arufelde' association has begun a comprehensive effort to rehabilitate the polluted Arufelde river watershed. The efforts include establishing water treatment facilities, afforestation drives, and community awareness campaigns to ensure the river's long-term sustainability and cultural significance.

name: Turn05_Morella_SatisfiedWithDeal
title: Saltana Promises MITZ Agreement Support
description: Following our negotiations with PM Alma Saltana, she has sent us a non-binding assurance that she will support the latest draft of the MITZ agreement when it comes time for the final board vote.

name: Turn05_Morella_UnsatisfiedWithDeal
title: Saltana Expresses Regret Over Failed MITZ Negotiations
description: Following our negotiations with PM Alma Saltana, she has sent a statement of regret that we could not agree on a final proposal for the MITZ. She will be continuing her talks with the Trade Zone's other partners, and hopes to count on our cooperation when it comes time for the final board vote.

name: Turn05_Narbel_DetainReport
title: Arrest Report
description: The Chief of Police, Karl Greiser, reports that over a thousand people were arrested in Narbel in relation to the operations against national security threats. According to the report, the situation in Narbel and the surrounding region is under the control of the police.

name: Turn05_Narbel_GasomBranchDownsizes
title: Downsizing Announced at Narbel's Gasom Branch
description: The Gasom branch in Narbel has recently announced a downsizing of its operations. The company's decision, while aimed at enhancing operational efficiency, has stirred concerns among the existing workforce. The economic repercussions of this move on Narbel's local economy and the future trajectory of Gasom are subjects of close attention.

name: Turn05_Narbel_GasomBranchExpands
title: Gasom's Narbel Branch Set for Expansion
description: In contrast to downsizing news from other locations, Gasom's Narbel branch has revealed plans for expansion. This development, viewed as a promising sign of the company's resilience, is expected to stimulate Narbel's local economy and create new job opportunities. The decision marks a key turning point for the energy giant in its recovery journey.

name: Turn05_Nelvisar_OilFieldWorkersMobiliseForRPP
title: Former Oil Workers Organize For RPP
description: The RPP has found an unlikely ally in the former Nelvisar oil field workers.
