The small, predominantly native Rizian village has traditionally been a bastion of RNC support, but given the recent disregard of workers rights by the Crown and the loss of jobs given the fields closure, that allegiance appears to be showing cracks as many are swayed by the arguments the workers bring forward regarding the need for political change.

name: Turn05_Pales_EnvoySent
title: Rizian Envoy Arrives In Pales
description: Markus Rielfel, the diplomat leading Rizia’s envoy mission to Pales, will negotiate the finalization of the gas deal. The practiced negotiator has helped solve various disputes between Rizia’s noble houses in the past and is therefore deemed more than capable to lead this round of talks. He is also the brother of the fabled foreign diplomat Cedric Rielfel, who is currently unavailable for the assignment.

name: Turn05_PortDrazon_AntiMonarchyProtests
title: Porte Drazon Anti-Monarchy Protests:
description: In Porte Drazon, protesters orchestrated a river demonstration, utilizing boats to obstruct waterways and bring attention to their grievances, articulating their call for a restructured constitutional framework that redistributes power.

name: Turn05_PorteDrazon_BorderControls_Bluds
title: Bludish Immigration Ban Implemented At Wehlen Border, Sallabes Port
description: Guards at the Wehlen-Rizia border as well as the Port of Sallabes have been instructed to deny entry to any citizen of Wehlen carrying Bludish identification papers.

name: Turn05_PorteDrazon_BorderControls_BludsDerdians
title: Bludish And Derdian Immigration Ban Implemented At Wehlen Border, Sallabes Port
description: Guards at the Wehlen-Rizia border as well as the Port of Sallabes have been instructed to deny entry to all citizens of Derdia, as well as any citizen of Wehlen carrying Bludish identification papers.

name: Turn05_PorteDrazon_ElectionFund_Transfer
title: RNC Acknowledges Royal Funding Receipt
description: The Rizian National Coalition has formally announced the receipt of election campaign funds from the Crown. In a press release from their headquarters in Porte Drazon, RNC leader Daria de Rava expressed gratitude towards the King for the financial support. She emphasized that this funding is crucial for the RNC's efforts in the upcoming House of Delegates election, promising to uphold the values and stability the monarchy represents.

name: Turn05_PorteDrazon_ElectoralCommisionCallsForVolunteers
title: Electoral Commision Recruiting Poll Watchers
description: In order to ensure a smooth election process, the electoral commision has put out a call for volunteers to help watch polls and count votes when the time comes. To reward volunteers, each of them will reward a medal for civic service to the country. Opposition figures have criticized using a volunteer system and expressed their preference for randomly picked citizens to do poll watching instead.

name: Turn05_PorteDrazon_ElectoralCommisionReady
title: Electoral Commission Has Enough Volunteers
description: The electoral commission announced that it gathered enough volunteers to ensure a smooth electoral process. It expressed its gratitude to all Rizian citizens willing to participate in the upcoming exercise of democracy.

name: Turn05_PorteDrazon_RNCCampaignStarts
title: RNC Kicks Off Election Campaign
description: With a large rally on the Toras square, the RNC officially kicked off their election campaign for the upcoming house of delegates elections. Tens of thousands of supporters gathered, waving Rizian and House Toras flags, chanting their support for the King’s party. Leader of the RNC and speaker of the HOD Daria de Rava delivered a rousing speech, with a short appearance by Hugo Toras himself sending the crowd wild.

name: Turn05_PorteDrazon_RPPCampaignHousing
title: RPP Puts Forward Housing As Campaign Issue
description: Amidst the worsening housing crisis in Porte Drazon, the RPP in recent weeks have started focussing their campaign in the capital around the issue. The local RNC chapter has cautiously requested for the King to address the issue, fearing that otherwise the opposition might gain ground in their traditional Rizia Imperii stronghold.

name: Turn05_PorteDrazon_TransitInfrastructure_Bad
title: New Report Highlights Poor State of Rizian Transit Infrastructure
description: Experts are warning that due to a lack of investment, Rizia's railway, bus and tram systems are becoming dangerously overloaded. If substantial modernization and expansion efforts are not undertaken soon, the public transportation infrastructure risks not only frequent service disruptions but also potential safety hazards due to the aging fleet and increased commuter demand.

name: Turn05_PorteDrazon_TransitInfrastructure_OK
title: New Report Highlights Rizian Transit Improvements
description: Experts have reported that Rizia's investment in its transit infrastructure is paying off, with the railway, bus, and tram systems handling current passenger loads effectively. Continuous funding and timely upgrades have allowed for a well-maintained and efficiently operated network, staving off the overcrowding and service delays that plague less modernized systems.

name: Turn05_Qabiz_EarlyVotingStarts
title: Early Voting Starts
description:
Traditionally the first part of the country to vote, residents of the island of Qaleqabiz have started heading to the polls. Custom dictates that votes on the island are to be tallied in the mainland, therefore early voting is required to ensure the votes can make it over on time.

Results won’t be announced until the rest of the country has voted.

name: Turn05_Ribel_BergianPoliceAmbushed
title: Bergian Police Ambushed By Young Militants
description: Bergian police were ambushed in Ribel by two underage suspects armed with KA-74's, who were quickly killed. The suspects are believed to have been newly recruited militants of the Bludish Freedom Front. This incident highlights the growing trend of underage recruitment by the BFF and the increasing danger posed by these young militants. The government is urged to take immediate action to address the root causes of the BFF's recruitment strategies and prevent further radicalization of young people.

name: Turn05_Ribel_ForeignEnergyInvestments
title: Foreign Energy Investments Flow into Ribel
description: Ribel has seen a notable influx of foreign energy investments, a positive trend that suggests growing international confidence in the region's energy sector. These investments are forecasted to stimulate Ribel's local economy and accelerate the development of its energy infrastructure. The impact of this surge in foreign capital on Ribel's overall economic growth and energy sector's performance is being closely monitored.

name: Turn05_Sallabes_AntiMonarchyProtests
title: Sallabes Anti-Monarchy Protests
description: Substantial rallies occurred in Sallabes, with protesters calling for a new decentralized constitutional agreement. Their focus is on achieving self-governance, as expressed through slogans and banners.

name: Turn05_Sallabes_HouseSazonEndorsesRPP
title: House Sazon Calls For Opposition Vote
description: In a joint statement, several House Sazon nobles have declared their support for the RPP. While the links between the Sazons and the opposition are well known, open declarations which defy the Monarchy are rare and signal weakening relationships between them and house Toras.

name: Turn05_Sarna_BFFPropagandaInSchools
title: BFF And Bludish Education In Bergia
description: Governor Phelix Bron reports the discovery of Bludish Freedom Front (BFF) propaganda in most schools that teach in the Bludish language. This highlights the BFF's efforts to recruit and radicalize young people in Bludish-majority areas. The government is urged to take immediate action to address the BFF's recruitment strategies and prevent further radicalization of young people. Governor Bron asks the lawmakers to introduce a ban on the Bludish language as a primary education language, and asks the government to properly enforce the national language of Sordland to everyone.

name: Turn05_Sordland_Decision_SordishTouristIssue_Extradite
title: Sordland Starts Trial Against Accused Tourists
description: After Rizia complied with the Sordish request of extraditing its citizens, a trial has now commenced. While the tourists proclaim their innocence, several witnesses from Rizia are present to counter their claims.

name: Turn05_Sordland_Decision_SordishTouristIssue_JusticeInRiza
title: Sordland Summons Rizian Ambassador
description: Sordland’s Government demands an explanation over the arrest and trial of a group of Sordish citizens on Rizian soil. In a brief remark to the Rizian ambassador, Sordish minister of foreign affairs Deivid Wisci relayed that Sordland retains the right to put its own citizen on trial and does not accept other countries incarcerating its citizens.

name: Turn05_Sordland_GasomInvest_DontInvest
title: Sordland Not Angry, Just Disappointed
description: The republic of Sordland has expressed its disappointment with our country as we opted not to invest in Gasom. While the country highlighted that this doesn’t have to mean a worsening of relations between our two countries, they do appear to be disappointed by our decision.

name: Turn05_Sordland_GasomInvest_Invest
title: Sordland Welcomes Gasom Investment
description: The Republic of Sordland has expressed its gratitude for our investment in Gasom and expressed hope for increasing business relations in the future.

name: Turn05_Terador_AirplaneDeal
title: Morella To Send Airplanes To Terador Base
description: As per our agreement with Morella, two dozen Morellan-made aircraft are to be delivered to Terador Air Force Base. Military analysts believe the addition will provide a much-needed modernization boost to the Rizian Royal Air Force.

name: Turn05_Topes_Decision_EsqirisFieldShutsDown
title: Local Environmental Group Celebrates Gas Field Shutdown
description: While authorities and workers lamented the closure of the Esqiris gas field, a small local environmental group has celebrated the shut down, saying it “provides an opportunity for Rizia to transition to sustainable energy sources”.

name: Turn05_Uziren_BludishProtestBill
title: Protest for Bludish Rights
description: A massive protest against the Sordish Language Bill has been raging in the city of Uziren since yesterday morning. Local police are trying their best to disperse the crowd. So far, the protests have been non-violent.

name: Turn05_Uziren_BludishProtestBill_A
title: Protest for Bludish Rights
description: A massive protest against the Sordish Language Bill has been raging in the city of Uziren since yesterday morning. Local police dispersed the crowd after violent clashes. Hundreds of protesters were detained.

name: Turn05_Uziren_BorderReport
title: Border Report
description: Defense Minister Iosef Lancea reports that the Wehlen borders have been closed and the divisions of the 3rd Army are ready for the operation.

name: Turn05_Uziren_Refugees
title: Refugees of Vernen
description: Reports from our border and the Wehzek city Vernen show that there are about a thousand people running away from Wehzek military forces towards the Sordish border.

name: Turn05_Uziren_SpecialZoneProtest
title: Protest Against Governor Bron's Security Policies
description:
An exceptionally large protest has taken place in Uziren, as well as several others in Bergia, indicating an increase in general unrest against the Special Zone and the governor's security policies targeting the Bludish Freedom Front. 

The governor has authorized widespread surveillance of Bludish individuals, which has created a climate of fear and mistrust in the community. The Bludish people are demanding that their civil liberties and human rights be respected, and that they are not unfairly targeted based on their ethnicity or perceived political affiliations.

name: Turn05_Valenqir_Decision_SordishTouristIssue_Silent
title: Protests Erupt After Sordish Tourists Return Home
description: After the Sordish tourists that violently attacked a Rizian citizen were released and boarded their flights home, a protest erupted in Valenqir, the site of the incident. Protestors demanded the tourists would be put on trial by the Rizian state, calling the decision to let them return to Sordland “an affront to lady justice herself”.

name: Turn05_Valenqiris_AntiMonarchyProtests
title: Valenqiris Anti-Monarchy Protests
description: Protests in Valenqiris are decentralized and span various regions. Demonstrators have blocked key government facilities in both urban and rural areas to voice their concerns.

name: Turn05_Valenqir_RPPTargetsTorasHeartland
title: RPP Campaign Reaches Toras Heartlands
description: A rally held by the RPP, with Manus Sazon himself delivering the speech, was held in Valenqir today. Thousands attended the rally, which effectively moved the campaign deep into the traditional heartlands of House Toras. Traditionally, local Toras nobles have prevented the RPP from holding campaign events in the city, signaling a worrying loss of support for the King. Last election, the RNC still secured over 85% of the vote in the city.

name: Turn05_Valgen_RegionalGrowth
title: Gruni Regional Growth Advances in Valgen
description: Gruni is witnessing an encouraging surge in regional growth. The agricultural and vineyard sectors, significant contributors to the region's economy, are particularly flourishing. This growth marks a promising phase for Gruni's economy and sets an optimistic tone for Valgen's economic development prospects.

name: Turn05_Valgen_RegionalRecession
title: Slowdown in Gruni Regional Growth Observed
description: Gruni is experiencing a slowdown in regional growth. Despite recent advances, the pace of economic development has decelerated. This development has brought attention to the need for strategic economic interventions that can rekindle growth momentum in the region.

name: Turn05_Valgen_RegionalStagnation
title: Stagnation Marks Gruni's Regional Growth
description: Gruni, known for its fertile lands and world-renowned vineyards, is currently experiencing a stagnation in regional growth. This economic flatlining has raised concerns over Gruni's economic resilience and the need for innovative strategies to revitalize its growth. The city and regional authorities are closely monitoring the situation to take necessary actions.

name: Turn05_Valgen_SurveillanceReport
title: Surveillance Report
description:
The Sordish Intelligence Directorate reported that the city of Valgen is housing a large number of people who may pose a threat to Sordish national security. The Directorate has issued the permission to wiretap any landlines in the city.

A man was arrested under suspicion of spying for Lespia. Interrogation is underway.

name: Turn05_Valgsland_AidSent
title: Valgsland Sends Naval Aid
description: Morellan PM Alma Saltana has informed Chancellor Hegel of Valgsland that Morella and Rizia have agreed to exclude the Republic of Lespia from the most recent MITZ draft agreement. Hegel promised that he will support the agreement, and furthermore has sent our military Valgslandian submarines as a gesture of gratitude.

name: Turn05_Valgsland_CautionsAgainstPrivatization
title: Valgsland Warns Against Sordish Privatization
description:
Chancellor Emmerich Hegel has voiced his concerns over potential privatization measures being considered in Sordland. The Chancellor, a strong proponent of Valgslandian Socialism, cautioned against the dangers of unchecked capitalism, citing the risk of increasing wealth inequality and social instability. He expressed a desire for Sordland to consider a more equitable approach to economic development, perhaps taking cues from Valgsland's own socialist policies. 

Hegel further stated that Valgsland would remain supportive of Sordland as long as the well-being of its people is prioritized.

name: Turn05_Valgsland_CondemnsHeljilandDeal
title: Valgsland Condemns Heljiland Recognition
description:
Chancellor Hegel condemned Sordland’s recognition of Heljiland as Agnolian soil, blaming our government for trying to create an international conflict in the Markian Sea.

The Valgslandian Navy also released a statement saying that they are being forced to expand their presence in the Markian Sea in order to be able to protect their interests. They warned the Sordish navy not to interfere with Heljiland’s affairs.

name: Turn05_Valgsland_NoAid
title: Valgsland Rescinds Aid Offer
description: Morellan PM Alma Saltana has informed Valgslandian Chancellor Emmerich Hegel of the latest MITZ negotiation results. Since Lespia is still included as a stakeholder, Valgsland is rescinding its prior offer of military aid.

name: Turn05_Vesord_RYRaided
title: Red Youth Hideout Raided
description: Vesord Police has organized a raid early in the morning to an abandoned building in the city of Vesord, under suspicions of hiding Red Youth members inside. The successful raid led to the arrest of eight militants and confiscation of two military grade assault rifles and bomb making equipment.

name: Turn05_Wehlen_CondemnsArcasianAid
title: Wehlen Condemns Arcasian Financial Aid
description:
President Smolak has condemned Sordland for accepting financial aid from Arcasia. He said that cooperating with Arcasia will only bring trouble to the region and warned Sordland for falling into the trap of the west’s neo-colonialist agenda.

Smolak also blamed Arcasian President Dwight Walker for trying to dominate eastern Merkopa and exploit its resources.

name: Turn05_Zille_ATASuppliesReceived
title: Ariana Toras Association Receives First Morellan Supply Shipment
description: To aid the Zille branch of the Ariana Toras Association in its non-violent resistance operations, we have organized a shipment of short-wave radios, printing supplies and educational materials. These useful information dissemination materials will reach operatives in the Zille harbor via the Morellan port of M'orn.

name: Turn05_Zille_SOSuppliesReceived
title: Su Omina Zille Branch Receives First Morellan Supply Shipment
description: Morella has begun smuggling firearms and other supplies to the Su Omina resistance group in Zille. The first shipment was successfully received by boat via operatives stationed at the Zille harbor.

name: Turn05_Zille_WehzekCitizensPriviliged
title: Ethnic Wehzeks Enjoying More Freedoms
description: Reports are emerging that Wehlen has started implementing a system of segregation between Rizian and Wehzek citizens, with large scale events often only accessible to one ethnic group. Additionally, it’s becoming increasingly clear that while Rizians have had their freedoms severely limited since the bombing, Wehzeks have barely been affected.

name: Turn06_Agnolia_ElectionWin
title: Van Hoorten Wins Elections
description: General elections held in Agnolia this week had resulted in the victory of the Nurist Democratic Union of Agnolia for the second time with its leader Maartin Van Hoorten continuing his duties as prime minister.

name: Turn06_Agnolia_TradeDeal
title: Agnolia Trade Deal Update
description:
The effects of the trade deal with Agnolia is now in effect as per the signed agreement. In the short amount of time, steel trade in Sordland has seen an increase in flow with especially the Agnland region benefitting the most from the results.

The Governor of Agnland has reported that this trade deal has helped increase the manufacturing output of the region.

name: Turn06_Agnolia_TradeDeal_H3
title: Agnolia Trade Deal Update
description:
The effects of the trade deal with Agnolia is now in effect as per the signed agreement. In the short amount of time, steel trade in Sordland has seen an increase in flow with especially the Agnland region benefitting the most from the results.

The Governor of Agnland has reported that this trade deal has helped increase the manufacturing output of the region immensely due to the combined effects of the H-3 highway passing through the region.

name: Turn06_Agnolia_WarnsNavyPresence
title: PM Van Hoorten Warns About Valgslandian Presence
description: Prime Minister Van Hoorten warned us about the increasing naval presence of Valgsland in the Markian Sea. He showed his wishes to have a stronger naval cooperation with Sordland in the future.

name: Turn06_Anrica_WomensRally
title: Women's Rights March
description: A group of demonstrators led by representatives from the Sordish League of Women marched in Anrica, calling for gender equality in Sordland’s public education system. Women were also among the counter-protesters, who argued for the right to keep educating girls separately from boys in order to preserve Sordish tradition.

name: Turn06_Argno_Decision_MalenyevistWorkerStrike_Allowed
title: Strike Leaders Talk Of Union
description: A strike organized by Malenyevist workers has brought the city to a standstill. Now, after authorities seemingly allowed the strike to proceed, its leaders are talking about establishing a proper trade union in the city, modeled after foreign examples.

name: Turn06_Argno_Decision_MalenyevistWorkerStrike_Dispersed
title: Strike Dispersed
description: Police forces have broken up barricades and picket lines, bringing the Malenyevist workers strike to a premature end. Workers refusing to go back to work have been fired and in order to keep the industry running, loyal citizens from other parts of the country have been brought in to temporarily fill their roles.

name: Turn06_Argno_MalenyevistPropaganda
title: Malenyevist Banner Drop In City Square
description: Malenyevist activists have organized a banner drop from the clocktower located on Argno’s central square. In the middle of the weekly market, a large red banner reading “Down With Romus! For A People’s Rizia!” was unfurled from the clocktower, with flyers handed out across the crowd. Despite efforts by authorities to react, not a single activist was caught. Police have opened an investigation into the matter.

name: Turn06_Argno_PowerPlantPhotographer
title: Suspicious Photographer at Energy Facility
description: A contractor working near a restricted energy facility was caught with photographic equipment. He claims to be an artist working on an exhibition titled "The Power of Rizia," celebrating the resilience of workers at the kingdom’s power plants. While his story seems plausible, domestic intelligence agents will closely monitor his further activities.

name: Turn06_Arvory_AgnlandInvested
title: Governor of Agnland Reports Results
description:
The Governor of Agnland reports that the investment provided by the government has been put into use via various programs for new companies and technology fairs in Arvory.

The opportunity has led to an increase in overall entrepreneurship in the region and revitalised the economy of Agnland, further increasing trade with nearby countries and regions.

name: Turn06_Arvory_AgnlandInvested_H3
title: Governor of Agnland Reports Results
description:
The Governor of Agnland reports that the investment provided by the government has been put into use via various programs for new companies and technology fairs in Arvory.

The opportunity has led to an increase in overall entrepreneurship in the region and revitalised the economy of Agnland, further increasing trade with nearby countries and regions. The governor has also reported that the opening of H-3 highway has led to a greater return on investment than expected.

name: Turn06_Arvory_EnergyFluctImpact
title: Energy Price Fluctuations Impact
description: Arvory is grappling with the implications of energy price fluctuations. These irregularities in energy costs have negatively impacted the local economy, with households and businesses facing financial strain due to unpredictable energy bills. The local government is under pressure to find solutions to mitigate the impact and stabilize the energy market.

name: Turn06_Arvory_EnergySurgeImpact
title: Energy Price Surge Takes a Toll
description: A severe surge in energy prices is wreaking havoc on Arvory's economy. Households and businesses are experiencing financial distress, with the steep rise in energy bills straining their budgets. The far-reaching economic repercussions of this price surge are causing significant concern and demand urgent attention from policymakers.

name: Turn06_Arvory_H3_SSC_Delayed
title: H-3 Highway Construction Update
description: The Sordish State Corporation has reported that the construction for the H-3 highway has been officially delayed for a year. The managers of the project apologised in a public statement, taking the blame on themselves.

name: Turn06_Arvory_H3_Taurus_Delayed
title: H-3 Highway Construction Update
description: Taurus Holding has reported that the construction for the H-3 highway has been officially delayed for a year. The managers of the project apologised in a public statement, blaming the strikes for the delay.

name: Turn06_ATO_ArrestLucita
title: ATO Calls For Swift Justice
description: Following the revelation that Lucita Azaro was behind the Rizian-Pales border incident, ATO has praised the investigation for their diligent work and called for a quick response by Rizian King Romus Toras. The military alliance demands the immediate arrest of the Azaro in order to demonstrate Rizia’s willingness to keep the peace.

name: Turn06_ATO_BearTrapCondemnation
title: ATO Expresses Concern Over "Operation Bear Trap"
description:
ARCASIAN TREATY ORGANIZATION
PRESS OFFICE, VENTRIE CITY

The Arcasian Treaty Organization expresses profound concern regarding the military escalation in northern Wehlen, particularly the misnamed "Operation Bear Trap" and Sordland's troubling intervention. Reports from the region indicate alarming developments, with the Wehzek Armed Forces demonstrating apparent disregard for established protocols in civilian areas. The complete media blackout imposed by President Smolak's regime only amplifies our gravest reservations.

The ATO demands immediate, unrestricted access for international observers and humanitarian organizations to verify conditions in the affected regions. Until such access is granted, we shall pursue all diplomatic avenues to address this crisis. The international community must not stand idle while fundamental principles of human dignity are threatened on our continent.

Augustine Beauvoire
ATO First Secretary

name: Turn06_ATO_CondemnsWar
title: ATO Condemns Rizian Agression
description: ATO considers the Rizian aggression against Pales as highly illegal and a violation of international law. The organization demands an immediate end to hostilities and calls for Rizia to resolve the issues surrounding the Aureus Gas Field through negotiations, not force. Member states are monitoring the situation closely and discussing whether or not aid, military or humanitarian, to the Palesian Grand Duchy is warranted.

name: Turn06_ATO_CondemsIgnoringInvestigation
title: ATO Condemns Rizia For Ignoring Investigation Results
description: ATO has condemned the Kingdom of Rizia for ignoring the results of the joint investigation of the recent border incident. In a statement, the military alliance called the refusal of Rizia to act upon the results and arrest those responsible “a dangerous escalation”, claiming it shows Rizian King Romus Toras has “no desire to maintain the peace across south Merkopa”.

name: Turn06_ATO_DeclaresNuclearBreakthrough
title: ATO Hails Nuclear Breakthrough: Advanced Tech Promises
description:
The ATO has proudly announced a major nuclear breakthrough that promises not only to revolutionize its military capabilities but also to greatly enhance its energy sector. The newly developed technology showcases the scientific prowess of the alliance and reinforces its strategic positioning on the global stage.

This state-of-the-art technology combines novel nuclear reactor designs and advanced materials that could potentially make nuclear power safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. For the military, this means the development of compact and powerful reactors for naval vessels, increasing their endurance and operational capabilities.

In the energy sector, this nuclear breakthrough could mean a cleaner and more plentiful source of power, helping to meet the escalating global demand for energy and addressing concerns about climate change. The ATO hopes this advancement will usher in a new era of sustainable growth and energy independence for its member nations.

name: Turn06_ATO_RehabOfQinal
title: Rehabilitation of Qinal: The Balancing Act of ATO
description:
Amidst growing tensions, the ATO is engaged in a delicate balancing act with Qinal, a key member showing signs of distancing itself from full membership to observer status. Central to this shift is a dispute resolution between Qinal and Arcasian PMCs, which has fueled concerns over sovereignty, rules-based order, and autonomy for Qinal.

The ATO has responded to these concerns with a serious warning to the PMC CEO's and a series of concessions aimed at reaffirming Qinal's autonomous standing while retaining its essential alliance ties. The flexibility of the ATO in addressing Qinal's concerns reflects the strategic importance of this member state, and the alliance's commitment to balance members' sovereignty with collective security interests.

name: Turn06_Aureus_NavalIncidentFreeShips
title: Naval Incident: Rizia And Pales Cooperate To Prevent Loss Of Life
description:
After three Palesian ships attempted to break the Rizian blockade of the Aureus gas field, resulting in the ramming of the Rizian Flagship RRN Valero and the sinking of one Palesian vessel, both sides came together to rescue any sailors left in the water.

The successful rescue attempt resulted in merely twelve of the Palesians aboard the sunken ship passing away, likely all after the initial collision. The remaining two Palesian vessels took the surviving sailors home. Unfortunately, the RRN Valero was damaged beyond repair, with the wrecked ship now being hauled back to Rizia’s shores.

name: Turn06_Aureus_NavalIncidentNoRescue
title: Naval Incident: Palesian Vessels Captured
description:
After a swift response by the Rizian ships blockading the gas field to the Palesian attempt to break the blockade, two of Pales’ vessels were captured and are now being hauled back to Rizian shores. One Palesian ship was sunk during the skirmish, after it rammed the RRN Valero. Thanks to the rapid response, the damage to the Valero could also be contained and the ship is now heading to port for further repairs.

Preliminary casualty figures among Palesian sailors number over 80 lost souls, with at least two hundred still unaccounted for.

name: Turn06_Aureus_NavalIncidentRescueBoth
title: Naval Incident: Rescue Attempts Fall Short
description:
After three Palesian ships attempted to break through the Rizian blockade of the Aureus gas field, during which one was sunk and the Rizian flagship RRN Valero sustained heavy damage, rescue attempts were mounted for both the Palesian sailors on board their sinking ship and the Valero.

Unfortunately, the divided attention resulted in a failure to contain the damage of the RRN Valero, with the heavily damaged ship now being towed back to shore. While several Palesian sailors were rescued out of the cold waters, another 60 have been confirmed dead, with at least one hundred still unaccounted for.

The remaining two Palesian ships managed to escape an attempt by Rizia’s remaining vessels to contain them and safely made it back to Pales’ port.

name: Turn06_Aureus_NavalIncidentValeroFocus
title: Naval Incident: RRN Valero Saved!
description:
After three Palesian ships attempted to break through the Rizian blockade of the Aureus gas field, one of them was sunk by Rizian Royal Navy counterfire after it rammed the RRN Valero, inflicting potentially serious damage on the ship.

Due to the rapid response of the other Rizian frigates in the area, the Valero was saved, with the damage sustained only requiring superficial repairs. The two remaining Palesian ships were captured by the Rizian fleet and are now being hauled back to shore.

Preliminary casualty figures among Palesian sailors number over 80 lost souls, with at least two hundred still unaccounted for.

name: Turn06_Aureus_NavyDeployedAfterAN
title: Rizian Navy Moves On Gas Field
description: Following the controversial AN ruling regarding the Aureus Gas Field, which Rizia claims is unfairly favoring Pales and against the interests of the nation, Rizian Royal naval vessels spearheaded by the RRN Valero have started moving towards the gas field to seize all of it for the King. Strong warnings have been issued to any Palesian attempts to intervene, saying that force will be used if deemed necessary.

name: Turn06_Aureus_NavyFallsBack
title: Royal Navy Leaves Gas Field
description: Complying with the recent AN ruling on the disputed Aureus gas field, Rizian naval vessels have begun their journey back to port, calling off the blockade and thus diffusing tensions between Pales and Rizia. The RRN Valero was the first to leave, with smaller vessels securing its retreat.

name: Turn06_Aureus_NavyStays
title: Rizian Navy To Stay Despite AN Ruling
description: While the AN ordered Rizian vessels to retreat from the disputed Aureus gas field as part of its recent ruling, the Rizian Crown has refused to back off its fleet. According to the country, the defense of Rizian interests is paramount and the final AN ruling is unfair towards Rizian interests.

name: Turn06_Benfi_BanCreationism
title: Head of Teachers’ Association of Sordland Resigns
description: After the implementation of the new curriculum which banned creationism from schools, the head of the Teachers’ Association of Sordland, along with 8 out of 12 members have resigned in protest. Following suit, teachers and principals from various schools in Benfi have also left their jobs. Approximately 1600 teacher positions are expected to be refilled in nearby regions.

name: Turn06_Benfi_CreationismOK
title: Teachers Resign in Eastern Sordland
description:
After the implementation of the new curriculum which made evolution mandatory, 4 out of 12 members of the Board of Teachers’ Association of Sordland have resigned in protest.

Following suit, teachers and principals from various schools in Benfi have also left their jobs. Approximately 800 teacher positions are expected to be refilled in nearby regions.

name: Turn06_Benievon_NoblesToCoverHousingSubsidies
title: Local Nobles Offer Contributions To Subsidy Fund
description: Several Benievon nobles associated with the Toras family have offered the Crown to assist with its generous program of housing subsidies to low income families. The nobles cited their Wruhecist beliefs as motivation for this charitable act.

name: Turn06_Conriat_MarketsCrash
title: Market Crash In Conriat
description: The market crash - which some are already referring to as “Black Tuesday” -- has hit Conriat hard. Its recent real estate boom is coming to an end as wealthy citizens sell off or simply abandon their luxury houses in the surrounding hills and decamp for Holsord. Two of its largest boat tour companies have shut down, and its tourism industry is expected to suffer further as Sordish citizens cancel planned holidays.

name: Turn06_Conriat_TradeWar
title: Conriat At A Standstill
description: The city of Conriat has partially shut down as a result of the Arcasia trade incident. With port traffic ground to a halt and wealthy citizens selling or abandoning their luxury properties as they decamp for Holsord, a full recovery may take months if not years.

name: Turn06_Conriat_UCBase
title: Conriat Naval Base Update
description: United Contana has finished moving its ships to the Conriat Naval Base. As per the terms of the new agreement, the United Contana military is allowed refuel and repair access to the Naval Base in exchange for providing logistical, financial and equipment support to Sordland.

name: Turn06_Conriat_UCBase_ValgslandNavy
title: United Contanan Ships Show Support to Valgslandian Fleet
description: Several of the United Contanan destroyers stationed in the joint Conriat Naval Base have left the port of Conriat in the morning to join the Valgslandian fleet which is patrolling around Heljiland.

name: Turn06_CSP_BearTrapSupport
title: CSP Backs Sordland's Participation in Wehlen's "Bear Trap"
description:
CENTRAL SECURITY PACT
PRESS OFFICE, KYOW
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

The Central Security Pact applauds the Republic of Sordland's meaningful contribution to Wehlen's "Operation Bear Trap." President Smolak and the Wehzek Armed Forces have undertaken necessary measures against Bludish Freedom Front separatist activities in northern Wehlen, and Sordland's participation demonstrates commendable commitment to regional stability.

The strategic significance of this operation cannot be understated. The CSP maintains full confidence in the professional conduct of all forces involved and welcomes continued coordination between both nations. Our endorsement symbolizes the alliance's dedication to the principle of mutual aid and support, as we continue to assert our commitment to collective security. We will continue to support all appropriate measures that secure lasting peace in this vital region.

Tahoka Mazatl
CSP Chief Spokesperson

BY ORDER OF THE CENTRAL SECURITY PACT SUPREME COUNCIL
CLASSIFIED: PUBLIC RELEASE AUTHORIZED

name: Turn06_CSP_CondemnsWar
title: CSP Demands Hostilities Cease
description:
In the interest of peace in the wider region, CSP demands an immediate end to hostilities between Pales and Rizia, condemning the Kingdom of Rizia’s invasion as an unacceptable escalation. The organization hopes talks between the countries can resume swiftly and calls for an immediate ceasefire to ensure civilian life is not endangered.

CSP also strongly urges other regional actors to not get involved militarily, to avoid a wider escalation of the conflict.

name: Turn06_CSP_GalmlandConference
title: CSP's Unity Conference in Galmland
description:
The CSP Unity Conference, recently held in Galmland, marked a pivotal juncture in resolving ideological dissonances within the alliance. Galmland's influential leader, Brighde Halvorsdatir, hosted the gathering amid a burgeoning climate of ideological disagreement propelled by the Galmish Manifesto. This innovative interpretation of Karlos Marcias' communist theory, with its focus on decentralized planning and workers' self-management, has stirred up an ideological storm within the CSP.

While Valgslandian Socialism, sharing similar decentralist sentiments, is seemingly more compatible with the Galmish Manifesto, they diverge notably in their stance on international cooperation. The Manifesto leans towards a cautious approach, preferring to build a self-reliant economy, whereas Valgslandian Socialism champions interdependence, seeing it as a conduit for shared prosperity and security. This difference, albeit subtle, has led to real-world implications, like the instatement of trade tariffs between Galmland and Valgsland, demonstrating the impact of ideological dissonances on economic policies.

The Unity Conference, despite the ideological contention, stressed the importance of common objectives: collective security, economic cooperation, and human rights.

name: Turn06_Derdia_CondemsBearTrap
title: Derdia Condemns Operation Bear Trap
description:
Supreme Wiseman Jorga Azmal has publicly criticized Operation Bear Trap, a military operation targeting the Bludish Freedom Front. Labeling it as an assault on Wruhecist brothers, the Wiseman expressed solidarity with the affected Golcondist Bludish community. He urged Sordland and Wehlen to respect religious and ethnic diversity and to pursue peaceful means in resolving conflicts. 

This criticism highlights the deep tensions between Derdia and the region.

name: Turn06_Deyr_BergiaInvested
title: Governor of Bergia Reports Results
description:
The Governor of Bergia reports that the investment provided by the government has been put into use via various programs for new companies and technology fairs in Deyr.

The opportunity has led to an increase in overall entrepreneurship in the region and revitalised the economy of Bergia, further increasing trade with nearby countries and regions.

name: Turn06_Deyr_BergiaInvested_BludBanned
title: Unexpected Results from Investment in Bergia
description:
The Governor of Bergia reports that the investment provided by the government has been put into use via various programs for new companies and technology fairs in Deyr.

Lasting effects of the lockdown has prevented the expected revenue boost and disappointingly there has not been a return yet for the investment. He has sent his apologies.

name: Turn06_Deyr_BludishProtest
title: Pro-Bludish Protest
description: Governor of Bergia, Phelix Bron, reports that a large group of students gathered in protest in downtown Deyr, disrupting traffic and acting violently. The police immediately reacted and the situation was brought under control.

name: Turn06_Deyr_EnergySurgeImpact
title: Deyr Reels Under the Impact of Energy Price Surge
description: The sharp increase in energy prices has unleashed economic hardship on Deyr. As the cost of living soars due to the rising energy bills, the populace is wrestling with substantial financial strain. The city's economic stability is under threat, and the need for timely intervention is becoming increasingly critical.

name: Turn06_Deyr_ErsenCase_Default
title: Ersen v. Sordland Case
description:
A landmark court filing has been appealed to the Court of Appeals today and is under review by the Minister of Justice. The lawyer and Bludish civil rights activist Ishval Ersen sued Governor Phelix Bron for the infringement of the constitutional rights of equality before the law. The case questions the separate legal treatment of the Bludish in Deyr, and by extension in the whole of Bergia.

Ishval Ersen argues that Governor Bron's policies, including the controversial Resettlement Policy infringes upon the right of property of the Bludish citizens. He claims the Articles 6 and 7 of the Constitution as well as the institution of the Special Zone are in direct conflict with the constitution and thus allows the separate treatment of the Bludish in all of Bergia and beyond.

name: Turn06_Deyr_ErsenCase_ReligiousHarmonySigned
title: Ersen v. Sordland Case
description:
A landmark court filing has been appealed to the Court of Appeals today and is under review by the Minister of Justice. Lawyer and Bludish civil rights activist Ishval Ersen sued Governor Phelix Bron for the infringement of constitutional rights. The case questions the legality of the Religious Harmony Bill, the separate legal treatment of the Bludish in Deyr, and by extension in the whole of Bergia.

Ishval Ersen argues that Governor Bron's policies, including the controversial Resettlement Policy infringes upon the right of property of the Bludish citizens. He claims the Articles 6 and 7 of the Constitution as well as the institution of the Special Zone are in direct conflict with the constitution and thus allows the separate treatment of the Bludish in all of Bergia and beyond.

name: Turn06_Deyr_IncreasedBFFSupport
title: Governor Bron Proposes Dividing Up Communities In Bergia
description:
Governor Phelix Bron has reported increased Bludish Freedom Front (BFF) support in Bludish-dominated neighborhoods in Deyr and in all Bergia. To address the issue, the governor has proposed dividing these communities and resettling Sordish and Bludish people to achieve a cultural balance in the Special Zone. The governor believes this approach will limit the influence of the BFF and reduce the risk of secessionist activities in the region. 

However, some officials claim that these measures would be directly against the Constitution and the governor of the Special Zone does not have the authority to enact such policies. This proposal still has raised concerns among some officials who fear it could be implemented, which would lead to further ethnic tensions and social unrest.

name: Turn06_Deyr_ResettlementOrder
title: Governor Bron Enacts "Resettlement" Order
description:
Governor Phelix Bron has issued a "Resettlement Order" allowing the eviction of Bludish citizens suspected of supporting the BFF and dividing up their communities. This policy has caused controversy and backlash, with many seeing it as a violation of the Constitution and calling for the judiciary to strike the order down. The order is seen as a violation of human rights and an attempt to target the Bludish community. 

The governor argues that it is necessary for security reasons and to combat the BFF's influence in the region, and claimed that his authority as the governor of Bergia gives him the legal right to pursue such policies for peace and stability in the region. The situation remains tense, and it is uncertain how this policy will affect the already fragile social fabric of Bergia.

name: Turn06_Elections_RNCPollSurge
title: Rizian National Coalition Makes Gains In Polls
description: Preliminary polling ahead of the House of Delegates elections is showing a sudden, strong surge in support for the Rizian National Coalition.

name: Turn06_Elections_RPPPollSurge
title: Rizian People's Party Makes Gains In Polls
description: Preliminary polling ahead of the House of Delegates elections is showing a sudden, strong surge in support for the Rizian People's Party.

name: Turn06_Erlory_ArcasianBase
title: Erlory Air Base Update
description: Arcasia has finished moving its planes to the Erlory Air Force Base. As per the terms of the new agreement, the Arcasian military is allowed refuel and repair access to the Air Force Base in exchange for providing logistical, financial and equipment support to Sordland.

name: Turn06_Erlory_DecreasedJustice
title: Justice System Overwhelmed
description:
The decreased funding of the Ministry of Justice has led to an unmanageable backlog of court cases. There have been reports all over Sordland from local courts stating they do not have a sufficient number of personnel to work through the backlog.

With the current estimates, clearing the backlog will take approximately 11 years with the current staff.

name: Turn06_Erzaren_BannedWPB
title: Crackdown on Bludish Separatists
description: Governor of Bergia, Phelix Bron, reported that the regional police forces have infiltrated hidden facilities used by the Workers Party of Bludia and the Bludish Freedom Front, arresting 60 enemies of the state.

name: Turn06_Erzaren_Emergency_Revoked
title: Citizens Celebrate Revocation of National Emergency
description: Citizens in Erzaren reacted positively to the revocation of the national emergency, with impromptu fireworks in the town square. Many had previously voiced their opposition to the increased police presence in their city.

name: Turn06_Erzaren_ProtestGovernor
title: Protest Against Governor Bron's Resettlement Order
description:
A massive protest erupted in Erzaren against Governor Bron's latest "Resettlement" policies. The order gives the governor the authority to evict Bludish citizens suspected of supporting the BFF and divide up their communities within the Special Zone. 

The protest was largely peaceful, but tensions rose when Bergian Security Forces arrived to disperse the crowd, leading to some clashes. The governor's controversial policy has sparked widespread anger among Bludish communities and human rights groups, who have called for the order to be repealed. The situation in Bergia remains volatile, and it is recommended that the government engage in dialogue with all parties to defuse tensions and find a peaceful resolution to the crisis.

name: Turn06_Estord_EnergyPricesHurt
title: Estord's Locals Bear the Brunt of High Energy Prices
description: The escalating energy prices are causing distress among the locals in Estord. Residents are feeling the pinch as the cost of essential utilities skyrockets. The adverse impact on the community's quality of life and economic wellbeing is raising concerns and calls for immediate action.

name: Turn06_FolceDator_MilitaryIndustryOutputIncrease
title: Military Industry Pledges Record Output
description: The recently expanded military factories located in Folce Dator have pledged to deliver an unprecedented amount of military hardware for the King’s army in the coming months. Industry leaders thanked the Treasury for previous investments and proclaimed the desire to repay their debt to the Crown. Some local workers organizations have reacted disgruntled to this news, fearing longer working hours and worse conditions.

name: Turn06_FortAles_CityOnHighAlert
title: Curfew Imposed
description: Authorities in Fort Ales have imposed a strict curfew between 8am and 8pm. Additionally, requests have been made for citizens to keep off any lights at night, with monuments and vital infrastructure being covered in sandbags to prepare for potential conflict.

name: Turn06_FortAles_PalesIncursion
title: Rizian Troops Surround Navar Castle
description: Rizian forces have surrounded the ancient paleaccis of Navar, where the Palesian troops that attacked Rizian soil have been holed up ever since they crossed the Alca river. Prior to seizing the castle, the Palesians shot dead six Rizian soldiers that were patrolling the area. Occasional gunfire can be heard in the area, but so far no storming of the castle is taking place.

name: Turn06_FortAles_PalesIncursionCleared
title: Rizian Troops Take Back Seized Castle
description:
After Palesian troops crossed into Rizian territory, fired on a patrol and seized the paleaccis of Navar, the Rizian Army has now struck back. Mere hours after the castle was occupied, Rizian troops stormed it, killing the dozen Palesian soldiers holed up inside and losing eight men in the process.

The firefight lasted only half an hour and special care was taken not to damage the historically significant site.

name: Turn06_FortAles_WarEnlistments
title: Fort Ales' Youth Lead the Charge in War Enlistment
description: The city is witnessing a surge in military enlistment, particularly among the youth, following the royal rallying cry for war. The city's historic military academy has become a hub of activity, with young men and women signing up to defend Rizia. This enthusiastic response highlights Fort Ales' reputation as a cradle of military leadership and its pivotal role in shaping the future of the armed forces in these critical times.

name: Turn06_GRACE_SupportsRizia
title: GRACE Reiterates Support For Rizian Security
description:
GRACE stands by Rizia’s right to secure its national interests. We condemn Palesian aggression against Rizian military assets and call for a swift resolution of the conflict in order to prevent a wider conflagration. 

In regards to the Aureus Gas Field, GRACE supports Rizia’s claim, as over 50% of the field lies within Rizian maritime boundaries. Pales’ attempt to claim rights to it can be considered a violation of Rizian sovereignty.

name: Turn06_GRACE_SupportsVendonesam
title: GRACE Nations Commit Support to Vendonesam
description:
GRACE announces an increase in support for the monarchist forces in Vendonesam as part of its efforts to uphold the principles of monarchic governance and promote regional stability. This action is intended to assist the royalist troops in restoring order amid the nation’s ongoing civil conflict.

Logistical aid, intelligence coordination, and diplomatic engagement form the foundation of GRACE’s support strategy. The organization reaffirms its steadfast solidarity with its allies in Vendonesam, emphasizing the importance of unity among monarchic nations in addressing shared challenges and contributing to global stability.

name: Turn06_Holsord_ACP_OldGuard
title: Anti-Corruption Police Investigation Update
description: The Anti-Corruption Police have completed preliminary investigations into suspected members of the ‘Old Guard’, including Orso Hawker, Heron Garaci, Lileas Graf, and Valken Kruger. No concrete proof of corruption or other wrongdoing has as yet been revealed.

name: Turn06_Holsord_ACP_Oligarchs
title: Anti-Corruption Police Investigation Update
description: The Anti-Corruption Police have completed preliminary investigations into Sordland’s main oligarchs, Marcel Koronti and Walter Tusk. No concrete proof of corruption or other wrongdoing has as yet been revealed.

name: Turn06_Holsord_ACP_Opposition
title: Anti-Corruption Police Investigation Update
description: The Anti-Corruption Police have completed preliminary investigations into members of the political opposition. No concrete proof of corruption or other wrongdoing has as yet been revealed.

name: Turn06_Holsord_BludishReformCommittee
title: Bludish Rights To Be Added To Current Reform Proposal
description:
Minister of Justice, Nia Morgna, reports that the reform committee was formed to check for possibilities to include new changes to the reform proposal as was asked, and she reports that they are already working on a proposal to change Article 6 and 7 to remove the racist elements from our constitution. 

The reform committee is now working to gain support for the new proposal and also includes the leaders of the Bludish rights movement, including independent MP Mansoun Leke and Workers Party of Bludia leader Fetih Ejall.

name: Turn06_Holsord_CommunityPolice
title: Community Police Update
description: The Community Police has completed its first round of volunteer training. A total of 800 Agno-Sordish, Sordish and Bludish citizens from the Nargis, Agnland and Bergia regions have received lessons in combat, de-escalation, first aid, and Sordish law. They have now been deployed to keep watch within their communities.

name: Turn06_Holsord_EducationPrivatization
title: Education Privatization Update
description: The Ministry of Education has reported that the privatization effort for education has been going well and that they are on track to meet targets. The capital received from the privatized schools and competing private investors has already shown results in the form of new schools and improved quality of education in most major cities.

name: Turn06_Holsord_EIRAProposal
title: EIRA Bill Proposed in Holsord to Combat Energy Inflation
description: The Grand National Assembly in Holsord has drafted the Energy Inflation Reduction Act (EIRA) in response to the recent surge in energy prices. The bill proposes a temporary price cap on gas prices, bilateral agreements with energy-rich countries, and the expansion of domestic energy production. This comprehensive approach is geared to mitigate the inflationary pressures on energy prices and stimulate domestic economic growth.

name: Turn06_Holsord_EmergencyReview_Revoked
title: Supreme Court To Retroactively Review The Constitutionality of the Emergency
description: Chief Justice Hawker announced that the Supreme Court has agreed to review Frens Ricter’s complaints about the unconstitutionality of the past state of emergency. The Supreme Court has taken the case and will be proceeding with a retroactive judicial review of the emergency decree.

name: Turn06_Holsord_EmergenyReview_Extended
title: Supreme Court To Review The Constitutionality of the Emergency
description: Chief Justice Hawker announced that the Supreme Court has accepted to review Frens Ricter’s complaints about the unconstitutionality of the state of emergency. The Supreme Court has taken the case and will be proceeding with a judicial review of the emergency decree.

name: Turn06_Holsord_ErsenCaseGoesToCourt
title: Ministry of Justice Files Ersen v. Sordland Concurrence
description:
The Ministry of Justice has reviewed the Ersen v. Sordland case and put forward its concurrence opinion before sending the dispute to the Supreme Court. The Minister of Justice, Nia Morgna, came forward agreeing with the case of Ishval Ersen and pointed out that a majority court dissent would do disservice to the legal precedent of future constitutional rights cases.

The case is now in the hands of the Supreme Court.

name: Turn06_Holsord_GeneralStaffGathers
title: General Staff Gathers
description: The General Staff has convened at the Ministry of Defense today to assess the security conditions of Sordland. More than twenty high-ranking officers were in attendance and discussed several war plans, the internal stability of the nation and the overall state of the armed forces.

name: Turn06_Holsord_GeneralStaff_NoConscription
title: General Staff Releases Statement
description: The General Staff made a statement about the danger of the anti-military stance the current government has taken. The press release highlights that the lack of Presidential support for the military is a major concern for the stability and defense of the nation. The staff opposed the reduction of the active field army.

name: Turn06_Holsord_InflationCrisis
title: Inflation Crisis Hits Sordland
description: The Ministry of Economy reports that recent government spending has left the country in constant debt. A considerable number of businesses are convinced that the Central Bank will print more money to cover the deficits. Hence, they are selling Ren reserves resulting in the prices of goods, services, and wages across the economy to rise substantially. Economists in the ministry fear that the country is falling into a debt trap.

name: Turn06_Holsord_LanguageBill
title: Language Bill Prepared by Kesaro
description: Kesaro Kibener is preparing a bill which aims to unify Sordish education by making Sordish the only language accepted in educational institutions, excluding specific foreign language studies.

name: Turn06_Holsord_NFP_Convinced
title: NFP Conference
description:
At yesterday’s party conference of the NFP, Kesaro Kibener announced that he will be giving his full support to the constitutional changes proposed by the USP. He asked the members of his party to follow him in this endeavour and set aside their differences for the greater good of the country.

NFP Group Deputy Chairman Mr. Holstron blamed the party leadership for ‘softening their image in order to attract more voters and losing track of the party’s real cause.’

name: Turn06_Holsord_NFP_NotConvinced
title: Statement From NFP Deputy
description: NFP Group Deputy Chairman Mr. Holstron made a public statement, criticizing President Rayne and the proposed changes to the constitution, calling the proposal ‘a waste of time and energy.’

name: Turn06_Holsord_PFJP_Convinced
title: PFJP Conference
description: At yesterday’s party conference of the PFJP, Frens Ricter announced that he will be giving his full support to the constitutional changes proposed by the USP. He asked the members of his party to follow him in this endeavour and set aside their differences for the greater good of the country.

name: Turn06_Holsord_PFJP_NotConvinced
title: PFJP Press Release
description: At today’s press release, PFJP Group Deputy Chairwoman Mrs. Suheil announced that their party will be doing everything in their power to block the constitutional changes proposed by the USP.

name: Turn06_Holsord_PrivatizationPlan
title: Privatization Plan Proposal
description: The Ministry of Health has finished a privatization proposal plan in order to increase the resources of the health system and to increase the quality of services through small scale market competition. Additionally, the Ministries report highlighted the weaknesses Sordland has when it comes to a potential epidemic. Minister Beniwoll reported that much more could be achieved through the healthcare system if the private sector could slightly assist by generating new revenue streams and adding new services.

name: Turn06_Holsord_ReformCommitteeUpdate
title: Heated Arguments Against Possible Additions to Proposal
description:
Minister of Justice, Nia Morgna, reports that the reform committee made enormous progress already, with even MP's from the USP showing their support for Bludish Rights. However, after the increase of the USP support, the party leaders started to break into meetings, seeking to delay and obstruct the work of the committee.

Currently, the proposal to change Article 6 and 7 is underway, but heated arguments in the committee is making it difficult to sway the USP leadership. The USP spokespersons demanded to stop the work on new changes to the already agreed proposal -- calling it a "constitutional coup."

name: Turn06_Holsord_SSP_OldGuard
title: Secret State Police Investigation Update
description: The Secret State Police have completed preliminary investigations into suspected members of the ‘Old Guard’, including Orso Hawker, Heron Garaci, Lileas Graf, and Valken Kruger. No concrete proof of corruption or other wrongdoing has as yet been revealed.

name: Turn06_Holsord_SSP_Oligarchs
title: Secret State Police Investigation Update
description: The Secret State Police have completed preliminary investigations into Sordland’s main oligarchs, Marcel Koronti and Walter Tusk. No concrete proof of corruption or other wrongdoing has as yet been revealed.

name: Turn06_Holsord_SSP_Opposition
title: Secret State Police Investigation Update
description: The Secret State Police have completed preliminary investigations into members of the political opposition. No concrete proof of corruption or other wrongdoing has as yet been revealed.

name: Turn06_Holsord_YSJournalistArrested
title: Holsord Post Journalists Arrested For Ties To Young Sords
description: Chief of Police Karl Greiser reported that the investigations on Holsord Post journalists came to it’s conclusion today. Consequently, 4 journalists, including the editor-in-chief of the newspaper were detained for their ties to Young Sords.

name: Turn06_Holsord_YSJournalistReleased
title: Holsord Post Journalists Released
description: 4 journalists, including the editor-in-chief of the Holsord Post who had been awaiting trial for their direct ties to the Young Sords have been released. The authorities responsible for their release reported that the investigations that led to their arrests were filled with mismatching information and not sufficient to find them guilty.

name: Turn06_Iza_Decision_FundReligiousCharities_Dastnurist
title: Local Dastnurist Community Happy With Charity
description: Local Dastnurist groups have stated their gratitude for the King’s generous donation to one of their leading charity organizations. They stated the allocated funds will be used to help alleviate migrant poverty in major population centers like Iza.

name: Turn06_Iza_SuOminaDemandsWarLand
title: Su Omina Calls Border Incident Act Of War
description: The ultranationalist organization Su Omina has held a major rally at Rico Toras’ Royal Residency in Iza. During the rally, the group called the recent Palesian incursion into Rizian lands an act of war and demanded a full scale response from the Crown, calling for a return of Pales to Rizian control.

name: Turn06_Iza_SuOminaDemandsWarNaval
title: Su Omina Demands War
description: During a large rally in Iza, leaders of the ultranationalist Su Omina movement have declared the recent attempt of Palesian ships to break through the Rizian blockade of the Aureus Gas Field an act of war. They demand King Romus to strike back harshly, calling for an escalation of the conflict to bring Pales back under Rizian rule.

name: Turn06_Iza_SuOminaDenouncesWeakness
title: Su Omina Issues Statement Denouncing King’s Weakness
description: Heavy criticism of the Crown has been issued by Su Omina, who demand an explanation on how it is possible that Palesian troops still occupy Rizian land, even after killing multiple soldiers. The ultranationalist organization went as far as threatening to send in its paramilitary wing to seize back the Castle themselves if the situation isn’t resolved in the coming days.

name: Turn06_Iza_SuOminaIntimidatesVoters
title: Low Turnout In Iza Amidst Voter Intimidation
description: RPP representatives have described the actions of the ultranationalist Su Omina group as despicable, as militants armed with clubs and other makeshift weapons guarded several key voting locales throughout the city, turning away voters who didn’t look ethnically Rizian. While the situation was tense and a few arrests were made, it never escalated, but did contribute to unexpectedly low turnout in the RPP’s traditional stronghold.

name: Turn06_Iza_SuOminaMarchesToFront
title: Su Omina Leaders Commence March For Pales
description: Hundreds of Su Omina volunteers have started a long march towards the Palesian border, starting in Iza and planning to pass through multiple towns and cities before they reach their destination. The leaders of the organization called on any sympathizers to join them in their quest and pledges allegiance to the King in case of future conflict.

name: Turn06_Iza_WarEnlistments
title: Citizens Rally to Join the Rizian Armed Forces
description: The city has witnessed a remarkable response to the war declaration. Recruitment centers are inundated with citizens answering the nation's call to arms. From seasoned veterans to young enthusiasts, the diverse group of volunteers symbolizes the city's dedication to Rizia's cause. The enthusiasm in Iza showcases the community's solidarity and readiness to contribute to the war effort on multiple fronts.

name: Turn06_Jales_CoastGuardIncreasesPresence
title: Coast Guard Ups Patrols
description: As part of the expansion of the border guards, the coast guard also received significant investments. Patrols have now been stepped up in the Sudis sea, to avoid any unwanted foreign actors making landfall on Rizia’s long coastline.

name: Turn06_Jen_EmergencyRally
title: Rally Despite Emergency
description: Chief of Police Karl Greiser reported that earlier today hundreds took to streets to protest the Valgslandian government’s actions in the Markian Sea despite the state of emergency. Authorities warned protesters to disperse immediately and that the rallies could be infiltrated by the enemies of the state. The crowd dispersed after the warnings of the local police forces without incident.

name: Turn06_Jen_Emergency_Revoked
title: Jen Citizens Decry Revocation of Emergency
description: At a city council meeting in Jen, citizens voiced their discontent at the lifting of Sordland’s state of emergency. Many claimed the increased police presence had made them feel safer, and that they now felt more vulnerable to encroaching threats. Council members vowed to hire and deploy more police officers within the city.

name: Turn06_Jen_YSArrested
title: Police Raid On Young Sords
description: Dangerous Young Sords members were arrested in a gathering at the local pub of the Saint Dast district of Jen after local intelligence was tipped off by an anonymous source. The raid on the pub resulted in the death of two Young Sords members and one civilian in the gunfight that broke out.

name: Turn06_Kyrute_CongratulateSuccesfulElections
title: Kyrute Congratulates Rizia On Successful Elections
description: The Republic of Kyrute extended its formal congratulations to the Kingdom of Rizia for holding a successful election. It cited a desire for continued diplomatic relations with our Kingdom and wished us a peaceful future.

name: Turn06_Lachaven_L1_SSC_Delayed
title: L-1 Railway Construction Update
description: The Sordish State Corporation has reported that the construction for the L-1 Railway has been officially delayed for a year. The managers of the project apologised in a public statement, taking the blame on themselves.

name: Turn06_Lachaven_L1_Taurus_Delayed
title: L-1 Railway Construction Update
description: Taurus Holding has reported that the construction for the L-1 Railway has been officially delayed for a year. The managers of the project apologised in a public statement, blaming the strikes for the delay.

name: Turn06_Lachaven_MarketsCrash
title: Black Tuesday Hits Lachaven
description: The market crash has plunged Lachaven into chaos. Some of the city’s most powerful corporations have already declared bankruptcy and shops along Republic Avenue have boarded up their windows in anticipation of possible looting. Lachaven’s famed bars and clubs are also operating at half-capacity as citizens spend less money on non-essentials.

name: Turn06_Lachaven_NBCPricesBalanced
title: Balanced Energy Prices in Lachaven, Reports NBC
description: The National Business Council in Lachaven has reported a balanced energy market. Despite regional fluctuations, Lachaven has maintained stable energy prices, which have had a positive impact on the local economy. This stability is fostering an encouraging business environment and promoting economic wellbeing among the populace.

name: Turn06_Lachaven_NBCPricesFluctuate
title: Energy Price Fluctuations Raise Concerns, NBC Reports
description: The National Business Council in Lachaven has reported fluctuations in energy prices. These oscillations have injected uncertainty into the local economy, causing concern among households and businesses. Policymakers and the council are monitoring the situation closely and exploring measures to stabilize the energy market.

name: Turn06_Lachaven_NBCPricesSurge
title: Surge in Energy Prices Alarms NBC
description: The National Business Council in Lachaven has reported a surge in energy prices. This sharp increase is causing widespread distress, with high energy costs negatively affecting households and businesses. The drastic shift in the energy market is sounding alarm bells, with urgent calls for strategies to mitigate the impact.

name: Turn06_Lachaven_TradeWar
title: Values Plummet In Lachaven
description: Lachaven is still reeling from the fallout of the trade war with Arcasia, as its largest exporters suddenly find their products’ value plummeting. A wave of bankruptcies is expected to result, as well as considerable damage to Lachaven’s tourism and nightlife industries.

name: Turn06_Lespia_CongratulateFreeElections
title: Lespia Congratulates Rizian Free Elections
description: Lespian Prime Minister Alvarez has expressed his support for Rizia’s decision to hold free and fair elections for the first time in history. He praised King Romus for his brave decision to reform the electoral law, so close to the vote.

name: Turn06_MaveNortus_IntelligenceTrainingOperations
title: Intelligence Hub Starts Language Program
description: The new Mave Nortus Intelligence hub continues stepping up operations, with experts in the Wehzek language now teaching new operatives the language. Fluent knowledge of the difficult language is supposed to help operatives blend in in the Zille region.

name: Turn06_Mermi_SuOminaBoatRally
title: Su Omina Commences Boat Rally
description: Hundreds of small vessels gathered in Mermi’s harbor today, flying an array of Rizian and Su Omina flags. Harsh criticism towards the monarchy was issued by the group over the retreat of Rizia’s navy from the Aureus gas field after the AN ruling. While the initial goal of the rally was to sail all the way to the disputed field, the coastguard swiftly intervened and rerouted the convoy back to port.

name: Turn06_Mermi_TroopMovements
title: Rizian Divisions Move South
description: Rizian army troops are on the move in the Mermi region, partaking in a strategic repositioning towards the Pales border. This is the first time the brand new Topes-Mermi-FortAles strategic linkage project has seen significant use, with columns of tanks and other military vehicles moving south along it.

name: Turn06_MITZ_Decision_MalenyevistWorkerStrike_SolidarityStrike
title: MITZ Workers Announce Solidarity Strike
description: The Morellan Assembled Mine Workers Union has called for a one day strike in solidarity with the dispersed strike in Argno, just over the border. The AMWU also mobilized Rizian workers active in the zone and brought in workers from Argno to speak at a large rally in the town of Meftiem.

name: Turn06_Monqiz_Decision_CigarettesFloodMarket_DistributeDiscounted
title: Cigarette Prices Slashed, Sales Surge
description:
The Crown has reduced taxes on tobacco, sending cigarette prices tumbling across Monqiz. Shops are seeing brisk business, with lines forming outside popular tobacconists.

Some worry the move will encourage long-term dependence, especially among the youth. Meanwhile, Dastnurist leaders have voiced strong disapproval, citing moral and health concerns.

name: Turn06_Monqiz_Decision_CigarettesFloodMarket_DistributeFree
title: Smoke Without Cost
description:
Crates of cigarettes are being handed out freely in Monqiz and nearby cities. Crowds gather around distribution points, eager for the giveaway. 

While the public mood appears upbeat, health officials and religious leaders warn of long-term consequences. Several Dastnurist sanctuaries have issued statements condemning the policy.

name: Turn06_Monqiz_Decision_CigarettesFloodMarket_DistributeWehlenTabaccoFree
title: Free Wehlen Cigarettes
description: Imported tobacco from Wehlen has flooded the Rizian market, fueling an unprecedented cigarette distribution campaign. Local authorities report a sharp rise in smoking rates, particularly among young adults. In Plavo and Monqiz, clerics have voiced concern over the moral implications.

name: Turn06_Monqiz_Decision_CigarettesFloodMarket_DontMeddle
title: Cigarette Sales Surge
description: With the flood of tobacco products continuing unimpeded, Monqiz tobacconists report record sales, while inspectors quietly monitor for contraband. Public health advocates say they are preparing for long-term consequences. For now, the smoke rises freely.

name: Turn06_Monqiz_Decision_CigarettesFloodMarket_LaunchAwareness
title: Campaign Warns of Smoking Risks
description:
Pamphlets, illustrated posters, and radio broadcasts have begun appearing across Monqiz as part of a Crown-sponsored health initiative. 

While tobacco remains widely available, officials hope that spreading awareness will guide citizens toward better choices.

Some tobacconists worry the campaign may impact sales, while physicians and educators welcome the shift toward prevention.

name: Turn06_Monqiz_Decision_PublicTransportationWorse
title: Railway Permanently Out Of Service
description: Due to a series of failures and increasingly costly repair requirements, the Porte Drazon-Monqiz railway has been put out of service indefinitely. The head of Rizia’s railways said in a statement: “unless significant investments are made, more and more lines will continue to fall into disrepair”.

name: Turn06_Monqiz_WarEnlistments
title: Monqiz's Strong Response to War Mobilization
description: The response to the war mobilization has been overwhelmingly positive. Citizens from all walks of life are showing up in droves at recruitment centers, demonstrating their eagerness to support Rizia's military campaign. The city, known for its rich cultural diversity, is presenting a united front, with community leaders and local organizations actively encouraging participation in the war effort.

name: Turn06_Montaklar_AzaroRalliesForWar
title: House Azaro Holds Military Parade
description: A military parade in front of the Azaro castle took place in Montaklar. While the parade was highly symbolic, with mainly personal bodyguards and important house figures taking part, it nonetheless demonstrated the house’s commitment to military prowess.

name: Turn06_Montaklar_WarEnlistments
title: Record Numbers at Recruitment Offices
description: The spirit of patriotism is palpable as young and old alike flock to recruitment offices, eager to serve Rizia in its war against Pales. Long lines of volunteers, united by a common cause, are a show of the unwavering commitment of the city, for the national effort. Local officials report an unprecedented surge in enlistment, reflecting Montaklar's strong tradition of military service and its residents' resolve to defend their homeland.

name: Turn06_Morella_CongraltulateRPPWin
title: Morella Extends Solidarity To RPP
description: Morella’s Prime Minister, Alma Saltana, has congratulated the RPP on its victory in the Rizian election. She highlighted shared values between the Rizian opposition party and her own and called upon King Romus to respect the results and be open to fruitful collaboration with the RPP.

name: Turn06_Morna_EnergyFluctImpact
title: Energy Fluctuations Impact Lorren's Morna
description: Energy price fluctuations in Lorren's Morna have brought about significant economic implications. Households and industries are grappling with the uncertainty and irregularity of energy costs, leading to financial stress and dampened business activity. Local authorities are considering intervention measures to stabilize the energy market and mitigate the impact.

name: Turn06_Morna_EnergySurgeImpact
title: Energy Price Surge Creates Challenges in Morna
description: Morna is facing an economic challenge with a recent surge in energy prices. The abrupt hike has inflicted a heavy financial burden on households and businesses, causing substantial economic distress. The situation calls for immediate and effective strategies to counter the impact and restore economic stability.

name: Turn06_Morna_ForeignEnergyInvestments
title: Foreign Investments in Coal Surge
description: Following the recent amendment to the Energy Protection Act, Morna has experienced a surge in foreign investments in the coal sector. The softened regulations have invited an influx of overseas capital, providing a much-needed boost to Lorren's struggling coal industry. This development holds promising prospects for the sector's revival and the local economy.

name: Turn06_Morna_LorrenInvested
title: Governor of Lorren Reports Results
description:
The Governor of Lorren reports that the investment provided by the government has been put into use via various programs for new companies and technology fairs in Morna.

The opportunity has led to an increase in overall entrepreneurship in the region and revitalised the economy of Lorren, further increasing trade with nearby countries and regions.

name: Turn06_Morna_PoliceViolence
title: Police Violence
description: The Chief of Police in Morna has put forward an assessment report regarding the performance of the local security forces in maintaining public order. According to the police chief, the force quelled a dozen unrest incidents with little loss of life on the side of the security forces.

name: Turn06_Narbel_Protests
title: Protests In Narbel
description: The Mayor of Narbel reports that 5000 demonstrators gathered on the streets of the city to protest the government. Demonstrations were peaceful and the citizens dispersed peacefully after four hours.

name: Turn06_Pales_AntiRizianProtests
title: Thousands March To Demand Repercussions For Sailor Deaths
description: Hundreds of thousands of people have gathered across Palesian cities demanding the international community to take action against what is perceived as a Rizian war crime. The sinking of a Palesian vessel by Rizian ships and the subsequent failure to rescue the sailors aboard said ship has sparked outrage across all levels of Palesian society.

name: Turn06_Pales_Decision_SabotagePalesianDefences
title: Pales Accuses Rizia Of Covert Action
