description: Palesian officials have lashed out at our country, accusing us of sabotaging vital military infrastructure. The country also pleaded to the international community for help, asking for diplomatic pressure on our Kingdom to avoid a military confrontation between our two countries.

name: Turn06_Pales_Mobilizes
title: Pales Condemns Invasion, Calls For International Support
description: Pales’ Grand Duke Axel Reinhart strongly condemns Rizia’s invasion and calls upon the international community to stand with Pales against this act of aggression. Pales is announcing a full mobilization of its society, calling for all young abled men to enlist in the military and for transformation of the economy into a state of war.

name: Turn06_Pales_NavyPutOnHighAlert
title: Palesian Navy Ready To Challenge Blockade
description: The Grand Duchy of Pales announced that it’s readying its navy to defy the blockade of the Aureus gas field by Rizian ships. It pointed out that according to the AN ruling the blockade of the gas field is a severe violation of international law and stated that while it had no intention of expanding the conflict, the Palesian navy would not hesitate to implement the AN ruling.

name: Turn06_Pales_ThanksRomusForVisit
title: Pales Thanks King Romus For Visit
description: The Palesian government thanks King Romus for his swift trip to Pales to avoid a further escalation of the tense situation. Pales hopes for future relations with Rizia to be fruitful and based on mutual respect and understanding.

name: Turn06_Pales_VinaKeptHostage
title: Princess Vina To Be Held In Pales
description: The Reinhart government has announced its refusal to allow Princess Vina to return home despite the termination of her diplomatic duties in Pales. According to their communique, the Princess is being held at an undisclosed location and will be flown back to Rizia once a resolution is reached in the current conflict.

name: Turn06_Pales_VinaSentBack
title: Princess Boards Plane To Rizia
description: Princess Vina has officially terminated her diplomatic duties in Pales and has been safely escorted to a charter plane. She is expected to arrive in Porte Drazon this evening.

name: Turn06_Plavo_Decision_FundReligiousCharities_Golcondist
title: Local Golcondist Community Welcomes Charity Spending
description: Local Golcondist groups have welcomed the charity money allocated to them by the central government. They promise the money will be spent wisely and go to those that need it the most.

name: Turn06_PorteDrazon_CommunicationsBlackout
title: Communications Cut Across Rizia Imperii
description: In order to hinder foreign espionage attempts and avoid unrest, the Palace has ordered all radio and telephone lines to be shut down across the entire Rizia Imperii provinces. This drastic policy signifies something big might be about to hit the country, which could put national security at risk.

name: Turn06_PorteDrazon_HomelessnessSkyrockets
title: Homelessness Rate Highest In South-East Merkopa
description: Porte Drazon’s homelessness rate has broken a new record, surpassing all other cities in the region as it passed the 0,8% threshold. City officials indicated that it has started to threaten the city’s global reputation as a popular tourist destination.

name: Turn06_PorteDrazon_LucitaArrested
title: Lucita Azaro Detained For Treason
description:
The Golden Guard has captured and detained Lucita Azaro, Duchess of Cardesse-Montaklar and Rizia's Royal Councilor of War and Security. On the orders of His Majesty, an official arrest by the Rizia Imperii police force is to be made shortly. 

On her way to the detention cell, Duchess Azaro claimed innocence and demanded an audience with the King. Her request was denied.

name: Turn06_PorteDrazon_LucitaBehindIncident
title: Investigation Reveals: Lucita Instigator Of Border Incident
description: The joint investigation into the border incident between Pales and Rizia has unearthed an unlikely culprit: Lucita Azaro. The Duchess of Cardesse-Montaklar and Councilor of War was revealed to have staged the incident in order to provoke a wider conflict between Rizia and Pales.

name: Turn06_PorteDrazon_ShareField_Agreement
title: Rizia, Pales To Begin Drafting Gas Field Co-Ownership Agreement
description: Following our discussion with Duke Axel Reinhart, the economic ministries of the Kingdom of Rizia and the Grand Duchy of Pales are to begin drafting a resource sharing agreement for the Aureus Gas Field. The King and the Grand Duke will have the opportunity to review the agreement in the coming months.

name: Turn06_PorteDrazon_SuspiciousNewEmployees
title: Suspicious New Employees Reported
description: Following internal recommendations, local authorities have initiated standard background verifications on recent hires within the country's energy companies. The checks, classified as part of ongoing workforce integrity assessments, were prompted by reports of unusual inquiries regarding operational protocols, including system security and emergency procedures. Officials maintain that this measure is precautionary and consistent with routine regulatory oversight.

name: Turn06_PorteDrazon_VigilForVina
title: Vigil For Vina Draws Massive Crowds
description: The nighttime vigil held to pray for the safe return for Princess Vina from Pales amidst rising tensions has drawn over a million people to the streets of the capital. Candles were handed out to participants, creating a haunting image of streets illuminated by candlelight, while religious chants echoed across the wide boulevards.

name: Turn06_Report_Aureus_TensionsRiseAwaitingAN
title: Tensions Rise As AN Decision Approaches
description: The standoff between Rizian and Palesian vessels around the disputed Aureus gas field is heating up in the run up to the long awaited Alliance of Nations arbitration regarding the issue. Both sides have accused each other of dangerous maneuvers endangering each other's ships, with frequent propaganda being broadcasted at each other by large loudspeakers on board the vessels.

name: Turn06_Ribel_WPBArrested
title: Illegal Event By WPB
description: Gendarmerie units ran into unidentified vehicles in the countryside of Ribel, and upon further investigation discovered a hidden gathering of the banned Worker's Party of Bludia members. The event was raided by the soldiers and while some suspects escaped in vehicles most were successfully brought into custody.

name: Turn06_Rizia_ConcernsGolcondistRefugees
title: Rizia Voices Concern over Golcondist Refugees
description: King Romus has expressed concerns regarding the potential influx of Bludish Golcondist refugees following escalating tensions along the Wehlen-Sordland border. He emphasized the need for Sordland to respond quickly and humanely, advocating for the protection of vulnerable populations and their safe stay within the country.

name: Turn06_Rumburg_CongratulateRNCWin
title: Message From Your Sister-In-Law
description:
“Dear Romus,

On behalf of the Kingdom of Rumburg, I would like to extend my official congratulations with the victory of the RNC in your elections. It warms my heart to see just how much your people support you. “

name: Turn06_Rumburg_HailsEnergyCooperation
title: Rumburg Applauds Sordish Energy Cooperation
description:
Queen Beatrice Livingston has praised Sordland's energy cooperation with Rizia's Rizian Oil and Gas state corporation and the ensuing lift of the Energy Protection Act limits. Rumburg, a significant investor in Gasom and other private Sordish energy companies via Royal Emerald Energy, stands to benefit from the cooperation. 

As with other fellow GRACE members, Rumburg sees these developments as an opportunity for increased economic interdependence outside of the intergovernmental organization, expressing optimism for more prosperous collaborations.

name: Turn06_Rumburg_JointOperation_Condemn
title: Rumburg Condemns “Terror” Against Bluds
description: In an official proclamation, Queen Beatrice of Rumburg has condemned Sordland and Wehlen’s joint operation against the Bludish Freedom Front, calling it a “campaign of terror”. This lends credence to the suspicion that Rumburg is aiding the Freedom Front in its fight.

name: Turn06_Sallabas_DrugHousingEstates
title: Local Landowners Complain About Drug Abuses
description: A coalition of local landowners have issued a formal complaint against the Tenant Protection Laws, claiming that increasing narcotics use inside the city is affecting the cleanliness and safety of their properties and that while under previous laws they would be able to simply evict the tenants, that is no longer the case.

name: Turn06_Sordland_BlackTuesday
title: Sords Scramble To Deal Black Tuesday
description: Black Tuesday caused a financial collapse today around Sordland, with shops closing and hastily adapting to the prices of goods rapidly tripling. Across the country, thousands of people were seen waiting in front of shops forming queues to buy necessary supplies as part of the mass panic caused by the crisis. The financial repercussions are now influencing all facets of Sordish society, and beyond.

name: Turn06_Sordland_CongratulateRNCWin
title: Anton Rayne Congratulates RNC
description: Sordish President Anton Rayne has formally congratulated the RNC with their election win, calling the victory a “triumph for stability and order” in the region. He further expressed his desire to continue improving relations with our now strengthened Monarchy.

name: Turn06_Sordland_CongratulateRPPWin
title: Anton Rayne Congratulates RPP
description: Sordish President Anton Rayne has congratulated the RPP with their election win, emphasizing that both his USP and the Rizian party share the aim of democratizing their respective countries.

name: Turn06_Terador_AirbaseStormed
title: Protesters Attempt To Storm Airbase
description: Anti war activists attempted to storm the newly expanded airbase at Terador in the early morning, as the first planes took off on missions over Palesian airspace. In the interests of national security, army troops quickly routed the protesters, with occasional gunfire reported in the forests surrounding the facility.

name: Turn06_Terador_AirbaseVisit
title: King Visits Terador Airbase
description: Together with Duchess Azaro, King Romus has taken a tour of the Terador airforce base, inspecting the state of Rizia’s air forces in the process and meeting with some of Rizia’s most decorated pilots.

name: Turn06_Terador_AribaseStormed
title: Protesters Attempt To Storm Airbase
description: Anti war activists attempted to storm the newly expanded airbase at Terador in the early morning, as the first planes took off on missions over Palesian airspace. In the interests of national security, army troops quickly routed the protesters, with occasional gunfire reported in the forests surrounding the facility.

name: Turn06_Terador_PeaceActivistsGather
title: Peace Activists Gather On Both Sides Of Border
description:
Several hundred activists have gathered on both the Palesian and Rizian side of the Terador-Ziqes border crossing, calling for restraint after the earlier military incident.

While the gathering has been largely peaceful on the Palesian side, the Rizian army has forcefully dispersed activists blocking road and railways, to avoid the hindrance of possible further military maneuvering.

name: Turn06_Uziren_BludsCrossBorder
title: Bludish Men Reported to Have Crossed Border To Join Fight In Wehlen
description: As Sordland and Wehlen’s joint operation against the Bludish Freedom Front intensifies, there have been reports of Bludish men crossing the border from Sordland into Wehlen in order to aid their compatriots. While the number is insignificant so far, it is suggested the government keep an eye on this troubling trend.

name: Turn06_Uziren_Polio
title: Polio Cases Discovered in Rural Uziren
description: Reports from our border cities indicated that the Polio outbreak in Wehlen has been moving towards Sordland. Specifically, there has been a sharp increase in cases in rural Uziren and nearby villages. Health professionals have been dispatched to curb the infections by quarantining the patients. There are currently 23 active cases in Sordland.

name: Turn06_Valgen_EconomyBad
title: Economic Report from Valgen
description: Valgen is suffering the effects of the economic recession, with unemployment spiking and many small businesses shuttering. The larger agricultural concerns are expected to announce a wave of layoffs as sales slow.

name: Turn06_Valgen_EconomyGood
title: Economic Report From Valgen
description: Valgen is reporting unprecedented prosperity as the economy continues to flourish. Unemployment is at an all-time low, and the region’s agricultural industries are expanding into the surrounding countryside in anticipation of increased exports.

name: Turn06_Valgen_EconomyNeutral
title: Economic Report From Valgen
description: As the economy stagnates, Valgen is reporting a slight dip in employment rates as well as the shuttering of some local small businesses. However, some larger corporations remain unaffected and several of the city’s big agricultural concerns are reporting growth. The local statistics office will continue to oversee the mixed signals.

name: Turn06_Valgen_EnergyFluctImpact
title: Valgen Impacted by Energy Fluctuations
description: The region of Gruni is being impacted by fluctuations in energy prices. These irregularities have placed economic pressures on households and businesses alike, leading to an unstable financial climate. The local authorities are seeking ways to stabilize the situation and mitigate the adverse effects of these fluctuations.

name: Turn06_Valgen_EnergySurgeImpact
title: Energy Surge Impacts
description: An abrupt surge in energy prices is causing economic distress in Valgen. With escalating energy bills, households and businesses are facing considerable financial strains, hindering local economic development. Urgent policy interventions are needed to alleviate the impact and stabilize the energy market.

name: Turn06_Valgen_ForeignEnergyInvestmentsLeave
title: Foreign Investments in Valgen's Energy Sector Withdraw
description: Valgen is witnessing a retreat of foreign investments from its energy sector. This unexpected reversal has raised concerns about the long-term stability and growth prospects of the local energy industry. The authorities are closely monitoring the situation to understand the underlying causes and to devise suitable countermeasures.

name: Turn06_Valgen_RYUnionArrested
title: Crackdown on Labour Union
description: Three leaders of the Labour Union of Sordland were arrested in Valgen today for their ties to the Red Youth. The authorities said a group of workers tried to stop the arrests and were subsequently detained along with the union leaders for obstructing justice.

name: Turn06_Vesord_RYArrested
title: Red Youth Members Arrested
description: Successful operations from the local police forces in Vesord resulted in the capture of two dozen suspected Red Youth members which were found guilty of carrying illegal weapons. The Red Youth members were hiding in a camp deep inside the forest beyond the city’s outskirts and are being held in custody until their trial.

name: Turn06_Wehlen_BorderGuard
title: Wehlen Border Report
description:
Chief of the Armed Forces Valken Kruger reported that the Wehzek Armed Forces are moving north towards the town of Vernen. On their way, many Bludish villages were assaulted and the initial reports indicate a high death toll.

As they are approaching closer to the border, Wehzek armies’ movement will be observed closely. Many displaced refugees from the battles have been seen moving towards the Sordish border. They have been turned around forcefully to ensure the complete defence of the border.

name: Turn06_Wehlen_JointOperation
title: Wehlen Joint Operation Report
description:
Chief of the Armed Forces Valken Kruger reported that the 12th battalion of the 3rd Army along with air support units are moving into Wehlen territory in cooperation with the Wehzek Armed Forces.

The battalion will move from Zeharen and Maradunord southwards and secure the northern part of the River Red with the help of the Wehzek Intelligence, trapping the targets in between two armies.

name: Turn06_Wehlen_JointOperation2
title: Rumburgian Spy Found
description: As joint operations against the insurgents in Wehlen continue, an intelligence agent from Rumburg was captured in the conflict zone. The spy had been embedded in the Wehlen army and admitted to passing along information to the Bludish Freedom Front. He is expected to stand trial for treason later this month.

name: Turn06_Wehlen_JointOperation3
title: Bludish Freedom Front Neutralized In Wehlen
description:
With the help of the Sordish Armed Forces, Wiktor Smolak’s army has effectively managed to eradicate the threat of the Bludish Freedom Front in Wehlen.

The leaders of the insurgency have been either killed or captured, and aerial footage shows that all known hideouts have been eliminated. Sordish troops will stay for several months to ensure peace has been restored before commencing withdrawal.

name: Turn06_Wehlen_NoWehlenDeal
title: Wehlen Military Initiates Assault on Targets
description:
Chief of the Armed Forces Valken Kruger reported that the Wehzek Armed Forces are moving north towards the town of Vernen. On their way, many Bludish villages were assaulted and the initial reports indicate a high death toll.

As they are approaching closer to the border, Wehzek armies’ movement will be observed closely. Many displaced refugees from the battles have been seen moving towards the Sordish border.

name: Turn06_Wehlen_NoWehlenDeal2
title: Wehlen Operations A Mixed Success
description:
Wehlen President Wiktor Smolak is drawing his operations against the Bludish Freedom Front to a close. The consensus is that while Wehlen’s army went a long way towards neutralizing the Bludish threat, there were many preventable casualties.

Furthermore, despite Wehlen’s best efforts, not all hideouts have been eradicated and anti-Smolak sentiment is at an all-time high among the remaining insurgents.

name: Turn06_Zille_ATAFlyerCampaign
title: ATA Spreads Flyers And Posters Throughout Region
description: Using the newly delivered supplies, the Ariana Toras Foundation has embarked on a mass information campaign across the Zille region, distributing leaflets and posters in all major population hubs. The campaign focuses on highlighting the historic ties between Zille and Rizia. Wehzek authorities have engaged in a counter campaign of tearing down the posters wherever they appear.

name: Turn06_Zille_SORailwayAttack
title: SO Attacks Fertilizer Transport
description: The Nationalist Su Omina has targeted a train transport carrying fertilizer from Zille to Nanta. The operation was carried out effortlessly thanks to the recently delivered equipment. No casualties were reported, as the group loaded significant amounts of fertilizer onto a truck and vanished into the Zille hinterland.

name: Turn06_Zille_SORailwayAttackFail
title: Eight SO Members Arrested As Railway Attack Fails
description: Wehzek security forces have thwarted an attempted attack on fertilizer transport by Su Omina. After a brief gunfight, all eight members of the group were arrested, with at least two in critical condition. Wehzek officials point to the attack as an example of why increased security measures in the area are still required.

name: Turn06_Zille_WehlenEncouragesMigration
title: Wehlen Encouraging Migration To Zille
description: By handing out monetary payments and plots of land in rural areas of Zille, Wehlen is attempting to encourage migration of ethnic Wehzeks to the exclave. Rizia condemned the revelations, accusing Wehlen of changing the ethnic makeup of the region that traditionally belongs to the Kingdom.

name: Turn07_Agnolia_PMWarnsValgslandianThreat_AgnoliaAlly
title: Agnolia warns against Valgslandian threat to the seas
description: Yesterday, Prime Minister Maartin Van Hoorten made a statement denouncing Valgsland’s activities in the Markian Sea. “Valgsland’s military activities only strengthen our resolve to defend what is rightfully ours and prove to the world that our alliance with Sordland is a necessary step to keep Valgsland’s aggression in check,” said the Prime Minister.

name: Turn07_Agnolia_PMWarnsValgslandianThreat_AgnoliaAlone
title: Agnolia warns against Valgslandian threat to the seas
description: Yesterday, Prime Minister Maartin Van Hoorten made a statement denouncing Valgsland’s activities in the Markian Sea. “Valgsland’s military activities only strengthen our resolve to defend what is rightfully ours and we will do so alone if we have to” boldly exclaimed the Prime Minister.

name: Turn07_Anrica_YoungSordsSupportPolice
title: Young Sords Support Police Forces
description:
It is reported that Young Sords members have been aiding police forces in Anrica with maintaining public order during the currently active state of emergency. The extent of their involvement and their cooperation with the local security forces remain unclear. 

While Mayor Curtan Leste have praised their efforts to maintain order, others have expressed concern about the potential consequences of working with a group with a history of violent actions.

name: Turn07_Antel_EjallArrested
title: Fetih Ejall Transported to Antel Rock Prison
description:
Minister Graf reports that Fetih Ejall, the leader of the WPB, has been arrested and taken to Antel Rock Prison. The charges against Ejall have not been disclosed to the public yet. 

Ejall's arrest has sparked outrage among WPB supporters, with many taking to the streets to demand his release.

name: Turn07_Antel_RecoveringFromMarketCrash
title: Antel is Recovering
description: The city of Antel has reported starting its recovery from the recent market crash. It is reported that more than 31.53% of its population travel to the nearby city of Conriat and Holsord for work. The crash has left most of the citizens of Antel unemployed due to most companies and shops having closed down during the disastrous event.

name: Turn07_Antel_RequestsAid
title: Antel Requests Aid
description:
Due to the recent crash, the number of unemployed citizens from the city of Antel had increased up to 35.23% of its population. The reason for this is that more than 31.53% of its population travel to the nearby city of Conriat and Holsord for work. The crash has left most companies and shops closed down.

The streets of Antel are now filled with homeless families and the crime rate has increased twice since.

name: Turn07_Antel_WhistleblowerInSafehouse
title: Whistleblower in Safehouse
description:
After receiving Agent Chelston Hailstone we have secretly transferred him to a safehouse near Antel. The perimeter is guarded by special forces units to ensure no escape or rescue attempt can be conducted by Rumburg intelligence.

The agent is currently being interrogated thoroughly to make sure that the preliminary information provided is accurate.

name: Turn07_Antel_WhistleblowerReport
title: Whistleblower Agent Report
description:
Agent Hailstone has revealed intelligence about a secret nuclear weapons program developed in Rumburg. Our intelligence has verified the details relayed about a heavy-water facility in the north of the kingdom and a ballistic missile test site.

The agent will be provided security under the protection program and will be given resources to transfer further intelligence to our units.

name: Turn07_Argno_MalenyevistInfiltration
title: Malenyevist Banner Drop In City Square
description: Argno’s mayor has warned the central government of potential Malenyevist infiltration within his administration, as the town struggles to find those responsible for a wave of Malenyevist propaganda stunts in the small town. It would appear that whoever is behind the activities has inside information and knows in advance when major police maneuvers are happening.

name: Turn07_Arvory_GasomBoomBranchOpens
title: Gasom Branch Opening Boosts Local Economy
description: The opening of a new Gasom branch in Arvory has provided a substantial boost to the local economy. The branch has brought new employment opportunities and promises a stable energy supply, enhancing the city's growth prospects and improving the quality of life for residents.

name: Turn07_Arvory_H3Result
title: Arvory Development Speeds Up Following Highway Construction
description: The completion of the H-3 highway between Lachaven and Arvory has resulted in decreased logistical costs and higher traffic flow to the latter city. The pace of development in Arvory has consequently quickened significantly, with dozens of construction projects now on the horizon.

name: Turn07_Arvory_ValgslandianNavyActive_AgnoliaAlone
title: Valgsland Navy Active in Markian Sea
description: The Heljiland island has been a disputed territory for many years between Agnolia and Valgsland, with Sordland standing on the sideline. Valgsland’s increased navy activities in the Markian Sea are heightening a standoff between the two nations and sharpening their rivalry for each other.

name: Turn07_Arvory_ValgslandianNavyActive_AgnoliaSide
title: Valgsland Navy Active in Markian Sea
description:
The Heljiland island has been a disputed territory for many years between Agnolia and Valgsland. Because of the fact that Sordland is also recognizing the island to belong to Agnolia, Valgslandian navy, probably with hopes to scare us, has been leading patrolling missions close to our territorial waters.

Valgsland’s increased navy activities in the Markian Sea are heightening a standoff between the Agnolia and Valgsland, sharpening their rivalry for each other.

name: Turn07_ATO_CondemsDrugTraffic
title: ATO Expresses Concern Over Drug Trafficking in Central Merkopa
description:
The ATO has issued a vehement condemnation of the drug trafficking activities in Central Merkopa. The illicit trade is said to span several regions, including Kalrad, Erdmarg, Wehlen, and is particularly concentrated in Agard. A growing concern for the international community, Agard, under the rule of Narco-lord Severo Rios, has earned an infamous reputation as a major hub of the narcotics trade.

Rios, however, maintains that his intentions are to regulate and legitimize the drug trade, rather than exploiting it illegally. Surprisingly, he has even expressed an interest in acquiring ATO observer status in an attempt to engage more openly with the international community and alleviate concerns. Nevertheless, the ATO's concerns revolve around not just the law-and-order aspect but also the destabilizing socio-economic impact of this activity. 

Drug trafficking has boosted the shadow economy, bred corruption, and fuelled violence in these regions. The ATO insists on a robust international effort to counter these activities, despite the ambitious and somewhat controversial propositions from Rios.

name: Turn07_ATO_PolarisExploration
title: ATO's IEC Uncovers Energy Resources in Polaris
description:
The ATO's International Expedition Command has established a groundbreaking presence in Polaris, uncovering a wealth of untapped energy resources. These resources, showing promise of sustainability and high yield, have sparked global interest and paved the way for further explorations in the polar region. A scientific achievement, the discovery is said to be a potential game-changer in the energy sector.

During the expedition, the team also encountered indigenous communities that had remained untouched by modern civilization. As they were brought into contact with the outside world for the first time, the ATO now faces the delicate task of respecting their cultural integrity while enabling their integration into the global community. 

It’s a fine balance to strike between advancing scientific exploration and ensuring the welfare of these unique communities.

name: Turn07_ATO_PrivatizationPraise
title: Sordland's Privatization of State Enterprises: Right Direction
description:
In a significant move that marks a major transition in its economic policy, Sordland has initiated the privatization of its state enterprises. The decision has been praised by the ATO, signaling a potential paradigm shift in the nation's economic landscape. The initiative aims to stimulate competition, foster innovation, and improve service quality, whilst boosting the nation's overall economic growth.

This policy change is part of a broader economic reform package introduced by Sordland, intending to reduce state monopoly in key industries and encourage foreign investment. With a particular focus on sectors such as energy, telecommunications, and transportation, the privatization move is expected to stimulate efficiency and competitiveness, thereby attracting potential international investors. 

As Sordland positions itself as a pro-market economy, the ATO recognizes this initiative as an encouraging sign of Sordland's commitment to a free and open economy.

name: Turn07_Borin_EconomyRecovering
title: Borin Economy Report
description: The mayor of Borin reported the prices of goods and necessities are stabilizing. This is a good sign of the start of a reduction in inflation. It has encouraged numerous trade deals within the region, boosting the businesses and, hence the economy back up to where it was.

name: Turn07_Borin_InflationStillBad
title: Borin Inflation Report - Inflation still high
description: There have been reports of a lack of daily supplies in the city of Borin. Citizens in the city are dying of hunger or are lacking necessary supplies. The mayor of Borin reported that people are buying and hoarding goods before the Sordish Ren loses any more value. Unfortunately, their action had only made the situation worse.

name: Turn07_Bronaz_Decision_WelfareProtestExpands_Default
title: Thousands Descend On Sleepy Bronaz
description: A large demonstration filled the streets of Bronaz, as people from across the country traveled to the town to demand improved welfare services. Frustration especially was heard at the broken promises of improved spending by the King. While some arrests happened on the margins of the protest, it was largely peaceful.

name: Turn07_Bronaz_Decision_WelfareProtestExpands_RiotPolice
title: Three Killed In Stampede
description:
A large demonstration filled the streets of Bronaz, as people from across the country traveled to the town to demand improved welfare services. Frustration especially was heard at the broken promises of improved spending by the King.

As the night fell, riot police on horseback charged into the crowd, resulting in countless injuries, with at least three protestors dying due to a stampede. Hundreds of arrests were made, with many transferred to other provinces due to limited holding cell capacity in the capital region.

name: Turn07_Bronaz_HousingCrisisSpreads
title: Porte Drazon Commuter Towns Hit By Housing Crisis
description: With large numbers of people unable to live in the capital, despite relying on work there, cities along the major railways and roads have effectively turned into commuter towns. Due to the unexpected growth, Bronaz is now also battling a housing crisis, while other towns within Rizia Imperii like Malcos and Delam reached capital-like rent prices. In these towns, large real estate companies have started raking in record profits from properties purchased years ago.

name: Turn07_Conriat_HOSFullNationalization
title: HOS Nationalized
description: Before leaving, the Heart of Sordland’s ex-CEO, Marcel Koronti, had released a statement titled: “Freedom of the press is dead in Sordland''. However, there is an overwhelming wave of support from within USP applauding the administration’s decision. With HOS under control, public opinions are fully within our grasp.

name: Turn07_CSP_NationalizationPraise
title: CSP Applauds Sordland's Nationalization Initiative
description:
The CSP regards Sordland's recent nationalization initiative as a crucial step in asserting control over key sectors of the economy and protecting the nation’s interests. By bringing critical enterprises under state management, Sordland is ensuring that essential services and industries remain secure from exploitation and operate for the benefit of its people.

This initiative represents more than an economic policy; it reflects a strong dedication to social welfare and the equitable distribution of resources. It emphasizes the government's role as the guardian of public interest, particularly in sectors that have a direct impact on the lives of Sordish citizens.

The CSP commends these efforts to nationalize critical industries, recognizing them as a decisive move to balance economic growth with social equity and to create a future where prosperity is shared by all.

name: Turn07_CSP_SpySatellite
title: CSP Launches First Three Spy Satellites: Leap in Surveillance
description:
Marking a significant leap in its surveillance capabilities, the CSP has successfully launched and operationalized its first three spy satellites. Equipped with advanced imaging and radar technology, these satellites represent a critical step forward in the CSP's defensive preparedness and intelligence-gathering prowess.

The satellites, codenamed "Qatjituk," "Validim," and "Oknihe," will be operating in low-Earth orbit, providing continuous and broad coverage across potential regions of interest. They are designed to deliver high-resolution images for detailed intelligence analysis and incorporate advanced radar systems capable of penetrating cloud cover or darkness.

name: Turn07_CSP_XinaAntiPiracy
title: CSP Sends Peace Armada to Assist XEC
description:
In a spirited demonstration of international solidarity, the CSP has dispatched a Peace Armada to assist the Xinan Economic Cooperation (XEC) in combating piracy. The move has been warmly received by the XEC member nations, particularly Qinal, Xelina, Narashima, and Fenncao, and further strengthens the cooperative ties between CSP and XEC.

The Peace Armada, led by the flagship vessel "Slovarya", comprises of a diverse fleet of destroyers, frigates, and support vessels. Their mission is not only to deter piracy but also to provide humanitarian aid and bolster maritime security in the region. With this action, the CSP reaffirms its commitment to upholding international maritime security and extends its support to allies and strategic partners during times of crisis. 

It also showcases the CSP's dedication to fostering a secure and stable environment for international trade and commerce.

name: Turn07_Derdia_BlessesCongratulatesRitual
title: Derdian Blessings for Sordish Descension Ritual
description:
Supreme Wiseman Jorga Azmal has expressed his deep appreciation for President Anton Rayne's successful conduct of the Day of Descension rituals. He congratulated the President on his performance and sent blessings on behalf of the Nurist Republic of Derdia. Azmal’s congratulatory message highlighted the potential for religious diplomacy in fostering stronger relations between our countries. 

However, he expressed hope that this religious goodwill can translate into improved political and social conditions for all Nurists but specifically Golcondists in Sordland.

name: Turn07_Derdia_BlessesDescensionDay
title: Derdia Extends Blessings on Descension Day
description:
Supreme Wiseman Jorga Azmal has issued a special address on the sacred Day of Descension, sending blessings to the global Nurist community, including those in Sordland. He encouraged all to reflect on the teachings of Nurity and specifically Saint Wruhec and to uphold its principles in their daily lives. 

In a veiled reference to recent tensions, he appealed for reaching Golconda and mutual servitude to God among all nations, irrespective of their beliefs.

name: Turn07_Derdia_EnergyDealShipping
title: Derdia And Rizia Agree To Increase Energy Trade
description: Following negotiations in the Derdian capital, Rizia has agreed to provide Derdia with a steady supply of energy. To achieve this, shipping will increase across the gulf of Moridia, with Rizia to aid Derdia in building the necessary facilities in their port of Yol to be able to receive the precious resource.

name: Turn07_Derdia_MissilesShipped
title: Promised Missiles Shipped To Rizia
description: Derdian military naval vessels have started escorting ships carrying the promised missile system to Rizia. The missiles are being shipped from the Derdian harbor of Yol and will arrive in Rizia in the days to come. Derdian military engineers have also been dispatched in order to help their Rizian counterparts with setting up the systems.

name: Turn07_Derdia_PipelineExtension
title: Rizia And Derdia To Jointly Extend Pipeline
description: The oil and gas pipeline connecting Rizia with Morella will be extended into Derdia, in what will become known as the Transmoridian Pipeline. Construction is starting immediately, with Rizian engineers handling most of the construction.

name: Turn07_Deyr_BergiaSteelFullNationalization
title: Bergia Steel Nationalized
description: The Lotherberg Group's spokesperson, Walter Tusk, has shown his discontent by calling the administration's actions “unconstitutional” and “undemocratic”. A significant number of investors both within and out of Sordland are canceling their orders, most likely due to Mr.Tusk’s influence.

name: Turn07_Deyr_BFF_EliminationOperationBegins
title: Interior Announces Operation Against the BFF
description:
The Interior Ministry has officially announced the commencement of a large-scale operation targeting the leaders of the BFF (Bludish Freedom Front) with the objective of completely dismantling the organization. The operation, described as a crucial step towards restoring security and stability, aims to eliminate the BFF in one swift and decisive action.

According to the report, specialized units and intelligence resources have been mobilized to conduct targeted raids and apprehend key members of the organization. The operation's main objective is to capture or eliminate all high-level members of the BFF, including all of their current leaders.

name: Turn07_Deyr_ErsenCase_ProBlud_WPBCallsPresidentToAction
title: Fetih Ejall Calls For Change To Article 6 and 7
description: The leader of the WPB, Fetih Ejall, has called upon President Rayne and the Grand National Assembly to take action after the recent statements in support of Ishval Ersen. The party has urged the president to include changes to Article 6 and 7 of the constitution in his reform proposal. The WPB believes that these changes are necessary to recognize the diversity of the Sordish population and ensure equality for all citizens. The call to action was also welcomed by the USP's reformist wing.

name: Turn07_Deyr_GovernorIssuesGolcondistThreat
title: Golcondist Threat Against Dastnurists
description:
Governor Bron has issued a warning to the residents of Bergia, urging them to remain vigilant against the threat of Golcondist extremists and potential violence targeting the Dastnurist community. The governor expressed concerns about rising tensions between the two Nurist groups, specifically highlighting the threat that Golcondism poses for the region. 

Bron emphasized the importance of maintaining peace and harmony within the Special Zone and called upon the residents to report any suspicious activities or individuals to the authorities. The governor assured that necessary measures will be taken to ensure the safety and security of all residents, regardless of their religious beliefs.

name: Turn07_Deyr_GovernorIssuesGolcondistThreat_Krull
title: Golcondist Threat Against Dastnurists
description:
Governor Krull has issued a warning to the residents of Bergia, urging them to remain vigilant against the threat of Golcondist extremists and potential violence targeting the Dastnurist community. The governor expressed concerns about rising tensions between the two Nurist groups, specifically highlighting the threat that Golcondism poses for the region. 

Krull emphasized the importance of maintaining peace and harmony within the Special Zone and called upon the residents to report any suspicious activities or individuals to the authorities. The governor assured that necessary measures will be taken to ensure the safety and security of all residents, regardless of their religious beliefs.

name: Turn07_Deyr_GovernorKrullStartsDuty
title: Herbert Krull Assumes Office
description:
Yesterday, Herbert Krull assumed the role of Governor of the Special Zone of Bergia, succeeding former Governor Phelix Bron, who was removed following formal charges. Krull, an experienced politician from the NFP and former deputy to Bron, pledged to prioritize stability and peace in the Special Zone. He called on the people of Bergia to join him in fostering positive developments for the region.

Krull also stressed his dedication to upholding the Constitution and ensuring the rights of all Sords are respected, irrespective of their ethnicity or background.

name: Turn07_Deyr_HomelessnessDecrease
title: Homelessness Among Bludish Decreases
description: Deyr is reporting a 20 percent decrease in homelessness among its Bludish population over the past two years, a development welcomed by Bludish rights activists. The decrease corresponds with a rise in wages and employment in the city following the government decision to invest in the Bergia region.

name: Turn07_Deyr_LanguageBillProtest
title: Bludish Students Drop School In Protest
description: Thousands of Bludish students dropped out of their schools in protest after teachers were forbidden to use the Bludish language in teaching. A Bludish teacher who did not abide by the new law was reportedly arrested by the regional police forces of Bergia for teaching mathematics in Bludish.

name: Turn07_Deyr_ProtestAgainstEjallArrest_Bron
title: Massive Protests Against Ejall's Arrest
description: Governor Bron has issued a report stating that massive protests and riots have erupted in the city of Deyr following the arrest of Fetih Ejall, the leader of the WPB. According to the report, the protests have caused significant damage to public property and posed a threat to public safety. Governor Bron has assured that necessary measures will be taken to restore order and bring those responsible to justice. He has also urged citizens to remain calm and cooperate with law enforcement officials to maintain peace and stability in the region.

name: Turn07_Deyr_ProtestAgainstEjallArrest_Krull
title: Massive Protests Against Ejall's Arrest
description: Governor Krull has issued a report stating that massive protests and riots have erupted in the city of Deyr following the arrest of Fetih Ejall, the leader of the WPB. According to the report, the protests have caused significant damage to public property and posed a threat to public safety. Governor Krull has assured that necessary measures will be taken to restore order and bring those responsible to justice. He has also urged citizens to remain calm and cooperate with law enforcement officials to maintain peace and stability in the region.

name: Turn07_Deyr_WehlenTradeReport
title: Wehlen Trade Report
description: The trade deal struck with Wehlen continues to bear fruit as Bergia sees an upward trend in agricultural exports. Manufacturing industries are also celebrating the decreased production costs that have resulted from the uptick in importation of Wehzek oil in the aftermath of the Operation Bear Trap.

name: Turn07_Erzaren_BludishProtest
title: Erzaren Protests
description:
Thousands of Bludish people have gathered in protest and called for the Special Zone to be abolished. Governor reported that certain groups within the protesting crowd vandalized shops and public property and the regional police force intervene.

According to the report of the police, the group dispersed but hundreds were wounded. The police are also said to have found eleven illegal Rumburgian-made pistols in the crowd.

name: Turn07_Erzaren_BludNationalistsSupportBFF
title: Two Organizations Declare Support For BFF
description:
The largest Bludish nationalist organization in Erzaren, "Children of Izzam," and a local Golcondist cult "Golkonda Bluderat" have publicly declared its full support for the militant organization Bludish Freedom Front. Children of Izzam, known for its strong advocacy of Bludish rights and interests, aligning itself with the BFF publicly, has raised concerns about the potential escalation of violence and destabilization in the region.

Lileas Graf reported that both organizations are now considered to be supporters of terrorism and thus will be swiftly taken to justice.

name: Turn07_Erzaren_ErsenCase_ProtestAgainstDelay
title: Massive Protests Against Court Decision
description:
According to reports, widespread protests have erupted across the city, heightening tensions between the Bludish community and the authorities. The protesters are voicing their frustration over the Supreme Court's decision to postpone Governor Bron's case. Many view the delay as further evidence of the government's disregard for the rights of the Bludish people and a broader agenda of suppression.

Governor Bron stated that special security forces are being deployed to the area to manage the situation.

name: Turn07_Erzaren_ErsenCase_ProtestAgainstSollistOutcome
title: Mixed Reaction and Protests Against Supreme Court Decision
description:
According to the reports, the Bludish people living in the city of Erzaren are outraged by the recent Supreme Court ruling. Despite celebrations of Governor Bron's dismissal taking place on the streets for hours, many are expressing skepticism and frustration towards the government's inability to fully recognize and address the systemic discrimination they face. 

Celebrations on the streets soon turned to protests, with demonstrators calling for more comprehensive reform and reparations for past injustices. Some are also demanding the resignation of Chief Justice Hawker, citing a lack of sensitivity and understanding towards the Bludish community. The situation remains tense, with authorities working to maintain order while also trying to address the grievances of the protesters.

name: Turn07_Erzaren_LocalsProtestJointOperation
title: Erzaren Locals Protest Against Military Presence In Wehlen
description:
Thousands of locals, many of them Bludish, stood and chanted in Erzaren’s main square in opposition to Sordland’s continued military presence in Wehlen following the conclusion of joint operations against the Bludish Freedom Front.

A reported 75 percent of Erzaren citizens disagreed with the initial government decision to intervene in Wehlen.

name: Turn07_Estord_GangViolence
title: Gang Violence Claims More Lives
description: The Police Chief of Estord reported that the local police forces are overburdened in their fight against the Koranelli crime syndicate. According to the report, over the last month three policemen, six civilians, and eleven mob members have been killed by the ongoing gang war between the Skinner Cartel and Koranelli.

name: Turn07_Estord_GangViolenceCurbed
title: Gang Violence Diminished
description: The Police Chief of Estord reported that the local police forces have finally eliminated one of the biggest money making schemes of the Koranelli. According to the report, over the last month, forty mob members have been arrested along with three high-ranking members of the Koranelli.

name: Turn07_FortAles_Decision_AntiAureusProtests_Allowed
title: Protestors Block Roads And Tramlines
description: Scores of environmental protestors have blocked roads and tramlines all over this city. Some local residents complained about being unable to make it to work on time and demanded authorities to take action, while business owners lamented lost revenue. Most disruptions ended by the evening.

name: Turn07_FortAles_Decision_AntiAureusProtests_Dispersed
title: Police Clears Road Blockades
description: Scores of environmental protestors have blocked roads and tramlines all over this city. Some local residents complained about being unable to make it to work on time and demanded authorities to take action, while business owners lamented lost revenue. By noon, most disruptions were cleared up, as police forces went around town and arrested those responsible for ‘disrupting society’.

name: Turn07_Gelsord_GovernmentProtest
title: Anti-Government Protest
description:
Yesterday morning, a group of protesters assembled in front of the Gelsord City Hall and have not yet dispersed. The group was responsible for blocking out vehicles including city buses and transport trucks and have been handing out anti-government pamphlets to passerbys.

The Mayor of Gelsord reported that the situation posed no active danger and that the people are only exercising their right to protest.

name: Turn07_Gelsord_RecessionHitsWorkers
title: Recession Hits Workers
description: As in the rest of Sordland, workers in Gelsord are bearing the brunt of the recession. The manufacturing sector has been hit particularly hard, as a record number of of factory workers filed for unemployment over the past month.

name: Turn07_GRACE_RiziaFutureSummit
title: Rumburg Convenes GRACE Summit
description: Rumburg has called for an emergency summit of GRACE, with royalty of member nations already on their way to Thornbourgh. One noticeable absentee: the King of Rizia, who has not been invited. While Rumburg hasn’t publicly stated the reason for the summit, many assume that it will decide on whether or not Rizia has a future within the organization, following deteriorating relations between the Kingdom and the rest of GRACE.

name: Turn07_Holsord_Amendment_NewProposal
title: New Changes Added To The Constitutional Proposal
description:
The proposal to amend the constitution has been successfully altered to include new changes to Article 6 and 7, specifically addressing Bludish rights. 

The additional amendments have generated significant controversy inside the government, particularly from the USP, whose leaders have expressed a strong desire to hold immediate discussions with the president.

name: Turn07_Holsord_CelebratingRevocation
title: Celebrations After Revocation of Emergency
description:
Today, a large group of people gathered in Soll Square to celebrate the revocation of the state of emergency. The group also called for the revocation of the Soll-era security laws.

The Mayor of Holsord reported that the event transformed into festivities with music playing all around the city. He said that the group were peaceful and nothing out of the ordinary took place.

name: Turn07_Holsord_CurrencyLosesValue
title: Currency Loses Value Against Arcasian Lira
description: Financial reports show that the Sordish ren has steadily been slipping against the Arcasian lira, though the exchange rate has not yet approached the all-time low reached during the Alphonso administration.

name: Turn07_Holsord_EmergencyBeingIgnored
title: Law Enforcement Ignores Emergency Rules
description:
There are countless reports coming in from around the country that the law enforcement authorities are not properly enforcing the rules defined in the emergency decree.

The reports have increased in number right after the Chief Justice announced that the Court will be taking Ricter’s case to review the constitutionality of the decree.

name: Turn07_Holsord_ErsenCase_ConflictedAmendment_BludsPullOut
title: The Bludish Representatives Leave Reform Committee
description: The leaders of the Bludish movement have recently withdrawn from the reform committee that was established to work on changes to Article 6 and 7 of the constitution. This decision follows which they consider to be conflicting statements by the president -- they pointed out that the president defended the current Sollist constitution despite earlier statements of support for Ishval Ersen's arguments. The Bludish leaders, including Mansoun Leke and Fetih Ejall, claim that they have been played by the government once again and that they are not willing to participate in a process that will not result in actual changes that recognize the Bludish people.

name: Turn07_Holsord_ErsenCase_ReligiousBillSigned_Autocrat
title: Supreme Court Files Ersen v. Sordland Dissent
description: The Supreme Court has filed a 8-3 dissent and closed the Ersen v. Sordland case today. Chief Justice Hawker dismissed the concurrence of the Ministry of Justice citing that the Religious Harmony Bill doesn't prevent Bludish people practicing religion in any shape or form. Further press releases were made criticising the words of the Vice Minister of Justice. Bludish constitutional rights won't be in question for some time.

name: Turn07_Holsord_ErsenCase_ReligiousBillVetoed_Autocrat
title: Supreme Court Files Ersen v. Sordland Dissent
description: The Supreme Court has filed a 6-5 dissent and closed the Ersen v. Sordland case today. Chief Justice Hawker dismissed the concurrence of the Ministry of Justice citing that the treatment of Bludish people has been equal before the law. Further press releases were made criticising the words of the Vice Minister of Justice. Bludish constitutional rights won't be in question for some time.

name: Turn07_Holsord_ErsenCase_SupremeCourtChargesBron
title: Supreme Court Finds Governor Bron Guilty
description:
Today, the Supreme Court has charged Governor Bron for enacting the "Resettlement Order," which discriminated against "Sords of different blood" living in the Special Zone of Bergia. The court ruled in favor of Ishval Ersen's argument, and Governor Bron was fined and removed from office. However, the court did not agree with the other arguments put forward by Ersen and maintained that the Constitution already provided equal rights to everyone.

As for the replacement for the governor, the Supreme Court ruled that in extraordinary circumstances such as this, the deputy of the governor shall assume duty until the end of the term instead of President appointing a new governor. The deputy who will assume the office is Herbert Krull -- an old member of the NFP.

The court's decision has garnered mixed reactions from the public, with some applauding the decision to hold the governor accountable for his actions, while others remain skeptical about the effectiveness of the ruling, citing the continuing discrimination against Bludish people. Most of the Bludish population of Bergia condemned the decision -- especially due to Governor Bron's replacement -- who they believe may prove to be worse than Governor Bron.

name: Turn07_Holsord_ErsenCase_SupremeCourtDelaysCase
title: Supreme Court Delays Ersen Case Until Further Notice
description:
Today, the Supreme Court has delayed the case of Ishval Ersen without further notice, thereby allowing Governor Bron to continue his policies in Bergia. Chief Justice Hawker stated that he did not yet find anything unconstitutional about Governor Bron's actions. 

The decision has sparked controversy and anger among those advocating for Bludish rights, who have criticized the Supreme Court for failing to take action to protect vulnerable communities. The delay of the case has been seen as a major setback for those seeking to bring about meaningful change in the country, and has raised concerns about the impartiality of the justice system.

name: Turn07_Holsord_GeneralStaffNegative
title: General Staff Releases Negative Statement
description: Earlier this week, the General Staff held a meeting in which Iosef Lancea had voiced his concerns about the administration. According to rumours, Lancea said, “If this president doesn’t demonstrate the leadership that Sordland needs, both domestically and abroad, then it is time for a new person in the Maroon Palace – the sooner, the better. The fate of our Republic depends upon it.”

name: Turn07_Holsord_GeneralStaffPositive
title: General Staff Releases Positive Statement
description: Earlier this week, the General Staff held a meeting in which Iosef Lancea had voiced his pleasure to work under the administration. According to rumours, Lancea said, “The current president is a man of tradition. He is strong and he is decisive. I had worked with President Soll before, I know President Soll, he is my friend. And I know that he is proud of what President Anton has achieved.”

name: Turn07_Holsord_HeronSentLucian
title: Lucian’s Report About Justice Garaci
description:
Lucian Galade reported that he had a half an hour long meeting with Justice Heron Garaci but failed to convince him to meet with the president. He also said that he did his best to persuade him to support the proposal but didn’t get any proper answers.

He expressed his deep apology for not bringing anything meaningful from his meeting with the justice.

name: Turn07_Holsord_HeronSentNia
title: Nia’s Report About Justice Garaci
description:
Nia Morgna reported that he had a half an hour long meeting with Justice Heron Garaci but failed to convince him to meet with the president. She also said that she did her best to persuade him to support the proposal but didn’t get any proper answers.

She expressed her deep apology for not bringing anything meaningful from her meeting with the justice.

name: Turn07_Holsord_InteriorConfirmsEjallsIntelligence
title: Interior Ministry Confirms The Validity of Fetih Ejall's Intelligence
description:
The Ministry of the Interior has officially confirmed the validity of intelligence received from Fetih Ejall, which provides crucial information about the Bludish Freedom Front (BFF) and the whereabouts of its leaders. The Ministry acknowledges the significant value of this intelligence, stating that it is a valuable asset in their efforts to address the threat posed by the BFF. 

With this information in hand, Lileas Graf expressed her optimism about a historic possibility to neutralize the entire organization with a swift operation.

name: Turn07_Holsord_KibenerShowSupportEmergency
title: Kibener Show Support to President
description: In today’s press statement, Kesaro Kibener of the NFP showed support for President Rayne after the Court’s decision to review the emergency decree. In his speech, he showed full support for the USP leadership, criticized Frens Ricter and called the Supreme Court to “do the right thing”.

name: Turn07_Holsord_KorontiBuysNedam
title: Nedam Bought by Marcel Koronti
description: As of today, The Nedam Mining Group is officially owned by Marcel Koronti. The CEO of Heart of Sordland is extremely grateful for our decisions and promises that the press will support the administration. However, there are voices of discontent within the USP and we should be expecting some pushback within the assembly.

name: Turn07_Holsord_KorontiBuysSSC
title: SSC Bought by Marcel Koronti
description: As of today, The Sordish State Corporation is officially owned by Marcel Koronti. The CEO of Heart of Sordland is extremely grateful for our decisions and promises that the press will support the administration. However, there are voices of discontent within the USP and we should be expecting some pushback within the assembly.

name: Turn07_Holsord_L1_SSC_Soon
title: L-1 Construction Soon To Be Completed By SSC
description:
Logistical problems have plagued the businesses between Holsord and Lachaven for many years, hampering the development speed of the two cities. The L-1 railway is the solution to this problem. Regrettably, the progress is slowing down due to the treacherous terrain, causing landslides, on the path to Gelsord.

Fortunately, there haven’t been any more difficulties since, and the project is expected to be finished in the near future.

name: Turn07_Holsord_L1_Taurus_Soon_SignedBill
title: L-1 Construction Soon To Be Completed By Taurus
description:
Logistical problems have plagued the businesses between Holsord and Lachaven for many years, hampering the development speed of the two big cities. The L-1 railway is the solution to this problem. Regrettably, the project is delayed due to the unforeseen expenses from the new Labour Laws.

Fortunately, there haven’t been any more difficulties since, and the project is expected to be finished in the near future.

name: Turn07_Holsord_L1_Taurus_Soon_VetoedBill
title: L-1 Construction Soon To Be Completed By Taurus
description:
Logistical problems have plagued the businesses between Holsord and Lachaven for many years, hampering the development speed of the two big cities. The L-1 railway is the solution to this problem. With the disaster at the Morbel mine in combination with the vetoed Worker’s Rights bill, Taurus’s Workers were striking causing the project to be delayed.

Fortunately, there haven’t been any more difficulties since, and the project is expected to be finished in the near future.

name: Turn07_Holsord_NedamFullPrivatization
title: Nedam Privatized
description:
As of today, The Nedam Mining Group has officially opened its shares to investors. Many groups and organizations are racing to acquire shares within the corporation. The two major organizations, the Heart of Sordland and the Lotherberg Group, are competing against each other for the majority.

Nevertheless, there are voices of discontentment within the USP and we should be expecting some pushback within the assembly.

name: Turn07_Holsord_NegativeApproval
title: Negative Presidential Approval Rating
description: Recent approval rating polling conducted by Chief Strategist Galade has shown that we have landed below the 25% approval rating. Our administration's performance has been widely questioned by the diverse poll taken by a thousand attendees from all the regions of Sordland.

name: Turn07_Holsord_PFJPCondemnsCourt
title: PFJP Condemns Supreme Court Decision
description:
In today’s press statement, Frens Ricter criticized the Supreme Court for ruling the emergency decree legal, blaming the Chief Justice for protecting the president despite his illegal actions.

In his speech, he called the Supreme Court to stop obstructing democracy and condemned both the administration and the Sollist justices. He also said that the president must be held accountable for acting against the constitution.

name: Turn07_Holsord_PFJPCongratulatesCourt
title: PFJP Congratulates Supreme Court Decision
description:
In today’s press statement, Frens Ricter congratulated the Supreme Court for ruling against the emergency.

In his speech, he called the Supreme Court to press further and investigate the whole administration. He said that the president must be held accountable for acting against the constitution.

name: Turn07_Holsord_PositiveApproval
title: Positive Presidential Approval Rating
description: Recent approval rating polling conducted by Chief Strategist Galade has shown that we have landed above the 50% presidential approval rating. Our administration's performance has been confirmed with the diverse poll taken by a thousand attendees from all the regions of Sordland.

name: Turn07_Holsord_SSCFullPrivatization
title: SSC Privatized
description:
As of today, The Sordish State Corporation has officially opened its shares to investors. Many groups and organizations are racing to acquire shares within the corporation. The two major organizations, the Heart of Sordland and the Lotherberg Group, are competing against each other for the majority.

Nevertheless, there are voices of discontentment within the USP and we should be expecting some pushback within the assembly.

name: Turn07_Holsord_TuskBuysNedam
title: Nedam Bought by Walter Tusk
description: As of today, The Nedam Mining Group is officially owned by Walter Tusk. With the acquisition of SSC, Walter Tusk is now without a rival within Sordland. The CEO of The Lotherberg Group is extremely grateful for our decisions and vows that the group will support the administration.

name: Turn07_Holsord_TuskBuysSSC
title: SSC Bought by Walter Tusk
description: As of today, The Sordish State Corporation is officially owned by Walter Tusk. With the acquisition of SSC, Walter Tusk is now without a rival within Sordland. The CEO of The Lotherberg Group is extremely grateful for our decisions and vows that the group will support the administration.

name: Turn07_Holsord_USPShowSupportEmergency
title: USP Meeting Show Support to President
description:
In yesterday’s internal USP meeting, a large group of party members voiced their support for the President after the Supreme Court took the case to review the legality of the emergency.

Vice President Petr Vectern criticized the Supreme Court for obstructing the duties of the administration.

name: Turn07_Holsord_USP_StatementAgainstPresident
title: USP Releases Statement Against the President
description: The United Sordland Party (USP) has released a statement sharply criticizing the president, introducing last-minute changes to the proposed amendments without their consent. The party statement accused the president of deviating from the core values and principles of Sollism. Consequently, they have declared their decision to withdraw their full support from the president and the current administration.

name: Turn07_Holsord_VoteFail_USPCriticizes
title: USP Meeting Criticizes President
description:
In yesterday’s internal USP meeting, a large group of party members voiced their disappointment in the failed constitutional vote in the Assembly.

Lileas Graf criticized President Rayne for pursuing change without in-depth research and proper communication between the party members, blaming the president and the vice president for the failure.

name: Turn07_Holsord_VoteWon_KibenerCongratulates
title: Kibener Congratulates Vote Results
description: In today’s press statement, Kesaro Kibener of the NFP congratulated President Rayne for the successful vote. In his speech, he showed support for the USP leadership and called the Supreme Court to vote in favour of the proposal.

name: Turn07_Holsord_VoteWon_RicterCongratulates
title: Ricter Congratulates Vote Results
description: In today’s press statement, Frens Ricter of the PFJP congratulated President Rayne for the successful vote. In his speech, he showed support for the USP leadership and called the Supreme Court to vote in favour of the proposal.

name: Turn07_Holsord_WPB_AnnouncesNewLeader_Leke
title: WPB Announces Mansoun Leke As Their New Leader
description: According to the reports, Mansoun Leke has been invited to re-join the Workers Party of Bludia (WPB) and subsequently elected as its new leader following the arrest of former leader Fetih Ejall by the authorities. Leke, a prominent figure within the Bludish community, is expected to grow the party's popularity in the next elections.

name: Turn07_Holsord_WPB_CondemnsCourtDecision
title: WPB Condemns The Supreme Court
description:
The Workers Party of Bludia (WPB) has issued a strong condemnation of the Supreme Court's decision regarding the Ishval Ersen case. In a statement released by the party, they express their deep disappointment and disagreement with the Supreme Court, which they believe is actively enabling the discrimination and inequality faced by the Bludish community in the country.

The WPB argued that the Supreme Court is further perpetuating the marginalization of Bludish people and disregarding their legitimate demands for justice and equal rights. They called for a comprehensive review of the justice system to ensure fair treatment and equal opportunities for all citizens.

name: Turn07_Holsord_WPB_CondemnsEjallArrest
title: WPB Condemns Ejall's Arrest
description:
The Workers Party of Bludia (WPB) has strongly condemned the arrest of Fetih Ejall, their leader, following the government's inclusion of his proposal to expand Bludish rights in the constitutional reform proposal. In a statement, the WPB expressed outrage and denounced the arrest as a hypocritical and politically motivated act to suppress the voice of the Bludish nationalists. They argued that the government's actions are an affront to democracy and a violation of basic human rights.

The WPB called for the immediate release of Fetih Ejall and demanded that the government address the legitimate concerns and aspirations of the Bludish people. This incident has further intensified tensions and sparked concerns about the government's commitment to actually pursue reforms for Bludish rights.

name: Turn07_Iza_AngelicaReinstated
title: Angelica Sazon Inaugurated
description: A grand inauguration was held at the Iza’s Palace, as Angelica Sazon reclaimed her spot as Duchess of Iza. After giving the oath of loyalty in front of the King in Porte Drazon, the new Duchess traveled to Iza, where a large banquet saw nobles present from all across the country, and although King Romus himself was absent, several of his closest advisors, including Hugo Toras, were present to celebrate the momentous occasion.

name: Turn07_Iza_GoldenGuardDispatched
title: Golden Guard Dispatched To Iza
description: The Golden Guard, led by Titus Gordion, has arrived in Iza, ready to instigate the investigation of Rico Toras. In the coming weeks, Golden Guard members will diligently monitor the duke, keeping their eye out for any wrongdoing or suspicious activity.

name: Turn07_Iza_HousingCrisisSpreads
title: Iza Housing Crisis Gathers Speed
description: As predicted years ago, the housing crisis that has plagued Porte Drazon has started spreading across other Rizian cities. As increasing amounts of tenants are unable to afford the capital, people are instead flocking to other major cities in search of affordable living space. Local officials warn that if action isn’t taken, Iza’s homeless population might soon approach Porte Drazon levels.

name: Turn07_Iza_RicoArrest
title: Rico Toras Arrested!
description: In the early hours of the morning, former Duke Rico Toras was dragged out of his Palace by members of the Golden Guard and placed under official arrest for treason. The disgraced Duke was then transferred to an undisclosed location in the Brenas countryside, where he will be privately detained until the King decides what to do with him.

name: Turn07_Iza_RicoDeposed
title: Rico Toras Deposed!
description: In the early hours of the morning, former Duke Rico Toras was dragged out of his Palace by members of the Golden Guard. He was then taken to the local TV station, where he was forced to resign his position as Duke of Iza, before being let go. Reportedly, the former Duke then traveled to relatives in the Valenqiris province, where he is rumored to be staying for now.

name: Turn07_Lachaven_GasomBankruptcy
title: Gasom Declares Bankruptcy, Ceases Operations
description: Gasom, one of Lachaven's key energy providers, has declared bankruptcy. The company has ceased all operations, leading to job losses and severe disruptions in the local energy supply. The economic consequences of Gasom's closure are expected to be far-reaching.

name: Turn07_Lachaven_GasomBooms
title: Gasom Experiences Boom, Expands Workforce
description: Gasom in Lachaven is experiencing a period of significant growth, leading to a major expansion of its workforce. This boom in business has not only boosted the company's fortunes but has also created numerous job opportunities, bolstering the local economy.

name: Turn07_Lachaven_GasomDefault
title: Gasom's Operations Stagnate
description: Gasom's operations in Lachaven have stagnated, with no significant changes in business volume or workforce size. The company continues to operate as usual, providing stable energy supplies but without any substantial growth or innovation in its services.

name: Turn07_Lachaven_GasomDownsizes
title: Gasom Announces Downsizing
description: Gasom in Lachaven has announced a downsizing of its operations. The move will result in job losses and a reduction in energy production capacity. This decision is likely to impact the local economy and could potentially disrupt energy supplies.

name: Turn07_Lachaven_H3_SSC_Soon
title: H-3 Construction Soon To Be Completed By SSC
description:
With the poor condition of the road network between Lachaven and Avory, causing unnecessary accidents along the seaside, a highway had been contracted to the government-owned Sordish State Cooperation. Regrettably, the progress is slowing down due to the treacherous terrain between Lenkurg and Arvory.

Fortunately, there haven’t been any more difficulties since, and the project is expected to be finished in the near future.

name: Turn07_Lachaven_H3_Taurus_Soon_SignedBill
title: H-3 Construction Soon To Be Completed By Taurus
description:
With the poor condition of the road network between Lachaven and Avory, causing unnecessary accidents along the seaside, a highway has been contracted to the privately-owned Taurus Holding. Regrettably, the project is delayed due to the unforeseen expenses from the new Labour Laws.

Fortunately, there haven’t been any more difficulties since, and the project is expected to be finished in the near future.

name: Turn07_Lachaven_H3_Taurus_Soon_VetoedBill
title: H-3 Construction Soon To Be Completed By Taurus
description:
With the poor condition of the road network between Lachaven and Avory, causing unnecessary accidents along the seaside, a highway has been contracted to the privately-owned Taurus Holding. Regrettably, there has been a strike during the progress, due to the vetoed Workers’ Rights bill, causing the project to be delayed.

Fortunately, there haven’t been any more difficulties since, and the project is expected to be finished in the near future.

name: Turn07_Lachaven_IncreasedSupportForBludishRight
title: Increased Support For Bludish Rights
description:
Public opinion in cities like Lachaven, known for their significant middle-class liberal population, is undergoing a noticeable shift, with a surge in support for Bludish rights. The case of Ishval Ersen has struck a chord with many individuals, leading to a growing sense of empathy and solidarity. 

The recent statements from officials of the WPB, urging the government to incorporate changes to Article 6 and 7, have resonated strongly with the Sordish population in these cities. Calls for reform to recognize and protect Bludish rights are gaining traction, and there is a palpable sentiment among residents that the time has come for meaningful change.

name: Turn07_Lachaven_L1Result
title: Port of Lachaven Gains New Importance
description: Following the completion of the L-1 high-speed railway between Holsord and Lachaven, the Port of Lachaven has been experiencing higher traffic than ever. An increasing number of businesses are now choosing to ship their goods by boat as a result of the more efficient transit process.

name: Turn07_Laren_MedicalQualityIncreased
title: Healthcare Quality Improved
description: Reports from hospitals and clinics in Laren indicate a significant rise in the quality of health care since additional funding was channelled into rural areas. Mortality rates appear to be decreasing, while patients are reporting a higher level of trust in physicians and medical facilities.

name: Turn07_Leiren_EnergyPricesHurt
title: Rising Energy Prices Severely Impact Local Economy
description: The local economy in Leiren is being significantly impacted by rising energy prices. The high costs of energy are putting a strain on both businesses and households, leading to reduced economic activity and increased financial stress. Unless addressed, these escalating energy prices threaten to cause long-term economic damage.

name: Turn07_MaveNortus_BludsLetIn
title: Rizia Opens Borders To Bluds
description: Rizia has opened the border crossing to Zille for Bluds fleeing from the Wehzek civil war, despite previous agreements with Wehlen not to do so. While Wehzek authorities on the other side of the border attempted to prevent the thousands of people wanting to cross from doing so, they quickly had to admit defeat and let them pass into Rizia.

name: Turn07_MaveNortus_IntelligenceInsertion
title: Rizian Agents Cross Into Zille
description: Operatives trained at the Mave Nortus Intelligence hub have begun their clandestine insertion into the Zille region, crossing the border river in small groups under cover of darkness. So far, all of the attempted insertions have been a success, with Wehzek authorities unable to secure the entire border.

name: Turn07_Monqiz_Decision_ProvincialTaxSubsidyTwo_Valenqiris
title: Tax Relief Arrives for Valenqiris
description:
The Crown has granted a provincial subsidy to Valenqiris, citing agricultural hardships following poor harvests and export disruptions. Local farmers and vineyard owners expressed cautious optimism, hoping the aid will help offset recent losses.

Officials in Monqiz noted that the funds will be directed toward stabilizing rural economies and maintaining seasonal employment.

name: Turn07_Monqiz_Decision_RoyalYachtFinal_Parade
title: Grand Parade Celebrates Yacht
description: Tens-of-Thousands fans of the Monarchy turned up in Monqiz for the celebration of the restored Royal Yacht. A military parade made its way to the harbor, where the ship is moored, where the boat made a celebration lap while King Romus waved at the crowds.

name: Turn07_Monqiz_Decision_VendonesamCivilWarEscalates_HarborProtest
title: Anti-Intervention Protest In Monqiz Harbor
description: A group of anti-war activists attempted to block the ships carrying military aid for Vendonesam from leaving the port. Their attempt was unsuccessful, with law enforcement swiftly arresting the troublemakers.

name: Turn07_Monqiz_PortSold
title: RSSC Assumes Control Over Port
description: Following the sale of the harbor of Monqiz to Rumburg, control over the facility has officially been handed over to the Rumburgian State Shipping Corporation. Rumburgian bureaucrats have started arriving and managing the port, with beneficial shipping rates already being awarded to Rumburgian corporations.

name: Turn07_Montaklar_Decision_ProvincialTaxSubsidyTwo_CardesseMontaklar
title: Subsidy Announced for Cardesse-Montaklar
description: Industrial leaders in Montaklar have welcomed the government’s announcement of a regional tax subsidy aimed at revitalizing production. Factory owners cite rising costs and outdated machinery as key barriers to growth. The subsidy is expected to ease these constraints, with early plans to modernize several key facilities. Labor unions remain cautiously optimistic, calling for transparency and fair allocation of the funds.

name: Turn07_Montaklar_Decision_RevolutionariesIncitement_AutonomousCityHall
title: City Hall Relocated
description: Following the revolutionaries' seizure of the Montaklar City Hall, the city government has temporarily located activities to a suitable building on the other side of town. Meanwhile, the revolutionaries have started turning the old city hall into a community center, hosting various political activities.

name: Turn07_Montaklar_Decision_RevolutionariesIncitement_UprisingEnds
title: City Hall Resumes Operations
description: With the city hall cleared of its occupants, it is slowly able to repair the damage and resume operations. Local authorities have assured the central government that something like this won’t happen ever again, something an increase of law enforcement around vital government sites should help with.

name: Turn07_Montaklar_MartialOversight
title: General Carlos Azaro Declares Martial Oversight in Montaklar
description:
