Following the recent unrest and the brief occupation of Montaklar City Hall by revolutionary forces, General Carlos Robles Azaro has declared martial oversight to restore security and stability.

Additional troops have been deployed to protect critical government sites, including City Hall, while stricter curfews and a rapid-response task force have been implemented to address any further disruptions. 

Local residents report an increased military presence, with patrols ensuring compliance with new regulations.

name: Turn07_Montaklar_PalesMapofSupply
title: Carlos Azaro and Hubertus Toras Update Pales Strategy Map
description:
General Carlos Azaro and Duke Hubertus Toras have begun reviewing the strategic map of Pales, first introduced in earlier military planning efforts. 

Using Hubertus' cartographic expertise and Carlos' war experience, they are refining the map to identify key resource depots, supply routes, and potential vulnerabilities in the enemy's logistical network.

The analysts suggest that targeting these supply routes could disrupt Palesian reinforcements and give Rizia a strategic advantage.

name: Turn07_Morella_Decision_War_RefugeeStory_Friendly
title: Morella Prepares Refugee Facilities
description: The Republic of Morella, following our request, has started preparing refugee facilities for those displaced by our war with Pales. The country says it was happy to fulfill the request, as saving human lives is central to the socialist principles of its government.

name: Turn07_Morella_Decision_War_RefugeeStory_Hostile
title: Morella Prepares Refugee Facilities
description: The Republic of Morella, has started preparing refugee facilities for those displaced by our war with Pales. The country has condemned our decision to transport refugees to their border, but has reiterated that saving human lives is central to the socialist principles of its government and that it will do everything it can to lessen the suffering of those affected by the war.

name: Turn07_Morella_HailsNationalizationPlan
title: Morella Lauds Sordland's Nationalization Move
description: Morella, under the leadership of Prime Minister Alma Saltana, has hailed Sordland's comprehensive nationalization plan. Echoing the Morellan Unified Front's socialist leanings, Saltana praised the decision as a stride towards economic justice and sovereignty. She expressed hope that this bold move would inspire similar policies across Merkopa, fostering a future marked by economic equality and shared prosperity.

name: Turn07_Morella_PilgrimsToLeaveMorellaAlone
title: Derdia Orders Pilgrims To Stop Traveling To Morella
description: Tensions at the Derdian-Morellan border have finally decreased, as Derdia ordered its pilgrims to no longer attempt to cross the border into Morella illegally. From now on, official Derdian policy is that Golcondist pilgrims should respect the borders and procedures of countries they are traveling to.

name: Turn07_Morna_UnemploymentReduced
title: Unemployment Greatly Reduced in Morna
description: Morna has seen a 15 percent decrease in unemployment over the past year. The city’s economy had previously been lagging behind the rest of Sordland; with the government decision to invest in the Lorren region, it appears to be bouncing back.

name: Turn07_Narbel_GasomBranchGrows
title: Gasom Branch Growth Boosts Local Economy
description: The expansion of a new Gasom branch in Narbel has given a significant lift to the local economy. This has generated fresh job opportunities and has established a stable source of energy supply in the region. This positive development is anticipated to augment Narbel's growth potential and elevate the standard of living for its residents.

name: Turn07_Narbel_GasomBranchShuts
title: Closure of Gasom Branch Impacts Local Economy
description: The abrupt closure of a Gasom branch in Narbel has impacted the local economy negatively. The shutdown has resulted in job losses and disruptions in energy supply, posing challenges for both households and businesses. The ramifications of this closure on Narbel's economy are expected to be extensive, necessitating urgent measures to mitigate the situation.

name: Turn07_Narbel_MedicalSalariesIncreased
title: Medical Staff Salaries Increased
description: The wage increase for doctors, nurses, and other healthcare workers has gone into effect in Narbel. Hospitals and clinics are already reporting a higher level of patient satisfaction, while the “rural incentive” provided on top of the salary raise is expected to draw more highly qualified medical staff to the area.

name: Turn07_Narbel_NewSchoolBuilt
title: New School Completed
description: Narbel celebrated the opening of its new secondary school, a two-story building with 50 classrooms and state-of-the-art teaching equipment. The school was funded as part of the government initiative to improve rural access to education.

name: Turn07_PalesInvasion_BFFDeployed
title: BFF Mercenaries Arriving In Secret
description: As promised by Rumburg, several brigades of BFF mercenaries have started arriving at the front line. To hide their presence, these soldiers are given Rizian arms and uniforms.

name: Turn07_PalesInvasion_DerdianMercenaries
title: Derdian Mercenaries Arriving At Pales Theatre
description: The mercenary brigades of Golcondists fighters, promised by Derdia, have started arriving in Rizia. Until further orders are received, they will remain stationed behind the frontlines, ready for the King’s command.

name: Turn07_PorteDrazon_Decision_ProvincialTaxSubsidyTwo_SubsidiesDenied
title: Provinces Left Waiting as Subsidies Denied
description:
Provincial representatives returned from the capital empty-handed after the Crown declined all subsidy requests.

Officials in Valenqiris, Cardesse-Montaklar, and Brenas had petitioned for support, citing agricultural hardship, industrial stagnation, and unemployment. While no public protests have been recorded, local councils are urging residents to prepare for tightened budgets and slower recovery.

name: Turn07_PorteDrazon_GoldenGuardManus
title: Golden Guard Monitoring Manus Sazon
description: The Golden Guard, led by Titus Gordion himself, are investigating Manus Sazon for any possible wrongdoing. Guard members have been positioned outside his house in Porte Drazon and are watching carefully over every move.

name: Turn07_Qabiz_AngelicaBoardsShip
title: Angelica Sazon Boards Ship To Mainland
description: The formerly exiled Angelica Sazon has started her journey back to the mainland, boarding a ship dispatched by the Sazon family to get her. The former Duchess has spent much of her life in exile on Qaleqabiz, but has finally been pardoned by King Romus.

name: Turn07_Qabiz_Decision_AngelicaPardon_Reject
title: Angelica Sazon Issues Formal Complaint
description: After the King once again rejected her pardon request, the former Duchess of Iza has issued a formal request to the Crown, claiming she’s being unlawfully held on Qaleqabiz against her will for crimes she never committed. The Sazon has said she is now considering bringing her cause forward to democratic countries, to increase diplomatic pressure on our country.

name: Turn07_Report_Nelvisar_OilWorkerGala5Year
title: Nelvisar Oil Workers Gala Celebrates 5 Years
description: The annual Nelvisar Oil Workers Gala, a new tradition celebrating the former oil workers of the now closed field, is celebrating its 5th anniversary. After the Gala was first organized when the field closed as a one-off event, a committee of workers decided to turn it into an annual tradition.

name: Turn07_Ribel_EducationQualityIncreased
title: Rural Education Improves Significantly
description: Ribel is reporting higher test scores and attendance rates since its education facilities were equipped with new textbooks and state-of-the-art teaching materials. The overhaul was a result of the decision to channel more funding into rural schools.

name: Turn07_Ribel_ProBludOrDefault_BFFThreatensJustices
title: BFF Threatens the Supreme Court
description:
According to intelligence reports, several leaders of the Bludish Freedom Front (BFF) held a secret gathering in Ribel following the Supreme Court's decision to delay the Ishval Ersen case. The BFF released a statement afterwards, in which they threatened to carry out attacks against the Justices of the Supreme Court. 

Minister Graf highlighted the seriousness of the statement and raised her concerns about the potential escalation of violence in the country.

name: Turn07_Ribel_ProSollist_BFFThreatensPresidentAndNFP
title: BFF Threatens Attacks Against President Rayne and Kesaro Kibener
description:
According to intelligence reports, several leaders of the Bludish Freedom Front (BFF) held a secret gathering in Ribel following the Supreme Court's decision to reject Ersen's arguments about the racism of the constitution, reiterating their commitment to Sollism. 

Following the meeting, the BFF released a statement rejecting the Sollist constitution and threatening to launch attacks against President Rayne and Kesaro Kibener.

name: Turn07_Ribel_WPBBanned_BFFThreatensPresident
title: BFF Threatens Actions Against President Rayne and Governor Bron
description:
According to intelligence reports, several leaders of the Bludish Freedom Front (BFF) held a secret gathering in Ribel. Following the meeting, the BFF released a statement threatening attacks against President Rayne. 

The statement was released in response to the ongoing oppression in the Special Zone of Bergia and the ban on the Workers Party of Bludia (WPB). The BFF's statement accused the government of suppressing the voices of the Bludish people and vowed to take action against the President and the authorities of the Special Zone, including Governor Bron. The BFF also called for the Bludish population to join them in their fight for freedom.

name: Turn07_Ribery_RecoveringFromTradeWar
title: Ribery is Recovering
description: Thanks to the administration's decisive actions, the economic impacts of the trade war between Arcasia and United Contana had lessened. The empty and barred up shops in the city of Ribery are slowly opening again. The city had been hit hard due to its main suppliers are from the nearby city of Lachaven.

name: Turn07_Ribery_RequestsAid
title: Ribery Requests Aid
description: The buzzing shops in the city of Ribery are now filled with barred up shops and sights of looting. The city has been hit hard due to its main suppliers being from the nearby city of Lachaven. Many corporations and businesses are moving away from the city entirely. The citizens of Ribery are requesting the government’s help to get out of their dire situation.

name: Turn07_Rumburg_AsksWhistleblowerReturn
title: Rumburg Informs of Whistleblower Escape
description:
Rumburg has informed us about an escaped whistleblower headed to Sordland. They have prematurely requested the extradition of any whistleblowers from the Rumburg if they are to be found. Chelston Hailstone, the said whistleblower, is reported to possess highly sensitive information about a covert weapons program. 

Queen Beatrice Livingston's administration has demanded the immediate return of Hailstone, considering his defection as a breach of trust between the two nations.

name: Turn07_Rumburg_ChemicalWeaponsShipped
title: Experimental Nerve Gas Dispatched
description: In a highly secret operation, away from the eyes of the international community, Rumburg has begun dispatching the promised nerve gas to Rizia. To avoid having to pass through other country’s airspace, the gas will take the longer route and be shipped.

name: Turn07_Rumburg_MilitaryAidDispatched
title: Military Aid On Its Way
description: The promised military aid from Rumburg was loaded onto cargo planes at Thornbourgh’s military airport this morning, and is presently on its way to Terador Air Base, from where it will rapidly be distributed to the front. A joint Rizian-Rumburgian fighter squadron is escorting the flight.

name: Turn07_Rumburg_WarmingRelationsSpyReturn
title: Rumburg Sees Potential for Warming Relations
description: Following the return of the whistleblower Chelston Hailstone to Rumburg, Queen Beatrice Livingston expressed gratitude to Sordland. The queen has indicated that this act of good faith could mark the beginning of warming relations between the two nations. She stressed the importance of mutual respect and cooperation in achieving regional stability and progress.

name: Turn07_Sallabes_Decision_ProvincialTaxSubsidyTwo_Brenas
title: Brenas Receives Support to Fight Unemployment
description: Amid rising joblessness, the Crown has allocated a regional subsidy to Brenas aimed at easing economic pressures across the province. Local councils in Sallabes are already drafting proposals to direct the funds toward mining safety upgrades, agricultural equipment, and expanded fisheries.

name: Turn07_Sallabes_DerdiansLetIn
title: Hunderds Of Derdians Arrive In Sallabes
description: Ships full of Derdian Golcondists have started arriving in the Rizian port of Sallabes, angering Wehzek president Wiktok Smolak, who denounces the migration as a “serious breach of previous agreements”.

name: Turn07_Sarna_BFFOperation_Raid
title: Massive Raid Against the BFF
description:
Lileas Graf reported that security forces have successfully conducted a targeted raid against the BFF in Sarna, aimed to apprehend key members of the organization and dismantle its infrastructure. During the raid, a significant quantity of weapons, explosives, and incriminating documents were seized, further substantiating the government's concerns regarding the organization's activities. 

Several individuals suspected of involvement in terrorist activities were also arrested, and the information extracted to them point out to a possible future meeting of all the leaders of the BFF close to the Wehzek-Sordish border. Lileas Graf portrayed the outcome as a significant blow to the BFF. Investigations are ongoing, and additional measures will be taken to address any remaining threats posed by the organization.

name: Turn07_Sarna_BFFOperation_Raid_DecreasedBudget
title: Massive Raid Against the BFF
description:
Lileas Graf reported that the security forces' targeted raid against the BFF in Sarna faced numerous challenges and fell short of its objectives. The operation, intended to apprehend key members and dismantle the organization's infrastructure, encountered logistical issues, including a lack of sufficient funding for necessary equipment and personnel. Despite these limitations, security forces managed to seize some weapons, explosives, and incriminating documents, but the quantity was relatively insignificant compared to the extent of the BFF's operations.

While several individuals suspected of involvement in terrorist activities were arrested, the information extracted from them revealed the complexity of the BFF's network and their plans for a future gathering near the Wehzek-Sordish border. Lileas Graf acknowledged that the operation's outcome was not as successful as anticipated, highlighting the need for increased resources and improved strategies to effectively combat the ongoing threat posed by the organization.

name: Turn07_Sarna_IncreasedAgriculturalProduction
title: Sarna Increases Agricultural Production
description: Sarna has experienced a 15 percent increase in agricultural output over the last two years. Employment in the agricultural sector has been rising commensurately. The boom is thought to be a direct result of the investments made in the Bergia region.

name: Turn07_Sordland_AlphonsoUpset
title: President Rayne Regrets Rizia Cancelling Bonds
description: Sordish President Anton Rayne has expressed his sadness over Rizia’s sudden announcement that the Kingdom has prematurely ended the bond agreement we made with his predecessor, Ewald Alphonso. The Sordish president blamed Rumburgian pressure on Rizia and called upon King Romus to ‘rethink his international partners’.

name: Turn07_Sordland_GusMangerUpset
title: Gus Manger Calls Cancellation Of Trade Deal ‘Unbelievable’
description: Sordish minister Gus Manger has expressed incomprehension about Rizia’s decision to cancel the trade deal between the two countries. The minister continued by calling Rumburgian pressure on Rizia ‘unacceptable’ and expressed hope that Sordland and Rizia could one day return to the negotiation table to revisit the agreement.

name: Turn07_Sordland_KorontiUpset
title: Marcel Koronti Calls Nationalization ‘Theft’
description: Sordish oligarch Marcel Koronti has lashed out fiercely at the Rizian government, calling the nationalization of his Valenqiris resort ‘unacceptable’ and ‘pure theft’. The millionaire has threatened to withdraw further investments from the Kingdom in retaliation, saying he will look for more trustworthy business partners in the future.

name: Turn07_Terador_LespianSpyBalloon
title: Discovery of Lespian Spy Balloon Components
description: Foreign intelligence operatives have confirmed that the remnants of a previously unidentified aerial phenomenon recovered near Terador belong to a Lespian spy balloon. This revelation has heightened concerns regarding Lespia's covert surveillance activities and potential espionage intentions within our kingdom. Military officials have decided to discreetly bolster counterintelligence measures to mitigate the threat while avoiding escalation.

name: Turn07_Uziren_BFFRecruitmentBron
title: BFF Recruitment
description:
It is reported that in the villages around Uziren a group of BFF missionaries are seeking to recruit militants to fight for the BFF.

Governor Bron reported that the gendarmerie forces in the area are now actively working towards eliminating the threat.

name: Turn07_Uziren_BFFRecruitmentKrull
title: BFF Recruitment Report
description:
It is reported that in the villages around Uziren a group of BFF missionaries are seeking to recruit militants to fight for the BFF.

Governor Krull reported that the gendarmerie forces in the area are now actively working towards eliminating the threat.

name: Turn07_Uziren_ErsenCase_BludsCallForAmendment
title: Massive Rally Calling For Reforms
description: A massive crowd have gathered in Uziren to demand that President Rayne take action to expand Bludish rights in his next reform proposal. The citizens are advocating for changes to Articles 6 and 7 of the constitution to recognize the Bludish people and grant them equal rights. They have organized protests and rallies in support of their cause and have submitted petitions to the Grand National Assembly.

name: Turn07_Uziren_ErsenCase_BludsCondemnPresident
title: Massive Rally Condemning President Rayne
description: A massive crowd have gathered in Uziren to condemn President Rayne for his recent statements defending the Sollist interpretation of citizenship rights. The people are calling for actual changes to be made to the constitution that recognizes the Bludish people and their culture. They believe that the president's defense of the constitution is a clear indication that the government has no intention of introducing significant reforms.

name: Turn07_Uziren_IllegalBorderCrossings
title: Illegal Crossings Rise at Wehlen Border
description: Border police have reported an increased number of arrests as Bludish and Wehzek refugees attempt to enter the country from Wehlen. Temporary detention centers have been erected in Uziren to process the deportation of the illegal entrants.

name: Turn07_Uziren_IllegalBorderCrossings2
title: Illegal Crossings Rise at Wehlen Border
description: Border police have reported an increased number of arrests as Bludish and Wehzek refugees attempt to enter the country from Wehlen without legal documents. However, due to our relaxed immigration policy, a large majority of skilled and educated workers had been accepted. However, it is unsure if they have had any history of crime and violence.

name: Turn07_Uziren_IllegalBorderCrossings3
title: Illegal Crossings Rise at Wehlen Border
description: Border police have reported an increased number of arrests as Bludish and Wehzek refugees attempt to enter the country from Wehlen without legal documents. Regardless, there are sights of groups of armed men and gangs crossing the border as well. Unfortunately, the border police had reported not having enough manpower to stop them.

name: Turn07_Uziren_LanguageBillProtest
title: Language Bill Protest in Bergia
description: After the passing of the Language Bill, a wave of Bludish protesters have risen and called for its revocation. The Governor of Bergia, reported that the situation has been brought under control and the regional police forces have been tasked with increased patrolling duties around the majority Bludish towns in Bergia.

name: Turn07_Uziren_NewHospitalBuilt
title: New Hospital Built
description: Uziren has just finished construction on its new, state-of-the-art hospital, expected to accommodate up to 1000 patients. The facility was built as part of the new initiative to improve health care access in Sordland’s rural areas.

name: Turn07_Vesord_EducationSalariesIncreased
title: Teacher Salaries Increased
description: The wage increase for teachers, principals, and other education staff has gone into effect in Vesord. Following the salary boost, teachers are already reporting a higher level of job satisfaction; students are expected to benefit commensurately.

name: Turn07_Vesord_ProtestAgainstEmergency
title: Protest Against Emergency
description:
A large group of people gathered to protest in the Vesord city center and asked for the resignation of the USP government.

The Vesord Police Chief reported that the protesters turned violent when riot police arrived on scene and were forced to intervene. Small-scale clashes erupted between the group and riot police but the situation was brought under control and the group has dispersed.

name: Turn07_Wehlen_BFFMilitantsNeutralized
title: Thousands of BFF Militants Neutralized
description:
The military authorities of Wehlen reported that with the help of Sordish Armed Forces, thousands of armed BFF militants have been neutralized.

During the joint operation, twelve operation bases that were located in the mountains between Sordland and Wehlen were destroyed. 

President Smolak expressed his gratitude for the aid of the Sordish Armed Forces and claimed that the threat of the BFF in Eastern Merkopa has been mostly dealt with.

name: Turn07_Wehlen_BFFZillePrison
title: Reports Emerge Of Torture Prison
description: The BFF guerilla group announced to the world that it managed to reveal the existence of a torture facility deep inside Wehlen proper. The ultra strict prison is supposed to not only hold BFF members, but also some of the arrested reported as missing in the aftermath of the Zille bombing, possibly including Rizian citizens.

name: Turn07_Zille_ATAActivityWaning
title: ATA Forced To Shut Down Nanta Branch
description: Due to lack of funding and amidst growing Wehzek repression, the Ariana Toras Organisation has been forced to defund and effectively shut down its Nanta branch. ATA states that it will still attempt to continue operations in the city, but merely as a volunteer organization.

name: Turn07_Zille_ATAAssembliesForm
title: ATA Forms Popular Assemblies Across Zille
description: The Ariana Toras Associations has significantly stepped up its operations within Zille, with popular assemblies made up for volunteers forming in almost all towns, including on a district level in Zille and Nanta. These assemblies mostly consist of volunteers, but are coordinated by one paid organizer per group.

name: Turn07_Zille_Decision_SecondZilleResistanceFunding_ATAIncrease
title: Additional Supplies Dispatched To ATA
description: An additional shipment of supplies, including more specialized materials like sound systems and a second printing press have been dispatched to the Ariana Toras Foundation in Zille.

name: Turn07_Zille_Decision_SecondZilleResistanceFunding_SOIncrease
title: Heavy Weaponry Smuggled To Su Omina
description: Preparations have begun to smuggle additional, heavier weapons to the Su Omina branch in Zille. These include a small armored car as well as anti tank missiles and landmines. Rizian operatives are expected to handle the deliveries over the coming days.

name: Turn07_Zille_DerdianMercenaries
title: Derdian Mercenaries Arrive In Zille
description: Slowly, the promised Derdian mercenaries have begun their covert insertion into the Zille region. Local Rizian assets are assisting with their smooth arrival, with the cells intending to remain hidden until activated.

name: Turn07_Zille_SOHarborExplosion
title: Explosion Rocks Zille Harbor
description: Last night, a loud bang awakened residents of Zille, as a large column of smoke started rising from the harbor. The explosion hit the migration terminal of the port, completely putting it out of service. At the time of the explosion, no one but two guards were present at the facility, only one of them surviving the blast. While the group hasn’t claimed responsibility, it would appear Su Omina was behind the attack.

name: Turn08_ACP_Investigated_NFP
title: NFP Investigation Report
description: The Anti-Corruption Police is continuing its investigation of the National Front Party. A few leads have been uncovered revealing high-ranking party officials’ ties to the Bernard Circas assassination. These will be duly followed up on.

name: Turn08_ACP_Investigated_OldGuard
title: Old Guard Investigation Report
description: The Anti-Corruption Police is continuing its investigation of the Old Guard. A few leads have been uncovered revealing several low-level cases of corruption as well as high-ranking party officials’ possible ties to the Bernard Circas assassination. These will be duly followed up on.

name: Turn08_ACP_Investigated_Oligarchs
title: Lotherberg Group Investigation Report
description: The Anti-Corruption Police is continuing its investigation of the Oligarchs. A few leads have been uncovered revealing Walter Tusk and Marcel Koronti’s involvement in illegal dealings, including suspected arms smuggling and money laundering. These will be duly followed up on.

name: Turn08_ACP_Investigated_PFJP
title: PFJP Investigation Report
description: The Anti-Corruption Police is continuing its investigation of the People’s Freedom and Justice Party. So far, no concrete evidence has been found against the party’s highest-ranking officials, though some further down in the ranks may have ties to the Oligarchs that have yet to be fully uncovered.

name: Turn08_AdarfoGivesLeadershipSpeech
title: RPP's New Leader Adarfo Sotelato Speaks At Party Gathering
description:
Adarfo Sotelato, the newly elected leader of the Rizian People's Party (RPP), delivered a fiery speech at a gathering of party loyalists in Porte Drazon, outlining his vision for radical change in Rizia. Sotelato declared that true justice can only be achieved through the complete dismantling of noble privileges and the redistribution of land to the Rizian people.

His speech included pointed critiques of the Crown's perceived complicity in maintaining the existing power structure and a call for immediate and democratic reforms to the nation's laws. Sotelato's demands for abolishing hereditary titles and empowering the people were met with thunderous applause from attendees.

The gathering, attended by RPP-aligned delegates and influential Rizian activists, seems to have cemented Sotelato's position as party head. Observers note that his radical agenda may intensify tensions between the monarchy and reformist factions, potentially posing a threat of growing revolutionary sentiment.

name: Turn08_Agnolia_HelijlandRecognition_Yes
title: Maartin Van Hoorten Reiterates Gratitude For Heljiland Support
description: The Agnolian PM has once again thanked us for supporting his cause at the Alliance of Nations, despite the vote on recognising Heljiland as Angolian failing to pass the assembly. Van Hoorten stated his willingness to increase cooperation with our Kingdom on the matter in the future.

name: Turn08_Anrica_MilitaryIndustryGrows
title: Anrica's Military Industry Expands with Domestic Investments
description: The military industry in Anrica is seeing significant growth, driven by substantial Sordish investments and locally sourced expertise. This capital infusion and homegrown innovation have led to major advances within the sector, establishing Anrica as an emerging nexus for military-industrial output. Increased self-reliance in military production may bolster Sordland's position against regional competitors.

name: Turn08_Anrica_SecondAid_MilitaryIndustryGrows
title: Military Industry Grows, Bolstered by Arcasia Investment
description: Anrica is witnessing a steady growth in its military industry, thanks to Arcasian investments and guidance from private military companies. This influx of foreign capital and expertise has significantly boosted the sector, positioning Anrica as a growing hub for military industrial output. Self-sufficiency in military production will help Sordland to deter regional rivals.

name: Turn08_Arvory_VATImpact
title: VAT Impact on Arvory's Small Businesses
description: In Arvory, the implementation of the Value Added Tax has significantly impacted economic activity, particularly hitting smaller businesses. The additional financial burden of the VAT is stifling growth and leading to increased economic strain among these enterprises. The local government is being urged to provide supportive measures to alleviate the impact.

name: Turn08_Aschraf_Anniversary_CancelledBron
title: Protests of Aschraf Anniversary Cancellation
description:
Thousands of Bludish people have marched against the cancellation of the Aschraf Anniversary event despite all warnings by Governor Phelix Bron. Deyr saw some of the most major clashes with riot police using extensive force to secure key buildings in New Deyr.

Hundreds are reported to have been wounded by the governor who has promised defiance in the face of adversity.

name: Turn08_Aschraf_Anniversary_CancelledKrull
title: Protests of Aschraf Anniversary Cancellation
description:
Thousands of Bludish people have marched against the cancellation of the Aschraf Anniversary event despite all warnings by Governor Herbert Krull. Deyr saw some of the most major clashes with riot police using extensive force to secure key buildings in New Deyr.

Hundreds are reported to have been wounded by the governor who has promised defiance in the face of adversity.

name: Turn08_ATO_AlvarezVisit_LespiaSanctions
title: ATO Supports Sanctions
description: Several ATO member states, including Lespia, have announced their support for a set of sanctions against our Kingdom, including travel bans, export restrictions and asset freezings of Rizian state corporations. If implemented, these sanctions are expected to hit our economy hard, reducing our competitiveness on the global market.

name: Turn08_ATO_ApproveSpecialZone
title: ATO Supports the Bergia Autonomous Zone in Sordland
description:
The ATO extends its full support for the establishment of the Autonomous Zone of Bergia in Sordland. This initiative provides the Bludish minority with local autonomy, allowing them to preserve and promote their cultural heritage. The ATO recognizes this step as an important advancement in fostering inclusivity and safeguarding minority rights.

The creation of the Bergia Special Zone represents a strategic effort to promote social harmony and mutual respect among Sordland's diverse population. It reflects the government’s dedication to ensuring equal rights and freedoms for all citizens, regardless of their ethnic or cultural background.

The ATO is confident that this initiative will contribute to long-term stability and peace in the region and views it as a constructive approach to addressing diversity within Sordland’s society.

name: Turn08_ATO_CBCentralizationCrit
title: Concerns Of Threats to Free Market Principles
description:
Sordland's recent initiative to centralize its central bank has sparked controversy within ATO circles. Such a move, the alliance fears, could lead to a significant shift away from free-market principles, potentially hampering competition, stifling financial innovation, and ultimately leading to an undesirable concentration of financial power in the hands of the state. 

While the ATO acknowledges the need for effective financial regulation, it argues that excessive centralization could undermine the very pillars of a free and dynamic economy. The alliance therefore urges Sordland to adopt a more balanced approach, one that harmonizes state oversight with market-driven principles.

name: Turn08_ATO_CondemnsValgslandAlliance
title: ATO Expresses Discontent Over Sordland-Valgsland Pact
description:
The emergence of a strategic alliance between Sordland and Valgsland has elicited unease within the ATO. The new alliance, seen as a strategic maneuver, seems to hint at a shift in the balance of regional power in favor of CSP-affiliated nations.

In particular, Arcasian President Dwight Walker, representing the ATO's concerns, has drawn attention to Valgsland's enhanced naval activities in the Merkopa Sea. This naval escalation, coupled with the establishment of the new Sordland-Valgsland alliance, is perceived as a potential source of regional destabilization. Consequently, the ATO, and by extension, Arcasia, is urging restraint in the face of these shifting geopolitical dynamics.

name: Turn08_ATO_GunRightsPraise
title: Guns in Sordland: Personal Freedom Protected
description:
The ATO has praised Sordland's recent presidential decree legalizing gun rights, recognizing it as a significant step toward enhancing individual freedoms. The alliance emphasized that the right to self-defense is an essential component of personal liberty, aligning with the principles upheld by its member states.

The military industry, reflecting the alliance's perspective, has welcomed this decision as a reinforcement of individual rights and freedoms. The ATO regards this landmark move as a vital measure to strengthen the foundations of personal liberty and contribute to the resilience of a free and secure society.

name: Turn08_ATO_ReligiousBanCrit
title: A Threat to Freedom of Expression
description:
The recent decree in Sordland pushing for a ban on the public display of religious symbols has been met with disapproval from the ATO. The alliance perceives this move as a potential infringement on the fundamental freedoms of expression and religion. The ATO argues that such restrictions could undermine cultural diversity, infringe upon personal liberties, and foster social discord. 

Consequently, the alliance calls upon Sordland to reconsider this decree, emphasizing the need to harmonize national security concerns with the upholding of fundamental rights and freedoms.

name: Turn08_ATO_RespondsToPolio
title: ATO Responds to Polio Pandemic Threat with Crisis Plan
description:
In response to the emerging polio threat originating from the Greater Bludia region, which encompasses Rumburg, Wehlen, Lespia, and Sordland, the ATO has created an Emergency Health Crisis Response plan. The strategy primarily focuses on bolstering border security and implementing stringent restrictions to prevent the spread of the disease, in contrast to mass vaccination campaigns.

Acknowledging the severity and the potential global implications of the polio pandemic, the ATO's plan lays out comprehensive preventive measures. These include enhanced surveillance at borders, rigorous health screenings, and strict enforcement of travel advisories. The alliance is urging its member states to commit to these measures as a unified response to the escalating health crisis.

name: Turn08_BFF_Violent_Unrest_Erzaren
title: Soll Dam Captured by BFF
description: The latest reports from the workers at the Soll Dam indicate that the energy facilities have been taken over in what is thought to be a terror attack. The escaped workers were unharmed and the witnesses reported that the attackers were most likely from BFF. According to their account, a group of at least 30 to 40 attackers quickly dismantled the security. Police have been deployed to the area. So far, no demands were made yet.

name: Turn08_BFF_Violent_Unrest_Ribel
title: Bombing of Gendarmerie Outpost in Ribel
description: Terrorists from BFF bombed a Gendarmerie outpost in Ribel. The attack took a toll of 6 lives and left 11 injured. An abandoned hideout with a cache of KA-74s was found with no trace from the terrorists. Area-wide search with armored vehicles and helicopters is now underway.

name: Turn08_Borin_YoungSords_HelpCatchRY
title: Young Sords Aids Police
description:
In an operation conducted by law enforcement personnel, a wanted Red Youth leader was apprehended in the city of Borin with the assistance of young Sords militants. 

Authorities are currently engaged in ongoing investigations to gather further information related to this individual and any associated activities within Borin. The Sordish Police Force acknowledged the cooperation and assistance provided by the Young Sords militants in the successful capture of the criminal.

name: Turn08_Bronaz_NewBusinessRise
title: Bronaz Bustling With Economic Activity
description: Bronaz, on the periphery of our capital, has seen a significant uptick in economic activity, with hundreds of new businesses springing up across town in recent years. Many of these businesses are choosing Bronaz as their desired location, due to its proximity to the capital but with a lower cost of living, although this is steadily rising.

name: Turn08_Bronaz_RustyArrested
title: Rusty Arrested!
description: Following a swift and successful raid by security forces on his Bronaz palace, Russello "Rusty" Montoro has been taken into custody. Arcasia has signaled its willingness to transfer the patent for Rizian Royal Gold's proprietary technology to the company's new owner, ensuring that mining operations continue uninterrupted.

name: Turn08_Bronaz_RustyFled
title: RRG CEO Whereabouts Unknown
description: Russello "Rusty" Montoro, CEO of Rizian Royal Gold, is thought to have fled the country, leaving his corporation in disarray and causing distress among members of the business community. With Arcasia's cooperation, he has revoked the licensing agreement for RRG's patented technology, severely hampering the company's gold extraction abilities.

name: Turn08_Community_Police
title: Community Police Reduces Drug Trade
description: Reports from Narbel indicate that the presence of the Community Police has had a positive impact on crime, with the area seeing a noticeable reduction in drug trade and drug possession arrests.

name: Turn08_Conriat_AutomativeIndustryGrows
title: Automotive Industry Expands in Conriat
description: Conriat is experiencing significant growth in its automotive industry. The increase in production and sales signifies a healthy upward trend for this sector, contributing positively to the city's economic landscape. Future projections remain optimistic, suggesting a continued growth trajectory for Conriat's automotive industry.

name: Turn08_Conriat_Prepare_Military_Action
title: Intelligence Report: Valgsland might be preparing for major invasion
description:
Military intelligence has reported a massive build-up of landing vehicles and navy ships at the port of Wilbern on Valgsland. Our agents are suspecting a massive naval military invasion of Heljiland or Agnolia in the future. It is not fully confirmed as the build-up could be a mockup exercise to divert eyes from elsewhere.

Our covert agents will monitor the situation on the ground for as long as possible.

name: Turn08_CSP_AlvarezVisit_CaleqabizToLespia
title: CSP To Dispatch International Carrier Task Force To Southern Antacean
description: In response to ATO’s takeover of Caleqabiz, the CSP has announced an international carrier group will be assembled and dispatched in order to secure its presence in the southern Antacean. The socialist block claims it aims to safeguard trade against ATO aggression, citing Morella as a specific example.

name: Turn08_CSP_CapitalPunishmentCrit
title: A Step Backwards in Human Rights?
description:
The Contanan Security Pact has strongly criticized Sordland's recent decision to implement capital punishment, describing it as a regression in human rights progress. The alliance has expressed concern over the risk of judicial errors and the potential to deepen social inequalities.

Urging a shift toward restorative justice and rehabilitation, the pact has called on Sordland to reconsider this policy. Framing such measures as outdated, the CSP emphasized the need for criminal justice systems to evolve in ways that reflect the principles of equity and fairness in modern society.

name: Turn08_CSP_CondemnsLespiaAlliance
title: CSP Cautions Against Sordland-Lespia Strategic Alliance
description:
United Contana, under the auspices of the CSP, has communicated strong reservations concerning the formalized alliance between Sordland and Lespia. This cooperative agreement, ostensibly for bolstering mutual defense and advancing economic interests, extends the ATO's influence in Eastern Merkopa. Chairman Leon "Malenyev" Chavatangakwunua, representing the CSP's stance, warns of the potential for this strategic alliance to disrupt the delicate equilibrium of power in the region.

This reservation is further accentuated against the backdrop of the recently concluded Arcasian-Lespia agreement permitting Arcasian military establishments in Lespia. This military expansion has sparked concerns about escalating tensions in the region, making the recent Sordland-Lespia alliance an area of heightened focus for the CSP.

name: Turn08_CSP_CondemnSpecialZone
title: CSP Condemns Bergia Special Autonomous Zone
description:
The CSP has expressed its concerns, condemning the initiative due to the potential for exploitation by separatist groups. Specifically, the CSP cites worries about the Bludish Freedom Front, a separatist nationalist group that might leverage this autonomy to destabilize the region, allegedly with funding from the Kingdom of Rumburg -- which they also blame the Republic of Arcasia for actively supporting.

The CSP believes that the establishment of the Bergia Autonomous Zone might inadvertently provide a platform for such groups to exert their influence, which could lead to heightened tensions and potential conflicts. The CSP has called upon the international community to carefully monitor the unfolding situation and act proactively to prevent any escalation.

name: Turn08_CSP_PrivatePrisonsCrit
title: Private Prisons: A Threat to Social Justice
description:
Sordland's endorsement of private prisons has been met with strong disapproval from the CSP. The alliance contends that this move commercializes justice, potentially undermining social equality and fair treatment. According to the CSP, justice should never become a profit-driven venture. 

It insists that the privatization of prisons could compromise inmates' rights, and impede the nation's pursuit of social justice. The alliance, therefore, encourages Sordland to reconsider this policy, emphasizing the fundamental role of the state in administering justice.

name: Turn08_CSP_RespondsToPolio
title: CSP Gathers Health Secretaries and Ministers
description:
In a swift and proactive response to the rapidly escalating polio threat emanating from the Greater Bludia region, the CSP has convened an emergency meeting of Health Secretaries and Ministers from its member nations. The objective of this meeting is to outline and implement a comprehensive mitigation plan, with a strong focus on mass vaccination as a primary strategy to combat the spread of this debilitating disease.

The CSP's approach differs markedly from that of the ATO, with its emphasis on preventative measures such as border security and travel restrictions. Instead, the CSP champions the deployment of a large-scale vaccination campaign to contain the outbreak at its source. During the meeting, the CSP also stressed the need for unified action, resource mobilization, and collaborative efforts between member nations to effectively manage and mitigate the health crisis.

name: Turn08_CSP_RumburgShipAccident
title: CSP Condemns The Submarine Attack on a Cargo Ship
description:
The CSP has issued a strong condemnation following the recent submarine attack on a cargo ship off the coast of Markanissa, near Northeast Rumburg. The incident, involving a Rumburg submarine erroneously targeting a cargo vessel belonging to United Contana, has raised serious concerns about maritime safety and the need for improved communication channels.

In light of the incident, the CSP is calling for immediate measures to prevent such occurrences in the future. A key proposition is the establishment of an emergency security hotline between GRACE and CSP. This would serve as a platform for real-time information exchange, ensuring quick and appropriate responses to any maritime distress signals. 

The pact believes that this initiative will significantly enhance maritime safety, providing a buffer against inadvertent escalations.

name: Turn08_CSP_RuralInstitutePraise
title: Social Equality in Rural Regions
description:
The establishment of rural education institutes in Sordland has been lauded by the CSP. The alliance views this initiative as a crucial step towards achieving social equality and empowering future generations. 

Vice-Secretary Chairman Toqezintli Iyotake of the United Assembly of United Contana has expressed his personal admiration for this initiative. He contends that such investments bridge the rural-urban divide, fostering a more inclusive society, and thus sets a commendable example for the rest of the world.

name: Turn08_Derdia_CondemsRemovalOfReligion
title: Derdia Objects to Sordish Religious Icon Removal
description:
Derdia's Supreme Wiseman Jorga Azmal has strongly criticized Sordland's decision to remove public religious symbols, calling it an infringement on religious freedom. He urged the international community to condemn such actions and emphasized the role of religious symbols in expressing and preserving the identity of religious communities.

Azmal also expressed hope that Sordland would reconsider its stance on the matter.

name: Turn08_Deyr_GovernorBron_ContinuesResettlement
title: Governor Bron Continues "Resettlement" Policies
description:
Governor Bron reports that his efforts in maintaining stability and safeguard the well-being of the Special Zone is continuing successfully. According to the report, the controversial "Resettlement" policies of the governor are continuing. Recent investigations into the collaborators of the Bludish Freedom Front have resulted in the eviction or apprehension of nearly four thousand Bludish residents in the city of Deyr.

Governor Bron highlighted that these measures, undertaken with careful consideration and in accordance with legal procedures, aim to ensure the safety and security of all residents in the region. However, the Minister of the Interior, Lileas Graf, has expressed concerns over this decision, emphasizing the potential ramifications and heightened tensions it may bring to the region.

name: Turn08_Deyr_GovernorErsen_Cancels_Both
title: Governor Ersen Announces The Nullification of the "Unified Education Act" and "Religious Harmony Act" In Bergia
description:
Today, Governor Ersen of the Autonomous Zone of Bergia made a groundbreaking announcement, declaring the nullification of both the "Unified Education Act" and the "Religious Harmony Act" within the borders of the region. These decisions followed a vote held in the Bergian Local Assembly in Deyr, where it was determined that the laws encompassed within both acts would no longer be applicable within Bergia.

The nullification of these acts marks a pivotal moment for the Bludish community and their linguistic, educational, and religious rights. It effectively lifts the ban on the usage of Bludish in both educational institutions and religious ceremonies within the region, reinstating the rights of Bludish individuals to freely express their language and faith.

The impact of these decisions is expected to be profound and far-reaching across the Autonomous Zone of Bergia. Institutions and individuals now have the freedom to reintroduce Bludish into their curriculum and religious institutions. Additionally, Bludish individuals can once again pursue careers as state-sanctioned priests.

name: Turn08_Deyr_GovernorErsen_Cancels_LanguageBill
title: Governor Ersen Announces The Nullification of "Unified Education Act" In Bergia
description:
Today, Governor Ersen of the Autonomous Zone of Bergia has announced the nullification of the "Unified Education Act" within the borders of the region. This decision follows a vote held in the Bergian Local Assembly in Deyr, where it was determined that the laws encompassed within the act will no longer be applicable within Bergia.

The nullification effectively lifts the ban on the usage of Bludish in educational institutions within the region, marking a pivotal moment for the Bludish community and their linguistic rights.

The impact of this decision is expected to be felt across the educational landscape of the Autonomous Zone, as institutions now have the freedom to reintroduce Bludish into their curriculum.

name: Turn08_Deyr_GovernorErsen_Cancels_ReligiousHarmonyBill
title: Governor Ersen Announces The Nullification of "Religious Harmony Act" In Bergia
description:
Today, Governor Ersen of the Autonomous Zone of Bergia has announced the nullification of the "Religious Harmony Act" within the borders of the region. This decision follows a vote held in the Bergian Local Assembly in Deyr, where it was determined that the laws encompassed within the act will no longer be applicable within Bergia.

The nullification effectively lifts the ban on the usage of Bludish in religious institutions and ceremonies within the region, marking a pivotal moment for the Bludish community and their linguistic and religious rights. This reversal also reinstates the rights of Bludish individuals to pursue careers as state-sanctioned priests.

The impact of this decision is expected to be felt across the religious landscape of the Autonomous Zone, as institutions and individuals will now have the freedom to express their faith in the Bludish language.

name: Turn08_Deyr_GovernorErsen_DewlenArgePortraitInSquare
title: Governor Ersen Displays Terrorist Dewlen Arge's Portrait In Deyr
description:
Yesterday, a controversial development has taken place in the People's Plaza in Deyr, as a portrait of the notorious terrorist Dewlen Arge, the former leader and founder of the BFF, was prominently displayed by the orders of Governor Ersen. Arge, currently serving time in Antel Rock Prison for his involvement in heinous acts of violence, used to be considered the number-one enemy of the Sordish state.

The Ministry of Interior swiftly raised concerns about this development, questioning the jurisdiction of the Autonomous Zone in granting the new governor the authority to showcase and promote individuals considered enemies of the state. They also expressed apprehension regarding the potential escalation of tensions between the Bludish and Sordish communities within the region.

The National Front Party (NFP) was quick to condemn the decision, emphasizing their strong opposition to any glorification of terrorists. Some individual members even went as far as threatening mob justice against the new administration in Bergia, further heightening concerns about social unrest.

name: Turn08_Deyr_GovernorKrull_InvitesHolstronRegionalDay
title: Governor Krull Invites Remus Holstron To Celebrate Bludish Holiday
description:
Governor Krull reports that his efforts in maintaining stability and promote unity between the residents of the Special Zone is continuing successfully. As part of his latest efforts, Governor Krull has extended an invitation Remus Holstron, the deputy of the National Front Party (NFP), to preside over the grand ceremony commemorating the regional holiday in Deyr. This day holds particular significance for the Bludish and Golcondist communities.

Governor Krull, in assuring the smooth execution of the event, has stated that all necessary preparations have been made to ensure a peaceful and inclusive celebration. However, the Minister of the Interior, Lileas Graf, has expressed concerns over this decision, emphasizing the potential ramifications and heightened tensions it may bring to the region.

name: Turn08_Deyr_SpecialZone_Abolished_BronDismissed
title: Special Zone of Bergia Abolished
description:
The Special Zone of Bergia has been officially abolished and the new structure is currently being implemented with speed. Under the new framework, Bergia will be aligned with the standard regional structure observed throughout Sordland, bringing it under the direct jurisdiction of the Ministry of Interior.

As part of this restructuring, the position of governor, currently held by Phelix Bron, has been abolished, resulting in his dismissal from duty. In the next local elections, the residents will have the opportunity to elect their own mayors and municipal representatives for each city in the region.

name: Turn08_Deyr_SpecialZone_Abolished_KrullDismissed
title: Special Zone of Bergia Abolished
description:
The Special Zone of Bergia has been officially abolished and the new structure is currently being implemented with speed. Under the new framework, Bergia will be aligned with the standard regional structure observed throughout Sordland, bringing it under the direct jurisdiction of the Ministry of Interior.

As part of this restructuring, the position of governor, currently held by Herbert Krull, has been abolished, resulting in his dismissal from duty. In the next local elections, the residents will have the opportunity to elect their own mayors and municipal representatives for each city in the region.

name: Turn08_Deyr_SpecialZone_Autonomy_BronDismissed
title: The Autonomous Zone of Bergia Is Formed -- Ishval Ersen Becomes Governor
description:
The Autonomous Zone of Bergia has been officially formed and the new structure is currently being implemented with speed. Under the new framework, Bergia will have a degree of autonomy within the broader Sordland administrative framework.

As part of this restructuring, the current governor, Phelix Bron, has been dismissed from duty following a regional election held in Bergia, which resulted in the appointment of Ishval Ersen as the new governor.

Under the new structure, the Autonomous Zone of Bergia will have increased decision-making powers and the ability to shape its own policies within certain limits defined by national legislation. The Governor of Bergia will be heading the newly founded Regional Assembly of Bergia. This development signifies a notable shift toward local empowerment and self-governance.

name: Turn08_Deyr_SpecialZone_Autonomy_KrullDismissed
title: The Autonomous Zone of Bergia Is Formed -- Ishval Ersen Becomes Governor
description:
The Autonomous Zone of Bergia has been officially formed and the new structure is currently being implemented with speed. Under the new framework, Bergia will have a degree of autonomy within the broader Sordland administrative framework.

As part of this restructuring, the current governor, Herbert Krull, has been dismissed from duty following a regional election held in Bergia, which resulted in the appointment of Ishval Ersen as the new governor.

Under the new structure, the Autonomous Zone of Bergia will have increased decision-making powers and the ability to shape its own policies within certain limits defined by national legislation. The Governor of Bergia will be heading the newly founded Regional Assembly of Bergia. This development signifies a notable shift toward local empowerment and self-governance.

name: Turn08_Expanded_AirForce
title: 140 Aircraft Added To Air Force Inventory
description: Sordland’s Minister of Defense, General Iosef Lancea, is reporting that efforts to expand our Air Force are completed. According to his report, 135 Sordland S-13 fighters and 155 Benfi Delivery BD-34 Bombers had been added to our existing 410 aircraft to a total of 700 aircraft.

name: Turn08_Expanded_Army
title: Personnel Recruitment Increased And Tanks Procured
description: Sordland’s Minister of Defense, General Iosef Lancea, is reporting that efforts to expand our army are complete. According to his report, our army personnel numbers have been reinforced to the addition of 200.000 soldiers, with the second army’s Mountain Commando Force to be increased to 50.000. In addition, 5 Light-Tank Battalions and 3 Heavy-Tank battalions, equipped with S-4 Soll tanks and H-3 Holsord heavy tanks, have been sent to the 2nd army as reinforcement.

name: Turn08_Expanded_Navy
title: 31 Vessels Enter Navy Service
description: Sordland’s Minister of Defense, General Iosef Lancea, is reporting that efforts to expand our navy are progressing. According to his report, 5 Conriat-class battleships (Revan, Wrace, Tordera, Eskel, and Markia), 5 Vesord-class destroyers, and 10 Benfi-class light cruisers which brought us to a total of 90 vessels, surpassing the Agnolian Navy.

name: Turn08_Gelsord_ElectronicsIndustryGrows
title: Electronics Industry Boom in Gelsord
description: Gelsord's electronics industry is witnessing a remarkable growth phase. The city's increased production capacity and innovative technologies are driving the sector's boom, contributing substantially to the local economy. With its reputation as an emerging hub for electronics, Gelsord stands poised for continued economic growth.

name: Turn08_Gendermarie_Police_Issue
title: Gendarmerie Police Issue
description: A massive miscommunication between the interior and gendarmerie has resulted in a failed raid in Vesord.  The Ministry of Defense and Interior have both put the blame on each other. There will be a gathering soon to solve the ongoing dispute within the security.

name: Turn08_GRACE_CommendsTradeGrowth
title: GRACE Commends Trade Growth
description: GRACE proudly acknowledges the significant growth in trade with the Kingdom of Rizia. This advancement is a direct result of our concerted efforts to foster stronger economic ties and collaborative initiatives. Our alliance is committed to further enhancing this fruitful partnership, ensuring mutual prosperity and economic development.

name: Turn08_GRACE_CondemsVendonesamLoss
title: Condemnation of Revolutionary Victory in Vendonesam
description: GRACE expresses its disapproval of the revolutionary forces' recent victory in Vendonesam. This development challenges the traditional monarchist values that GRACE staunchly supports. We reaffirm our commitment to monarchist regimes and call for renewed efforts to support and promote these governance structures within the international community.

name: Turn08_GRACE_ContestsVendonesamStalemate
title: Intensified Support to Overcome Stalemate in Vendonesam
description:
GRACE is escalating its support for the monarchist forces in the Vendonesam Civil War, reaffirming its role as a steadfast ally of nations committed to preserving monarchic governance. To address the ongoing stalemate, GRACE is deploying additional resources, including enhanced strategic military assistance, logistical support, and intelligence-sharing capabilities.

This initiative is a reflection of our shared values and the collective responsibility of monarchic nations to uphold stability and order in times of crisis. GRACE remains resolute in its mission to assist its allies in achieving a decisive outcome, ensuring that the principles of monarchic rule continue to thrive and contribute to regional and global stability.

name: Turn08_GRACE_Decision_TradeEnds
title: GRACE Countries Express Regrets At Falling Trade Volume
description: Several GRACE countries, including Rumburg, have expressed their regrets at the reducing levels of trade between Rizia and the rest of the block, and hoped it could improve in the future with renegotiated trade agreements.

name: Turn08_GRACE_Decision_TradeGrows
title: GRACE Countries Rejoice At Increasing Trade
description: Several GRACE countries, including Rumburg, have expressed their happiness about increasing trade levels between Rizia and the rest of the block, and hoped it can increase even further in the future.

name: Turn08_GRACE_HailsVendonesamVictory
title: Celebration of Monarchist Triumph in Vendonesam Civil War
description: GRACE proudly hails the recent victory of the monarchist forces in Vendonesam's Civil War. This triumph not only marks a significant milestone in Vendonesam's history but also serves as a show of effectiveness and resilience of monarchist governance. Our alliance views this victory as a reaffirmation of our core values and a demonstration of the enduring strength of monarchist ideals in the region.

name: Turn08_H3_Positive_effects
title: Lenkurg Commerce All Time High
description:
Commercial activity reports coming from the Ministry of Economics display that the small business activity in Lenkurg has increased with new goods entering and exiting the port with trucks traveling at the same distance as before with faster speeds thanks to the new highway. Lenkurg also reported an increase in visitors and new business openings ever since the opening of H-3.

The influx of people is primarily coming from Agnolia and the Nargis region of Sordland who are buying properties and enjoying the cheaper seaside alternative to Lachaven.

name: Turn08_H3_SSC_Finished
title: H3 Finished/ SSC
description: The long-awaited road network running from Lachaven to Arvory had been completed. The speed of transportation in the region is expected to be improved substantially. Even though there have been some issues causing it to be delayed, Sordish State Cooperation has delivered its promise.

name: Turn08_H3_Taurus_Finished
title: H3 Finished/ Taurus
description: The long-awaited road network running from Lachaven to Arvory had been completed. The speed of transportation in the region is expected to be improved substantially. Even though there have been some issues causing it to be delayed, Taurus Holding had delivered its promise.

name: Turn08_Holsord_ATOInfluenceGrows
title: ATO's Influence on the Rise in Holsord
description: Holsord is experiencing a surge in activities related to the Arcasian Treaty Organisation (ATO). The city has seen an increase in ATO-sponsored events, including symposiums, public forums, and networking sessions. The local populace is showing considerable interest in ATO's objectives and initiatives, reflecting the organization's successful attempts to expand its influence within Holsord.

name: Turn08_Holsord_BFFThreat_PresidentSecurityIncreased
title: Presidential Security Increased
description:
The Presidential Guard reported that the security measures surrounding President Rayne have been significantly bolstered following the receipt of a threatening letter from the notorious extremist group, the Bludish Freedom Front (BFF). 

In response to this credible threat, a comprehensive review of the President's security arrangements has been conducted, leading to the implementation of enhanced protective measures. These include increased personnel deployment, heightened surveillance systems, and closer coordination with intelligence agencies to preempt any potential threats.

name: Turn08_Holsord_ChiefJusticeHawker_FoundDead
title: Chief Justice Hawker Murdered By Unknown Assailants
description:
The Sordish Police Force reports that Chief Justice Orso Hawker was brutally murdered in the New Erlory district of Holsord while walking his dog in the morning. 

Preliminary reports indicate that the Chief Justice was the target of a meticulously planned attack by a group of unknown individuals. Multiple assailants, armed with automatic rifles, opened fire from a passing vehicle, ruthlessly taking his life. The attackers swiftly fled the scene and the search for them is ongoing. Investigations on the incident will follow.

name: Turn08_Holsord_CSPInfluenceGrows
title: CSP's Growing Presence Felt in Holsord
description: The Contanan Security Pact (CSP) has been visibly strengthening its presence in Holsord. A number of CSP-affiliated organizations and advocacy groups have set up operations within the city, leading to increased visibility for the alliance. The city has hosted several CSP-led seminars and gatherings, and these events have been met with significant participation from local citizens, signaling a growing acceptance of CSP's influence in Holsord.

name: Turn08_Holsord_Impeachment
title: Supreme Court Conspiring To Impeach
description:
Lucian reports that the Supreme Court is thinking about pushing Ricter’s case further to impeachment.

In his note, he wrote: “Chief Justice and five other justices met behind closed doors to discuss what to do with the investigations against you, Mr. President. I’m afraid the chief justice is thinking about putting you on trial and take you down. They have already found you guilty of violating Article 100. If they indeed united in that meeting, it will be very bad, sir.”

name: Turn08_Holsord_OvidGrecerChargesBron_Amended
title: Ovid Grecer Charges Governor Bron -- Replaces Him With Ishval Ersen
description:
The previously delayed case of Ishval Ersen against Governor Phelix Bron has finally reached a conclusive verdict. Governor Bron has been found guilty of power abuse, resulting in discrimination against Sordland's citizens, directly contravening the newly enacted Constitution, specifically Articles 6 and 7.

In light of his conviction, Governor Bron has been swiftly relieved of his duties and transferred to Antel Rock Prison for appropriate incarceration. Recognizing the need for a smooth transition, a special transitionary council has been established to govern the Special Zone until the upcoming elections.

Following careful consideration, the council has selected Ishval Ersen as the most fitting candidate for the position of governor. Ersen, a prominent advocate for Bludish rights from Bergia, has gained significant recognition for championing these concerns at the national level.

name: Turn08_Holsord_OvidGrecerChargesBron_Default
title: Ovid Grecer Charges Governor Bron -- Replaces Him With Ishval Ersen
description:
The previously delayed case of Ishval Ersen against Governor Phelix Bron has finally reached a conclusive verdict. After a thorough examination, Governor Bron has been found guilty of abusing his powers, leading to discrimination against the citizens of Sordland and violating constitutional laws.

In light of his conviction, Governor Bron has been swiftly relieved of his duties and transferred to Antel Rock Prison for appropriate incarceration. Recognizing the need for a smooth transition, a special transitionary council has been established to govern the Special Zone until the upcoming elections.

Following careful consideration, the council has selected Ishval Ersen as the most fitting candidate for the position of governor. Ersen, a prominent advocate for Bludish rights from Bergia, has gained significant recognition for championing these concerns at the national level.

name: Turn08_Holsord_PresidentialSalary
title: Presidential Salary Increased
description: The Grand National Assembly discussed and passed a new law increasing the yearly salaries of elected officials including that of the President of Sordland.

name: Turn08_Holsord_TargetsKilled
title: SSP Reports Successful Operation
description: Chief of Police Karl Greiser reports that the “classified” operational assignments are completed with success. The target was eliminated successfully.

name: Turn08_Holsord_USPUnresponsive
title: State Mechanisms Hampered in Holsord Due to USP's Obstructionism
description:
The operations of state mechanisms in Holsord are being hampered due to obstructionist tactics employed by the United Sordland Party (USP). The USP's resistance is resulting in significant delays in policy implementation, with approximately 35% of proposed projects experiencing undue hold-ups. 

The situation is raising concerns about the efficient governance of Holsord and its long-term impact on public services.

name: Turn08_Kyrute_AlvarezVisit_CaleqabizToLespia
title: Kyrute Urges Calm Around Caleqabiz Issue
description:
Kyrutian Chancellor Inos Adriumer has urged both CSP and ATO to de-escalate the soaring tensions surrounding the island of Caleqabiz, after details of the Lespian-Rizian deal regarding the island became known. 

The island nation has requested both power blocs to refrain from increasing military assets in the Antacean sea, and committed itself to full neutrality in the conflict.

name: Turn08_Kyrute_CondemnsEmergency
title: Emergency State Extension Receives Kyrute's Disapproval
description: The Republic of Kyrute has voiced significant concerns regarding the extension of the state of emergency in Sordland. This position aligns with Kyrute's dedication to democratic principles and the protection of civil liberties. Chancellor Inos Adriumer has called on Sordland to reassess this decision and emphasize the safeguarding of its citizens' fundamental rights.

name: Turn08_L1_Positive_effects
title: Gelsord Commercial Activity Increased
description:
Commercial activity reports coming from the Ministry of Economics display that a record number of new companies are being founded in Gelsord due to an economic boom. The report also indicates an increase in the logistical intake and output of the city is driving the tech company growth. The research council of the city has also reported positive growth for the next few years.

Gelsord also reported the most visits of passengers ever with people from Holsord taking the high-speed rail to see the city just for fun. The largest group of visitors are still scientists and students.

name: Turn08_L1_SSC_Finished
title: L1 Finished/ SSC
description: The long-awaited L-1 railway running from Holsord to Lachaven had been completed. With Holsord connected to the country's biggest port in Lachaven, businesses in the region are expected to gain a significant boost. Even though there have been some issues causing it to be delayed, Sordish State Cooperation had delivered its promise.

name: Turn08_L1_Taurus_Finished
title: L1 Finished/ Taurus
description: The long-awaited L-1 railway running from Holsord to Lachaven had been completed. With Holsord connected to the country's biggest port in Lachaven, businesses in the region are expected to gain a significant boost. Even though there have been some issues causing it to be delayed, Taurus Holding had delivered its promise.

name: Turn08_Lachaven_GasomHighProfitShares
title: High Profit Share Returns from Gasom Corporation
description: The Gasom Corporation in Lachaven is reporting high profit share returns, contributing significantly to the state's income. The robust profits are a result of effective business strategies and favorable market conditions. These returns underline Gasom's key role in the state's economic landscape and its potential to continue contributing to financial prosperity.

name: Turn08_Lachaven_HighBudgetTwo
title: National Business Council Demands Stimulus
description:
The NBC leadership figures from both state and private sectors have brought forward requests for governmental stimulus initiatives in light of the budget surplus.

The missed opportunities of growth and a lack of injection to drive an upward trend is being criticized. More economic intervention is requested to unlock a grander economic expansion in the near and long-term future.

name: Turn08_Lachaven_NBCVATImpact
title: National Business Council Reports Negative Impact of VAT on Spending
description: The National Business Council of Lachaven has expressed concerns about the adverse effects of the Value-Added Tax on consumer spending. According to their report, the imposition of VAT has resulted in increased costs for consumers and a subsequent decrease in overall spending. This trend poses a significant challenge for the local economy and warrants careful review by policy-makers.

name: Turn08_Lachaven_NegativeBudgetTwo
title: National Business Council Requests Fiscal Conservatism
description:
The NBC issued a warning about the government budget deficit which occurred in the third year of the administration.

Leadership figures from the private and state sectors brought forward complaints that the country could head towards a debt crisis if the situation is left unchecked. Experts have sounded the alarm about a potential credit rating downgrade in this situation if a better balance won't be achieved soon.

name: Turn08_Lachaven_VeryNegativeBudgetTwo
title: National Business Council Warns of Excessive Spending
description:
The NBC issued a critical warning about the massive government budget deficit which occurred in the third year of the administration.

Leadership figures from the private and state sectors brought forward complaints that the country could head towards a serious debt crisis if the situation is left unchecked. Experts have sounded the alarm about a potential credit rating downgrade in this situation if a better balance won't be achieved soon.

name: Turn08_Lespia_AlvarezVisit_GasExportsToRizia
title: Lespia Starts Gas Exports To Rizia
description: Lespian tankers have left the port of San Mantua, delivering the promised gas to facilities in Porte Drazon.

name: Turn08_Lespia_AlvarezVisit_LespiaDoesntFollowSanctions
title: Lespia Won’t Sanction Rizia
description: The Republic of Lespia announced it will not be sanctioning our country, despite growing international calls for sanctions to be imposed. Prime Minister Alvarez cited new found understanding between our two countries as his motivation.

name: Turn08_Lespia_Sanctions_Ally_Valgsland
title: Lespia Sanctions
description: Lespia has announced a slew of trade sanctions against us with increases of up to 30 percent of import tax on certain goods along with the cancellation of military arms sales, medical assistance, and other economic cooperations between our countries. The sanctions came as a direct reaction to the alliance signed with Valgsland.

name: Turn08_Manus_SecurityThreat
title: Manus Sazon Designated As A Threat By Internal Security
description:
Following a detailed assessment by national security agencies, Manus Sazon has been designated as an internal security threat. Authorities cite Sazon's recent public statements advocating systemic changes and his alleged ties to subversive factions as grounds for the classification. His influence among Rizian anti-monarchist groups and potential connections to external destabilizing actors are seen as direct threats to the unity and stability of the Kingdom.

Security protocols have been updated to monitor his activities, while legal frameworks are being explored for further actions against Sazon and his known affiliates.

name: Turn08_MaveNortus_IntelligenceServiceSearchesVina
title: Intelligence Hub Commences Vina Search
description: The intelligence hub, located in Mave Nortus, has rapidly mobilized its resources to lead the search for Princess Vina. The hub’s agents will focus on broadening the search beyond Rizia, looking at foreign countries as possible destinations for the runaway Princess.

name: Turn08_Modernized_AirForce
title: State-Of-The-Art Aircraft Enter Aircraft Inventory
description: Sordland’s Minister of Defense, General Iosef Lancea, is reporting that the efforts to modernize our Air Force is complete. According to his report, our existing 410 Sordland S-13 fighters and Benfi Delivery B-34 Bombers have been upgraded. With the latest technology S-16 fighter jets and Benfi Prime Delivery BPD-36 bombers. The new bombers have increased range, speed, bomb payloads along with more sophisticated radar and radio guidance assisted targeting systems allowing for more precise bombing day or night. Our pilots nicknamed them the night-herons.

name: Turn08_Modernized_Army
title: State-Of-The-Art Military Equipment and Tanks Enter Inventory
description: Sordland’s Minister of Defense, General Iosef Lancea, is reporting that the efforts to modernize the army are complete. According to his report, our soldiers’ equipment has been upgraded with the newest Morna Industry MI20 submachine guns, the Strongarm 55 or S55 assault rifles, BP56 or the Bernard semi-automatic pistol, 1956, and Walter air-cooled .303 Arcasian machine gun. Furthermore, our H-3 Holsord Heavy tanks have been upgraded to the newest model, the H-4 Holsord Heavy Tanks with 25-185mm armor and a more powerful engine. Its armaments have also received substantial upgrades in the form of a new 88mm L/43 main gun, and a 12.7mm heavy machine gun mounted on top of the turret.

name: Turn08_Modernized_Navy
title: Battleships Refitted and Modernized
description: Sordland’s Minister of Defense, General Iosef Lancea, is reporting that the efforts to modernize our navy is complete. According to his report, our existing 15 Conriat-class battleships have been upgraded. Their main battery is equipped with 38 cm guns, 30 degrees elevation with a maximum range of 34,450 m. Their AA have also been upgraded with 14, 10.5 cm caliber guns. Their armors have been reinforced with a belt that ranged in thickness from 210 to 290 mm, covering the central portion. Besides that, our light cruisers and battlecruisers have also been upgraded to the latest technology.

name: Turn08_Monqiz_Decision_VendonesamStalemate_Aid
title: Aid Shipment Leaves For Vendonesam
description: Tens-of-thousands of tonnes of humanitarian aid left the Monqiz harbor on its way to Vendonesam, where it is to help alleviate the suffering of civilians stuck in a civil war that seemingly has no end.

name: Turn08_Monqiz_Decision_Vendonesam_TroopsReturn
title: Ceremony For Returning Veterans
description: Troops returning from Vendenosam received a hero's welcome as they embarked the ships at Monqiz’s harbor, complete with a royal marching band treating them to the finest Rizian anthems.

name: Turn08_Monqiz_Decision_VendonesamVictory_Banquet
title: Banquet Held To Celebrate Vendonesam Win
description: To celebrate the victory of Rizian ally Kabauen Sang Tam, banquets are held in major Rizian cities in his honor, with King Romus attending one in Monqiz. At the banquet, Romus and the Vendonesam minister of war, who was the guest of honor, shook hands, with the minister thanking our King for his extensive support to his government.

name: Turn08_Monqiz_Decision_VendonesamVictory_Monument
title: Monument To Fallen Soldiers Of Vendonesam Campaign Unveiled
description: King Romus, together with the Vendonesam ambassador, has unveiled a monument to honor the fallen Rizian soldiers who aided the besieged Monarchy in its civil war. The ambassador thanked our King for his extensive support in the war, remarking that it is thanks to Rizia’s unwavering support that the Prince Consort emerged victorious.

name: Turn08_Monqiz_NoblesRentCapWorkarounds
title: Nobles Continue To Increase Rents Despite Regulation
description: Tenants organizations in Monqiz have raised concerns at more and more landlords increasing rents far beyond the 8% yearly threshold. Exceptions to those thresholds by renovating housing stock are commonly being used, as well as highly illegal rental agreements without formal contracts.
