title: Archsanctuary Roof Arson by Vandals
description:
Hundreds of vandals attacked the Archsanctuary and set fire to the roof of the Archsanctuary. The firefighter's department and local police immediately intervened to prevent further damage to the building while fending off the vandals that injured the firefighters. The police units found themselves surrounded and barricaded themselves in the Archsanctuary with the Archpriest.

A reinforcement police contingency broke through the mass revolt and saved the surrounded security units. Several armed rioters shot at police officers while armed vehicles gunned down violent armed rioters. The situation in the city is escalating.

name: Turn09_Deyr_Unrest_BFF_Military
title: Military Assumes Control in Bergia and Nargis to End BFF
description:
The Sordish Armed Forces are reporting that Soll Dam has been freed from the grasps of the rebels. During the raid, 3 separate bases of operations were discovered and eliminated by the army.

To put an end to the unrest, the army has assumed direct command over the security in both the Bergia and Nargis regions. Governors have been temporarily relieved of their duties until the unrest has been eliminated entirely.

name: Turn09_Deyr_UnrestBFFMilitary_AirForceBomb
title: Air Force Bombs Suspected BFF Outposts
description:
After accurate military intelligence reports on several suspected BFF outposts around the city of Deyr, the Sordish Air Force began operational planning to destroy them. Twenty bombers departed from Erlory and bombed three different BFF outposts resulting in a massive destruction of the enemy military capacity to conduct operations inside and outside of Deyr.

In the after action report the military counted 8 anti-air guns, several tons of guns and ammunition destroyed and 394 BFF killed. The Air Force conducted aerial recon missions and spotted the BFF retreating towards the mountains. A helicopter squadron was dispatched and eliminated the retreating forces.

name: Turn09_Deyr_Unrest_Violent_Military
title: Military Assumes Control in Bergia and Nargis to End Unrest
description:
The Sordish Armed Forces are reporting that the violent unrest across Bergia and Nargis is now under control. So far, 237 militants have been killed with many more in custody. The death toll is expected to increase as operations continue.

To end the protests, the military has assumed direct control over the security in both the Bergia and Nargis regions. Governors have been temporarily relieved of their duties until the unrest has been eliminated entirely.

name: Turn09_Erlory_ATOPlanes
title: ATO Modernises Airforce with New Planes
description:
Sordland’s Minister of Defense, General Iosef Lancea, is reporting that we have received the supplies and new aircraft from ATO.  According to his report, we have added S-16 fighter jets and Ventrie Express VE-34 bombers to our airforce.

Equipped with modern avionics, more accurate radar-guided gunsights; and a superior weapons loadout, the Sordland S-16 supersonic jet fighter gives our airforces a decisive edge in aerial combat. Their speed and maneuverability are exceeding our pilot’s expectations.

They are nicknaming these new aircraft as Arcasian Hornets.

name: Turn09_Erlory_SchoolShooting
title: School Shooting
description: A mass shooter at a school in Erlory has been arrested. Unfortunately, the incident has taken away the lives of 12, comprising teachers and mostly students. According to the investigation, the attacker had obtained the gun used in the attack from a legal gun shop that was recently opened in Erlory.

name: Turn09_Erlory_War_Airforce
title: Airforce Preparing for War
description: The Air Force is readying its planes to depart for the Rumburg operation. Fighter training and bombing exercises are happening daily. The planes will rebase to Lachaven to establish air control in Nargis when the operation starts.

name: Turn09_Erzaren_BFF_Diplomatic_PromiseFailed
title: Attack at Soll Dam
description:
After the failure of the diplomatic talks, the BFF militants occupying the Soll Dam fired at the police which surrounded the area. Three policemen were wounded.

Police forces have encircled the rebel positions in Soll dam and they are ready for their orders. Special operations unit has reported that they are using their best men to ensure their success.

The operation has 3 main objectives. Search, secure and destroy. The expected start time will be sundown tonight.

name: Turn09_Erzaren_Emergency_Revoked
title: Citizens Celebrate Revocation of National Emergency
description: Citizens in Erzaren reacted positively to the revocation of the national emergency, with impromptu fireworks in the town square. Many had previously voiced their opposition to the increased police presence in their city.

name: Turn09_Erzaren_SollDam_Explosion
title: Explosion at Soll Dam
description:
During today’s operation by the police, the BFF rebels used explosives to destroy the main electrical transformer of the Soll Dam which connects the hydroelectric power to the national grid. The entire plant output – a significant portion of the supply to Bergia, Nargis, and Agnland – was lost, leading to widespread power outages in the regions.

Chief of Police Greiser reported that the number of casualties is suspected to be more than twenty. Regional police forces immediately arrived at the dam and the hunt for BFF rebels around Erzaren continued.

name: Turn09_Erzaren_SollDam_Explosion1
title: Soll Dam Transformers Explode
description:
The bomb attack at the Soll Dam has destroyed the main transformers of the critical energy infrastructure facility. The explosion heard from Erzaren has caused the city to descend into darkness while security forces moved into the area to take control of the situation.

Engineers and technical teams are on standby to immediately begin repairs once the security situation has resolved. Emergency funds of the Interior have been unlocked to help with the crisis.

name: Turn09_Erzaren_Unrest_BFF_Diplomatic
title: BFF Backs Down
description:
After his release, Dewlen Arge, the ex-Bludish Freedom Front leader called the militants to drop their weapons and back down.

The militants at the Soll Dam retreated and several of them were detained after surrendering to the police.

name: Turn09_Erzaren_UnrestBFFMilitary_CellsDestroyed
title: Assault Units Destroy BFF Cells
description:
A dozen hidden Bludish Freedom Front cells were destroyed by infantry assault units specifically equipped for difficult offensive operations. A thousand soldiers participated in the four-day-long operation and after suffering losses in many ambushes on the way to the hilly positions of the enemy, the military succeeded, thanks to accurate artillery support and aerial recon. The enemy mine placements delayed military operations for a significant time but were overcome with engineers.

The BFF fought hard and long but eventually succumbed to the superior equipment and numbers of the military which also gathered help from the local civilian populace to accurately find the hidden cells. At the end of the operation, 34 Sordish soldiers lost their lives and the eight BFF outposts were destroyed along with 219 enemy combatants. Erzaren was declared cleared by the armed rebels.

name: Turn09_Erzaren_Unrest_BFF_Police
title: Police Ready For Operation
description:
Police forces have encircled the rebel's positions in Soll Dam and they are ready for their orders. Our special operations unit has reported that they are using their best men to ensure their success.

This operation has 3 main objectives: search, secure, and destroy. The expected start time will be sundown tonight.

name: Turn09_Estord_Investigation_Koranelli_NotStopped
title: Koronti Links to Koranelli Cartel Confirmed
description: The joint investigation into Marcel Koronti by the Ministry of Justice and the Ministry of the Interior has confirmed that Koronti’s corporation Heart of Sordland has been laundering money for the Koranelli cartel. Koronti has been apprehended at his Estord villa and now awaits trial in Antel Rock.

name: Turn09_Estord_Investigation_Koranelli_TippedOff
title: Koronti Tipped Off About Investigation
description: An unknown source from within the Sordish government is suspected to have tipped off Marcel Koronti about the joint investigation into his corporation’s links to organized crime. The investigators could find no employees willing to divulge information about HOS, and the corporation’s records appear to have been scrubbed clean.

name: Turn09_Estord_Rumburg_PlaneShot
title: Rumburgian Plane Shot
description: Iosef Lancea reports that a Rumburgian war plane was shot down by anti-aircraft upon violating the Sordish airspace. According to the report of the General Staff, the plane was flying over the town of Halgen inside Sordish borders and did not retreat upon warning.

name: Turn09_Estord_Rumburg_PlaneWarned
title: Rumburg Plane Warned Inside Airspace
description: A lone Rumburgian warplane violated our airspace by entering the territory of Sordland for two minutes and left after issuing a radio message.

name: Turn09_Estord_UnrestMilitary_TanksRoll
title: Armored Column Rolls Through Rioters
description:
The 3rd armored division's military outpost was surrounded by nearly ten thousand rioters for two days. The local commander reported a potential to be overwhelmed as a unit. The situation escalated when the Colonel of the division ordered battle formation and attacked the rioters with tanks and APCs which resulted in 310 killed and 1321 wounded. Many tanks of the column rolled through the protestors.

When first aid and medical teams arrived to save lives the Colonel forbade them to treat the rioters as they were branded enemies of the state. The division has since suppressed or killed all dissenting voices in Estord and taken over the city. The situation is tense but secure.

name: Turn09_FolceDator_WorshippersMarchOnCapital2
title: Rioting In Folce Dator As Worshippers Reach City
description: As the religious march, now numbering over one hundred thousand participants, reached Folce Dator, riots broke out in the city. The city, which is home to a significant Golcondist and Dastnurist community, saw religious violence destroy shops and public property, with at least 4 killed and several dozens injured. During the violence, one weapon depot was targeted, with the worshippers successfully seizing multiple machine guns and other military grade weaponry.

name: Turn09_Gelsord_ElectionVote_Albin_ReformistVotes
title: Vice President Clavin Drawing Reformists
description: A large majority of reformists have been scared off due to our pro-Soll agenda. However, our Vice President, Albin Clavin, has been hosting rallies trying to sway the reformist USP voters to our side.

name: Turn09_Gelsord_InvestmentSynergyHigh
title: High Investment Synergy Achieved
description: Investments across multiple sectors are demonstrating high levels of synergy, leading to impressive economic growth. The well-coordinated infusion of capital into sectors in different ways has resulted in significant advancements and a boost in productivity. This efficient allocation of resources is driving economic success and setting a strong foundation for future prosperity.

name: Turn09_Gelsord_PoliticalOrgs_RYAttacks
title: Red Youth Launch Attack on Gelsord
description: Banned Red Youth members have launched attacks on the civilian infrastructure in Gelsord causing massive damage. Many militants of the group were armed and fired on police officers resulting in many deaths. A bomb attack on the Gelsord Research Council has led to the death of many scientists. The Gendarmerie has now entered the city and is actively clashing with the group. It is expected that there are several hundred armed members hiding in the urban sprawl.

name: Turn09_Gelsord_RecordFemaleStudents
title: Record Number of Female Students
description: The proportion of female students enrolled in Sordland’s education system is getting closer to half the student body, with more than a million enrolments recorded this academic year being women, the highest share on record in Sordland, according to a report by the Ministry of Education.

name: Turn09_GRACE_CondemnsCSPCaleqabiz
title: Condemnation of CSP's Control of Caleqabiz Base
description: GRACE strongly objects to the CSP's recent occupation of the Caleqabiz Base. This action disrupts the balance of power in the region and undermines regional stability. We urge the CSP to withdraw from the base and engage in constructive dialogue to resolve this issue, maintaining peace and respecting sovereign rights.

name: Turn09_GRACE_GrandDuchyAcceptance
title: Grand Duchy of Pales Becomes Newest GRACE Member
description: GRACE has announced that the Grand Duchy of Pales has joined the alliance, reflecting its growing influence and appeal on the international stage. This expansion enhances GRACE's geopolitical reach and strengthens its collective support for monarchist governance worldwide. Queen Beatrice Livingston of Rumburg remarked, "The addition of Pales signifies a stronger commitment to our shared values and the promotion of monarchy as a stable form of governance."

name: Turn09_GRACE_RemovalOfRizia
title: GRACE Terminates Kingdom of Rizia's Membership
description: GRACE has announced the termination of the Kingdom of Rizia's membership following extensive deliberations. This decision reflects the changing political and strategic priorities within the alliance. GRACE cited Rizia's deviation from the alliance's direction and charter as the primary reason for this move. Queen Beatrice Livingston of Rumburg commented, "This decision ensures that GRACE remains cohesive and true to its core values."

name: Turn09_GrandLibraryUnderRenovation
title: Grand Library Under Renovation for Queen Mother's Birthday
description:
The Grand Library of Porte Drazon, one of Rizia's most revered cultural landmarks, is undergoing extensive renovations in preparation for Queen Mother Estela's upcoming birthday celebration. The library, which has remained closed for over a decade, will be reopened under her name as a symbolic gift to honor her lifelong contributions to Rizia. 

This occasion is set to be a grand affair, with invitations extended to Rizia's three royal houses—Toras, Sazon, and Azaro—who have all confirmed their attendance.

name: Turn09_Havas_MalenyevistTunnelsDiscovered
title: Police Uncover Evidence Of Malenyevist Activities In Lirean Hills
description:
Rizian police forces have uncovered that a large network of old mine shafts, natural caves and other hidden paths inside the luscious Lirean hills, near the Morellan border, has been used by Malenyevists to smuggle and organize activities for years. Aside from an assortment of small arms caches, a printing press and even paper recycling facilities have been found. 

It is likely that the arms used in the recent Montaklar bank robbery originate from here, although authorities worry that the discoveries might only be the tip of the iceberg, as no concrete evidence pointing to the robbery was found.

name: Turn09_Havas_War_InternalDissent_Default
title: Thousands Of Anti War Protesters Block Vital Railway Line
description: Anti war demonstrators have blocked a vital railway line in Havas, leading straight to the Palesian front, for several hours. When trains with fresh recruits passed, the demonstrators stopped the trains and attempted to convince the recruits on board to desert.

name: Turn09_Havas_War_InternalDissent_Disperse
title: Clashes In Havas As Police Disperses Anti War Protest
description: Police forces have cleared an anti war protest in Havas, after protestors attempted to block a vital railway carrying recruits and supplies to Pales. Around thirty people were detained.

name: Turn09_Holsord_AidsElectionCampaign_Tusk
title: Tusk Aids Election Campaign
description: Walter Tusk had made a donation of five million SR to our election campaign. Lotherberg Group also volunteered to help with the election and assured us that their polling experts will aid the campaign crew.

name: Turn09_Holsord_Assassination
title: Interior Opens Investigation into Assassination Attempt
description: With judiciary approval, Minister of Interior has opened an investigation into the recent assassination attempt. Police forces and private detectives have been deployed. Higher security measures have been put in place to avoid any future attempt.

name: Turn09_Holsord_CBRCBReducesDamage
title: Central Bank Changes Greatly Reduce Economic Damages
description:
The synergy of Central Bank Centralization and the Central Bank Act has been remarkably effective in mitigating economic damages. The combination of these two financial mechanisms has amplified the central bank's ability to respond to economic crises, manage inflation, and foster stability. 

This has greatly reduced the impact of recent financial upheavals, providing a much-needed economic safeguard for the nation's residents.

name: Turn09_Holsord_CBRReducesDamage
title: Central Bank Act Mitigates Economic Damages
description: The previous implementation of the Central Bank Act has been instrumental in reducing the economic damages inflicted by recent market volatility. The Act's measures, including tighter regulations and increased financial oversight, have stabilized the local economy, cushioning some of the impact of external and internal economic shocks and protecting consumers.

name: Turn09_Holsord_CentralBank
title: Central Bank Part of Administration
description:
The Central Bank's authority has been officially transferred to the Maroon Palace. As a result, the responsibility for monetary policy now falls directly under your purview, Mr. President. This transition could facilitate more agile and strategic financial decision-making. The economic advisory team in the palace has expressed their support for this restructuring. 

The full impact of this transition on Sordland's fiscal landscape will be continually assessed and reported.

name: Turn09_Holsord_Emergency_Revoked
title: Celebrations After Revocation of Emergency
description:
Today, a large group of people gathered in Soll Square to celebrate the revocation of the state of emergency. The group also called for the revocation of the Soll-era security laws.

The Mayor of Holsord reported that the event transformed into festivities with music playing all around the city. He said that the group was peaceful and nothing out of the ordinary took place.

name: Turn09_Holsord_GeneralStaffReport
title: General Staff Report
description: With the experienced General Staff purged, their new counterpart is taking up where they left off. The new staff is reorganizing and improving our defensive strategies against Rumburg. Their lack of field experience seems to be showing.

name: Turn09_Holsord_HOSResearchPOHigh
title: High Public Opinion
description:
The recent poll conducted by the Heart of Sordland Research Group reflects a high public approval rating, with 59% of respondents voicing satisfaction with the current administration and its policies. This broad support paints a favorable picture for the incumbent in the next electoral contest.

*The sample group was picked by HOS researchers

name: Turn09_Holsord_HOSResearchPOLow
title: Low Public Opinion
description:
According to the latest polling data from the Heart of Sordland Research Group, public approval for the incumbent administration sits at a low 35%. The significant portion of respondents expressing dissatisfaction indicates a challenging scenario for the current administration in the upcoming election.

*The sample group was picked by HOS researchers

name: Turn09_Holsord_HOSResearchPOMedium
title: Average Public Opinion
description:
The Heart of Sordland Research Group's most recent poll exhibits an average level of public approval for the current administration. With 50% of respondents expressing satisfaction and an equal proportion voicing concerns, the public sentiment appears mixed. This balanced opinion signals a competitive landscape for the upcoming election.

*The sample group was picked by HOS researchers

name: Turn09_Holsord_HOSResearchPOVeryHigh
title: Very High Public Opinion
description:
The Heart of Sordland Research Group's latest poll reveals very high public approval for the current administration, with 73% of respondents expressing strong support. The administration's policies and leadership have struck a chord with the majority of the populace, suggesting a strong position ahead of the upcoming election.

*The sample group was picked by HOS researchers

name: Turn09_Holsord_HOSResearchPOVeryLow
title: Very Low Public Opinion
description:
Our latest poll, conducted by the Heart of Sordland Research Group, reveals a very low level of public approval for the current administration. With a mere 20% of respondents expressing support, and the overwhelming majority voicing strong disapproval, the upcoming election appears to be a steep uphill battle for the incumbent.

*The sample group was picked by HOS researchers

name: Turn09_Holsord_InvestmentSynergyHigh
title: High Investment Synergy Achieved
description: Investments across multiple sectors are demonstrating high levels of synergy, leading to impressive economic growth. The well-coordinated infusion of capital into sectors in different ways has resulted in significant advancements and a boost in productivity. This efficient allocation of resources is driving economic success and setting a strong foundation for future prosperity.

name: Turn09_Holsord_InvestmentSynergyLow
title: Low Investment Synergy Reported
description: The synergy between investments across sectors remains limited, with misaligned and uncoordinated strategies resulting in suboptimal outcomes and slower economic progress. This situation points to the necessity of adopting a more integrated and strategic investment approach to unlock their full potential.

name: Turn09_Holsord_InvestmentSynergyMedium
title: Medium Investment Synergy Observed
description: A moderate level of investment synergy is being observed across several sectors. Investments are generally aligning well and contributing to steady economic progress. While some areas could benefit from improved coordination, overall, the positive interplay between various investments is supporting consistent economic growth.

name: Turn09_Holsord_LowStability
title: Country Stability Decreased
description:
The Ministry of Interior has reported that Sordland is suffering from low stability due to the amount of active crisis the country is facing.

Different elements of government and structures of order are operating past their operational limits. This situation adversely influences further economic growth.

name: Turn09_Holsord_MurderInvestigation
title: UC Ambassador Murder Investigation
description:
Investigations into the assassination of Ambassador Mazovtl found evidence that the assassin, Arnold Symon Nerder had ties to various organizations, each having their own ties with the Old Guard.

A.S.N. was discovered to have served as a policeman in Arvory and Holsord before retiring and joining the Nurist Cultural Foundation.

name: Turn09_Holsord_NFP_LuderinSon_Holstron
title: NFP Welcomes General Luderin’s Son
description: The new leadership of the National Front Party has under Remus Holstron welcomed General Luderin’s son into their midst today in Holsord. Seeing a Luderin back in politics is shocking to many citizens. General Luderin infamously organized the military coup against former President Wisci, that led to the Sordish Civil War. The new NFP leader had a close relationship with General Luderin himself during the war, so it is not surprising that he would be the one to invite Luderin’s son into the party.

name: Turn09_Holsord_NFP_LuderinSon_Kibener
title: NFP Welcomes General Luderin’s Son
description: The National Front Party has welcomed General Luderin’s son into their midst today in Holsord. Seeing a Luderin back in politics is shocking to many citizens. General Luderin infamously organized the military coup against former President Wisci, that led to the Sordish Civil War. Mr. Kibener has organized the event to appeal to his voter base. This is a symbolic step for the NFP, as Luderin was arguably the most well-known nationalist in Sordland.

name: Turn09_Holsord_Parade
title: Parade Report
description: Iosef Lancea reported that the military personnel who were involved with the parade’s organization and security checks have been put under custody until further notice.

name: Turn09_Holsord_PeacefulUnrest_MarchGovDistrict
title: Peaceful March in Holsord Government District
description:
40.000 march peacefully through the Holsord Government district to display their opposition to the government. The march is being watched by civilian and local police units to ensure safety and order. Sounds of the massive march echoed through each Ministry. Politicians couldn't access their workplaces due to blocked roads.

The situation is being monitored and if the march turns violent a large riot police group is waiting on standby to intervene in order to protect government property including the Maroon Palace.

name: Turn09_Holsord_Petr_Missing
title: Petr Vectern Nowhere To Be Found
description: Evelyn Vectern had notified us about Petr Vectern not being able to be reached at Holsord Police Department and sparing no efforts in looking for him. According to the initial report, he couldn’t be found in any of his properties in Sordland, and he was last seen traveling to Erlory.

name: Turn09_Holsord_PoliticalOrgs_YSAgainstProtest
title: Young Sords Force Protestors Out
description:
Young Sords members have marched against the protestors in Holsord and intimidated thousands through beatings and acts of violence. The efforts alleviate the pressure on the police units which are already extended. Even though the Young Sords members are acting harshly they have yet to turn their behavior on our forces.

A massive Young Sords march with torches has attracted 12000 people followed by a massive clash in which the group has attacked a 5000 rioter group headed for the palace. Some Young Sords are camping at the Hill of Pride and waving Sordish flags.

name: Turn09_Holsord_SollTrial
title: Date Set For Soll’s Trial
description:
After months of investigations and hearings, the preparations for Tarquin Soll’s trial have been completed and the Supreme Court has announced the date of the trial as next Tuesday.

The Supreme Court will deliver its verdict about Tarquin Soll’s involvement in “crimes against Sordish citizens, corruption, murder and unconstitutional behavior.”

name: Turn09_Holsord_UC_AmbassadorKilled
title: United Contanan Ambassador Killed
description:
Ambassador Mazovtl, the United Contanan ambassador to Sordland, was murdered in Kafe Holsord. He was shot in the head by a Mungam pistol.

The attacker was killed immediately after the attack.

name: Turn09_Holsord_Unrest_BFF_BronDiplomatic
title: Delegates Return from Soll Dam
description:
Delegates sent to Soll Dam have returned to Holsord after their meeting with the BFF rebels occupying the energy facilities. Governor of Bergia, Phelix Bron has been released from his captivity.

Leader of the delegates, Mansoun Leke will be arriving at Maroon Palace to discuss the results of the meeting with the president. He will be provisioned with a guest level security clearance immediately upon arrival at the Maroon Palace.

name: Turn09_Holsord_Unrest_BFF_Diplomatic_Promise
title: Bill Failed at the Assembly
description: The bill that was proposed according to the demands of the BFF failed to gather a majority in the Grand National Assembly. The majority of the MP’s condemned the administration for trying to make a deal with separatists and declared that any dealing with the group will be blocked by the Assembly.

name: Turn09_Holsord_Unrest_BFF_KrullDiplomatic
title: Delegates Return from Soll Dam
description:
Delegates sent to Soll Dam have returned to Holsord after their meeting with the BFF rebels occupying the energy facilities. Governor of Bergia, Herbert Krull has been released from his captivity.

Leader of the delegates, Mansoun Leke will be arriving at Maroon Palace to discuss the results of the meeting with the president. He will be provisioned with a guest level security clearance immediately upon arrival at the Maroon Palace.

name: Turn09_Holsord_Unrest_Peaceful_Diplomatic_Katarina
title: Katarina Horten’s Invitation to the Maroon Palace
description:
The de facto leader of the protests, Katarina Horten has been invited to the palace as the spokesperson at the request of the president. She will be provisioned with a guest level security clearance immediately upon arrival at the Maroon Palace.

Mrs. Horten will be searched thoroughly and two guards will be assigned to her at all times for the security of the president during the talks.

name: Turn09_Holsord_Unrest_Violent_Police_Successful
title: Simultaneous Raids Points to Rumburg Involvement
description:
Police forces have raided tagged buildings that were confirmed to be housing militants with a simultaneous attack. As a result, multiple weapons caches have been destroyed. During one of the raids, evidence was found to point to a Rumburgian connection.

Further investigations are underway.

name: Turn09_Holsord_USPMechanismSlows
title: USP Obstruction Intensifies, Government Nearing Standstill
description:
The obstructionist tactics of the United Sordland Party have become more pervasive, pushing the country's administration towards a near halt. As time passes, the incessant resistance from the USP is resulting in prolonged delays in policy implementation and significant hold-ups in proposed projects. 

This escalation of obstructionism is causing growing concerns about the future of efficient governance and public services in Sordland.

name: Turn09_Holsord_War_MilitaryMobilized
title: Military Mobilized
description: The General Staff reports that all armies stationed across Sordland have been mobilized and are preparing for the invasion.

name: Turn09_Holsord_WPB_CPS_InTalks
title: WPB-CPS Having Talks
description: According to reports from the capital, the leaders of the Workers Party of Bludia and the Communist Party of Sordland held a meeting together. The leaders were suspected to have talked about entering an alliance before the elections to pass the election threshold.

name: Turn09_Holsord_WPB_Leader_New_Mansoun
title: Mansoun Becomes New WPB Leader
description: In a public statement, WPB headquarters announced that Mansoun Leke was invited back to the party and was elected as the new leader of the WPB. They stated that WPB will not pull back from the race and will continue with Leke as their presidential candidate.

name: Turn09_Holsord_WPB_Leader_ReturnToFill_Mansoun
title: Mansoun Might Return To WPB To Fill Ejall’s Role
description:
According to reports from the capital, due to the serious condition of Ejall, the leadership of the Workers Party of Bludia held an emergency meeting in their party headquarters in Holsord to appoint a new leader as their presidential candidate.

After the meeting, the party invited Mansoun Leke to their headquarters.

name: Turn09_Iza_Decision_NationalDestabilizationTwo
title: Order Breaks Down As Street Battles Erupt
description: Protests against the Monarchy have turned violent in Iza, with the city authorities unable to maintain any semblance of orders. Street battles have erupted between anti-monarchy demonstrators and ultranationalist Su Omina, resulting in multiple casualties. Smoke is constantly rising from the city center, as buildings routinely are set ablaze.

name: Turn09_Iza_War_InternalDissent_Default
title: Half A Million Protest War In Iza
description: Half a million Rizians turned out for a large anti-war demonstration in Iza, demanding an immediate end to hostilities and a safe return home for all soldiers serving at the frontlines.

name: Turn09_Iza_War_InternalDissent_Disperse
title: Police Charge Anti War Protest
description: Mounted police officers, dispatched on our orders, have charged into a large peaceful anti war demonstration in Iza. Several injuries were reported, but the crowds swiftly dispersed after the intervention, with calmth restored by the early evening.

name: Turn09_Jen_AidsElectionCampaign_YS
title: Young Sords Aids Election Campaign
description:
Young Sords members in Jen volunteered to aid the election campaign and started to work directly with the campaign advisors and the local party office.

Their help is expected to result in a significant boost in votes from Central Sordland.

name: Turn09_Jen_BFFUnrest_NFPAmbushed
title: NFP Party Gathering Ambushed by BFF
description:
A top party leadership gathering of the strongest NFP branch was ambushed by the BFF with an FPG-3 rocket launcher attack. A dozen party officials lost their lives and two NFP MP's were heavily injured. The armed police force arrived at the scene several minutes after the attack was reported and couldn't find the BFF rebels which are suspected to have fled towards Bergia. The Gendarmerie squads nearby have been dispatched to the rural areas to find the attackers.

The party office was partially destroyed and citizens are urged to stay at home. NFP party leadership condemned the attack and called for a Sordish state ridden of these traitors.

name: Turn09_Jen_Desollinisation
title: De-Sollinisation Progress
description: We are putting an end to all propaganda stories about Tarquin Soll across all schools and universities in Jen. Soll's pictures have also been confiscated with heavy resistance from the citizens, requiring drastic measures to be enacted.

name: Turn09_Jen_ElectionVote_Gloria_ConservativeVotes
title: Vice President Tory Drawing Conservatives
description: A  large majority of conservatives have been scared off due to our reformist agenda. However, our Vice President, Gloria Tory, has been hosting rallies trying to sway the conservative USP voters to our side.

name: Turn09_Jen_Emergency_Revoked
title: Jen Citizens Decry Revocation of Emergency
description: At a city council meeting in Jen, citizens voiced their discontent at the lifting of Sordland’s state of emergency. Many claimed the increased police presence had made them feel safer, and that they now felt more vulnerable to encroaching threats. Council members vowed to hire and deploy more police officers within the city.

name: Turn09_Jen_Unrest_PoliceAmbushed
title: Disguised Rebels Ambush Police Officers
description: Armed revolters have disguised themselves as construction workers and attacked several police officers with weapons that led to several deaths in broad daylight. The police responded immediately but several casualties were sustained. More citizens began fighting against the police in the streets of Jen causing the city to collapse into chaos. The police retreated back to their headquarters and kept engaging the rebellious protestors.

name: Turn09_Kyrute_CondemnsMediaCensorship
title: Kyrute Condemns Sordish Media Censorship
description: The government of Kyrute condemns the recent actions taken by the State Council of Radio & Television in Sordland, regarding it as a form of media censorship. Freedom of expression and press are cornerstones of democratic societies and Kyrute urges Sordland to uphold these fundamental rights.

name: Turn09_Kyrute_Decision_LeaveAllianceOfNations_Leave
title: Kyrute Urges Us To Return To AN
description: Kyrute, the seat of the Alliance of Nations, has urged our country to rethink its decision to leave the organization. The island republic says that while “AN resolutions must be respected”, there’s still common ground to be found.

name: Turn09_Lachaven_BFFUnrest_PoliceAcademy
title: Deadly Attack at Graduation Ceremony
description:
Lachaven police chief has reported a heinous attack on new police academy graduates conducted by the BFF. During broad daylight, the armed rebels have gunned down 29 graduates with their KA-74's. The attackers were later killed in a gunfight with a Gendarmerie attachment while trying to escape from Republic Avenue.

The mayor of Lachaven has announced a day of mourning to the young graduates that wanted to keep Sordland's streets a little safer.

name: Turn09_Lachaven_CapitalFlight
title: Partial Lotherberg Capital Withdrawals Hit
description:
Dozens of well-connected businesspeople tied to the Lotherberg group have pulled a massive amount of financial resources out of the country which has damaged the economy to a degree.

Government reserves are being injected to maintain stability to fill the gap left by the massive private sector withdrawal. The Lotherberg group released a general statement regarding the will to diversify their investments and reduce their risk in Sordland.

name: Turn09_Lachaven_CentralBankSoftensBlow
title: Central Bank Interventions Mitigate Economic Strains
description:
In Lachaven, the Central Bank's active interventions are helping soften the impact of economic uncertainties. Through its nimble monetary policies and robust fiscal measures, the bank has effectively managed to dampen volatility and ease market concerns. These strategic moves have stimulated domestic investment and consumption, contributing to a more stable economic landscape. 

While economic challenges persist, the Central Bank's efforts are crucial in ensuring the city and its citizens navigate these challenging times more comfortably.

name: Turn09_Lachaven_DebtCrisis
title: Debt Crisis Shocks the Economy
description:
The Central Bank and the Ministry of Economy are tackling the extensive damages caused by the debt crisis and the subsequent credit rating downgrade of Sordland.

Both entities are resorting to all sorts of currency and economic control measures to stabilize the volatility triggered by the events.

name: Turn09_Lachaven_FairTrade
title: Fair Trade Commission Creates Trade Regulation
description: The Fair Trade Commission has begun work in assessing the existing trade irregularities and unfairness. The first act of the commission will be to create new trade regulations to balance import and export differences to ensure local competition can remain strong.

name: Turn09_Lachaven_Kyrute_Interview
title: One-On-One Interview From Kyrute
description:
Lucian Galade organized an interview for the presidency on the internationally renowned One-On-One. The famous journalist Tuomas Sacker will be asking the questions.

The crew of “One-On-One” and Tuomas Sacker will arrive next week in Lachaven from Kyrute.

name: Turn09_Lachaven_MediaCensored_SCRT
title: Supreme Council of Radio and TV Bans Content
description: Supreme Council of Sordish Radio and Television announced a ban on HOSTV’s talk show program “Sweaty Talk,” and the comedy show “Gotta Live With It,” for making dangerous anti-government propaganda and inciting conflict within society.

name: Turn09_Lachaven_PeacefulUnrest_MarchRepublic
title: People for Justice March in Republic Avenue
description:
100.000 March through Republic Avenue in a display of civil disobedience and solidarity. Lachaven's coastline and downtown was flooded by people that came all around Nargis and Agnland to display their unhappiness. Local security forces are ensuring that the situation remains calm and safe for everyone. Dozens of civilian police units are within the march and observing the situation from the inside.

The mayor of Lachaven has ensured a peaceful display of democratic privileges and warned that any provocateurs will be dealt with immediately.

name: Turn09_Lachaven_PFJP_NewSlogan_Ricter
title: PFJP Ricter's Slogan: Victory for Everyone
description: As the 1957 election starts to approach, Frens Ricter and The People’s Freedom and Justice Party are making waves in Lachaven. Their campaign slogan “Victory for Everyone” covered the city after a campaign visit to the city. The PFJP has been the United Sordland Party’s major opposition since their formation, each year earning a higher percentage of votes.

name: Turn09_Lachaven_PFJP_NewSlogan_Suheil
title: PFJP Suheil's Slogan: Victory for Everyone
description:
Ricter is gone. Suheil is Party Lead.

As the 1957 election starts to approach, new leader Manoly Suheil and The People’s Freedom and Justice Party are making waves in Lachaven. Their campaign slogan “Victory for Everyone” covered the city after a campaign visit to the city. The PFJP has been the United Sordland Party’s major opposition since their formation, each year earning a higher percentage of votes.

name: Turn09_Lachaven_PoliticalOrgs_RYHelpsPolice
title: Police Receive Support from Red Youth
description:
Two thousand Red Youth members attached to local police units overseeing the massive riots occurring around Lachaven. The RY ensured that peace was kept and supported by the overwhelmed units at certain parts of the city. The help was welcomed by the Lachaven police that praised that the org members have been peaceful and shared information about the movements of the other protests.

Local leaders of the Red Youth pledged that Lachaven won't be destroyed by violent rioters and ensured that they will do anything that is necessary that freedom of speech and the security of the city is maintained with the police forces.

name: Turn09_Lachaven_PublicOpinion_Good
title: Well-Received PR Visit
description: Following a brief visit to Lachaven, the president spent the afternoon meeting and taking photos with jubilant citizens at Republic Avenue. The enthusiasm displayed was not unexpected, it was clear the citizens were delighted to witness their popular president in person.

name: Turn09_Lachaven_PublicOpinion_Low
title: Controversial PR Visit
description: Following a brief visit to Lachaven, there has been an outcry against the unpopular president, with violent protests feared to be imminent. The city is deeply unhappy with the president’s term, and there have already been some calls for Rayne’s resignation.

name: Turn09_Lachaven_PublicOpinion_Medium
title: Lukewarm PR Visit
description: Following a brief visit to Lachaven, the president spent the afternoon meeting local citizens at Republic Avenue. Some Sords chose to voice their disapproval of the administration, but President Rayne handled the dissenting voices well, earning further loyalty from his base supporters.

name: Turn09_Lachaven_SollDam_Explosion4
title: Power Outages in Nargis
description:
The suburbs of Lachaven went dark today after the transformers broke down. The events that transpired at the Soll Dam caused Sordland to lose 30% of its electricity. The Sordish Grid Corporation's central electrical station in Lachaven immediately reacted by requesting surplus electricity from neighboring countries.

Lachaveners were told to reduce their consumption by half as solutions are to come.

name: Turn09_Lachaven_SordishNavyDrill
title: Sordish Navy Conducts Drills Amid Rising Tensions
description: The Sordish Navy in Lachaven has commenced a series of military drills in response to rising regional tensions. These exercises aim to evaluate the navy's preparedness to address potential threats and to ensure maritime security in the area. The drills also underscore Sordland's dedication to preserving peace and stability within its territorial waters.

name: Turn09_Lachaven_TourismHitByInstability
title: Instability Severely Affects Tourism Industry
description: The tourism industry in Lachaven has been dealt a heavy blow due to increasing regional instability. Visits to the city have sharply declined as tourists opt for safer destinations. The downturn in tourist numbers has led to considerable losses for local businesses and threatens the city's standing as a major tourist hub in Sordland.

name: Turn09_Lachaven_TradeTariffsHurt
title: Trade Tariffs Disrupt Port and Marine Commerce
description: Recent trade tariffs have adversely impacted ship commerce and overall marine trade in Lachaven. The increased costs of importing and exporting goods have resulted in fewer shipments passing through the city's port, causing a significant slowdown in trade activities. The economic ripple effects of this disruption are being felt by businesses throughout the city.

name: Turn09_Lachaven_Unrest_BlueMansion
title: Protesters Occupy Blue Mansion & City Hall
description:
The Blue Mansion was taken over by violent protests that overwhelmed civil servants and state staff. Many were beaten and the property was heavily damaged. The massive protests also took over city hall and vandalized government property. Riot police tried to disperse the crowds which resulted in a massive clash with hundreds of wounded people. Fires burned and smoke billowed into the night. Firefighters were working hard to prevent a mass fire.

The city was in utter chaos after the event and the mass protests seem to be ever-growing. More reinforcements of riot police have been called to the city to help.

name: Turn09_Lenkurg_Agnland_Economy_Bad
title: Tons of Salmon Left Rotting In Storage
description: The Mayor of Lenkurg requests financial aid for the city to slow down the economic crash which was triggered by a massive decrease in fish exports. The city is reported to have a problem in finding new customers. Tons of Salmon are left to rot on a daily basis which caused many fishermen to move away from the city.

name: Turn09_Lenkurg_Agnland_Economy_Good
title: Competitor to All East Merkopan Fishing Exporters
description: Citizens of Lenkurg expressed their gratitude for the new investments and policies that led to the increased development of the region. Recent data indicates that the fish exports have quadrupled since we took office and that new industries began to flourish. Not only did the city become the main competitor to all fish exporters in the region but also began to house a tourism hub in Agnland.

name: Turn09_Lenkurg_Agnland_Economy_Stablising
title: Lenkurg Depends on Fish Exports to Grow
description: Lenkurgs dock reported fishing revenues to increase by 30%. Business owners and fisheries commended the administrative push to strengthen the economy. Lenkurg and Agnland's problems are not yet solved however as analysis shows the city is barely recovering to pre-recession levels of economic activity.

name: Turn09_Lespia_BorderDeployment
title: Lespia Deploys Military to Sordish Border
description:
It is being reported that Lespian Armed Forces have increased their presence along our southern border with Lespia. New border guards and infantry divisions have been transferred close to the border.

According to our intelligence, Lespians are also installing defense systems with offensive capabilities. This poses a great danger for Holsord, and the whole country.

name: Turn09_Lespia_Decision_NationalDestabilization_Violence
title: Lespia Condemns Our Crackdown
description: Lespia’s Patricio Alvarez has condemned our violent crackdown on protesters.

name: Turn09_Lespia_RavnosIslandDefconTwo
title: Lespia Raises Alert Level Over Ravnos Island
description:
In response to the recent escalation in Heljiland, Prime Minister Patricio Alvarez announced that Lespia is transitioning to DEFCON 2. The declaration reflects a heightened state of readiness and underscores Lespia's concern about the potential spillover of regional conflict. Alvarez emphasized the nation's focus on safeguarding its security while expressing hope for a peaceful resolution.

He urged the Alliance of Nations to take prompt and decisive action to de-escalate the situation.

name: Turn09_MaveNortus_SmolakCall_WehlenJoinsWar
title: Columns Of Tanks Enter From Zille
description: Columns of Wehzek tanks, destined to help our forces at the Palesian front, have driven through Mave Nortus. Local residents were initially worried, thinking an invasion was underway, but have realized ever since Smolak’s announcement that the incursion is a friendly one, with permission of the Rizian King.

name: Turn09_Monqiz_Decision_NationalDestabilizationOne
title: Rioting Targets Entertainment District
description: Multiple casinos, high end restaurants and wellness resorts have been damaged in rioting against our government in Monqiz. After the rioters were dispersed from Palas Toras, their initial target, the angry mob turned to the entertainment district as a symbol of wealth and inequality.

name: Turn09_Monqiz_RailwayReentersOperations
title: Porte Drazon-Monqiz Railroad Reopens
description: The railroad connecting Rizia’s biggest port with its capital city has finally reentered operations, after falling into disrepair earlier into King Romus’ reign due to chronic underinvestment. Rizians living between the two cities rejoice as finally they are reconnected to the wider country again.

name: Turn09_Monqiz_SordishPolioArrives
title: Several Polio Deaths Reported
description: Monqiz is struggling with an emerging polio epidemic, as Sordish tourists appear to have brought the deadly disease to Rizia. Already, several deaths have been reported, as authorities rush to avoid the outbreak spreading to other parts of the countries.

name: Turn09_Morbel_Lorren_Economy_Bad
title: Morbel Soon To Be A Ghost Town
description: The Mayor of Morbel requests financial aid for the city to combat the increased emigration. He reported that the city will be a ghost town in a few years if no measures are taken. The lack of goods and materials flowing from Morna and Holsord is the main contributing factor of the city's economic downturn.

name: Turn09_Morbel_Lorren_Economy_Good
title: Trade and Commerce Propel Morbel and Lorren Region
description:
The Mayor of Morbel reported that the city saw thrice the economic growth that was expected. Based on the delivered reports, businesses are competing to open their shops open in the city. We can expect the city to grow into an industrial and commercial hub in the future.

The positive upswing is credited to the huge amount of goods and materials flowing through the city from Morna to Holsord.

name: Turn09_Morbel_Lorren_Economy_Stablising
title: Economic Improvements Felt in Morbel
description:
The city of Morbel reported economic growth to increase by 10%. Locals praised the central government's efforts in reviving Lorren. However, the economic potential of the city isn't fully realized.

The flow of goods and materials between Holsord and Morna is one of the main factors keeping the local economy afloat.

name: Turn09_Morbel_Unrest_Roadblocks
title: Thousands of Violent Protesters Setup Roadblocks
description: Thousands of protestors have set up roadblocks at the exits and entrances of Morbel blocking traffic into the city. Riot police have been dispatched but couldn't stop the violent protesters that have been smashing cars and intimidating all citizens trying to access the city. The police chief said that the force is losing control of the situation and pleaded for help.

name: Turn09_Morella_CongratulatesCSPJoin
title: Morella Celebrates Sordland Joining CSP
description: Following Sordland's decision to join the superpower alliance of Malenyevist nations, the CSP, Prime Minister Alma Saltana expressed jubilation at this pivotal development. She commended Sordland for aligning itself with nations striving for social equity and lauded this as a milestone in regional politics. Morella, currently a CSP candidate, views this as a positive sign of the growing influence of Malenyevist ideology in Merkopa.

name: Turn09_Morella_Decision_NationalDestabilization_Violence
title: Morella Condemns Our Crackdown
description: Morella’s PM Alma Saltana has condemned our violent crackdown on protesters.

name: Turn09_Morella_IntermerkopumAcceptance
title: Morella To Join Regional Alliance Talks
description: Prime Minister Alma Saltana has accepted our invitation to join talks for a South Merkopan alliance. She will be present at the upcoming roundtable in Porte Drazon.

name: Turn09_Morella_IntermerkopumRefusal
title: Morella Backs Out Of Regional Alliance Talks
description: Prime Minister Alma Saltana has refused our invitation to join talks for a South Merkopan alliance, citing fundamental disagreements with Rizia as well as the other potential partners.

name: Turn09_Morna_Campaign_CPS
title: CPS Huge Campaign
description: The Communist Party of Sordland has organized a large campaign push in the city of Morna as the next election looms in the distance. There has been an increase of support for communism, and some anti-communist groups fear the next election the CPS may earn enough votes to enter the Grand National Assembly.

name: Turn09_Morna_InvestmentSynergyHigh
title: High Investment Synergy Achieved
description: Investments across multiple sectors are demonstrating high levels of synergy, leading to impressive economic growth. The well-coordinated infusion of capital into sectors in different ways has resulted in significant advancements and a boost in productivity. This efficient allocation of resources is driving economic success and setting a strong foundation for future prosperity.

name: Turn09_Morna_InvestmentSynergyLow
title: Low Investment Synergy Reported
description: The synergy between investments across sectors remains limited, with misaligned and uncoordinated strategies resulting in suboptimal outcomes and slower economic progress. This situation points to the necessity of adopting a more integrated and strategic investment approach to unlock their full potential.

name: Turn09_Morna_InvestmentSynergyMedium
title: Medium Investment Synergy Observed
description: A moderate level of investment synergy is being observed across several sectors. Investments are generally aligning well and contributing to steady economic progress. While some areas could benefit from improved coordination, overall, the positive interplay between various investments is supporting consistent economic growth.

name: Turn09_Morna_SeaPortOpens
title: Sea Port Opens
description: The Morna Sea Port has opened to international sea traffic. Sordish ships are now traveling to 40 destinations worldwide and offer cheap sea travel from distant continents like Rika and Xina. The disconnected Lorren region is set to benefit from the influx of goods and people. More jobs have been created as a result of the port activity.

name: Turn09_Morna_UnrestMilitary_BrigadierExecution
title: Brigadier Orders Immediate Execution of Rebels
description:
Brigadier Dalrin has successfully brought down a massive revolt in Morna last week and arrested 2341 rebels that actively fought against security units. While fighting in the outskirts is still ongoing most of the resistance to the military has died down after the bloody clashes of last week. The Brigadier announced that no mercy be shown to the traitors of Sordland and declared the immediate execution of them.

Tomorrow all 2341 will be executed by firing squad as a message to any further rebel sentiment in the country.

name: Turn09_Nanta_DiscardedBallotsDiscovered
title: Thousands Of Discarded Ballots Found
description: A few ballot boxes, containing thousands of votes from Rizian majority areas of Nanta, have been found in a field outside the city. While the previous administration of the town has rapidly evacuated to Wehlen, thus evading responsibility, evidence points at a deliberate attempt to rig the vote.

name: Turn09_Nanta_StreetFestival
title: Zille Unity Street Festival A Success
description: A hastily organized street festival, celebrating the unity of Rizian and Wehzeks living in Nanta, filled the streets of the city with life over the past two days. The festival celebrated the return of Zille to Rizia, while at the same celebrating Wehzek life in the city and focused on promoting intercultural dialogue.

name: Turn09_Narbel_Unrest_CompanyTakeover
title: Gasom Facilities Occupied by Rioters
description:
Hundreds of rioters descended upon the natural gas facilities of Gasom in a bid to take over the private property. Police tried to stop the 3000-strong group and managed to crowd control some of them while others have entered the private facilities and taken over some of the buildings.

More police units have arrived and began sieging the occupiers of the offices. After a week of a standoff in which the occupiers swelled in numbers a massive clash resulted in the destruction of the facility and the death of 18 people including 4 police officers.

name: Turn09_Narbel_Unrest_Violent_Police_Unsuccessful
title: Police Overwhelmed in Remote Cities
description:
Since the deployment of the police forces to combat the unrest, many attacks have occurred in remote cities. Ambushes are rampant and the security forces are being pushed back. Police stations and patrols were the main targets of the militants.

Unless reinforcements are provided, the current forces are not enough to control the situation.

name: Turn09_Nelvisar_Decision_NationalDestabilization_AutonomyPersists
title: Nelvisar Commune Persists
description: Despite our promises, the self-declared commune of Nelvisar has announced that it will continue existing, ousting local nobles from their position of power. However, the former oil workers leading the effort have announced the town will continue to pay taxes to Rizia, as long as they are left alone to do as they please.

name: Turn09_Nelvisar_Decision_NationalDestabilizationTwo
title: Former Oil Workers Declare Autonomous Town
description: The former workers of the now-shut Nelvisar oil field, having stayed organized thanks to the yearly galas in their honor, have seized control over the Nelvisar town hall and declared Nelvisar an autonomous commune where no government forces are welcome.

name: Turn09_Nelvisar_WorshippersMarchOnCapital3_Autonomy
title: Nelvisar Autonomous Town Attempts To Stop Worshippers
description:
Heavy fighting broke out in Nelvisar, after the religious march on the capital reached the now-autonomous commune. The oil workers, opposed to many of the religious ideas put forward by the worshippers, attempted to prevent them from passing through the town.

After gunfire was exchanged and multiple casualties were reported, the march on the capital decided to pass by Nelvisar instead of going through it, so as to not risk any more delay.

name: Turn09_Nelvisar_WorshippersMarchOnCapital3_Regular
title: Former Oil Workers Join Religious March
description: The small town of Nelvisar, home to a significant community of former oil field workers, has been reached by the religious march on the capital. There, after previous attempts by the oil workers to organize into a commune were prevented by the state, many of them joined the procession, feeling disillusioned with other alternatives.

name: Turn09_Pales_Decision_Unification_Reject
title: Pales Baffled At Unification Rejection
description: Palesian Duke Reinhart has expressed disbelief after we turned down his proposal for reunification, saying “I simply don’t understand why King Romus worked so hard to bring our countries closer together, only to back out at the last minute”.

name: Turn09_Pales_Decision_War_PalesInfrastructureCollapse_Aid
title: Pales Calls Aid “Insult To Injury”
description: The Palesian government has called plans to deliver humanitarian aid to its civilians an insult, saying that instead of lobbying for aid, the international community should support an immediate ceasefire and an end of air strikes on civilian infrastructure.

name: Turn09_Pales_IntermerkopumAcceptance
title: Pales To Join Regional Alliance Talks
description: Duke Axel Reinhart has accepted our invitation to join talks for a South Merkopan alliance. He will be present at the upcoming roundtable in Porte Drazon.

name: Turn09_Pales_IntermerkopumRefusal
title: Pales Backs Out Of Regional Alliance Talks
description: Duke Axel Reinhart has refused our invitation to join talks for a South Merkopan alliance, citing lingering mistrust between Rizia and the Grand Duchy.

name: Turn09_Pipeline_NatDes_TombVandalized
title: Late King’s Tomb Vandalized
description: The National Mausoleum was vandalized overnight, with the late King’s tomb defaced. Authorities suspect political motives as investigations into the perpetrators are underway.

name: Turn09_Plavo_GuardiansPreventUnrestMassPrayer
title: Wruhec’s Guardians Maintain Peace At Mass Prayer
description: The newly formed Wruhec’s Guardians have ensured the mass prayer, which drew tens of thousands of worshippers to the city of Plavo, went smoothly. The Guardians managed to manage the crowds, avoiding any incidents or stampedes.

name: Turn09_Plavo_MassPrayer
title: Tens Of Thousands Of Worshippers Expected
description: Wruhecist communities across the country have called upon their members to attend a planned mass prayer at the Plavo sanctuary. The prayer, although religious in nature, is also expected to address political issues.

name: Turn09_Plavo_WorshippersMarchOnCapital1
title: Worshippers To March On Capital
description: In the aftermath of the mass prayer, the worshippers, who are still in Plavo, called upon more people unhappy with our rule to join them. The organization is intending to set off on a march to Porte Drazon itself, in order to demonstrate the strength of the Wruhecist community and demand political change.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_Decision_NationalDestabilization_Default
title: Largest Demonstration In Rizian History
description: Nearly three and a half million people marched in Porte Drazon against our reign, making it the largest ever demonstration in Rizian history.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_Decision_NationalDestabilizationOne
title: Millions Take To The Streets
description: The streets of Porte Drazon flooded with angry protestors, angry at our government’s policies. While demands varied, one thing is clear for the majority: the King has to go. With organizers claiming over two million participants, and the Rizia Imperii police unable to contest that number, these protests are the largest in Rizian history.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_Decision_NationalDestabilizationOne_CurfewDefied
title: Hundreds of Thousands Defy Curfew At Mass Protest
description: Despite the curfew, hundreds of thousands have turned out in Porte Drazon to voice their dissatisfaction with the King, calling for his resignation. The demonstration was held at night, starting an hour before the curfew came into effect. While arrests were made on the fringes of the demonstration, Rizia Imperii police quickly realized they would be unable to stop the giant mass of people, and decided to back off.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_Decision_NationalDestabilizationOne_MilitaryKills
title: 36 Killed As Military Opens Fire
description: Military forces stationed to maintain order and prevent mass mobilisations against our reign, have opened fire on a protest. At least 36 people were killed, with scores more injured. Organizers of the anti-king demonstrators have already said they will continue and not let the ‘martyrs’ death be in vain.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_Decision_NationalDestabilizationOne_ProtestsContinue
title: Protests Continue Despite King’s Promises
description: Porte Drazon saw another mass demonstration, with once more over two million people flooding the streets of the capital to demand the abdication of the King. It would appear our attempt to appease the demonstrators with concessions has failed.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_Decision_NationalDestabilizationOne_SecurityKills
title: 12 Killed As Security Forces Open Fire
description: Security Forces forces stationed to maintain order and prevent mass mobilisations against our reign, have opened fire on a protest. At least 12 people were killed, with scores more injured. Organizers of the anti-king demonstrators have already said they will continue and not let the ‘martyrs’ death be in vain.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_Decision_NationalDestabilization_Promises
title: Largest Demonstration In Rizian History
description: Nearly three and a half million people marched in Porte Drazon against our reign, making it the largest demonstration in Rizian history. Survey work among the participants of the demonstration have identified some sympathy for the promises we made, although many remain skeptical.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_Decision_NationalDestabilizationTwo
title: Authorities Prepare For Another Mass Demonstration
description: Authorities in the capital are scrambling to organize a response to yet another mass demonstration against the Monarchy that is to take place there in the coming days. With protesters expected to arrive from all over the country, this could be the biggest one yet.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_Decision_NationalDestabilization_Violence
title: Porte Drazon Reels From Demonstration Massacre
description: While the large demonstration against our reign was largely prevented, the people of Porte Drazon are now reeling from the massacre committed by our forces. Hospitals report being completely overwhelmed, with the local authorities continuing to crack down on any gathering bigger than 5 people.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_Decision_PublicTransportationDestroyed
title: Only One In Four Busses Run – Single Metroline Still In Service
description: Porte Drazon’s public transport system has witnessed a complete collapse, with severe lack of rolling stock due to countless equipment failures the main culprit of the situation. Merely one in four buses are still able to run and only one of the city's three underground lines is still in operation, due to track failures on the other two.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_Decision_RRGFuturePostNationalization_StatePrivateCoop
title: RRG Share Sales Begin at Stock Exchange
description:
Public trading of Rizian Royal Gold shares has officially commenced at the Porte Drazon Stock Exchange. Early trading sessions saw strong interest from investors across the financial sector.

Officials report stable transaction volumes and note that monitoring efforts are in place to ensure an orderly market environment. The share offering marks a new phase in RRG’s integration into the broader economy.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_Decision_StockExchangeResults_Average
title: Stock Exchange Sees Modest Gains
description:
The opening of the Porte Drazon Stock Exchange has brought moderate economic improvement, with investments slightly exceeding initial expectations. Local businesses see some increased activity, but the overall impact has been less substantial than hoped.

As the city continues to adapt to its new financial role, residents are cautiously optimistic that gradual growth will follow.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_Decision_StockExchangeResults_Bad
title: Stock Exchange Struggles to Deliver
description:
The grand opening of the Porte Drazon Stock Exchange has not lived up to expectations, with economic returns falling short. Local businesses report minimal benefits, and residents are questioning whether the project was worth the investment.

Economic analysts point to poor planning and lack of investor confidence as key factors. Hopes for a financial boost are now giving way to skepticism.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_Decision_StockExchangeResults_Good
title: Stock Exchange Yields Positive Returns
description:
The launch of the Porte Drazon Stock Exchange has shown promising results, attracting a steady flow of investments. Local businesses, especially in the financial sector, are reporting increased activity and optimism.

While the city sees economic benefits, some residents are cautiously hopeful that the growth will be sustained beyond the initial surge.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_Decision_StockExchangeResults_Great
title: Stock Exchange Spurs Economic Surge
description:
The Porte Drazon Stock Exchange is making a significant impact, with domestic companies thriving and international investments flooding in. Local businesses report increased activity, particularly in the financial and hospitality sectors.

Residents express optimism as the economic boost raises hopes for long-term stability and growth. Officials are confident that the exchange will continue to enhance Porte Drazon’s reputation as a thriving commercial hub.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_Decision_StockExchangeResults_Horrible
title: Stock Exchange Collapse Shocks City
description:
The Porte Drazon Stock Exchange has suffered a disastrous opening, with economic performance falling far short of expectations. Local businesses are reporting severe downturns, and residents are openly questioning the decision to establish the financial hub.

Economic experts attribute the collapse to poor planning and a lack of investor confidence. Public sentiment is overwhelmingly negative, with many calling for accountability.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_Decision_TourismCampaignResults_BoomingSuccess
title: Tourism Boom Boosts Local Economy
description:
Porte Drazon has welcomed an unprecedented 12.5 million visitors this year, far surpassing projections. Luxury hotels are fully booked, and local businesses are reporting record profits.

The influx of tourists has revitalized the Zpana Riverfront and historic districts, drawing international attention and solidifying the city’s reputation as a premier destination. Residents are optimistic as the economic benefits continue to grow.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_Decision_TourismCampaignResults_Failure
title: Tourism Campaign Falls Flat
description:
Porte Drazon's tourism initiative failed to make a significant difference, attracting only 2.7 million visitors -- barely an increase over previous years. Local businesses report disappointing returns, and the city's reputation as a cultural hub remains unfulfilled.

Economic analysts cite poor strategic planning and insufficient international outreach as key factors. Residents question whether the investment was worthwhile.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_Decision_TourismCampaignResults_GoodSuccess
title: Tourism Brings Growth to Porte Drazon
description:
The city has welcomed 9.3 million visitors this year thanks to the recent tourism campaign. Hotels report high occupancy rates, and the local economy is experiencing steady growth as new businesses flourish.

Residents are cautiously optimistic, hoping that the influx of tourists will continue to support the city's development.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_Decision_TourismCampaignResults_ModestGain
title: Tourism Brings Modest Growth
description:
Porte Drazon's tourism campaign has attracted 6.8 million visitors, providing a slight boost to the local economy. However, infrastructure is feeling the strain as new businesses compete for limited space.

Residents are encouraged by the increased foot traffic, but express concern about the city's ability to sustain growth.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_Decision_TourismCampaignResults_Underwhelming
title: Tourism Campaign Falls Short
description:
Porte Drazon saw only 4.1 million visitors this season, despite efforts to raise the city's profile. Local business owners express disappointment, noting that the anticipated economic boost never materialized.

International publicity and logistical challenges are cited as contributing factors. Residents wonder whether the campaign's potential was overestimated.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_GuardiansDeployed
title: Wruhec’s Guardians Prepare For March Arrival
description: As the worshippers close in on the capital, Wruhec’s Guardians have been deployed on every street corner in order to prevent the calmth. Already, minor clashes have occurred between the Guardians and other anti-government demonstrators, as they have started forcefully clearing squares to allow the large mass of expected people to arrive safely.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_HomelessnessReduces
title: Homelessness In Freefall
description: As the program providing housing to homeless individuals starts picking up speed, the number of unhoused inside Porte Drazon has effectively halved. A shortage of housing still exists, making finding suitable housing space difficult, but new constructions are underway to alleviate these problems.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_HousingCrisisEases
title: Housing Crisis Eases
description: Due to recent actions undertaken by the King, the housing crisis that has been gripping Porte Drazon in recent years has shown signs of slowing down. While experts have warned the city isn’t out of the woods yet, many residents will breathe a sigh of relief as rapidly increasing rents become a thing of the past.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_HousingMovementOutraged
title: Housing Movement Outraged, Mass Rally
description: Following the King’s decision to ignore the demand of Porte Drazon’s expropriation movement, hundreds of thousands of citizens took to the street, defying a ban issued by city authorities. Skirmishes and arrests were made on the periphery of the rally, with the movement vowing that the battle for fair housing is only just beginning.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_LimitedBuybackIneffective
title: Housing Movement Slams Buyback
description: The limited buyback of properties from major landlords by the Crown has been slammed by the housing movement as ineffective policy, only serving to concentrate power into the hands of the Toras family. Early predictions have indicated the buyback will have no effect on rental prices, but has the potential to reduce the homeless population if administered correctly.

name: Turn09_PorteDrazon_SordishPolioArrives_Response
title: Polio Outbreak Contained
description: Due to a rapid response from authorities, several people have been placed in isolation to prevent the polio outbreak from spreading to the capital city. This has so far managed to avoid a major outbreak in Porte Drazon.

name: Turn09_ReformDeclaration_HouseAzaroGathers
title: House Azaro Holds Private Meeting
description:
The Rizian Intelligence reports that in an unexpected meeting yesterday, prominent members of House Azaro convened a private gathering at their ancestral estate in Montaklar late last evening. The meeting, arranged with little prior notice and utmost secrecy, brought together important figures like Taddeus Azaro and Carlos Robles Azaro.

While the specifics of the agenda remain unknown, sources report heightened security measures around the estate during the meeting.

name: Turn09_ReformDeclaration_HouseAzaroGathers_War
title: House Azaro Holds Private Meeting As Generals Leave Frontlines To Attend
description:
The Rizian Intelligence reports that in an unexpected meeting yesterday, prominent members of House Azaro convened a private gathering at their ancestral estate in Montaklar late last evening. The meeting, arranged with little prior notice and utmost secrecy, saw the abrupt departure of key military commanders, General Taddeus Azaro and General Carlos Robles Azaro from the Palesian frontlines to attend.

Sources report that security around the estate was considerably heightened during the meeting, with additional guards posted and access strictly limited.

name: Turn09_ReformDeclaration_SuOminaGathering
title: Su Omina Rally Denounces Reforms
description:
A group of Su Omina members held a rally in Mave Nortus today with a coalition of "anti-reformist" groups and organizations. In the gathering also attended by several landowners and industrialists, the group denounced the King’s recent endorsement of the RPP’s call for reforms, labeling it a betrayal of Rizian heritage and noble traditions.

Speakers at the gathering called for Rizian National Coalition to resist against any measures that would diminish the privileges of Rizia’s nobility or disrupt the current social order. Chants of “Preserve the Realm” and “Glovurius Axa Rizia” echoed through the streets, with visible anger directed at the Rizian People's Party and the increasing Reform Movement.

name: Turn09_Revolutionaries_SuspiciousActivityinPorteDrazon
title: Suspicious Activity in Porte Drazon
description:
Rizian Intelligence has noted an increase in unusual activity within Porte Drazon over the past week. Anonymous tips and scattered reports indicate the movement of unregistered vehicles and the gathering of small groups in industrial areas near the city center. Residents in certain neighborhoods have reported heightened tension, with unfamiliar faces frequenting local establishments and warehouses.

Authorities have also identified a surge in encrypted communications originating from within the city, raising concerns about potential coordination for an undisclosed event. While no direct threats have been identified, the timing and concentration of these activities, coinciding with the preparations for the Queen Mother's birthday celebration at the Grand Library, have raised alarms.

Local law enforcement has been instructed to maintain a heightened presence around key locations and continue surveillance on the identified hotspots.

name: Turn09_Ribel_Relocation
title: Relocation Benefits
description: Our effort to relocate teachers and doctors has met some pushbacks, but also yielded beneficial results. The villagers in Ribel are being educated in the fields of agriculture, botanics increasing the agricultural output of the region.

name: Turn09_Ribery_Unrest_HistoricalSite
title: Rioters Destroy Ribery Historical Site
description:
Rioters have looted the gold and jewelry found in the ancient caves underneath Ribery while engaging with police forces. Some suspects were caught but the police units suffered heavy casualties when the rioters used a bulldozer to run over a police formation. 14 police officers were heavily injured and hospitalized.

The rioters descended upon the shops in the downtown area and destroyed most civilian property in the city. Some went further to hunt the police officers at the hospitals.

name: Turn09_Rizia_CelebratesSollTrial
title: Rizia Applauds Soll's Trial
description:
King Romus praised Sordland's decision to bring former President Soll to trial, viewing it as a commendable commitment to justice. The king expressed hope that this trial marks a turning point for transparency and accountability in Sordish governance and remembrance for the horrific punishment of the monarchists, the Black Battalion, and the expulsion of the Sordish royal lineage. 

He stressed the importance of such actions in strengthening the trust between the two nations.

name: Turn09_Rumburg_Reparations
title: Foreign Minister Called For Peace
description: Foreign Minister of Rumburg congratulated our decision to pay reparations and thanked our government for being diplomatic. He called for peace and better relations between our two countries and told us that the Rumburgian government will surely do the right thing and bring the two countries even closer.

name: Turn09_Sallabes_Decision_NationalDestabilizationOne
title: Sazon Heckled During Speech
description: Merida Sazon, a minor noble from the Elle Nors region, was heckled as she attempted to address the protest aimed against our government in Sallabes. The protesters accused the Sazon of ‘failing to achieve meaningful change through opposition’ and demanded a ‘more revolutionary strategy’ to deal with the King.

name: Turn09_Sallabes_DiplomaticGala
title: Leona Sazon Hosts Diplomatic Gala
description: Countess Leona Sazon organized a gala in Sallabes to raise funds for displaced families affected by the conflict. Key political figures attended, making this not just a charitable event but a significant diplomatic gathering to unify support for Rizia during these trying times.

name: Turn09_Sallabes_ZilleReturn_GiveToBrenas
title: Sazons Celebrate Return Of Zille
