description: House Sazon has held a grand celebration in Sallabes, celebrating our decision to reincorporate Zille into the Brenas province. Almost all Sazon nobles, including minor ones, were present. Celebrations are expected to continue well into the night, after which a major Sazon celebration will travel to Zille itself.

name: Turn09_Sarna_AgriculturalZoneOpens
title: Agricultural Zone Opens
description: The Sarna agricultural zone has opened to the public. Long lines of farmers are waiting in line to apply for the new cooperation opportunities. The opening is expected to increase the agricultural output of Sarna by 40%. As per the reports, agricultural workers from nearby cities are also migrating, creating an influx of jobs and investments.

name: Turn09_Sarna_Bergia_Economy_Bad
title: Increased Crime and Racial Violence Plagues Sarna
description: The Mayor of Sarna requests financial aid and additional security for Sarna. He reported a spike in racial violence and crime in the city. The lack of investments seems to intensify the economic differences between different parts of society.

name: Turn09_Sarna_Bergia_Economy_Good
title: The New Major Hub for Trade and Agriculture
description: The city growth is expected to increase by 200%. Internal statistics show that Sarna will be able to rival Deyr in the next decade if trends maintain. This success is attributed to the recent government investments and policies in the region. Sarna has the potential to be the center of trade and commerce for west Sordland.

name: Turn09_Sarna_Bergia_Economy_Stabilising
title: Economic Stabilisation Hampered by Racial Tension
description:
The Mayor of Sarna reported some economic growth. He expressed his gratitude for the investment of the government in the region. However, the multi-cultural city of Sarna is still struggling with societal problems.

Tensions between the Bludish people and the local Sords is still high.

name: Turn09_Sarna_InvestmentSynergyHigh
title: High Investment Synergy Achieved
description: Investments across multiple sectors are demonstrating high levels of synergy, leading to impressive economic growth. The well-coordinated infusion of capital into sectors in different ways has resulted in significant advancements and a boost in productivity. This efficient allocation of resources is driving economic success and setting a strong foundation for future prosperity.

name: Turn09_Sarna_InvestmentSynergyLow
title: Low Investment Synergy Reported
description: The synergy between investments across sectors remains limited, with misaligned and uncoordinated strategies resulting in suboptimal outcomes and slower economic progress. This situation points to the necessity of adopting a more integrated and strategic investment approach to unlock their full potential.

name: Turn09_Sarna_InvestmentSynergyMedium
title: Medium Investment Synergy Observed
description: A moderate level of investment synergy is being observed across several sectors. Investments are generally aligning well and contributing to steady economic progress. While some areas could benefit from improved coordination, overall, the positive interplay between various investments is supporting consistent economic growth.

name: Turn09_Sarna_UnrestMilitary_SoldiersShoot
title: Soldiers Gun Down Violent Rioters
description:
Violent riots took over the city of Sarna which led to a large military detachment to be sent to take back control of the city. A massive confrontation between the rioters and the infantry brigade led to 123 deaths and 412 wounded civilians. The streets of Sarna were bloodied and the military took over the civilian authority to ensure no further riots occurred. A thousand arrests followed the clashes and many traitors are being interrogated at the local prison.

A second attempt by the rioters was made to take back city hall in which they used hunting rifles to shoot at soldiers. Soldiers gunned all rioters down and quelled any further attempt.

name: Turn09_Sarna_WPB_Leader_Poisoned
title: WPB Leader Poisoned
description:
Leader of the Workers Party of Bludia, Fetih Ejall, was poisoned by a nerve agent and was hospitalized in a serious condition. During his trip to Sarna to deliver a speech for his campaign, he suddenly became ill after eating zabla with a local family.

An investigations has been launched to find the culprit.

name: Turn09_Sordland_Decision_Unification_Agree
title: Sordland Extends Congratulations
description: Sordish president Anton Rayne has congratulated us on the planned unification of Rizia and Pales. Rayne highlighted the need for a unified people and praised us for achieving this through diplomatic means.

name: Turn09_SuOmina_Fights_PalesResistance
title: Su Omina Secures Control in Palesian Cities
description: The Crown has authorized the deployment of Su Omina members into occupied Palesian cities to dismantle resistance movements. While their presence has drawn criticism, their operations have been highly effective in neutralizing local insurgents, significantly reducing the threat to our stationed troops. With resistance efforts crushed, maintaining control over the occupied territories has become considerably easier for the Kingdom, though tensions among the local population remain high.

name: Turn09_Topes_EvictionWave
title: Wave Of Evictions As Holiday Rentals Take Over
description: Due to the increasing number of tourists visiting the restored Rezenid city of Topes, major housing providers have deemed short term holiday rentals as more profitable. This has led to a wave of evictions, as landlords clear their properties of tenants to rent them out at higher prices to tourists.

name: Turn09_TourismDown_CivilAvitation_FuelShortage
title: Fuel Reallocation Hampers Tourism Growth
description: The recent reallocation of fuel resources from civil aviation to the military has resulted in a notable decline in tourism throughout the kingdom. While the Military Officials emphasize the strategic importance of reinforcing military operations, economic authorities warn that prolonged strain on tourism may further alienate foreign visitors, resulting in long-term damage to the sector.

name: Turn09_Unrest_DastnuristsAgainstRPP
title: Dastnurist Sanctuary Condemns the Protests
description: The influential Dastnurist sanctuary in Argno has declared its support for counter-protesters against the intensifying anti-government unrest. In a public statement, Elder Pontius Vales called the reforms "an affront to divine order," urging the faithful to stand against the dissenting groups, which he described as a "group of unbelievers who seek to terrorize Rizian public life."

name: Turn09_Unrest_DastnuristsSupportRPP
title: Dastnurist Sanctuary in Argno Declares Support For Protests
description:
The Dastnurist sanctuary in Argno has emerged as a vocal supporter of the ongoing protests challenging the Crown. Elder Pontius Vales, a respected spiritual leader, delivered a sermon today calling for "justice for the people" and endorsing the protest movement as a moral imperative to end centuries of inequality.

Tensions are growing as traditionalist factions criticize the sanctuary’s position, accusing it of politicizing faith. Meanwhile, reformist and revolutionary leaders have praised the Dastnurist endorsement as a pivotal moment in the movement.

name: Turn09_Unrest_GolcondistsSupportRPP
title: Golcondist Fellowship of Rizia Gives Support To Reform Protests
description:
The Golcondist Fellowship of Rizia has openly declared its support for ongoing protests in urban centers across the kingdom. The protests in Plavo, largely led by youth groups, trade unions and the RPP, were also joined by Golcondist protesters after the Fellowship's announcement.

In a public statement, the Fellowship emphasized its commitment to Golconda and called on the Crown to heed the voices of discontent. It has also mobilized volunteers to provide food to the protesters.

name: Turn09_Unrest_WruhecistsAttackReformRally
title: Religious Groups Attack Reform Rally
description:
Violence erupted today at a reform rally in central Jales, where members of several Wruhecist organizations clashed with demonstrators advocating for constitutional reform. Armed with improvised weapons, the attackers stormed the rally, dispersing the crowd and injuring dozens before law enforcement intervened.

Eyewitnesses report that the assailants accused the protesters of "undermining traditional values" and promoting secularism contrary to the moral fabric of the kingdom. The rally, organized by the Rizian People's Party, had drawn thousands advocating for expanded suffrage and limits on monarchical authority. Authorities arrested several individuals linked to the violence, while paramedics treated the injured on-site.

name: Turn09_Unrest_WruhecistsSupportRPP
title: Wruhecist Organizations Give Support to the Growing Reform Movement
description:
Three prominent Wruhecist organizations—the Society of Six Stars, the Wruhecist Fellowship of Nelvisar, and the Little Brothers of Wruhec—have issued statements in support of the burgeoning reform movement sweeping the kingdom. The groups emphasized their alignment with calls for expanded political freedoms.

In their statement, the Society of Six Stars called the movement “a moral imperative,” arguing that supporting such a progressive popular movement is in line with Wruhecist principles. This endorsement marks a significant shift for Wruhecist groups, who traditionally support the Rizian Crown loyally. Observers suggest this could embolden reformist momentum while further polarizing the kingdom’s other religious groups.

name: Turn09_Uziren_BanRevoked_BFP
title: Celebrations in Uziren
description:
Many of the locals in Uziren gathered at the city square to celebrate the revocation of the ban on the Bludish Freedom Party. The mayor of Uziren reported that the amnesty and the revocation were greeted by the Uzireners with festivities.

Dancing and singing continued well into the night.

name: Turn09_Uziren_UnrestBFFMilitary_MountainBase
title: Mountain Commando's Destroy BFF Base
description:
Sordish Mountain Commando's have begun sweeping operations along the Uziren mountain range under harsh weather conditions in order to find the guerrilla bases of the BFF. The operation led by one of the most experienced mountaineer officers has resulted in great success after two large bases were destroyed following a massive gunfight.

Meanwhile, the BFF launched a counterattack with vehicles towards Uziren but were engaged by a defensive armored column which destroyed their light vehicles and inflicted massive casualties on the enemy. Following the successful defense the units supported the mountaineers in their final push to cleanse the mountains of the BFF militants. It is estimated that the BFF lost 1432 soldiers in the two-week long fight.

name: Turn09_Valgen_AidsElectionCampaign_RY
title: Red Youth Aids Election Campaign
description:
Red Youth members in Valgen volunteered to aid the election campaign and started to work directly with the campaign advisors and the local party office.

Their help is expected to result in a significant boost in votes from Eastern Sordland.

name: Turn09_Valgen_BFFUnrest_GoldRaided
title: BFF Raids Gold Reserves
description:
The Gold Reserves in Valgen were stolen by a BFF rebel attack in which forty tonnes of gold were lost. The police have entered a chase with the BFF rebels which led to a countryside cottage. Unfortunately, it was a planned ambush by a rebel element. Twenty police officers lost their lives in the ambush and the security forces lost track of all the gold that was stolen. The Mayor of Valgen has declared a state of emergency in the city.

Armed police units from Benfi are on the way to help maintain security and stability in the countryside which is seeing more reports of rebel attacks.

name: Turn09_Valgen_BFFUnrest_RailRoadGunRightFight
title: Armed Citizens Fight BFF Rebels in the Countryside
description:
The BFF sabotaged the L-1 Railway at Erlory and captured the railway station. The rebels committing acts of looting and incitement led some armed civilians to protect their businesses and homes with their guns. Dozens were wounded in the clashes before gendarmerie units arrived at the scene to take back control of the station. The ongoing three-way battle led to massive damage to civilian infrastructure. The railway station and the tracks were destroyed leading to a halt of railway transportation.

Police forces had a difficult time differentiating between the BFF which led to some unintended civilian casualties but eventually, the BFF retreated out of the city and was captured by an armed police battalion.

name: Turn09_Valgen_Gruni_EconomyAverage
title: Moderate Growth in Gruni's Economy
description:
Gruni region is experiencing moderate economic growth with Valgen at its centre. Forecasts for the next decade suggest a stable but unspectacular expansion across various sectors, including urban development, agriculture, and tourism. While government investments and regional policies have helped steady the ship, the region's growth has not reached the vibrant levels initially projected. 

Nonetheless, Gruni continues to progress, consolidating its role as a crucial economic entity in eastern Sordland.

name: Turn09_Valgen_Gruni_EconomyBad
title: Economic Stagnation in Gruni
description:
The economy of Gruni region, with Valgen at its epicentre, is confronting stagnation. Despite earlier forecasts of considerable growth across sectors, including urban development, agriculture, and tourism, current trends paint a rather bleak picture. The region's growth strategies and government investments have not translated into the expected economic surge. 

If this stagnation continues, Gruni's ambition of becoming a dynamic economic hub in the east of Sordland may face serious delays.

name: Turn09_Valgen_Gruni_EconomyGood
title: Gruni's Flourishing Economy
description:
Gruni region, with Valgen as its heart, is witnessing a major economic upswing. Projected growth rates for the next decade suggest an impressive expansion across multiple sectors - from urban development and trade to agriculture and tourism. These positive trends are the direct outcome of robust government investment and effective regional policies. 

Gruni is rapidly evolving into a vibrant economic hub, fostering prosperity in the east of Sordland.

name: Turn09_Valgen_SuicideRates
title: Suicide Rates Triple
description:
The latest information from the city of Valgen displays a worrying increase in reported suicides.

The suicide rate in the city seems to have tripled compared to the previous four years. Increased rates of depression were also observed among the local populace.

name: Turn09_Valgsland_HeljilandOperation
title: Heljiland Operation Signalled
description:
Valgslandian military officials gave us their signal for their operation into Heljiland. All Sordish civilian vessels have retreated from the potential conflict zone.

Several Sordish ships and planes will continue their trips around the island and will share intelligence with the Valgslandian forces.

name: Turn09_Valgsland_NavalPresence
title: Valgsland Increases Naval Presence in Grey Strait
description:
It is being reported that the Valgslandian Navy has increased its presence along our shores, particularly at the Gray Strait. The already massive fleet patrolling the Markian Sea is now accompanied by a second one.

According to our intelligence, Valgslandians are also installing defense systems with offensive capabilities on their southern shores. This poses a great danger for Holsord, and the whole country.

name: Turn09_Valgsland_PraisesOligarchExpulsion
title: Valgsland Lauds Sordish Oligarch Expulsion
description: Chancellor Emmerich Hegel publicly commended the recent expulsion of powerful oligarchs in Sordland. Hegel remarked that such actions could pave the way for a more equitable distribution of wealth and power within Sordland, aligning more closely with socialist ideals. The Chancellor expressed hope that this significant step would help to curb the undue influence of a wealthy few, leading to a more balanced society.

name: Turn09_Vesord_Unrest_CampFreedom
title: Camp Freedom Rebels Clash with Police
description:
After the violent takeover of private camping property by rebels a group of 400 police officers descended upon the camp to dispel the rebels who were found to be armed resulting in a massive firefight. The rebels lost 43 people in the gunfight while the police had 10 killed in action.

The camp was captured but many more police units were wounded during the operations. Two hundred armed rebels surrendered while a few dozen escaped towards Morna and are being searched for.

name: Turn09_Wehlen_Decision_LeaveAllianceOfNations_Leave
title: Wehlen Rethinking AN Membership
description: Following our decision to leave the AN, Wehlen has now announced that it is seriously considering its own position, signaling the growing dissatisfaction of disgraced nations with the organization.

name: Turn09_Wehlen_Decision_NationalDestabilization_Violence
title: Wehlen Praises Our Crackdown
description: Wehlen’s Wiktor Smolak has praised our violent crackdown on protesters, saying we are an example of how to maintain order.

name: Turn09_Wehlen_IntermerkopumAccept
title: Wehlen To Join Regional Alliance Talks
description: President Wiktor Smolak has accepted our invitation to join talks for a South Merkopan alliance. He will be present at the upcoming roundtable in Porte Drazon.

name: Turn09_Wehlen_IntermerkopumRefusal_NoZille
title: Wehlen Backs Out Of Regional Alliance Talks
description: President Wiktor Smolak has refused our invitation to join talks for a South Merkopan alliance, following our inability to reach an agreement regarding the Zille handover.

name: Turn09_Wehlen_IntermerkopumRefusal_Zille
title: Wehlen Backs Out Of Regional Alliance Talks
description: President Wiktor Smolak has refused our invitation to join talks for a South Merkopan alliance, citing unresolved differences with Rizia and his neighbors. He stresses that the handover of Zille will still go as planned.

name: Turn09_Wehlen_RaisesRumburgConcern
title: Wehlen Raises Concerns Over Rumburg Posturing
description: Amidst escalating tensions in the region, Wehlen's President, Wiktor Smolak, has issued a statement raising concerns about Rumburg's aggressive manoeuvres. Expressing unease over Rumburg's clandestine support for the Bludish Freedom Front, Smolak warns Sordland to stay vigilant. This warning comes on the heels of a recent aerial engagement between Sordland and Rumburg, further inflaming the already volatile atmosphere.

name: Turn09_Zille_CelebratesReturn
title: Zille Celebrates Return
description: Tens of thousands turned out on the streets of Zille to celebrate its return to Rizia. Monarchist banners were flown, with Romus’ name being loudly shouted by the crowds in reverence.

name: Turn09_Zille_KingsSpeechAndSigningCeremony
title: Preparations Begin for King's Reunification Event
description: Preparations are currently underway for the upcoming reunification speech and signing ceremony led by the king.

name: Turn10_AdarfoMurder_ArcasianInvolvement
title: Adarfo Sotelato's Murder Investigation Reveals Possible Arcasian Involvement
description:
Preliminary findings from the investigation into the assassination of Adarfo Sotelato suggest potential involvement of Arcasian private military contractors. Forensic analysis of materials recovered from the Golden Dusk attack points to the use of advanced weaponry and equipment commonly linked to Arcasian manufacturers. High-caliber rounds found at the scene match known specifications of Arcasian military exports.

This revelation has the potential to inflame tensions with Arcasia, as Rizian protesters accuse Arcasia of interference and demanding the Crown to take action.

name: Turn10_Agnolia_AssaultHeljilandIsland
title: Inexplicable Manoeuvres from Agnolian Armies
description: We have several reports that Agnolia is mobilizing troops toward their capital Staalport. A suspicious number of civilian ships have gathered at the city port, and some of our generals are growing wary that Agnolia might use the Rumburg war as cover to attempt to retake Heljiland from Valgsland with a naval invasion.

name: Turn10_Agnolia_ATOBid
title: Agnolia Puts Forward Bid to Join ATO
description: The Republic of Agnolia officially put forward a bit to join ATO. It is likely that they will be entering the Arcasian sphere as President Walker has tentatively accepted their bid to gain more foothold against CSP.

name: Turn10_Agnolia_CondolencesAssassination
title: Agnolia Expresses Solidarity Following Assassination Attempt
description: In the wake of the harrowing assassination attempt on President Rayne, Agnolia's Prime Minister, Maartin Van Hoorten, has sent his heartfelt condolences. The Prime Minister conveyed his deep concern and expressed solidarity with Sordland in these trying times. Van Hoorten called upon his citizens to remain vigilant, stressing the importance of maintaining peace and stability in the region.

name: Turn10_Agnolia_PreparesToAssaultDome_FullStrength
title: Agnolia Prepares Assault on Dome
description: Agnolia’s commander has sent us military reports that all their armies are in place to launch a full-scale assault on Dome. The country has positioned its best troops at the front line and announced that they are committed to liberating their city from Rumburg's tyranny.

name: Turn10_Agnolia_PreparesToAssaultDome_HalfStrength
title: Agnolia Prepares To Assault Dome
description: Agnolia’s commander has sent us reports that their armies are in place to launch a full assault on Dome. Yet their numbers seem to betray their commitment to retake the city, as a significant portion of the country’s forces have stayed behind to defend Heljiland from a potential Valgslandian invasion.

name: Turn10_Anrica_ElectionVote_Gloria_Consolidates
title: Vice President Tory Consolidates Conservative Base
description:
Due to our pro-Soll policies, a large majority of USP conservative voters said that they would likely vote for president Rayne.

In addition, our Vice President, Gloria Tory, has been hosting rallies trying to consolidate their support.

name: Turn10_Anrica_LespianArmiesLate
title: Lespian Armies Slowed Down
description: After days of travel from Holsord to Lachaven, the Lespian armies requested to rest and restock their supplies in Anrica. However, the mayor of Anrica has refused to let foreign armies enter a Sordish city due to fear of upheaval or even a potential takeover, further delaying the arrival of Lespia’s army to the frontline.

name: Turn10_Argno_GuardiansDeployed
title: Wruhec’s Guardians Prevent Union Activity
description: The newly deployed Wruhec’s Guardians have started an intensive anti-union campaign in Argno, rooting out any remaining pro union sentiment among workers. The guardians highlight the importance of work in the Wruhecist values, saying everyone should work together to achieve Golconda instead of squabbling over things like pay and working conditions.

name: Turn10_Arvory_Highway_AgnoliaLate_NotBuilt
title: Agnolia's Late Arrival
description: Agnolia's commander reported that his armies might not arrive in time for the battle, placing the blame on the poor infrastructure in the Agnland region slowing down the movement of their units.

name: Turn10_Arvory_Highway_AgnoliaNotLate_Built
title: Agnolian Army Ready in Agnland
description:
Agnolia's commander reported that his armies are in position in the Agnland region to help with the upcoming battle. He applauded Sordish infrastructure as his armies traversed smoothly through the region's improved roadway network.

The H-3 highway will be a key logistical link for transporting troops and supplies to and from Agnolia.

name: Turn10_ATO_AgardObserver
title: ATO Grants Agard Observer Status, Addressing Drug Trade
description:
The ATO has granted observer status to Agard, a nation infamously known for its central role in the drug trade spanning Kalrad, Erdmarg, Wehlen, and Agard itself. While condemning the illegal activities, the ATO seeks a collaborative approach, with a focus on the socio-economic impact of the rampant drug trafficking. Agard's narco-lord, Severo Rios, has voiced intentions to legitimize the drug trade, aiming for regulation over exploitation.

With Rios at its helm, Agard's entry as an observer into the ATO signifies a potential diplomatic approach towards tackling the illicit drug trade. This move indicates Rios's commitment to engage transparently with the international community, which, despite skepticism, offers an opportunity for dialogue and resolution.

name: Turn10_ATO_AnrakaNAP
title: ATO Signs Non-Aggression Pact for 3 Years with Anraka
description:
Amid escalating tensions between United Contana and Arcasia, the Arcasian Treaty Organization has signed a non-aggression pact with the Federation of Anrakan Isles. Located strategically between the continents of Merkopa and Contana, the federation provides a critical diplomatic and security buffer. Its influential naval fleet supports stability in the region and ensures uninterrupted global commerce.

The geographical location and naval strength of the Anrakan Isles enable it to act as a neutral ground for global trade, maintaining open trade routes despite ongoing superpower confrontations. The agreement reflects efforts to ensure regional peace and highlights the federation's role as a key player in economic cooperation.

name: Turn10_ATO_WorldLiberty
title: ATO Declares World Liberation Manifestation
description:
In a major diplomatic development, the ATO has declared the World Liberation Manifestation (WLM), a strategic vision focused on promoting liberty, equity, and wealth across the globe. This declaration marks the ATO's dedication to advance these core values, serving as a counterpoint to the CSP's recent World Revolution Manifesto.

The WLM advocates for a world where freedom, fairness, and prosperity reign supreme. These principles are rooted in the ATO's belief in a free-market economy and democratic governance, and they reflect the alliance's commitment to enhancing the global quality of life. This manifesto seeks to influence global policies and negotiations, promoting a future where every individual can exercise their liberties, enjoy equal opportunities, and share in global wealth.

This vision contrasts the CSP's model, offering an alternative path to global prosperity. The ATO asserts that through the principles of the WLM, nations can achieve sustainable growth without sacrificing their individual freedoms. The WLM thus signifies a bold step towards a globalized world where prosperity is shared, liberties are upheld, and equity is non-negotiable.

name: Turn10_Benfi_ElectionVote_Lucian_Shines
title: Vice President Galade Shines during Campaign
description:
Our Vice President, Lucian Galade, has been hosting massive rallies trying to sway both the conservative and reformist voters while also trying to attract new undecided voters.

Fortunately, the great and extraordinary oratory skills of the VP has led to many new voters to flock to the USP. The VP is shining while expanding the potential voter base.

name: Turn10_Benfi_ElectionVote_Lucian_Struggles
title: Vice President Galade Struggles during Campaign
description:
Our Vice President, Lucian Galade, has been hosting rallies trying to sway both the conservative and reformist voters while also trying to attract new undecided voters.

Unfortunately, due to their close relationship with the administration and the unpopular reputation, the VP is struggling to draw in voters.

name: Turn10_Benfi_ElectionVote_Women
title: Women For Rayne
description: Recent polls suggest a surprising amount of support from women in Sordland. According to our pollsters, 53.4% of women said that they will vote for President Rayne due to the improvements in the women's rights situation.

name: Turn10_Conriat_CSP
title: CSP Modernises Sordland Navy
description:
The admirals have been working tirelessly along with their CSP counterparts to modernise our navy. The regiments training have been changed to include more maneuvering exercises as well as naval invasion training.

Our destroyers have been retrofitted with the latest technology hull plating and cutting-edge main guns transported from United Contana. General Staff reports that the Sordish Navy has never been in a better condition.

name: Turn10_Conriat_ElectionVote_MarcelKoronti
title: Marcel Koronti Endorsed President Rayne
description: Sordish media mogul and businessman, Marcel Koronti, has officially endorsed us to be the next President of Sordland. With Mr. Koronti's wide-ranging connections and new media power, we can expect more votes in the upcoming election.

name: Turn10_Conriat_ElectionVote_PublicOpinon_Positive
title: Election Poll Results
description: With the election drawing near, our staff at the Maroon Palace has conducted general election polls all across Sordland. Our election polls show that around 38% of Sordish citizens would likely vote for the USP in the upcoming election.

name: Turn10_CSP_WarnsGRACE
title: CSP Warns GRACE Against Formation of Anti-Malenyevist Union
description:
The Contanan Security Pact has issued a strong warning to the Guild of Royal Allies for Commercial Exchange, condemning its plans to establish an anti-Malenyevist military alliance. The CSP accused GRACE of actively undermining its ideological foundation and destabilizing the region, labeling the proposed military union a deliberate provocation. The statement described GRACE’s actions as a direct threat to peace and pledged decisive measures to counter what it sees as an escalation of hostility.

Rejecting the notion of dialogue, the CSP asserted that GRACE’s intentions align with external powers seeking to weaken the pact. The leadership emphasized its readiness to defend its principles and regional interests against this perceived threat, calling on its allies to prepare for a united response to the growing ideological and military challenge.

name: Turn10_CSP_WorldRevolution
title: World Revolution Manifesto: A Revolutionary Step
description:
Vice-Secretary Chairman Toqezintli Iyotake of the United Assembly of United Contana has made a groundbreaking announcement. He has proposed the World Revolution Manifesto, a revolutionary vision calling for an ideological shift towards Malenyevism and Valgslandian Socialism globally. This manifesto aims to revolutionize global governance, focusing on investment in education, infrastructure, and health, rather than military investments.

The World Revolution Manifesto is seen as a continuation of CSP's colossal investment scheme initiated three years ago. This scheme had channeled 150 billion KS into Rika's infrastructure and education sectors, transforming the continents social landscape and shaping it as a beacon of sustainable development. This new manifesto, while global in scope, aims to replicate this success, fostering a worldwide revolution.

The approach is a peaceful one, favoring socio-economic development over military power. The goal is to construct a world where liberty, equality, and wealth are universally accessible.

name: Turn10_Derdia_CondemnGuardians
title: Derdia Condemns Wruhec’s Guardians
description: Derdia has condemned our policy of deploying Wruhec’s Guardians to maintain order across the country, saying the fundamentalist organization unfairly targets Golcondists.

name: Turn10_Deyr_BludsProtestsWehlenArmy
title: Peaceful Protests in Bergia
description: Bergia’s Bludish community has been holding rallies protesting the presence of Wehzek troops in the region. Even though the protests have been peaceful so far, local police forces are staying vigilant in case the demonstrators turn violent.

name: Turn10_Deyr_BludsSabotageWehlen
title: Deyr Resists Wehlen Troops
description: The Bludish citizens of Deyr have barricaded the entrances to the city, forcing the Wehlen army to circle around it in order to move forward to Lachaven. The Wehzek generals reportedly debated mounting an attack on Deyr before deciding to press on.

name: Turn10_Deyr_ElectionVote_Minority_BigImpact
title: Minority Poll Results
description: The opinion polls on minority voter groups have been very positive, especially from the Bludish citizens in our country. Thanks to our relaxed immigration law, their votes will have a larger impact on the election.

name: Turn10_Deyr_ElectionVote_Minority_SmallImpact
title: Minority Poll Results
description: The opinion polls on minority voter groups have been very positive, especially from the Bludish citizens. However, due to our tighten immigration law, their votes will only have a small impact on the election outcome.

name: Turn10_Deyr_Unrest_BFF
title: Archsanctuary Closes To The Public
description: Due to the continued upheaval in Bergia, the Archpriest of Deyr has made the decision that the Archsanctuary, the most holy site of the Nurist religion, will no longer be holding public services. The building is currently surrounded by protective barricades and remains as yet unharmed.

name: Turn10_Erlory_ATO
title: ATO Modernises Sordland Airforce
description:
The airforce generals have been working tirelessly along with their ATO counterparts to modernise our airforce. The regiments training have been changed to include more maneuvering exercises as well as night time bombing training.

Our warplanes have been retrofitted with the latest technology radar systems and cutting-edge bombs transported from Arcasia. General Staff reports that the Sordish Airforce has never been in a better condition.

name: Turn10_Erlory_Coup
title: Air Force Issues Civilian Flight Warning
description: The Air Force has issued a warning against non-essential air travel. Civilians are discouraged from booking flights except in the case of business purposes or to visit sick or dying relatives.

name: Turn10_Erlory_ElectionVote_Petr_Shines
title: Vice President Vectern Shines during Campaign
description:
Our Vice President, Petr Vectern, has been hosting massive rallies trying to sway both the conservative and reformist voters while also trying to attract new undecided voters.

Fortunately, the great charisma of the VP has led to many new voters to flock to the USP, the VP is shining while expanding the potential voter base.

name: Turn10_Erlory_ElectionVote_Petr_Struggles
title: Vice President Vectern Struggles during Campaign
description:
Our Vice President, Petr Vectern, has been hosting rallies trying to sway both the conservative and reformist voters while also trying to attract new undecided voters.

Unfortunately, due to their close relationship with the administration and the unpopular reputation, the VP is struggling to draw in voters.

name: Turn10_Estord_DigDownAndDefend
title: Rumburg’s First Wave
description:
At 7.00, Rumburg launched their tactical bombers ready to bomb our trenches across the border.

Our fighters attempted to limit their bombers' effectiveness. Dogfights occurred in the sky as bombs dropped across the battlefield for several hours straight.

At 10.00, Rumburg initiated an all-out assault with their tank columns leading the attack. Our hulled-down tanks managed to barely hold the line, while our infantry fought in the trenches nearby supporting them.

name: Turn10_Estord_DigDownAndDefend_Lost
title: Rumburg’s First Wave - Conclusion
description:
After 3 hours of constant fighting the momentum of the Rumburg armies started to die down.

As General Valken was about to order an all-out assault to puncture Rumburg's defensive line at Crimsrad, news of our eastern front's collapse in Agnland arrived. Rumburgs military pressure started to mount up again following the event. 

As we were unable to send troops to support the eastern flank, the only option was to retreat all divisions back to Lachaven to avoid a full encirclement by the enemy.

name: Turn10_Estord_DigDownAndDefend_Victory
title: Rumburg’s First Wave - Conclusion
description:
After three hours of constant fighting, the momentum of the Rumburg armies started to die down.

General Kruger ordered an all-out assault to puncture their defensive line at Crimsrad. Before they could reorganize, Sordland's flag was already flying high in Crimsrad.

The news led to the collapse of Rumburg troop morale across the battle line. As we started gaining ground, Rumburg generals ordered a full retreat back to defend Tzarsbourgh to avoid a full collapse of the front, not realizing that our tanks and infantry were already assaulting Tzarsbourgh’s garrisons.

name: Turn10_Estord_PhaseTwoMeetings_Dome_Optimistic
title: Optimistic Phase Two Meeting
description:
Following the Sordish army’s successful invasion of Tzarsbourgh, our commanding officers held a meeting in the city itself to review the battle plans for the second phase of our military operation.

The meeting went well and the generals walked out of the room with an optimistic projection for the assault on Dome.

name: Turn10_Estord_PhaseTwoMeetings_Pessimistic
title: Loud Arguments In Phase Two Meeting
description:
Following the Sordish army’s successful invasion of Tzarsbourgh, our commanding officers held a meeting in the city itself to review the battle plans for the second phase of our military operation.

However, the meeting quickly devolved into loud arguments between the generals, who walked out of the room with somber faces and pessimistic projections.

name: Turn10_Estord_PhaseTwoMeetings_Thornbourgh_Optimistic
title: Phase Two Meeting
description:
Following the Sordish army’s successful invasion of Tzarsbourgh, our commanding officers held a meeting in the city itself to review the battle plans for the second phase of our military operation.

The meeting went well and the generals walked out of the room with an optimistic projection for the assault on Thornbourgh.

name: Turn10_Estord_Surrendered
title: Population Exchange Begins
description: As part of the new order to secede Estord to Rumburg, population exchange of Sordish and Rumburgian citizens has begun. Police forces were assigned to the city to prevent potential violent escalations.

name: Turn10_Estord_TheBattleOfEstord
title: Battle of Estord
description:
At 7.00 in the morning, the Rumburg armies marched into the city of Estord. The city was empty, its citizens having been evacuated days earlier. 

At 9.00, while the Rumburg armies were savaging and looting what was left of Estord, General Lancea sounded the signal for an all-out assault. At 12.45, our first wave clashed with their southern flank.

At 15.13, our pincer attack started to take shape as the eastern and western armies began to enclose the enemy. The intensive fighting happened both in the sky and on the ground throughout the night.

name: Turn10_Estord_TheBattleOfEstord_Lost
title: Battle of Estord - Conclusion
description:
At 4.00 following the day, Rumburg troops defending the eastern front of Estord routed. In that crucial moment, Rumburg's commander made a decision that changed the tide of the battle.He ordered all divisions to withdraw to the central area of the city.

At 11.00, as our troops pushed in the vicinity from all sides, the Rumburg general ordered all his men to do a full assault to the east to break out. We were caught off guard and by the time the other armies got to the eastern front, the fighting turned into a melee. 

They managed to break our eastern front and stopped our pincer. With their rear free of our soldiers, they turned around and commenced a full assault on our remaining armies.

name: Turn10_Estord_TheBattleOfEstord_Victory
title: Battle of Estord - Conclusion
description:
At 4.00 following the day, Rumburg troops defending the eastern front of Estord routed.

Our general commanding the army on the eastern side immediately signaled the victorious news to our headquarters and in the meantime telegraphed the news internationally and to all propaganda spies in Rumburg.

With their shattered eastern front, their flank was exposed and their supply lines were cut off. As we slowly gained ground, the Rumburg general capitulated.

At 14.00 on the same day, Sordland's flag was raised on top of Estord once again.

name: Turn10_Estord_TzarsbourghMarch
title: March Toward Tzarsbourgh
description:
At 7.00, we initiated an all-out bombing and artillery barrage across Rumburg’s line in Crimsrad and the logistic points between Crimsrad and Tzarsbourgh.

At 7.30, our planes were spotted in Estord. Rumburg launched their fighters as a countermeasure to our air assault. 

At 9.30, General Lancea ordered the first army to push through the enemy line into Crimsrad. Our tank divisions in the first army charged forward, facing the Rumburg tanks head-on with our infantry behind to support them.

name: Turn10_Estord_TzarsbourghMarch_Lost
title: March Toward Tzarsbourgh - Conclusion
description:
As our armies were about to reach a breakthrough of Rumburg's defensive line at Crimsrad, news of our eastern front's collapse in Agnland arrived. Rumburg military pressure started to mount up. 

Because we couldn't support the eastern flank, the only option at the time was to retreat all divisions back to Lachaven to avoid a full encirclement by the enemy. 

Unfortunately, as we retreated, we suffered a very high amount of casualties.

name: Turn10_Estord_TzarsbourghMarch_Victory
title: March Toward Tzarsbourgh - Conclusion
description:
With our tanks leading the charge, we managed to push through Rumburg’s defenses. Before Rumburg could respond to our offensive, Sordland's flag was flying high in Crimsrad.

The news of the fall of the city led to the collapse of Rumburg troop's morale across the battleline. As we started gaining ground, Rumburg generals ordered a full retreat back to defend Tzarsbourgh to avoid a full collapse of the front, not realizing that our tanks and infantry were already assaulting Tzarsbourgh’s garrisons.

name: Turn10_Estord_War
title: Hospitals and Schools Bombed in Estord
description:
Rumburg bombing runs began yesterday night. They have leveled most of the urban areas attacking hospitals and schools alike. There are many dead among the civilian populace. Local commanders report civilians and wounded children are inside their target areas.

We are sending more anti-air systems to Estord to defend the city but the local defences are heavily damaged.

name: Turn10_HODBansDeathPenalty
title: House of Delegates Bans Death Penalty
description:
A bill to ban death penalty was proposed by the RPP today in the House of Delegates, and passed into law by majority vote. 

The new law replaces capital punishment with life imprisonment, offering a second chance for reform and ensuring justice aligns with the principles of human dignity. Prisoners currently on death row will now serve life sentences under the updated legal framework.

name: Turn10_Holsord_AllianceOfNations_Begins
title: Schedule for the Alliance of Nations Session
description: We have received the schedule for the upcoming Alliance of Nations session. According to the dates outlined, Sordland One is being prepared for the flight to Konstantium, Kyrute. Minister of Foreign Affairs Deivid Wisci will be attending the session as well as accompanying Mr. President on the flight.

name: Turn10_Holsord_ANCondemsSordland
title: AN Ambassador Condemns Sordland
description: The AN Ambassador has strongly condemned us after the recent rhetorical escalation against the Alliance of Nations. Sordland has received a warning that the international community will not stand by while our nation is adding fuel to the fire.

name: Turn10_Holsord_ANSupportsSordland
title: AN Ambassador Supports Sordland
description: The AN Ambassador has extended their full support after the recent revelations about Rumburg on the international stage. Sordland has received a guarantee that the international community will stand by its territorial integrity and independence in these times. This boost the confidence of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

name: Turn10_Holsord_CongressCancelled
title: USP Congress Cancelled
description: In light of the encroaching war with Rumburg, the USP Congress will not happen this year. President Anton Rayne retains his position as party leader, and will represent United Sordland as a presidential candidate in the coming elections.

name: Turn10_Holsord_Coup
title: Military Assumes Interior Security Duties
description: With the new powers that it has been granted, the Sordish military has assumed responsibility for keeping peace within Sordland’s borders, overriding local police authority. Extra troops have been dispatched to Camp Strongarm to manage the growing unrest in Holsord.

name: Turn10_Holsord_ElectionVote_EmergencyExtended
title: Emergency Extended Votes
description: With the emergency still being active during the elections, our police will be monitoring the voting procedures very closely to ensure the right votes are cast. The security forces will ensure that only the rightly 'eligible' and 'legal' votes can be cast at the ballot.

name: Turn10_Holsord_Mobilization
title: Nationwide Mobilization Order
description: A nationwide mobilization order has been issued to reinforce our manpower pool. New recruits will be mostly serving as reserves but we will prepare for the worst case scenario. Approximately one million men have been recruited so far and they will begin their accelerated training immediately.

name: Turn10_Holsord_MoneyTransfer
title: Money Transfer Completed
description: The Bank of Kyrute is happy to inform you that the transfer of your personal assets has completed successfully. It will take approximately 30 business days for the amount to be withdrawable in local territory. Thank you for choosing BoK.

name: Turn10_Holsord_NuclearWeapons
title: Existence of Nuclear Weapons in Rumburg Confirmed
description:
AN intelligence has confirmed that the information from the Rumburgian whistleblower was true. Rumburg does have nuclear weapons capable of threatening Sordland and Eastern Merkopa.

The Alliance of Nations ratified a barrage of sanctions on Rumburg by the member states.

name: Turn10_Holsord_Railway_LespiaArmyTransportation
title: Morale Surges As Lespian Armies Depart Holsord
description:
Jubilant Sordish citizens in Holsord saw off hundreds of thousands Lespian soldiers and armored vehicles as they departed on the L-1-Railway to the Estord frontline.

Recordings and news of the massive, technologically advanced force have emboldened the morale of our soldiers as well as the war support of our citizens.

name: Turn10_Holsord_USPCongress
title: USP Congress Called
description: With the now ex-Interior Minister Lileas Graf challenging President Anton Rayne following her resignation, a congress has been called at which members of the USP will determine the party’s future leadership. At the Grand National Assembly, both Graf and Rayne will make speeches, after which the votes will be cast.

name: Turn10_Iza_AttemptsToBringTogetherGroups
title: RPP Reaches Out To Religious Groups
description: Following the deadly rioting that targeted religious minorities in Rizia, a local RPP branch in Iza has attempted to mend the rift, bringing together securalists, Wruhecists and various minorities to redirect their anger towards the central government instead of towards each other.

name: Turn10_Iza_ConstitutionCelebration_ManusPM
title: Iza Erupts In Celebration As Manus Named PM
description: The diverse city of Iza has seen overnight scenes of celebration, with many in the traditional RPP stronghold celebrating the inauguration of Manus Sazon as the first Prime Minister of the country. For the first time in a long time, many ethnic and religious minorities feel like their voice is represented in government.

name: Turn10_Iza_HODLargeProtest
title: Iza Demonstrations Quelled After Intense Stand-Off
description: In Iza, thousands flooded the main square, chanting against the king's plans for the House of Delegates. The protest became difficult to manage, but law enforcement eventually dispersed the crowd after prolonged efforts.

name: Turn10_Iza_HODSmallProtest
title: Protests in Iza Dissolved Within an Hour
description: In Iza, a brief protest broke out in the main square, chanting against the king's plans for the House of Delegates. Law enforcement responded swiftly, dispersing the crowd with minimal resistance.

name: Turn10_Iza_ManusExecuted
title: Rioting As Iza Commemorates Manus Sazon
description: Riots broke out in Iza following the announcement that Manus Sazon was executed. Supporters of the Rizian People's Party, who long held the hope that the Sazon would bring about change, attacked police stations and other symbols of Royal power.

name: Turn10_Iza_ReligiousRiots
title: Golcondist And Dastnurist Businesses Destroyed
description:
Scores of Golcondist- and Dastnurist-owned businesses, often run by immigrants from Derdia and Wehlen, have been destroyed by religious demonstrators, blaming the country's woes on heretic influences from abroad. At least eight people have been reportedly killed as certain shop owners resisted, but they were no match for the religious fervor.

Reportedly, Su Omina members eagerly joined in on the rioting. Eventually, law enforcement restored order, announcing swift trials for those arrested.

name: Turn10_Iza_ReligiousRiotsGuardians
title: Golcondist And Dastnurist Businesses Destroyed
description:
Scores of Golcondist and Dastnurist-owned businesses, often run by immigrants from Derdia and Wehlen, have been destroyed by religious demonstrators, blaming the country's woes on heretic influences from abroad. At least twenty people have been reportedly killed as certain shop owners resisted, but they were no match for the religious fervor. 

The Wruhec’s Guardians stationed in the city helped coordinate the attacks, providing lists of foreign-owned businesses to the demonstrators and ensuring law enforcement stayed away from the violence. Reportedly, Su Omina members eagerly joined in on the rioting.

name: Turn10_Iza_RentIncreases
title: Iza Landlords Up Rents
description: Profiting from the housing subsidies granted by the Crown to poor families, landowners in Iza have started rapidly increasing rents, draining the royal coffers in the process. Due to the acute housing crisis gripping Iza, tenants often have no choice but to accept these rent increases.

name: Turn10_Iza_RicoExecuted
title: Su Omina Torch Parade In Honor Of Rico
description: Hundreds of Su Omina members marched through Iza at night time, torches lit in honor of Rico Toras, who many once considered to be one of them. About one hour in, security forces loyal to the Crown broke up the parade, on the grounds that all commemorations for traitors to the Kingdom is forbidden.

name: Turn10_Jen_Unrest_Violent
title: Peaceful Protest Turns Violent
description: What was supposed to be a peaceful demonstration in downtown Jen turned violent as a number of participants brought weapons, leading to bloody clashes between protesters and counter-protestors. Several bystanders were caught in the crossfire; the number of wounded is not yet known.

name: Turn10_Kyrute_BankWelcomesAccount
title: Presidents Finances Welcomed in Kyrute
description: The Republic of Kyrute and its banking sector warmly welcome President Anton Rayne's decision to transfer personal finances to our trusted institutions. This act further solidifies the financial relationship between Kyrute and Sordland, and the Chancellor extends assurance of utmost security and confidentiality regarding these assets.

name: Turn10_Kyrute_PeaceTreaty
title: Kyrute Welcomes Peace
description: The Republic of Kyrute has welcomed the peace treaty in Pales, calling for a swift resumption of regular civilian life. The country highlights the need for reconciliation between Palesians and Rizians after all the destruction that’s been caused.

name: Turn10_Lachaven_Coup
title: Navy Oversees Import and Export Flow
description: Under the orders of the military, naval corps are being transferred from the Conriat Naval Base to the Port of Lachaven in order to better oversee the flow of imports and exports into and out of Sordland.

name: Turn10_Lachaven_DebatePrep
title: Presidential Debate Prep in Lachaven
description: The debate between the candidates in the next Sordish presidential election is slated to take place tomorrow evening at the Sordish Broadcasting Corporation headquarters in Lachaven. It will be broadcast live on television, and several million households are expected to tune in.

name: Turn10_Lachaven_ElectionVote_Albin_Consolidates
title: Vice President Clavin Consolidates Reformist Base
description:
Due to our reformist policies, a large majority of USP reformist voters said that they would likely vote for president Rayne.

In addition, our Vice President, Albin Clavin, has been hosting rallies trying to consolidate their support. Unfortunately, they are only the minority in USP so we may have to look for more votes elsewhere.

name: Turn10_Lachaven_ElectionVote_WalterTusk
title: Walter Tusk Endorsed President Rayne
description: Sordish businessman, Walter Tusk, has officially endorsed us to be the next President of Sordland in the upcoming 57' election. With Mr.Tusk's wide-ranging connections and power, we can expect more business owners and pro-economy citizens to vote for us.

name: Turn10_Lachaven_LackOfSupplies
title: Our Frontlines Request More Supply
description: Our generals in the front line are requesting more ammunition, grenades, and medical equipment on the front line. According to their reports, our troops are barely holding the line and some of our soldiers can't even shoot back due to the lack of ammunition. Our Artillery units have to fire selectively which caused a big rift between our generals on where should our focus be. Unfortunately, we are straining our resources and won't have enough to support the entire front line.

name: Turn10_Lachaven_Lespia_AirWings
title: Lespian Airforce Soar in Sordish Sky
description:
A flurry of activity in the skies above Lachaven is invigorating the region's military readiness. Our strategic allies from Lespia have dispatched their renowned air wings to our military airfields, executing daily drills as they prepare for the prospect of conflict. The state-of-the-art aircraft flown by these experienced pilots paint a formidable image of air supremacy. 

The spectacle is not merely a testament to our military preparedness; it has also become a profound morale booster for our ground troops. The presence of these skilled Lespian aviators signals strong ally support and deepens the resolve of our military personnel.

name: Turn10_Lachaven_SufficientSupplies
title: Our Generals Express Their Gratitude
description: Our Generals sent us their deepest gratitude for our excellent administrative work on the home front. Our artillery units are continuously shelling the enemy without concern over ammunition. Thanks to the continuous supply of medical equipment, we have minimized the number of casualties. They were able to initiate continuous assaults due to the successes of the home front.

name: Turn10_Lachaven_Unrest_Violent
title: Republic Avenue Looted
description: As violent protests continue throughout Sordland, authorities in Lachaven are reporting out-of-control looting at the shops along Republic Avenue, with multiple windows broken and high-value items stolen.

name: Turn10_Lachaven_ValgslandArrivedInLachaven
title: Valgsland Armies Arrived in Lachaven
description:
The mayor of Lachaven has reported that Valgslandian transport ships have docked at the port and their troops are moving to the frontline. However, certain citizens have displayed animosity towards the Valgslandian soldiers.

Fortunately, no violence has occurred during the deployment of the troops.

name: Turn10_Laren_War
title: Rumburg War Crimes
description:
In the places Rumburg soldiers managed to break our defense, there have been atrocious reports of war crimes. These reports outline death marches on the dislocated civilian populations and mistreatment of prisoners.

According to a field commander they do not fight like a regular army. Reports of new chemical weapons have been sent over to Holsord. The war crimes will be reported to the international community for the whole world to see.

name: Turn10_Lespia_ArmyReady
title: Lespia’s Army Stands Ready
description: The Republic of Lespia reaffirms its steadfast dedication to the alliance with Sordland. The Lespian Armed Forces remain prepared to stand in solidarity with our allies in any challenge that may arise. Should Sordland seek Lespia's support, our nation will respond without hesitation.

name: Turn10_Lespia_RustyExecuted
title: Lespia Laments Loss Of Great Businessman
description: Lespia has formally sent their condolences to the family of Rusty Montoro, claiming the death of a talented businessman like him is ‘rather tragic’ and a ‘great loss to global capital’.

name: Turn10_Lespia_UrgeCalm
title: Lespia Urges Calm
description: The Republic of Lespia hereby reiterates commitment to peace in Eastern Merkopa. The tensions between Rumburg and Sordland have to be prevented to escalate further. We are strongly urging calm in the region.

name: Turn10_Lespia_WarAllied
title: Lespian Army on its Way
description: The Lespian military command joined with the Sordish military command. Latest reports are indicating that their armored and mechanized divisions are on their way to support the 1st Army.

name: Turn10_Monqiz_HODLargeProtest
title: Monqiz Demonstrators Dispersed After Prolonged Protest
description: In Monqiz, a large-scale protest erupted, with demonstrators occupying key intersections to oppose the king’s plans for the House of Delegates. The gathering proved difficult to quell, but authorities managed to disperse the crowd after several tense hours.

name: Turn10_Monqiz_HODSmallProtest
title: Quick Resolution to Monqiz Protests Following King's Decision
description: Protests in Monqiz erupted in opposition to the king’s plans for the House of Delegates, but the gathering was quickly contained and disbanded by local law enforcement.

name: Turn10_Monqiz_HugoExecuted
title: Halls Of Monqiz Palace Quiet
description: An eerie quiet has fallen over Monqiz’ Toras palace, with many saddened by the execution of Hugo Toras, who almost everyone in the Palace had some sort of personal connection to. Footsteps are the only remaining sound that echoes through the great hallways.

name: Turn10_Montaklar_AzaroExecuted
title: Azaros Hold Vigil For Fallen Family Members
description: The Azaro’s have held a small military parade in Montaklar, officially to honor ‘all dead family members’. While the parade didn’t mention recent executions to avoid Royal repression, the matter was on everyone's minds.

name: Turn10_Montaklar_CrownRules
title: Montaklar Transitions to Direct Crown Rule
description:
The province of Cardesse-Montaklar, long recognized for its military strength and industrial significance, has been formally placed under the direct authority of the Crown. With this shift, House Azaro has relinquished its royal estates and titles.

As part of the transition, portraits of King Romus and the Royal Family have replaced those of the Azaro leadership in Montaklar City Hall, symbolizing the new governance. Additionally, Camp Domus, Rizia's primary military base, has been renamed Camp Romus, reflecting the province’s new allegiance.

name: Turn10_Montaklar_GuardiansDeployed
title: Wruhec’s Guardians Preventively Close Minority Shops
description:
To prevent religious-inspired rioting causing large scale property damage and deaths, Wruhec’s Guardians stationed in Montaklar have preventively closed all shops owned by non Wruhecists in the city indefinitely. 

Despite initial protest by Montaklar’s significant Golcondist community against the measure, many shop owners have started leaving the city, facing no other choice than to look for employment elsewhere.

name: Turn10_Montaklar_HODLargeProtest
title: Massive Montaklar Protest Dispersed After Hours of Resistance
description: Montaklar saw a massive turnout as citizens marched through the streets in defiance of the king’s decision regarding the House of Delegates. Despite facing resistance, authorities eventually restored order.

name: Turn10_Montaklar_HODSmallProtest
title: Montaklar Protests Short-Lived as Authorities Intervene
description: In Montaklar, protesters gathered in response to the king's recent decision regarding the House of Delegates, though the demonstration was brief, with authorities dispersing the group swiftly and without incident.

name: Turn10_Montaklar_HousesUnite
title: House Azaro Restores Order
description:
In the wake of the riots in Montaklar, House Azaro has swiftly reinforced security by deploying additional forces to key locations. 

General Carlos Robles Azaro has assured citizens that stability will be maintained, with curfews and military patrols to prevent further unrest. 
Local authorities report that government functions continue uninterrupted and that daily life remains unaffected. 

Businesses have been advised to follow security measures as tensions ease.

name: Turn10_Montaklar_PalesTreatyAzaro
title: Azaro’s Celebrate Acquiring Pales
description: The Azaro’s have hailed the acquisition of Pales into their territory, as the Royal House becomes the first one to control two distinct provinces. The family expressly thanked King Romus, as Azaro forces were dispatched to install order in the newly acquired region.

name: Turn10_Morella_PeaceTreaty
title: Morella Calls For Quick Return Of Those Displaced
description: Morella has welcomed the signed peace treaty and is now calling for a quick return home for those who fled the conflict. The country is hosting many thousands of refugees and while it has accepted them graciously, it is also keen on them returning home now that the conflict is over.

name: Turn10_Morna_ElectionVote_PublicOpinon_Average
title: Election Poll Results
description: With the election drawing near, our staff at the Maroon Palace has conducted general election polls all across Sordland. Our election polls show that roughly 27% of Sordish citizens would prefer to vote for the USP in the upcoming election.

name: Turn10_Nanta_WehzeksProtest
title: Wehzeks Protest Return To Rizia
description: The Wehzek minority in Nanta, one of the largest in the Zille region, has organized a protest against the city’s return to Rizia. Local Wehzek leaders claimed the social standing of Wehzeks has significantly reduced since we assumed control.

name: Turn10_Narbel_Surrendered
title: Arson Attacks in Narbel
description: Sordish citizens in Narbel started protesting the forced relocation following the order. Rumburgian flags were burned and during the increasingly violent protests, arson attacks occurred all over the city. Firefighters are attending the scenes.

name: Turn10_Narbel_War
title: Rumburg Artillery Targets Destroyed
description:
We stopped the continuous shelling of Narbel by Rumburgian artillery. Yesterday night, our artillery brigades have targeted their locations and destroyed their heavy weaponry in a counter-artillery strike.

Our division will take this opportunity and attempt a breakthrough to create a pocket to trap the enemy tanks. Vectern Sis Da!

name: Turn10_Narbel_WehlenWarCrimes
title: Wehlen set Lards and Dateford in flames
description:
Reports are coming in that Wehzek soldiers have committed atrocities on their march through Narbel, specifically in the encampments where large numbers of Bludish and Rumburgian refugees from Lards and Datefort are housed.

Assault, looting and other violent acts are among the rumored war crimes.

name: Turn10_NewGov_Epic_KingsWall_B
title: The King's Wall
description: The wall began as a network of barbed wire and makeshift barriers but is now being reinforced with concrete and watchtowers. Movement is heavily restricted, with crowds gathering on both sides, many attempting to flee before the final sections are completed.

name: Turn10_Pales_ChemicalCleanup
title: Military Engineers Leading Chemical Cleanup
description: Our army’s military engineer corps is overseeing the cleanup of Pales, ensuring that any traces of the nerve gas we unleashed on the city are dealt with and to safeguard the civilian population against possible unintended further exposure.

name: Turn10_Pales_Peace
title: Vina Greeted To Massive Crowds Amidst Unification Celebration
description:
Princess Vina appeared on the balcony of Castle Reinhart, together with her husband Axel, to thunderous applause from the hundreds of thousands that gathered in the Palesian capital to celebrate their countries unification with Rizia. 

In the coming days, Vina and Axel will visit more Palesian cities together, showcasing the newly found unity between Rizia and Pales.

name: Turn10_Pales_War
title: Army Maintains Order At Parade
description: Any attempts of meaningful protest to our victory parade has been handled by military police units stationed in the former Palesian capital. While Palesian opposition to our victory has largely been broken, small sectors of society still show willingness to resist our rule, necessitating preventive arrest to prevent a threat to public security.

name: Turn10_PeaceTreaty_Bronaz
title: Vigil For The Fallen
description: Thousands have gathered in Bronaz, at the Blua Monte, the largest military cemetery in the country, to commemorate those fallen in the Pales war. The mood was very gloomy, with almost every family in the country knowing someone who was either injured or killed in the conflict. At the cemetery, over 23,000 soldiers are buried in sober, white coloured graves.

name: Turn10_Plavo_SalExecuted
title: Police Disperse Prayer For Sal
description: A small prayer held at the Plavo sanctuary to commemorate Wiscerer Sal Ignacius, who was executed for being a traitor to the Crown, has been dispersed by our security forces. Currently, gatherings commemorating executed traitors are considered illegal, as they risk undermining the authority of the King’s decision.

name: Turn10_PorteDrazon_ConstitutionCelebration
title: Thousands Celebrate New Constitution
description: Pro democracy campaigners from across the political spectrum gathered in Porte Drazon, celebrating the signing of the new constitution, with a large rally held outside the House of Delegates. Speakers of both the RPP and RNC were present at the rally, a rare show of unity in support of a constitutional Rizia.

name: Turn10_PorteDrazon_Decision_NationalDestabilization_Abdicate
title: Largest Demonstration In Rizian History
description: Nearly three and a half million people marched in Porte Drazon against our reign, making it the largest demonstration in Rizian history. A jubilant mood was reported as the announcement of our abdication reached the protestors.

name: Turn10_PorteDrazon_HODLargeProtest
title: Porte Drazon Protests Disbanded After Hours of Tension
description: In Porte Drazon, a large crowd gathered outside the palace gates to protest the king’s decision regarding the future of the House of Delegates after its closure. Authorities struggled to contain the demonstration, but after several hours, the protest was finally disbanded.

name: Turn10_PorteDrazon_HODSmallProtest
title: Minor Protest Quickly Quelled in Porte Drazon
description: In Porte Drazon, a small but vocal protest formed near the king’s residence following his decision regarding the future of the House of Delegates after its closure.

name: Turn10_PorteDrazon_LucitaMiscarriage
title: Lucita Azaro Suffers Miscarriage In Prison
description:
Disgraced Duchess and former Queen Consort Lucita Azaro was rushed to the hospital from Porte Drazon Citadel late last night after experiencing heavy bleeding. Once there, it was determined that the three-month-old fetus she was carrying had been lost, most likely stemming from the stress of imprisonment.

Azaro herself is in stable condition.

name: Turn10_PorteDrazon_WorshippersMarchOnCapital_Destabilisation
title: Half A Million Wruhecists Descend On Capital
description:
The religious march on Porte Drazon is finally complete, with nearly half a million worshippers flooding the squares and boulevards of the city, where they now intend to stay indefinitely. 

Riots have broken out as the religious demonstrators attacked other protestors, unsuccessfully attempting to disperse republican and socialist oriented enemies of the state. Several casualties have been reported.

name: Turn10_PorteDrazon_WorshippersMarchOnCapital_GuardiansDestabilisation
title: Half A Million Wruhecists Descend On Capital
description:
The religious march on Porte Drazon is finally complete, with nearly half a million worshippers flooding the squares and boulevards of the city, where they now intend to stay indefinitely. 

Riots have broken out as the religious demonstrators attacked other protestors, with the Wruhec’s Guardians helping them in dispersing republican and socialist oriented enemies of the state. Several casualties have been reported.

name: Turn10_PorteDrazon_WorshippersMarchOnCapital_Peaceful
title: Half A Million Wruhecists Descend On Capital
description: The religious march on Porte Drazon is finally complete, with nearly a quarter of a million worshippers flooding the squares and boulevards of the city. As they made their point, the demonstrators have now begun their journey home, leaving the city behind as a tranquil oasis of peace.

name: Turn10_Qalus_Decision_ValenqirisEnvironmentalCrisis_OutputFalls
title: Wine Production Falls As Environmental Crisis Worsens
description: Due to inaction by the Government, wine production is taking more and more of a hit as the environmental crisis gripping Valenqiris worsens. Grapevines are unable to extract enough healthy nutrients from the poisoned soil, as increasing amounts of plants continue to die off.

name: Turn10_Qalus_Decision_ValenqirisEnvironmentalCrisis_RankingRestored
title: Grape Quality Ranking Recovers
description: Thanks to diligent efforts by the administration, viticultural experts have restored the previously downgraded grape ranking to its original rank. The measures taken by the government seem to be paying off, as groundwater pollutants are down and nature is starting to recover.

name: Turn10_Remaz_ChemicalCleanup
title: Military Engineers Leading Chemical Cleanup
description: Our army’s military engineer corps is overseeing the cleanup of Remaz, ensuring that any traces of the nerve gas we unleashed on the city are dealt with and to safeguard the civilian population against possible unintended further exposure.

name: Turn10_Remaz_Peace01
title: Unity Column Erected On Grand Market Square
description: A large unity column is being built on Remaz’ grand market square, to celebrate the unification of Pales and Rizia. The column bears the insignia of all Rizian royal houses, including that of the Reinharts, with a golden Toras bull adorning the top.

name: Turn10_Remaz_Peace02
title: Vina And Axel Finish Tour In Front Of Unity Column
description: Vina and Axel have finished their grand unity tour of Pales in Remaz, the province’s second largest city. The couple unveiled the newly constructed victory column to enthusiastic cheers from the crowds.

name: Turn10_Remaz_War
title: Rebuilding Efforts Underway
description:
Efforts to rebuild Remaz, Pales’ second largest city, after the brutal siege are underway. At the center of the reconstruction process is a new Toras Column, complete with golden bull at the top, being built on the grand market square. 

Slowly, civilians displaced because of the war have started returning to the city.

name: Turn10_Report_GRACE_Decision_Unification_Agree
title: GRACE Congratulates Us On Reunification
description: The GRACE organization has extended its congratulations for the imminent ascension of Pales to our Kingdom, pointing to the increasing strength of a regional monarchy as a positive development.

name: Turn10_Report_Intermerkopum_PeaceTreaty_Win
title: Intermerkopum Members Congratulate Us On Pales Victory
description: Our fellow members in the Intermerkopum Alliance have sent an official statement congratulating us on our victory against Pales, calling it a “turning point for regional power in South Merkopa.” They added that Intermerkopum remains committed to standing by Rizia, whatever threats we may face.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_DrillResources
title: Zille Developement Project
description: Rizia has declared Zille’s resource-rich lands a national development project. Industrial teams are assessing resource extraction sites while local environmental groups protest potential ecological damage.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_ApplyATO
title: Path to ATO Integration
description: Rizia's application for membership in the ATO has been received, putting us on the road to candidate status. This move is seen as a step toward bolstering national security and reinforcing strategic alliances on the international stage.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_ApplyCSP
title: CSP Membership Denied, Diplomacy Continues
description: Rizia's application for membership in the CSP was rejected, citing concerns over political alignment and economic compatibility. Despite this setback, officials emphasize that diplomatic efforts will continue to strengthen regional ties through alternative partnerships.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_Armada
title: Rizian Armada
description: Rizia announced the formation of a modern navy, featuring aircraft carriers and jet-powered naval aviation. Expansion of Monqiz Port and Naval Shipyard has boosted the local economy, though the program remains in its early stages.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_BondScheme
title: Sovereign Bonds Backlash
description: The issuance of "Sovereign Bonds" with no repayment plan has triggered severe public discontent. Citizens are frustrated by the financial strain imposed on them, leading to protests and demands for transparency. The initiative has failed to gain support and is being met with increasing resistance.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_CrownRestoration
title: Crown Restoration Pact
description: Rizia's launch of the Crown Restoration Pact to provide diplomatic and financial backing to pro-monarchy movements in unstable republics has earned strong support from GRACE members and Rizian loyalists.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_CurrencyChaos
title: Zille Currency Crisis
description: By refusing to recognize Zille’s new currency and flooding its markets with Rizian guilders, Rizia has destabilized the local economy. Smolak’s government is in turmoil, while rural areas increasingly rely on barter systems.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_DemilitarizedZone
title: Demilitarized Zone
description: A neutral border zone was established for trade and diplomacy between Rizia and Pales. While tensions remain high, the initiative is largely seen as a success by both populations.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_DrillResources_Rizia
title: Mass Excavation Project
description: The preliminary survey to assess the nation’s resources uncovered thorium deposits west of Iza. This discovery has sparked interest in nuclear energy, with the potential to significantly enhance Rizia’s energy independence and future economic growth.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_GreatWallOfSound
title: Wall of Sound
description: Massive speakers along the Rizian-Zille border now blast patriotic Rizian music at high volumes. Local leaders condemn the act, while reports surfaced of wildlife disruption and hearing damage among border guards.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_GulfOfRizia
title: Gulf of Rizia Renaming
description: Rizia has officially renamed the Gulf of Moridia to the "Gulf of Rizia" to reflect its dominance in the region. The decision has sparked outrage from Derdia, Morella, and Wehlen, who refuse to recognize the change.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_IndependentZilleAlliance
title: Alliance with Zille Draws Mixed Reactions
description: The decision to accept an alliance with the newly independent Zille has sparked mixed reactions. Critics warn of security risks and economic strain, while supporters highlight strengthened regional ties. A newly agreed-upon open border is expected to boost trade and mobility.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_KingsWall_A
title: The King's Wall
description: Construction of the King’s Wall has begun, symbolizing strength and unity under the Crown. The grand fortification is designed to solidify border defenses, deter external threats, and reinforce Rizia’s sovereignty.

name: Turn10_ReportNewGov_Epic_MandatoryStock
title: Public Backlash Over Mandatory Stock Investments
description: Rizia's introduction of mandatory stock investments has sparked public outrage, leading to widespread protests. Despite the financial losses, some investors continue to buy shares, trusting the long-standing stability of the monarchy and its economic influence.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_MilitaryIndComplex
title: National Militarization Initiative
description: Rizia’s investment into transforming its military capabilities continues with the expansion of strategic bases and the finalization of contracts for advanced weaponry. There have been limited protests regarding the potential economic strain and rising tensions, while supporters see the expansion as essential for national security.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_OperationSanctuary
title: Operation Sanctuary
description: Rizia's campaign to support Zillian refugees and resistance members has led thousands of families to cross the border, with temporary camps now established in Sallebus and Mave Nortus.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_PalesDualCitizenship
title: Reinhart Praises Dual Citizenship Decision
description: Our decision to grant Palesian citizens the ability to apply for Rizian passports has been met with praise by Duke Reinhart. The Palesian monarch emphasizes that although reunification between our nations is not an option, he wishes to maintain close ties and foster a spirit of mutual respect. The Rizian Ministry of Internal Affairs has outlined a phased implementation plan for the passport program, initially focusing on applicants with existing family connections, professional exchanges, or proven Rizian descent, eventually extended to anyone with Palesian citizenship.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_PalesRail
title: Pales Officials Welcome New Railway Announcement
description: Our decision to construct a high-speed railway between the Rizian and Palesian capitals has been warmly welcomed by the Pales provincial council. Key figures have emphasized the railway’s potential to boost trade, tourism, and labor mobility, while reducing travel time between the two capitals to under four hours. Construction is set to begin in the fourth quarter of this year,

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_ReclaimRiziaMorella
title: Preparations for Greater Pales Conquest
description: Military mobilization has begun as Rizia prepares to expand its control over all of Greater Pales, including territories currently held by Morella.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_RedistributeEstates
title: The People's Land Act
