description: Elite-owned estates are being redistributed to common citizens, sparking condemnation from the upper class but celebration among lower-class Rizians who gain land ownership. As some wealthy families flee the kingdom, newly empowered citizens invest in local businesses, driving regional economic growth.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_Renaissance_Art
title: Royal Patronage Initiative
description: The Royal Patronage program has ignited a cultural renaissance, beginning with the revitalization of Old Town’s public spaces. This marks the first of many efforts to invest in art and architecture, preserving Rizia’s heritage while shaping its future.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_Renaissance_Science
title: Royal Patronage Initiative
description: The monarchy has directed royal patronage toward advancing cancer research, with substantial funding allocated to research institutions. This kingdom-wide focus aims to foster groundbreaking treatments and establish Rizia as a leader in the fight against cancer, benefiting both the nation and the world.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_RoyalCharityFund
title: Royal Charity Fund
description: A portion of the Royal Charity Fund has been allocated to civil projects, including infrastructure improvements in rural areas and the expansion of public healthcare facilities. Public expectations for further large-scale projects remain high.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_RoyalReclamation_Loss
title: Pales Reclamation Day
description: A new national holiday, Pales Reclamation Day, has been declared to honor Rizian resilience and reaffirm their claim to lost lands. While widely celebrated, the declaration sparks debate over future territorial ambitions.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_RoyalReclamation_Won
title: Preparations Begin for New Holiday
description: Pales City Hall has already begun preparations for next year's inaugural {RiziaDLCText.NewPalesHoliday}, a holiday established to emphasize the historical bond and present-day unity between the Palesian and Rizian people. The celebrations are expected to include a military parade and fireworks over the Pales harbor.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_RoyalSummit
title: Monumental Carving on Monte Alzorria
description: Monte Alzorria, a towering mountain near Porte Drazon, has been selected for the monumental carving of Rizia's greatest monarchs. Preparations are underway, with the renowned sculptor Julian Arizkun, who is based out of the University of Iza, leading the project.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_RoyalWaste
title: Royal Waste Initiative
description: Thousands of balloons filled with Rizian garbage and manure were sent into Pales as a symbolic "tribute." Protests have erupted across Pales, with citizens expressing their outrage at the blatant insult and unsanitary conditions caused by the debris.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_RoyalWaste_Topes
title: Royal Waste Initiative Fallout
description: As a result of the Royal Waste Initiative, strong winds have redirected many balloons back into Rizian territory, littering towns as far as Topes. Outraged locals have condemned the fiasco, demanding accountability for the mess and the foul stench now plaguing their communities.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_SkySilkRoad
title: The Sky Silk Road
description: As part of its initiative to expand global trade, Rizia has signed a contract for the construction of a new cargo plane fleet with Crown Air, based in Jales. This partnership will strengthen economic corridors and expand international logistics capabilities.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_StockPurchase
title: Stock Purchase Initiative Backlash
description: The national decree requiring all citizens to invest in the Porte Drazon Stock Exchange has led to widespread public outrage. The forced financial participation has sparked massive protests, with many questioning the fairness of the initiative and its potential long-term impact on their livelihoods.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_StockPurchase_
title: Protests Sparked by Sovereign Bonds
description: Rizia's issuance of "Sovereign Bonds," with no repayment plan, has sparked public outrage and fueled mass protests. However, some investors persist in purchasing bonds, relying on the monarchy's proven track record of stability and financial strength.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_TaxForeignBiz
title: The People's Dividend
description: Rizia’s tax on foreign businesses has been met with hostility from international partners, leading several corporations to withdraw from the market. Despite this, the policy remains popular domestically, providing a boost to personal income and improving the standard of living for citizens.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Epic_TidalGenerator
title: Taming the Tides
description: Rizia has completed scouting locations for tidal generators and settled on a site south of Monqiz to harness ocean energy. While environmentalists have raised concerns about potential impacts on marine life, the project has garnered strong public support for its promise of renewable energy.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_GreatResettlement
title: The Great Resettlement
description: The offer to relocate thousands of loyal Rizian families to Zille resulted in an overwhelming response, forcing authorities to halt applications once capacity limits were reached.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Intermerkopum_MutualDefense
title: Intermerkopum Mutual Defense Pact Approval
description: Despite concerns about escalating tensions with ATO and CSP, the Intermerkopum mutual defense pact was deemed essential for regional security and received unanimous approval from member nations.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_Intermerkopum_OpenApplications
title: Unanimous Approval for Intermerkopum Membership
description: Despite some reservations about potential sovereignty risks, the decision to open Intermerkopum membership applications received unanimous approval, primarily driven by the goal of strengthening international alliances and securing Rizia’s position on the global stage.

name: Turn10_Report_NewGov_SmolakReef
title: Smolak Reef Initiative
description: The decision to remove dozens of Smolak’s statues and submerge them in the Gulf of Moridia to create artificial reefs has met widespread approval from the Zillian public.

name: Turn10_Rumburg_Declaration
title: Proclamation of War
description: In order to address the decades-long atrocities committed by Sordland once and for all, effective immediately, Her Majesty Queen Beatrice Livingston declares that a state of war exists in between the Kingdom of Rumburg and Sordland.

name: Turn10_Rumburg_PeaceTreaty_Win
title: Queen Beatrice Extends Congratulations
description: Queen Beatrice has congratulated us on our victory against Pales, calling it a “turning point for monarchical power in Merkopa”. She added that Rumburg remains committed to standing by Rizia, whatever threats we may face.

name: Turn10_Rumburg_RejectedSurrender
title: Rumburg Closes All Diplomatic Channels
description: Rumburg closed all diplomatic channels with Sordland and blocked all incoming and outgoing communication. Our intelligence and army reports that the troop movements in the border are indicating a preparation for an invasion.

name: Turn10_Sallabes_ManusWarHero
title: Sazon Heir Hailed As War Hero In Homecoming Ceremony
description:
A grand ceremony at Arena Sallabes honored the Sazon special divisions for their contributions to our victory in the Pales War.

In particular, Manus Sazon received a medal and the honorary rank of Lieutenant Commander for helping the Sazon forces make it through the conflict with minimal casualties.

name: Turn10_Sallabes_UnderCrownAuthority
title: Brenas Under Crown Authority
description:
Following the Crown's assumption of control over Brenas, House Sazon has officially relinquished its royal estates and titles.  

Among the adjustments, the fashion house Countess Colors, originally founded by Leona Sazon, has been renamed His Majesty's Colors reflecting its new royal affiliation.

name: Turn10_Sallabes_UniteOfHouses
title: House Sazon Quells Resistance
description:
In response to civil unrest, House Sazon has moved swiftly to reassert control over Brenas. Increased patrols and strategic raids on dissenters have stabilized the region, with Countess Leona Sazon focusing on the importance of unity. 

Reports indicate that disruptions to commerce have been minimal, and city officials are ensuring that order has been fully restored.

name: Turn10_Solles_ChemicalCleanup
title: Military Engineers Leading Chemical Cleanup
description: Our army’s military engineer corps is overseeing the cleanup of Solles, ensuring that any traces of the nerve gas we unleashed on the city are dealt with and to safeguard the civilian population against possible unintended further exposure.

name: Turn10_Solles_Peace
title: Gulf Of Pales Turns Into Sea Of Colour
description: In a sight reminiscent of the Galmish revolutionary fishing boat parades, the Gulf of Pales has filled with ships waving Rizian, Palesian and House Toras banners to celebrate the newly found unity between our people, turning into a sea of color. Thousands of onlookers gathered at the waterfront in Solles to witness the spectacle.

name: Turn10_Solles_War
title: Attempted Uprising Quelled
description:
An attempted uprising by Reinhart loyalists, who remained in hiding ever since the war ended, has been successfully defeated by Rizian armed forces still present in the city. The lightly armed group attempted to unsuccessfully seize the harbor, hoping to allow a ship of their exiled comrades to moor.

Unfortunately, our army could not prevent vandals from spraying anti-Rizian graffiti around town amidst the chaos, reading "from the Alca river to the Antacean sea, Pales will be free!". Authorities have commenced a cleanup operation.

name: Turn10_Unrest_RevolutionaryEscalation
title: Jales Falls
description: The city of Jales has become the latest urban center to be overtaken by the growing protest movement, its noble governors ousted and replaced by a so-called 'revolutionary council'. The recent surge of aggression, marked by the destruction of property and threats to public safety, represents a significant threat to the stability of our kingdom. Our security forces find themselves underequipped and unable to contain the spiralling situation.

name: Turn10_Uziren_BludsSabotageWehlen
title: Roads along Oldeburg and Gumren Blocked
description:
As the Wehzek army continues its march through Bergia, we are receiving reports of increasing casualties due to booby traps and raids by Bludish militants, presumably as an act of revenge for Operation Bear Trap.

The road along Gumren and Oldeburg has also been blocked with a dozen logs, further hindering their progress.

name: Turn10_Uziren_Unrest_BFF
title: Explosion at Uziren Market
description: As unrest in Bergia continues, authorities in Uziren have reported an explosion at the city’s famous market. A homemade bomb appears to have gone off in an area with high foot traffic; the number of casualties is still unknown.

name: Turn10_Uziren_War
title: Uziren War Report
description:
Heavy fighting broke out as Rumburgian soldiers advanced on the defensive positions in Uziren. We have lost 87 soldiers, 2 tanks and 14 warplanes. Rumburg’s attack has been thwarted but the assaults are expected to continue.

Behind the frontline, a special operations team managed to sneak into the enemy territory and demolished the enemy anti-air systems. They were spotted by the enemy and an airstrike struck their position. The situation is expected to deteriorate.

name: Turn10_Valenqir_RFCWins
title: RFC Valenqir Wins Rizian League
description:
Royal FC Valenqir has created an incredible success story, as the club was in third season up until two years ago and has now instantly gone to the top and won the Rizian league. 

For a club that up until two years ago was struggling to fill even half a stadium, the club's meteoric rise is a testament to the successful investments in Rizia’s football industry. The nation now holds its breath to see if the success can continue into next season's Merkopa Cup.

name: Turn10_Valenqir_TheUniteOfHouses
title: House Toras Reaffirms Authority
description:
House Toras has taken decisive action to quell the unrest in Valenqiris, reinforcing the province's government with additional security measures. 

Authorities have announced the swift removal of rebel agitators to ensure continued stability. Duke Hubertus Toras has assured residents that Valenqiris remains steadfast under his leadership. 

Government services and commerce continue without interruption.

name: Turn10_Valenqir_UnderRoyalRule
title: Valenqiris Under Direct Royal Rule
description:
With the Crown assuming full control over Valenqiris, governance of the province now rests solely with King Romus Toras. The reigning nobles in Monqiz have relinquished their royal estates and titles, marking the end of their provincial authority.

Emblematic of the restructuring, the Bull's Horns, the House Toras-owned dining establishment on the Monqiz pier, has been replaced with Crown Appetite, a royal restaurant set to redefine the region’s culinary scene.

name: Turn10_Valgen_ElectionVote_PublicOpinon_Alarming
title: Election Poll Results
description: With the election drawing near, our staff at the Maroon Palace has conducted general election polls all across Sordland. Our election polls show that roughly 16% of Sordish citizens would vote for the USP in the upcoming election.

name: Turn10_Valgsland_ArmyReady
title: Valgsland’s Army Stands Ready
description: The Democratic Republic of Valgsland reaffirms its enduring dedication to the alliance with Sordland. The Valgslandian Armed Forces stand ready to defend alongside our allies against any adversity. Should Sordland call upon Valgsland, our nation will respond without delay.

name: Turn10_Valgsland_InvadeEastRumburg
title: Valgsland Fleet Prepared To Embark
description: Valgsland's admirals have notified us that two different locations across Rumburg's eastern shores have been selected for amphibious landings. Furthermore, their massive fleet is ready to embark from Wilbern and Sigmort at a moment's notice.

name: Turn10_Valgsland_PabelExecuted
title: Chancellor Hegel Angry At Commonor’s Execution
description: Valgish Chancellor Hegel has announced his anger at our Kingdom’s decision to execute Pabel Adria, calling the execution of a ‘working class man’ a symbol of Rizian state repression. The Chancellor invited anyone who was a friend of Pabel to travel to Valgsland, to personally see the difference of how the socialist state treats its workers compared to Rizia.

name: Turn10_Valgsland_UrgeCalm
title: Vaglsland Urges Calm
description: The Democratic Republic of Valgsland reaffirms its dedication to fostering peace in Eastern Merkopa. The rising tensions between Rumburg and Sordland must be prevented from escalating further. We strongly urge all parties to exercise restraint and maintain calm in the region.

name: Turn10_Valgsland_WarAllied
title: Valgsland Army on its Way
description: The Valgslandian officers joined with the Sordish military command to collaborate. Latest reports are indicating that their ships are on their way to blockade Rumburg’s supplies. Marines began their preparations additional military equipment is on its way to support the land troops facing Rumburg.

name: Turn10_Vesord_RumburgNavyInferior
title: Rumburg Ships Sunk and Captured in Markian Sea
description:
Rumburg's navy has been spotted patrolling the Markian Sea. Even Sordland’s improved fleet has not been able to keep their ships entirely at bay. Reports of ships sunk in the naval battles are mounting substantially.

Fortunately, the losses are mainly on Rumburg’s side. With the Markian sea primarily under Sordish control, we have managed to sink or capture hundreds of trade ships carrying supplies for Rumburg, some even disguised as civilian boats.

name: Turn10_Vesord_RumburgNavySuperior
title: Rumburg’s Navy Terrorizing Sordish Trade Ships
description: Rumburg's navy has been spotted patrolling the Markian Sea. Despite our numerous attempts to assert control over the area, we could not contend with their superior submarine fleet. Hundreds of Sordish trade ships bearing war supplies have consequently been sunk before they could enter our ports.

name: Turn10_Wehlen_WithdrawArmy
title: President Smolak Withdraws Army
description:
We have received a communication from President Wiktor Smolak in response to the hostilities faced by the Wehlen army in the Bergia region. In his words: “Wehlen will not fight for a country that despises us.”

He has ordered his army to withdraw from Sordland, and sent an international diplomatic notice to the AN that Wehlen would not be taking part in the war against Rumburg.

name: Turn10_Wehlen_ZilleTransferred
title: Zille Permanently Transferred to Wehlen
description: The documents have been finalized for our official concession of the territory of Zille to the nation of Wehlen. From henceforth, the Kingdom of Rizia will have no claim on the region. Residents of Rizian heritage will have the option to apply for Wehzek citizenship.

name: Turn10_Zille_FedoSquare
title: Smolak Square Renamed
description: The nobles of House Sazon hosted a grand celebration to inaugurate Fedo Square, reinstating the name by which it was known prior to its renaming as Smolak Square under Wehzek rule. There was a parade honoring His Majesty's role in restoring Zille to its original ruling house.

name: Turn10_Zille_WehzekExodus
title: Zille Port Sees Exodus Of Wehzeks
description: In the wake of the Zille referendum, thousands of Wehzeks are hastily leaving the region, often leaving possessions and property behind. A true exodus situation has developed at Zille’s harbor, with Wehlen dispatching additional boats to bring back their people.

name: Turn10_Ziqes_ChemicalCleanup
title: Military Engineers Leading Chemical Cleanup
description: Our army’s military engineer corps is overseeing the cleanup of Ziqes, ensuring that any traces of the nerve gas we unleashed on the city are dealt with and to safeguard the civilian population against possible unintended further exposure.

name: Turn10_Ziqes_Peace
title: Local Authorities Guarantee Protection Of Palesian Culture
description: Following concern by the ethnic Palesian population in Ziqes, a city which is almost 40% Rizian, that the reunification will turn the city into a culturally Rizian one, local authorities have guaranteed that policies will be put into place to ensure the cultural balance of the city is maintained.

name: Turn10_Ziqes_War
title: Ethnic Rizians Take Over Empty Homes
description: The newly installed Ziqes major has started promoting the city inside of Rizia, offering homes left by fled Palesians to Rizian citizens for cheap. This effort to change the ethnic makeup of the city has been strongly criticized by Palesians, as it means many will never be able to return to their homes.

name: Turn11_Monqiz_TheocracyDeclaration
title: Queues At Harbor As People Leave
description: After the King’s speech declaring Rizia a theocracy, secular people, as well as those with non-wruhecist religious beliefs, have been rushing towards Monqiz’s harbor, boarding ships headed to Lespia, Kyrute, Valgsland and Galmland. Those leaving are often of a middle class background and before, as poorer citizens are unable to afford the move abroad.

name: Turn11_Morella_TheocracyDeclaration
title: Morella Worried About Bordering Third Theocracy
description: Morella has denounced our change towards a theocratic system of government. The country is worried about now being surrounded by religious systems of government on both sides, with Rizia following Derdia and the Free Cities in becoming the next theocracy in the region, and is readying itself to welcome an influx of secularist political refugees from Rizia.

name: Turn11_Plavo_TheocracyDeclaration
title: Prayers Held At Plavo To Celebrate Religious Government
description: Thousands of worshippers gathered at the Plavo sanctuary to pray for King Romus together, praising our decision for installing a religious system of governments. More worshippers are expected to descend upon the town in weeks to come, with the local economy preparing for record profits.
